title: MG Patient Service Specialist
description:
SUMMARY:

This position is to function as a member of the administration team and complete assigned daily front end tasks to ensure smooth day to day operations in the BHMG physician practice. The Patient Service Specialist must maintain a professional, positive manner when talking with patients in-person, over the phone, or via email.
Brown University Health employees are expected to successfully role model the organization's values of Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence as these values guide our everyday actions with patients, customers and one another.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Answers calls and routes telephone calls appropriately; takes messages, follows through with each message, ensuring that the appropriate physician/staff member receives the information. Provides routine information to callers and gives only authorized medical advice from a provider.

  • Provides a high level of customer service to all new and existing patients of the practice.

  • Creates patient cases and documents telephone calls and messages into EPIC.

  • Schedules patient appointments and appropriate testing for patients as requested.

  • Registers patients in EMR and verifies information including demographics and obtains accurate health insurance information. Conduct eligibility checks to ensure insurance is reflected accurately.

  • Collects required insurance co-pays from patients including any prior balances.

  • Follows scheduling notes and direct schedules patient visits in other BHMG practices as advised.

  • Performs pre-visit planning daily for all upcoming scheduled appointments to include running insurance eligibility.

  • Responsible to obtain prior authorizations and/or insurance referrals as per practice need.

  • Performs outreach to select patient groups as directed for patient care and quality measurement/guidelines. Schedules specialty appointments/testing as required.

  • Performs work in EMR buckets as directed and per practice need.

  • Responsible to inform manager of administrative supply needs or assists with ordering.

  • Follows up with providers on missing slips and creates claims in EPIC.

  • Responsible to work assigned revenue cycle buckets as directed.

  • Must be able to work independently with little supervision.

  • Adheres to BHMG policies.

  • Always uses discretion to ensure patient confidentiality.

  • Performs other duties as requested.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • One to three years as a medical assistant preferred.

  • Strong customer service excellence expected.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills required.

  • Experience with EMR strongly preferred. (Athena a plus)

  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Word, Excel, and Outlook preferred.


EDUCATION:

High School Diploma or equivalent required. Education from approved medical assistant program or equivalent preferred.

title: Spare Parts Commercialization Specialist
description:
Job Description

Join us to create change and have an impact in homes around the world.

At Electrolux Group, a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

Come, join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute and grow together.

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home!

Where you’ll be:

This position will be based at our Corporate Headquarters located in Charlotte, NC or Fletcher, NC.

About the Role:

The Spare Parts Commercialization Specialist is responsible for leading the successful introduction and commercialization of service and spare parts for new and existing products. This role partners closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, Warehousing, Sales, Marketing, and Supplier teams to ensure spare parts are identified, sourced, priced, documented, and available in support of product launches and lifecycle management activities.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and skilled at coordinating cross-functional activities to ensure launch readiness and a seamless customer support experience. This position also plays a key role in driving process improvements, improving data accuracy, and enhancing service parts operations across the business.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end commercialization and launch activities for service and spare parts associated with new product introductions and product updates

  • Coordinate cross-functional activities to ensure parts are accurately identified, sourced, priced, documented, and available to support product launches

  • Manage key launch milestones, including parts setup, pricing, purchase order placement, warehouse readiness, and documentation release

  • Partner with Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, Warehousing, and Supplier teams to ensure alignment and execution of launch requirements

  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to support customer communications and launch announcements for new spare parts offerings

  • Track and report key performance indicators related to parts readiness, launch execution, and operational performance

  • Analyze data to identify risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement throughout the spare parts commercialization process

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, accuracy, and overall service parts readiness

  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of spare parts information within internal systems and databases

  • Support validation, documentation, and change management activities related to service parts introduction

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

  • 3+ years of experience in product commercialization, new product introduction (NPI), supply chain, service parts planning, product lifecycle management, or aftermarket operations

  • Strong project coordination and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Detail-oriented mindset with the ability to identify issues and drive solutions

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with service parts, aftermarket operations, or spare parts management

  • Experience supporting new product introductions, commercialization activities, or launch management

  • Knowledge of Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and product lifecycle processes

  • Experience with warranty, reliability, quality, or product support functions

  • Supplier management or supplier collaboration experience

  • Experience with Power Query, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or other analytics and reporting tools

Benefits include:

  • Flexible work hours/hybrid work environment (80/20)

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance

  • Competitive holiday and vacation time off program

  • Retirement Savings Plan (401(k)) with relevant company contribution.

  • Discounted products and an EAP upon hire and tuition reimbursement after 12 months of service

Please be advised that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

title: Mgr, Suitability
description:
The Manager, Suitability leads a team within Enterprise Supervision and is accountable for providing strategic leadership, operational oversight, and subject matter expertise related to suitability supervision activities. This role ensures Thrivent’s insurance, securities, and investment advisory sales practices comply with applicable regulatory requirements while supporting business objectives and protecting the organization from regulatory, financial, and reputational risk. The manager partners closely with Supervision Leadership, Compliance, Legal, Field Leadership, and other stakeholders to deliver consistent, high-quality suitability outcomes. The role promotes a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and client-centric decision-making aligned with Thrivent’s purpose, promise, and values.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide leadership and oversight of suitability review activities, ensuring consistent and risk-based application of regulatory and internal requirements.

  • Establish performance expectations, goals, and metrics aligned with Enterprise Supervision objectives and Thrivent strategic priorities.

  • Apply deep knowledge of insurance, securities, and investment advisory regulations to identify, assess, and mitigate regulatory, financial, and reputational risk.

  • Evaluate the effectiveness of suitability controls and recommend enhancements in response to regulatory change, business evolution, or emerging risk.

  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, Field Leadership, and other stakeholders on sales practice issues, special projects, and enterprise initiatives.

  • Lead and coordinate responses to regulatory inquiries, examinations, and audits related to suitability supervision.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on suitability and regulatory risk matters, providing guidance and recommendations to leadership.

  • Recruits, develops, and sustains a high-performing team while promoting a culture of shared accountability, operational excellence, and partnership across the organization.

  • Models Thrivent’s leadership competencies – Model the Way, Rally the Team, and Deliver Outcomes. ​

  • Supports and/or develops an environment in which Thrivent employees and colleagues are focused on continuous improvement, exceptional employee engagement, and an unwavering commitment to our clients. Shapes and/or supports a culture that represents the Thrivent purpose, promise and values, ensuring that Thrivent’s trust and reputation remain strong with its clients. ​

Describe below the audience this role will interact with and level of influence they will have on those roles.

This position interacts with individual contributors, managers, directors, and senior leaders across Thrivent; field leadership and advisors; internal partners including Compliance and Legal; and external vendors or consultants. The Manager, Suitability exercises influence through expert guidance, risk-based recommendations, and leadership on suitability and regulatory matters.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS:

Required:

  • College degree or equivalent work experience required.

  • 10+ years working in the financial services industry and/or compliance related experience required.

  • Extensive knowledge of FINRA/SEC/IA/MSRB rules and regulations and the ability to interpret and apply as required.

  • Extensive level of understanding of financial services industry products (including life and annuities, mutual funds, equity, fixed income, options, margin, advisory, and alternative/complex products), best practices, and trends.

  • Extensive leadership experience, including training, mentoring, and developing teammates.

  • Strong analytical and technical skills, including experience with Excel, CoPilot, AI and financial services tools.

  • Ability to act independently and take accountability for high-impact decisions.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration and influence skills among all organizational levels; strong facilitation and executive communications skills.

  • FINRA Series 4, 7, 24, 52(for individuals that passed the Series 7 after 11/7/2011), 53, 66 or 63/65 required or obtained within 90 days of hire/transfer or a combination thereof as directed by the manager and dependent upon specific job responsibilities.

Pay Transparency


Thrivent’s long-term growth depends on attracting, rewarding, and retaining people who are committed to helping others thrive with purpose. We accomplish this by offering a wide variety of market competitive compensation programs to attract, reward, and retain top talent. The applicable salary or hourly wage range for this full-time role is $114,731.00 - $155,224.00 per year, which factors in various geographic regions. The base pay actually offered will be determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to, location, relevant experience, skills, and knowledge, business needs, market demand, and other factors Thrivent deems important.


Thrivent is unique in our commitment to helping people to be wise with money and live balanced and generous lives. That extends to our benefits.


The following benefits may be offered: various bonuses (including, for example, annual or long-term incentives); medical, dental, and vision insurance; health savings account; flexible spending account; 401k; pension; life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance; disability insurance; supplemental protection insurance; 20 days of Paid Time Off each year; Sick and Safe Time; 10 paid company holidays; Volunteer Time Off; paid parental leave; EAP; well-being benefits, and other employee benefits. title: Clinical Documentation Integrity Specialist
description:
Welcome to Montage Health’s application process!

Job Description:

The Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI) Specialist - Physician Education & DRG Integrity is an in-house, concurrent documentation role responsible for working directly with physicians, advanced practice providers, HIM coding, quality, case management, and revenue cycle leadership to improve the accuracy, completeness, and clinical integrity of inpatient documentation. This position works elbow-to-elbow with physicians and care teams to help identify the working DRG on day one of admission, improve documentation of the principal diagnosis and clinically relevant secondary diagnoses, and reduce the need for retrospective queries through real-time collaboration, education, and trend-based intervention.

The role is designed to support the development of a fully internal inpatient CDI program and aligns with Vizient/Kaufman Hall recommendations related to program structure, workflows, and governance.

Experience Required

  • Minimum 3-5 years of acute care hospital experience in Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI), inpatient coding, Health Information Management (HIM), case management, utilization management, quality improvement, or related clinical operations.
  • Minimum 3 years of concurrent inpatient CDI experience performing documentation reviews, provider education, and compliant documentation clarification activities.
  • Minimum 3 years of inpatient coding experience with demonstrated knowledge of ICD-10-CM/PCS coding, MS-DRG assignment, principal diagnosis selection, CC/MCC capture, and coding compliance requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating directly with physicians, advanced practice providers, coding professionals, and interdisciplinary teams.
  • Strong working knowledge of:
  • MS-DRG reimbursement methodology
  • ICD-10-CM/PCS coding principles
  • Principal and secondary diagnosis assignment
  • Severity of Illness (SOI) and Risk of Mortality (ROM)
  • Clinical indicators and clinical validation
  • Query compliance standards
  • Documentation requirements impacting quality, reimbursement, denials, and regulatory reporting

Preferred

  • Physician-facing CDI or Physician Documentation Liaison experience.
  • Experience providing physician education related to clinical documentation, coding, quality metrics, and DRG optimization.
  • Experience with CDI analytics, reporting, and performance improvement initiatives.
  • Experience supporting CDI program implementation, insourcing, or optimization efforts.
  • Experience utilizing Epic, CDI technology platforms, and coding workflow tools.

Education, Licensure & Certifications

Required:

  • California RN license for candidates qualifying through the RN pathway.
    • RN Licensure Clarification: This position performs CDI/HIM functions and does not include direct patient care or the practice of nursing. Candidates qualifying through the RN pathway may hold an active, unrestricted RN license from any U.S. state.

  • CCS or CCS-P

Preferred:

  • CCDS (Certified Clinical Documentation Specialist) or CDIP (Certified Documentation Improvement Practitioner)
  • Candidates processing both CDI and Coding credentials
  • Additional AHIMA, ACDIS, or HFMA certifications relevant to CDI, coding, compliance, quality, or healthcare revenue cycle

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Strong background in both inpatient coding and clinical documentation integrity.
  • Able to translate coding, quality, clinical, and reimbursement concepts into meaningful physician education.
  • Trusted physician partner capable of improving documentation quality while maintaining compliance and clinical integrity.

Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Scribe
description:
At OrthoVirginia, you’re part of a team dedicated to delivering expert orthopedic and therapy care across the state. As Virginia’s largest provider of musculoskeletal care, we offer full-time and part-time opportunities in a collaborative, team-oriented environment.

With more than 159 physicians in over 35 locations—including Lynchburg, Northern Virginia, Richmond, Southwest Virginia, and Hampton Roads—OrthoVirginia is a leader in orthopedic surgery, non-surgical care, and physical, hand, and occupational therapy. Our nationally recognized specialists treat a full range of musculoskeletal injuries and conditions, helping patients of all ages move, heal, and thrive.

Join us and become part of a trusted network committed to excellence in orthopedic care.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Accurately document patient encounters within the electronic medical record (EMR) in real time.

description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/29/2026

Meet the Team

The CX Pricing Operations (CXPO) team acts as the backbone for services pricing across the entire CX portfolio, ensuring our financial strategies align with market realities. We bridge the gap between product management and finance, translating complex business goals into actionable pricing strategies and SKU mappings. Our team thrives on precision and collaboration, working across functional boundaries to maintain the health and integrity of our global pricing data. Joining us means being at the center of Cisco’s monetization strategy, where your work directly impacts how we deliver value to our customers and partners worldwide.

Your Impact

As a CXPO Pricing Business Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in maintaining the accuracy and efficiency of our global services pricing lifecycle. You will execute complex price changes and service mappings, ensuring all systems are synchronized and aligned with our strategic goals. You will perform regular data integrity audits to identify and resolve discrepancies, safeguarding the financial health of our service offerings. You will partner with cross-functional stakeholders to navigate dynamic business requirements, transforming complex data into actionable insights that support informed, strategic decision-making. Additionally, you will support competitive benchmarking projects to inform our broader pricing strategy. By developing and refining repeatable processes, you will directly contribute to the operational excellence and scalability of our pricing team.

Minimum Qualifications

We value demonstrated skills and practical experience. To be considered for this role, you must meet the following requirements:

  • 2–4 years of practical experience in business operations and data analysis.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in SQL for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g., pivot tables, lookup formulas, logical functions, data validation).
  • Proven experience managing large, complex datasets with a high degree of accuracy.
  • Demonstrated ability to proactively identify operational obstacles and follow through on tasks to deliver reliable outcomes.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage in constructive debate to resolve challenges.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in translating complex business problems into structured project plans.
  • Proven ability to synthesize data-backed insights into recommendations for senior stakeholders.
  • Experience in process re-engineering or building repeatable playbooks to drive operational scalability.
  • Experience with Cisco internal pricing and quoting tools (e.g., CCW) or comparable enterprise-level pricing/quoting platforms.
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools for advanced data analysis, predictive modeling, and generating actionable business insights.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Senior Scientist (Discovery Bioscience)
description:
Senior Scientist (Discovery Biology)

Salary: £41,700 - £51,300

Department: Therapeutic Innovation, R&I
Reports to: Principal Scientist
Location: Babraham Research Campus, Cambridge (Lab Based – Low Flex)
Contract type: Permanent position
Hours: Full time, 35 hours per week

Closing date: Sunday 20th September

Interview process: 2 stage interview process, initial screening call via MS Teams followed by on-site competency-based interview with presentation.

Interview Dates: First stage between 1st – 7th October; Second stage between 14th – 16th October

At Cancer Research UK, we exist to beat cancer.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Scientist to join us at Cancer Research Horizons (CRH) in Cambridge, for a permanent position. As a Senior Scientist in Bioscience, you will play a key role in defining and supporting critical path drug discovery biology for both small and large molecule therapeutics.

The successful candidate will join our Discovery Biology team within our Bioscience department and apply their extensive technical expertise and knowledge to biomarker discovery, evaluating biological and disease mechanisms of action, as well as experimentally interrogating clinical positioning hypotheses.

This is therefore a laboratory focused role that requires a deep scientific understanding of cancer biology, strong laboratory technical skills, and hands-on experience of drug discovery. As part of the Discovery Biology team within Bioscience, you will work closely with the Target Validation and Translational Biology teams to collaboratively address key biology across our portfolio of projects. Every role at CRH is united by a single mission: beating cancer sooner. We carry out work that matters - impacting patients, families, and the future of science.

About Cancer Research Horizons

As the world’s biggest medical research charity, we’ve helped bring eleven new cancer drugs to market. However, there is still an urgent need to bring more effective treatments to patients faster.

We have recently developed a new approach to driving therapeutic innovation through the creation of Cancer Research Horizons (CRH). We have brought together Cancer Research UK’s established drug discovery teams under one organisation and leadership team, combining our unique pipeline of cancer biology expertise and access to CRUK’s world-class academic network, cutting edge technology platforms and clinical expertise to 1) Bring new treatments to patients faster and 2) Tackle the biggest challenges in discovering cancer drugs by seeking out more radical ideas and embracing risk in our bid to achieve success.

Based at sites in Cambridge, the CRUK Scotland Institute in Glasgow, and Newcastle University, you’ll be joining over 200 staff from both industrial and academic backgrounds, all dedicated to bringing forward the day we cure cancer and making real life impact.

What will you be doing?

  • Design, perform and interpret gene perturbation studies using tool therapeutics (compounds or antibodies), gene knockdown and gene editing approaches, as well as rescue studies with over-expression systems in cancer cell lines and immune-relevant co-culture models.
  • Conduct and interpret phenotypic analysis in cancer cells including cell proliferation, apoptosis, and colony formation assays, including use of Incucyte analysis.
  • Design and execute mechanistic studies to elucidate drug-target engagement and downstream effects on biological pathways.
  • Identify and validate pharmacodynamic (PD) biomarkers to support preclinical-to-clinical translation using platforms including:
    • Western blot / capillary electrophoresis (e.g., Simple Western)
    • RT qPCR and RNA based signatures
    • Immunofluorescence for pathway activation (experience of high content imaging is desirable)
    • ELISA/MSD immunoassays
    • Flow Cytometry
  • Review and critically appraise oncology, relevant informatic databases, and related literature, as well as unpublished research to identify and explore novel clinical positioning opportunities and biomarkers.

What are we looking for?

  • PhD (or equivalent) in Cancer Biology, Cell Biology, Molecular Biology, or a related discipline with industry experience. Candidates with a BSc or MSc (or equivalent) will also be considered if they demonstrate substantial and relevant industry experience.
  • Deep scientific understanding of:
    • Key oncology areas such as tumour signalling and metabolic pathways, genetics/ epigenetics of cancer associated gene expression, or interactions of the tumour micro-environment.
    • Mechanisms of drug action and drug resistance.
    • Pharmacology concepts.
  • Strong experimental design, technical expertise, and scientific problem-solving skills.
  • Proven track record developing and applying PD biomarkers, mechanism of action, or clinical positioning studies to support delivery of drug discovery programmes.
    • Experience in proteomics (including sample preparation, data review and interpretation) and/or contributing to the advancement of later-stage research programmes towards clinical development and positioning would be a bonus.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey complex data clearly.
  • Within this predominantly lab-based position can work autonomously and adapt to new challenges within a fast-paced setting.

Our organisation values guide all that we do.

Bold: Act with ambition, courage and determination

Credible: Act with rigour and professionalism

Human: Act to have a positive impact on people

Together: Act inclusively and collaboratively

We’re looking for people who can believe in and embody these organisation values and can use them to drive forward progress against our mission to beat cancer.

If you’re interested in applying and excited about working with us but are unsure if you have the right skills and experience, we’d still love to hear from you.

What will I gain?

We create a working environment that supports your wellbeing and provide a generous benefits package, a wide range of career and personal development opportunities and high-quality tools. Our policies and processes enable you to improve your work-life balance, take positive steps in your career and achieve your personal wellbeing goals.

You can explore our benefits by visiting our careers web page.

How do I apply?

We operate an anonymised shortlisting process in our commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion. CVs are required for all applications; but we won’t be able to view them until we invite you for an interview. Instead, we ask you to complete the work history section of the online application form for us to be able to assess you fairly and objectively.

For more information on this career opportunity please visit our website or contact us at recruitment@cancer.org.uk.

For more updates on our work and careers, follow us on: Linked In, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

Our vision is to create a charity where everyone feels like they belong, benefits from and participates in, the work we do. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and cultures, in particular those from ethnic minority backgrounds who are currently under-represented.

We want to see every candidate performing at their best throughout the job application process, interview process and whilst at work. We therefore ask you to inform us of any concerns you have or any adjustments you might need to enable this to happen. Please contact recruitment@cancer.org.uk or 020 3469 8400 as soon as possible.

Unfortunately, we are unable to recruit anyone below the age of 18, so that we can protect young people from health & safety and safeguarding risks.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Meet the Team

The Splunk Metadata Catalog (MDC) team is part of the core Splunk Platform organization. We are building a high-scale Knowledge Graph that empowers Splunk users to discover data assets effortlessly, map complex relationships, and trace data lineage across diverse ecosystems.

You will join a fast-paced, high-impact team pioneering foundational technology central to the Cisco Data Fabric strategy. As a Staff Engineer, you will shape architectural decisions and build systems that scale across enterprise-grade data platforms.

Your Impact

As a Staff Software Engineer on the team, you will:

  • Drive Architecture & Design: Lead the technical design, architecture, and implementation of complex, highly scalable features and microservices within the Metadata Catalog and Knowledge Graph platform.

  • Build Scalable Distributed Systems: Design, build, and optimize robust, low-latency, and high-throughput services that handle large-scale graph relationships and data lineage queries.

  • Raise the Engineering Bar: Champion engineering best practices, design reviews, code quality, and a robust Developer Owned Quality mindset across the team.

  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Guide, mentor, and coach mid-level and early-career engineers, fostering technical growth and operational rigor.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, Architects, SREs, and peer engineering teams across Cisco Data Fabric to deliver unified solutions.

  • Operational Excellence: Own services in production, establishing observability standards, SLOs/SLAs, performance benchmarks, and participating in on-call rotations and post-incident reviews.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor's in computer science / engineering + 8 years of related experience, or Masters + 6 years of related experience, or PhD + 3 years of related experience

  • Distributed Systems & Cloud: Proven track record of designing, building, and deploying enterprise-grade distributed systems and cloud-native microservices in production (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Core Programming: Advanced proficiency with strong debugging and system-level programming skills in an object-oriented or systems language (e.g., Go, Java, or C++).

  • Containers & Orchestration: Strong hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • CI/CD & DevOps: Deep experience with modern CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and infrastructure-as-code practices in an Agile environment.

  • Engineering Fundamentals: Strong mastery of data structures, algorithms, concurrency, system design, and database principles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Graph Technologies: Direct experience working with graph databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune, Apache AGE, ArangoDB) or query languages/frameworks (Cypher, Gremlin, GraphQL, RDF/SPARQL).

  • Metadata & Lineage Systems: Background building metadata catalogs, data governance tools, schema registries, or data lineage platforms.

  • Big Data & Streaming: Familiarity with high-throughput streaming and data processing systems (e.g., Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, Apache Spark).

  • Observability & Reliability: Experience establishing observability metrics, tracing (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus), and resilience patterns for mission-critical cloud services.

  • Communication & Influence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Network Threat Hunter
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing...

The Network Threat Hunting role is crucial for maintaining the security of Verizon's network. Their primary objective is to proactively identify threats within Verizon's network. Professionals in this role combine their deep knowledge of security and networking with an understanding of the current threat landscape and various attack methodologies. By providing actionable intelligence to network and security teams, they aim to predict, mitigate, prevent, or respond to active and potential threats that could negatively impact Verizon's network operations.

  • Staying up-to-date on emerging global threat activity and trends from both state and non-state actors and the threats they pose to the telecommunications infrastructure.

  • Leading the analysis of network traffic and events, anomalous patterns with a focus on threats missed by automated security tools, or are unknown and unprecedented, and presenting actionable insights in artifacts to stakeholder organizations.

  • Creating and evolving network threat hunting techniques through analyzing current and past incidents and breaches using internal and external data sources and intelligence.

  • Conducting time-sensitive analysis during cyber investigations, including active network threat hunting and malware analysis.

  • Proactively identifying potential network threat vectors and vulnerabilities through advanced threat research and analyzing log data, malicious code, packet captures, behavioral analytics and other artifacts to detect active and potential threats.

  • Creating hypotheses and predictions of possible network threats and vulnerabilities, and working with other partner teams to validate.

  • Cultivating and maintaining strong working relationships with Verizon's network threat intelligence partners and conveying substantive findings from threat hunting findings.

  • Creating and maintaining documentation on threat hunting findings, processes and hand offs.

  • Providing recommendations on tools, capabilities or datasets that may support the network threat hunting goals.

  • Identifying gaps in network logging capabilities and developing strategies to address them.

  • Identifying and proposing automated alerts for new and previously unknown network threats.

  • Developing expertise on Verizon’s network threat landscape using internal data, threat trends, and operational metrics, and clearly communicating this landscape to stakeholders.

  • Serving as an expert on network threat hunting methodology and providing peer reviews and mentoring to other team members.

  • Ensuring the organization meets established metrics, including administrative, auditory, and KPIs.

What we’re looking for...

We're looking for a threat hunter with strong critical thinking and analytical skills, comprehensive knowledge of Verizon’s network and security mechanisms, and a current understanding of the evolving threat landscape. This individual will be responsible for deriving insights from extensive network data to identify threats potentially overlooked by automated systems. The threat hunter will leverage historical events, logs, and data enrichment within a collaborative environment to connect disparate information, think creatively and generate actionable artifacts for stakeholder teams. These efforts will be crucial in proactively safeguarding Verizon’s network and customers from current and future threats. The successful candidate will demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning, contributing to the evolution of threat hunting methodologies within the broader threat intelligence organization, and supporting partner stakeholder organizations.

You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience.

  • Four or more years of relevant work experience.

  • Four more years of experience in designing, testing or operating networks with switching and routing experience (including OSI model, protocols, BGP data and Netflow).

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • Four or more years of experience in cyber related fields including but not limited to cyber security, information technology, SIEM security tools, cyber security investigations Network Security, Computer Security, Intelligence Analysis, Information Assurance, Incident Response, Intrusion Detection, Malware Analysis, Information Security Management, Penetration Testing, Vulnerability Management, Red team, Blue Team, Purple Team.

  • Master’s Degree or certifications in Computer Science,Telecommunications Engineering, Cyber Security, Systems Engineering or related disciplines.

  • A proven track record in managing complex processes, driving results, and adapting to change.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Software programming and scripting experience.

  • Data Science methodologies applied to network data to enable advanced threat detection.

  • Ability to thrive in a high-intensity, production-driven, and dynamic environment.

  • Experience with data analytics, AI or Machine learning methodologies.

  • Experience in the Diamond Model of Intrusion Analysis, Lockheed Martin Cyber Kill Chain & MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Experience in Cybersecurity, Networks,

  • At least two years of experience with incident response, security operations, malware analysis, or threat hunting

  • At least three years of experience with application of data science concepts and techniques to enable advanced threat detection

  • Working knowledge of tools such as Splunk and Elastic Search, Grafana, Netscout

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

If you believe this job posting is missing information required by the Virginia wage or salary range transparency law, please report it via vz.tatc@verizon.com.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits and Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $101,000.00 - $194,000.00.

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
We continually strive to help our workforce achieve their professional and personal goals, engaging them in challenging and inspiring projects.

Position Overview:

The Senior Systems Engineer is a specialist within EOS Space Systems (EOS SS) and is responsible for applying knowledge to the development of products and designs that support the product development and product goals of EOS SS.

Senior Systems Engineers exercise technical knowledge within or across specialist disciplines and the ability to work under general direction to apply strategic alignment. Adherence to governance and standards and interacting with people in cross functional teams to achieve business outcomes with the appropriate levels of integrity, safety, and ethics of these designs is critical to the role.

Primary Duties:

Specific Functions & Tasks

  • Conduct the Systems Engineering review process for the whole product development lifecycle.
  • Support the configuration control of systems for program milestone reviews.
  • Develop verification and validation plans and ensure capture of analysis and test results allowing sign-off of requirements.
  • Support change through the full Systems Engineering lifecycle including requirements gathering, design, development, integration, verification, deployment and sustainment, as well as supporting the ongoing development of the Support System.
  • Development of Systems Engineering documentation and artefacts.
  • Assist with the development of verification and validation plans.
  • Assist with providing suggestions and recommendations for hardware and software specifications, through supporting activities such as: functional analysis, timeline analysis, trade studies, requirements allocation and interface definition studies.
  • Assist with the implementation of concept demonstration, prototype and production systems in collaboration with all engineering disciplines. Enable the use of rigorous system development methods to ensure safe, secure, and reliable systems.
  • Ensure requirements, design traceability and configuration management are enabled according to relevant standards.
  • Engage the Project Management Group regarding Senior Systems Engineering, project management, documentation and quality activities.
  • Adhere to and ensure understanding and compliance with company procedures to achieve a safe and secure work environment.

Strategy and Architecture

  • Develop environment that fosters seamless capture of EOS SS’ IP as well as, develop strategies for capturing and assessment of legacy IP data.
  • Apply strategy for emerging, new, and current technologies, products, services within Space Systems and provide support for the innovation and delivery practices required to assure the implementation of this strategy.
  • Assess and apply engineering methods and tools in specific domains, Space System knowledge, and engineering best practice to maintain competitive advantage, explore EOS SS technologies and recommend how to minimise exposure and risk.
  • Communicate, advocate and influence stakeholders through effective negotiation and communication while fostering an environment of innovation, learning and continuous improvement within and outside the organisation.

Development and implementation of Engineering

  • Undertake cohesive best practice designs and analysis and develop efficient work practices to support product development activities and business outcomes.
  • Understand and apply the routine use of rigorous development and problem-solving methods to apply safe, secure, and reliable solutions to engineering problems.
  • Work collaboratively with engineers across functional teams to solve complex problems as a team and ensure all requirements are identified, captured, and analysed such that the design/product can be developed that satisfies the safety, quality, policy, legislative and design authority requirements.
  • Undertake clear and pragmatic tests, evaluation and verification activities on integrated system designs and prototypes (including formal check points) to verify and provide recommendations for sign-off of all design requirements to the lead engineer and Design Authorities based on relevant legislative requirements, standards, and contracts.
  • Prepare and review all documentation at the team levels that is required to support designs and provide tailored advice and recommendations to teams and decision makers.

Relationship and engagement

  • Actively listen, share knowledge and experience, provide guidance and mentorship, and work collaboratively to support teams across engineering and other relevant internal and external customers to deliver engineering and business outcomes.
  • Work with Production Engineers and Technicians to apply and ensure the best design solutions are delivered to solve production problems and obtain business outcomes under the broad direction of the Chief Engineer.
  • Interact with EOS Executive, Project Managers, and Project Engineers to ensure design solutions are delivered on time and on budget and meet other project management requirements.
  • Communicate insights and provide strong engineering judgement for progress and the advancement of sound engineering solutions.

Delivery and operation

  • Interpret the design and execution of user acceptance testing and other verification activities to provide recommendations to the VP Engineering and other Design Authorities.
  • Support production and review manufacturing and supplier requirements to meet specified timeframes, engineering standards, and business outcomes.

People and skills

  • Work and interacts with people in cross functional multidisciplinary teams to solve routine engineering problems and solutions.

Key Attributes:

  • Ethical Leader.
  • Influencer.
  • Deep Technical knowledge.
  • Problem solver.
  • Engineering judgement.
  • Details oriented.
  • Works Collaboratively.
  • Insightful.
  • Communicates well.
  • Inventive.
  • Solution orientated.
  • Team builder
  • Uses experience for sound judgements.

Experience:

  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in a similar role.
  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision.
  • Experience in effective use of engineering processes, methods, tools and infrastructure.
  • A collaborative mindset, with excellent communication skills and a passion and aptitude for problem solving.
  • An ability to apply engineering practices with experience across the engineering lifecycle through concept development, design, integration, test, sustainment and delivery.
  • Experience with multi-disciplinary teams in a structured product development or project engineering environment is desirable.
  • Experience in Space sector is desirable.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in engineering (any specialty, excluding civil).
  • Post Graduate qualifications in Senior Systems Engineering are desirable.

title: Seasonal Casual (Caringbah)
description:
Join us and experience Bunnings from the other side of the counter!

What’s in it for you when you’re part of our team:

  • Team discount at Bunnings and other Wesfarmers brands including Kmart, Target and Officeworks to name a few

  • Free standard OnePass membership

  • Access to over 100+ exclusive team member benefits across health, shopping, travel and stay, wealth, work and leave

About the role:

Our team members are the face of Bunnings, always ready to give it a red-hot go! They provide friendly and helpful service to everyone who walks through our doors, ensuring every experience counts. When customers visit us, they are greeted by passionate team members eager to offer tools and advice to turn any D.I.Y. dream into a reality. Whether it's finding the right product or sharing expert tips, our team is here to help every step of the way.

We are looking for seasonal casual team members to join us on fixed-term contracts joining us in September 2026 through to end of January 2027 - a great chance to jump in and be part of the action! As the weather warms up and our stores get busier, you’ll play a key role in helping customers bring their D.I.Y. projects to life while being part of a fun, fast-paced team. From first hello to final solution, our team is there every step of the way.

We provide an adult pay rate for 18 years of age and above at $35.08 per hour for this role.

What's involved:

  • Provide our customers with the best experience across the store
  • Manage stock efficiently while keeping the workspace clean and tidy
  • Serve customers with a smile at our checkout registers
  • Join a team that is supportive, inclusive, makes a difference in the community, and has fun doing it

Who we're looking for

We're looking for team members who are passionate about helping others and eager to learn and give it a go. Whether you have a green thumb, are into D.I.Y., looking for your first retail role, or even considering a career change, we would love to hear from you!

You'll need:

  • A genuine passion for customer experience with energy and enthusiasm
  • To be able to approach, connect and confidently interact with customers
  • An enthusiasm for learning about products and services and the readiness to lend a hand across different areas of the store.
  • To act with integrity, be safe and do your best
  • The availability to work flexible hours (including late nights, early mornings and weekends) from September 2026 – January 2027

When you’re ready to give this opportunity a Red Hot Go, all you’ll need to do is:

  • Submit an application and complete an online chat interview (20 minutes)

  • If successful, next step includes an online video interview (15 minutes)

  • If you’re a match, we’ll invite you to an onsite meet and greet with our leaders (20 minutes)

You’ll be part of a workplace where you’ll feel like you belong.


We love the diversity across our teams, brought together in an inclusive culture guided by our values. We welcome applications from individuals of all ages, cultural backgrounds, abilities, sexual orientations, and gender identities. We strongly encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples to apply and join us in shaping a workplace that celebrates First Nations voices, perspectives, and contributions. Please note, you must be age 15 or over to apply for a role at Bunnings.

We’re all about fairness at Bunnings, and our team’s here to support you every step of the way. If you need any adjustments, just let us know - we’re here to help. If you’ve got the experience, skills, and drive to grow - but don’t quite nail every part of the job description - we still want to hear from you. For support, contact us at jobs@bunnings.com.au.

Bunnings reserves the right to close job advertisements at any time, so we encourage you to apply early. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, as we have a dedicated internal Talent Acquisition team managing all hiring processes.

About Us

Bunnings is the leading retailer of home improvement and lifestyle products in Australia and New Zealand. We're proud to support project builders, commercial tradespeople and the housing industry through our network of stores, trade centres, frame and truss sites and online.

At Bunnings, our purpose is simple: we’re here to inspire people to have a red hot go! Whether that's backing our team to grow, supporting customers to take on new projects, or helping communities make a real difference. By joining our passionate and diverse team, you will be part of a culture that encourages you to roll up your sleeves and build something great together. If you’re ready to have a go, apply today.

Please note if you are offered a role with us, background checks may be required. This can include police, employment, medical and qualification checks. If a police check search returns a criminal record, Bunnings will assess whether the record impacts your ability to perform the key requirements of the role.

title: Associated Scientist - Contrato Temporal
description:
Resumen del Puesto

Te unirás a un equipo multidisciplinar de referencia mundial en la búsqueda de nuevas soluciones terapeúticas para enfermedades infecciosas de alta incidencia que afectan a las poblaciones más vulnerables. Colaborarás en estudios de laboratorio, procesarás y analizarás muestras biológicas, que apoyarán las decisiones de los diferentes proyectos. Trabajarás estrechamente con compañeros del ámbito de la biología, farmacología y bioseguridad. Valoramos habilidades prácticas en el laboratorio, manejo de los datos y una actitud colaborativa. Este puesto ofrece impacto visible, aprendizaje, crecimiento y la oportunidad de contribuir a nuestra misión de unir ciencia, tecnología y talento para adelantarnos juntos a tratar y combatir las enfermedades.

Responsabilidades

Este puesto te dará la oportunidad de realizar tareas que serán clave para avanzar en tu carrera profesional. Dentro de estas responsabilidades se incluyen algunas de las siguientes:

  • Realizar tanto estudios de laboratorio como in vivo utilizando protocolos establecidos y controles adecuados, así como colaborar en la planificación de los mismos.
  • Llevar a cabo las técnicas de los ensayos relacionados con los proyectos que se estén desarrollando, y preparar y procesar las muestras biológicas que deriven de ellos.
  • Registrar datos experimentales y resultados de manera clara para garantizar su integridad y reproducibilidad.
  • Manejo y mantenimiento de equipos de laboratorio y de instalaciones animales, asegurar la disponibilidad de los suministros mediante su registro actualizado y garantizar las practicas de trabajo seguras mediante su fomento y apoyo.
  • Contribuir al desarrollo de protocolos, optimización de métodos y resolución de problemas.
  • Realizar cualquiera de las actividades relacionadas con su formación y puesto de trabajo.

¿Por qué tú? Modelo de trabajo

Este puesto está basado en nuestras instalaciones en España y es presencial. La naturaleza práctica del trabajo significa que no son adecuados los modelos de trabajo híbridos o remotos.

Requisitos Básicos

Estamos buscando profesionales con las siguientes habilidades y calificaciones requeridas para ayudarnos a alcanzar nuestros objetivos:

  • Ciclo formativo de grado medio o superior de la rama sanitaria o relacionado con las ciencias de la vida.
  • Experiencia práctica en trabajo in vivo con roedores y de laboratorio de al menos 3 años
  • Formación acreditada en vigor para el trabajo experimental con animales de laboratorio. Funciones A, B y C.
  • Experiencia trabajando en entornos de laboratorio BSL2 o BSL3 y en el manejo de equipos de este tipo de instalaciones de bioseguridad.
  • Gran capacidad de atención a los detalles y capacidad para mantener registros precisos en laboratorio.
  • Compromiso con la seguridad en el laboratorio, el bienestar animal y la integridad de los datos.
  • Experiencia en desarrollar el trabajo dentro de unos protocolos de calidad.
  • Flexibilidad para trabajar en equipo y gestionar cambios.

Se valorará

Si tienes las siguientes características, será un plus:

  • Habilidades de comunicación en inglés.
  • Familiaridad con el desarrollo, optimización y resolución de problemas de ensayos.
  • Experiencia trabajando en equipos multidisciplinarios y funcionales cruzados.
  • Habilidades básicas de registro de datos utilizando herramientas como Excel o similares.

Lo que valoramos

Buscamos personas que comuniquen con claridad, trabajen de forma colaborativa y resuelvan problemas con juicio práctico. Valoramos el rigor científico, la curiosidad y la disposición para aprender. Contarás con apoyo para desarrollar tus habilidades y construir una carrera significativa.


Skills

Biotechnology, Cell Biology, Data Quality, Following Instructions, Interpersonal Communication, Lab Maintenance, Life Science, Molecular Biology, Proper Documentation, Scientific Presentations, Scientific Research, Scientific WritingSpanish Salary Range / Rango salarial en España: EUR 27,675 to EUR 46,125The annual gross base salary range for new hires in this position is listed above for each applicable location. These ranges take into account a number of factors including the candidate’s skills, experience, education level and the market rate for the role. title: Physicist and All Source Analyst - Sr
description:
Join the Nalley Consulting team as a Physicist and All Source Analyst.

Position: Physicist and All Source Analyst
LCAT: Senior
Location: Charlottesville, VA or Reston, VA

Required Clearance and polygraph: TS/SCI and CI poly required. Candidates with current CI poly conducted within the past 7 years strongly prioritized.

Required experience and education: Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience with intelligence, or 12+ years of experience with intelligence in lieu of a degree.

Description

  • Support defense analytical requirements with enhanced scientific research, capability or limitation analysis, reverse engineering analysis or characterizations, and facility and vulnerability assessments.
  • Support applied and interdisciplinary fields of physics such as astrophysics, biophysics, directed energy weapons, and geophysics.
  • Conduct independent research, technical writing, modeling, and oversight or advising of allied engineering disciplines on fiber optics, acoustics, semiconductors, lasers, weapons development, and testing, and identify the characteristics of hard and deeply buried targets.

Qualifications

  • Experience conducting all-source analytic production on nuclear programs, including production facilities, stockpiles, logistics, systems employment, security, and vulnerabilities of facilities and stockpiles
  • Experience with all-source analysis production, including analytic tradecraft, ICD 203 and 206, and DIA writing style
  • Knowledge of applying and querying SIGINT, GEOINT, OSINT, and HUMINT data sets and databases
  • Knowledge of nuclear weapons programs, including nuclear weapons effects, nuclear fuel cycle, and nuclear infrastructure
  • Ability to independently develop high-quality tailored deliverables, including actionable leads, ICD-compliant written products, network charts, and formal or informal briefings
  • Ability to adjust to changing mission requirements and deliver products within a short time frame
  • Ability to collaborate with other mission partners on production and take lead briefing at unique events
  • Active TS/SCI clearance; willingness to take a polygraph exam
  • Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience with intelligence, or 12+ years of experience with intelligence in lieu of a degree

Other qualifications:

  • Experience countering missiles and delivery systems, advanced weapons, and CBRNE
  • Experience with data analytics and visualization
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • Bachelor’s degree in Nuclear Engineering, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or Chemical Engineering.

ABOUT NALLEY CONSULTING

Nalley Consulting is a Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business working with prime partners to staff Department of Defense and Intelligence Community positions. Created by a U.S. Navy intelligence veteran, Nalley Consulting has grown to include multiple IDIQ vehicles in several states.

Nalley Consulting fringe benefits include:

  • Excellent medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • PTO
  • 11 paid federal holidays
  • Tuition assistance

  • Paid parental leave for birth or adoption
  • 401k matching up to 5 percent of the base salary
  • Flex time
  • Company-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

description:

This position reports to:

Support Services Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will have the opportunity to provide project administrative services at the business level. Each day, you will perform project administrative activities. You will also showcase your expertise by providing backup support to the team in case of workload.

The work model for the role is: onsite/hybrid


This role is contributing to the ABB Australia Process Industries Division, base in Brisbane.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Coordinate project delivery activities to ensure projects are completed on time, within scope, and in line with contractual requirements.

  • Manage procurement, resource coordination, and supplier engagement to support efficient project execution.

  • Monitor project performance, budgets, risks, and schedules, providing accurate reporting and recommending corrective actions where required.

  • Maintain project financials, invoicing, SAP updates, and documentation, ensuring accurate records and successful project closure.


Qualifications for the role

  • You are in highly skilled in Contract Management and SAP and you enjoy working within a team

  • 10 years of experience in Project Administration

  • Highly adept in Financial Analysis, Cost Control, Contract Management, Risk Mitigation, Cash Flow Management, SAP ERP (PS, SD, CS), Microsoft Office, Stakeholder Communication, Budget Planning, Report Analysis, ABB BOL.

  • You are passionate about your role and innovative in making changes to improve processes

  • Degree or Have a demonstrated track record in Business Administration and Finance


More about us

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain expertise coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Operations Maintenance Coordinator - PZ
description:
Excited to grow your career?

We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply!

Our people make all the difference in our success.

Compensation Grade

The Operations Maintenance Coordinator – PZ is responsible for managing and coordinating maintenance activities and operational interfaces within an assigned unit or area. This includes day-to-day maintenance, emergent issues, and planned and unplanned outages. The role ensures that maintenance processes—identification, planning, scheduling, and execution—are effectively implemented and aligned with operational priorities.

The position plays a key role in delivering safe, compliant, and reliable operations by supporting high asset availability and continuous improvement in maintenance execution.

Accountability 1: Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE)

  • Comply with and actively promote the INEOS Life Saving Rules, the INEOS 20 Principles of Process and Behavioral Safety, and all site SHE requirements.
  • Ensure all maintenance activities are planned and executed in compliance with site environmental compliance requirements (reporting, LDAR repair timing, etc.).
  • Manages asset compliance with process safety and personnel safety inspections and testing completed by asset maintenance resources (interlock instrument calibrations, turbine overspeeds, relief valve testing, etc.).
  • Be a safety leader through visible leadership in the field, including safety observation conversations, audits, and near miss reporting.
  • Adhere to the SHE incident management system established for the site including participation in reporting, incident investigations, sharing of lessons learned, corrective action tracking and personnel training.
  • Knowledgeable of the specific process and maintenance execution hazards within the unit to be able to plan work and communicate those hazards to execution forces.
  • Verifies clear understanding of work scope, carefully reviews the type of work and potential safety or process reliability hazards.
  • Takes appropriate action to initiate proper safety reviews (e.g., temporary job plan, confined space, hot work, etc.) when reviewing the work scope.

Accountability 2: Maintenance Planning, Scheduling & Execution

  • Coordinate the full maintenance workflow including identification, prioritization, planning, scheduling, and execution of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities.
  • Lead daily and weekly planning and scheduling meetings to align maintenance execution with operational priorities and resource availability.
  • Ensure maintenance work scopes are clearly defined, technically sound, and aligned with best practices and manufacturer recommendations.
  • Drive schedule compliance by coordinating resources, removing execution barriers, and monitoring progress against plan.
  • Ensure all maintenance procedures are followed and work is executed safely, efficiently, and to quality standards.
  • Coordinate execution of maintenance activities during routine operations as well as planned shutdowns and unplanned outages.
  • Support development of job plans and work packages to enable efficient execution by maintenance teams.

Accountability 3: Operational Coordination & Interface Management

  • Serve as the primary interface between operations, maintenance, engineering, and contractors to ensure clear alignment on maintenance priorities and execution plans.
  • Maintain continuous communication with Operations to ensure equipment preparation, isolation, and handover processes are completed in accordance with schedule.
  • Coordinate small-scale maintenance and project activities within the unit, ensuring alignment with production requirements.
  • Interface with Asset Support, Engineering, and Planning functions to scope, schedule, and execute more complex maintenance activities.
  • Communicate schedule changes, constraints, and priority shifts to all relevant stakeholders in a timely manner.
  • Coordinate with SHE teams to ensure safety and environmental considerations are integrated into maintenance plans.
  • Monitor unit conditions and daily logs to proactively identify emerging maintenance needs and adjust priorities accordingly.

Accountability 4: Work Management & Prioritization

  • Manage work orders within SAP from initiation through execution and completion, ensuring data accuracy and proper documentation.
  • Evaluate and prioritize competing maintenance requests based on safety, reliability, and production impact.
  • Create and manage work notifications for maintenance activities not generated through routine processes.
  • Allocate resources effectively across maintenance activities, balancing planned work, backlog reduction, and emergent issues.
  • Monitor and manage maintenance backlog to ensure timely execution of critical work and alignment with site targets.
  • Ensure execution teams clearly understand work priorities, scope, and expectations for both scheduled and break-in work.
  • Continuously review and optimize maintenance workflow processes to improve efficiency and execution discipline.
  • Acts as a field representative and point of contact for outside vendors working in the asset. This includes performing field safety orientations and regular field visits while the work is being performed.
  • Monitor Daily Logbook and communicate with Asset Manager / Process / Reliability Engineers at beginning of day to determine current maintenance needs.

Accountability 5: Asset Reliability & Continuous Improvement

  • Support mechanical integrity and asset care programs by ensuring inspection, testing, and maintenance activities are completed on time.
  • Coordinate preventive and predictive maintenance activities (e.g., lubrication, vibration monitoring, calibrations) to sustain equipment reliability.
  • Troubleshoot equipment failures and underperformance to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
  • Partner with engineering and reliability teams to improve maintenance strategies and eliminate recurring issues.
  • Contribute to development and execution of outage and turnaround (TAR) plans, including scope definition, scheduling, and execution support.
  • Identify opportunities to improve maintenance effectiveness, reduce downtime, and extend asset life.
  • Ensure adherence to asset care standards and continuous improvement initiatives across maintenance processes.
  • Supports asset integrity management systems:
  • Scheduling and planning of Preventative Maintenance (PMs)
  • Review PM plans to ensure proper scope in accordance with manufacturer’s recommendations and best engineering/maintenance practices
  • Monitor status of mechanical integrity programs for the asset and coordinate work notifications as required to support these programs and ensure completion prior to due date. This may include but is not limited to:
  • Relief device testing and inspections
  • Pressure vessel and tank inspections
  • Completion of mechanical integrity inspection recommendations
  • Safety and environmental instrument calibration and testing
  • Routine preventative and predictive maintenance tasks (e.g., lubrication, vibration, filter changes, etc.).
  • Turbine over-speed testing and verification
  • Leak Detection and Repair (LDAR) compliance
  • Railroad track inspections
  • Dock hose regulatory testing

Accountability 6: Cost Control & Performance Management

  • Support delivery of maintenance activities within budget constraints while ensuring safety and reliability are not compromised.
  • Coordinate with Procurement to source materials, parts, and contractor services in a cost-effective and timely manner.
  • Evaluate maintenance spend and identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency and execution effectiveness.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including schedule compliance, PM completion, backlog levels, and reliability performance.
  • Provide input into maintenance budgets, outage planning costs, and forecast adjustments as needed.
  • Ensure maintenance work is executed in a manner that balances cost, quality, and long-term equipment reliability.
  • Drive continuous improvement in maintenance cost performance in collaboration with site leadership.

Required profile:

  • Level of Education & Knowledge:
  • 8+ years of maintenance or operations related experience in a petrochemical manufacturing facility.
  • 18 Years of Age with a High School diploma or GED; technical or related education preferred.
  • Must possess or obtain a Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC) card prior to first day of employment.
  • Possess a current, valid license to operate a motor vehicle in the United States.

Experience & Technical Skills:

  • Experience in maintenance, operations, or industrial coordination roles
  • Experience with planning, scheduling, or work management processes
  • Knowledge of plant maintenance and equipment reliability
  • Experience working in cross-functional operational environments
  • Proficiency with SAP/CMMS and Microsoft Office tools

Competencies & Behavioral Skills

  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills
  • Ability to manage multiple competing demands in a dynamic environment
  • Problem-solving and decision-making capability
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management
  • Continuous improvement mindset
  • Ability to work collaboratively across teams

description:
Surveying New Graduate | Bettendorf, IA
100% Employee-Owned | Big-firm resources, local-team relationships, ONE IMEG culture

This posting is for Summer 2027 New Graduate opportunities.

IMEG is hiring a Surveying New Graduate in Bettendorf, Iowa to support land surveying work under the leadership of a Survey Coordinator or Land Surveyor. This entry-level role offers hands-on surveying, analysis, and project execution experience, with mentorship, training, and opportunities to grow your expertise from day one. In this role, you will support field and office survey workflows, including calculations, CAD and survey-software reductions, data management, and quality control for transportation, municipal, and bridge projects. You will work closely with clients and coworkers while building your judgment through documented practices, systems, and reviewed examples.

Location: Bettendorf, IA
