title: Senior Software Engineer, Control Plane (Go) - Hypershield
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/15/2026

Note: This is a remote U.S. based role, requiring work within the Pacific Time Zone.

Meet the Team

Join Cisco’s Cisco Hypershield team, where we are building the next generation of distributed security infrastructure for modern networking environments. Within Hypershield, the Smart Switch team develops foundational security capabilities that extend across multiple Cisco platforms, including switching, routing, and firewall systems.

This team is responsible for core control plane software that enables policy configuration, deployment workflows, logging, visibility, and feature orchestration across a shared security architecture used by products spanning Cisco systems networking portfolios, including Nexus, Catalyst, and emerging smart switch platforms.

The work here is highly foundational: features built by this team influence security behavior across multiple Cisco networking products and future infrastructure platforms.

Your Impact

In this role, you will design and develop control plane software for security features used in smart switching platforms and distributed firewall systems. You will contribute to core feature development from design through implementation, with a focus on APIs, policy orchestration, and secure service integration.

You will work closely with engineers across control plane, data plane, and platform teams to deliver scalable capabilities that support deployment, observability, and policy enforcement across distributed environments.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop control plane features for network security products using Go in Linux-based environments

  • Build and maintain APIs and cloud-based configuration services that translate network and security policy into configurations consumed by distributed networking infrastructure.

  • Develop business logic for network configuration and orchestration, working with networking concepts such as VLANs, VRFs, VXLAN, network topology, and TCP/IP-based communication.

  • Build software that manages and distributes configuration across networking devices and systems, with an understanding of how control-plane decisions interact with the underlying data plane.

  • Work with network configuration models and interfaces, including YANG or similar standards used to configure and manage network infrastructure.

  • Integrate third-party components and internal services into Cisco security platforms

  • Collaborate with data plane and platform engineering teams to deliver end-to-end feature functionality

  • Contribute to architecture discussions, feature design, and technical execution for new security capabilities

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with peers across a geographically distributed team, with regular overlap during Pacific Time (PST/ PDT) business hours.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree + 8 years of related software engineering experience, or Master's + 6 years of related experience, or PhD + 3 years of related experience.

  • 5+ years of development experience in languages such as Go, or C++

  • Experience developing software in Linux environments

  • Experience developing software for networking or network infrastructure products, with knowledge of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, VLANs, VRFs, VXLAN, network topology, routing/switching, or control plane/data plane interactions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional Go development experience

  • Experience designing and developing APIs using REST, gRPC, or Protocol Buffers

  • Experience working with Kubernetes-based applications, including developing, deploying, debugging, or operating software running in Kubernetes environments

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes concepts such as CRDs, Kubernetes APIs, controllers, RBAC, or secrets management

  • Experience developing software for switching, routing, firewall, or other network infrastructure platforms.

  • Familiarity with network configuration and management technologies such as YANG, NETCONF, telemetry, or similar infrastructure configuration frameworks.

  • Experience working effectively in a remote or distributed team environment

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

description:
Description

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

    • Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive manual test plans, test cases, and test suites for Web, API, and Thick Client applications.
    • Perform functional, regression, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure product quality and coverage.
    • Collaborate with development and product teams on acceptance criteria, edge cases, and defect validation.
    • Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps and expected versus actual results.
  • Driving Automation Excellence
    • Help drive adoption of automation frameworks and best practices across teams within the Business Unit.
    • Collaborate with teams to identify automation opportunities and improve overall test strategy.
    • Advocate for shift-left testing and early quality validation.
  • Performance & Quality Engineering
    • Design and execute performance and load testing using JMeter.
    • Analyse system performance, identify bottlenecks, and provide recommendations for optimization.
  • Mentorship & Collaboration
    • Mentor and support QA engineers in test automation concepts, tools, scripting, and best practices — serving as a senior technical resource and go-to person for automation guidance within the team.
    • Provide technical guidance without direct people management responsibilities.
    • Collaborate with product, development, and DevOps teams to ensure alignment on quality goals.
    • Contribute to knowledge sharing and capability building within the team.
  • Operational Excellence
    • Participate in planning, estimation, and requirement analysis.
    • Define and contribute to quality metrics and automation effectiveness tracking.
    • Troubleshoot complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS (KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES)

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent.
  • 8-12 years of experience in software testing with balanced expertise across both manual and automation testing.
  • Proven experience as a senior individual contributor in quality engineering/automation.
  • Solid hands-on experience in test automation with the ability to guide and mentor team members on automation practices, tool usage, and best practices — framework design expertise is not required.
  • Hands-on expertise in:
    • Web automation (Selenium / Playwright / Cypress)
    • API automation (REST Assured / Postman / similar tools)

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Experience in performance testing using JMeter.
  • Proficiency in Java, Python, JS or similar programming languages.
  • Experience with JIRA or similar test/defect management tools.
  • Solid understanding of databases (Oracle, SQL Server) and SQL queries.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to debug and troubleshoot complex systems.
  • Experience working in enterprise-scale applications/products.
  • Ability to influence without authority and drive adoption of best practices.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across teams.
  • Passion for mentoring team members, particularly in test automation, and enabling others to grow their technical skills.
  • Ability to balance hands-on execution with broader quality impact.

Shell is looking for a Sr. Credit Analyst – Power & Gas to join its team in Houston, TX.

This role acts as a primary Americas contact within the Global T&S Credit Risk organization for credit risk management & support for Trading and Supply, supporting SENA (Shell Energy North America). Primary responsibility will be supporting the Americas Region focusing on credit risk management and trade credit approval, contract negotiations (NAESB, EEI, ISDA, PPA), portfolio credit management, customer interfacing and stakeholder management. This includes negotiating credit language with customers and execution of credit contractual terms. Direct interaction with various T&S functions where quick decisions must be executed while balancing risk/reward in decision making to optimize value and control/manage credit risk.

Accountabilities:

  • Act as a primary day-to-day interface within the Global T&S Credit Risk organization with commercial, financial, legal, contract admin and treasury stakeholders with respect to the execution of the deals/trades in carrying out credit risk strategies for assigned portfolio within the Americas Trading Portfolio

  • Ensure all commercial activities entered into by the above portfolio remain in compliance with the approved global Shell T&S Credit Policy

Develop and implement new ideas and best practices from collaboration and implement where needed

The position partners closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, manufacturing operations, test operations, product operations, quality, finance and IT, to analyze, document and improve business processes supporting product development and outsourced manufacturing.

  • Support data audits, compliance checks and reporting requirements for internal and external partners.
  • Partner with product operations and engineering to support product releases, change orders and lifecycle status updates.
  • Support the development and deployment of AI solutions for the Product Operations domain

  • 8+ years of experience in a Product Operations, NPI management, Change Control, ECOs, and EOL process improvement, ideally in a semiconductor environment.

  • Familiarity with setting up bills of material and New Product Introduction process in Oracle
  • Degree in Supply Chain, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Information Systems, Mechanical Engineering or related field.
  • Familiarity with MS Office Products, including Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint and SharePoint. Experience with Oracle Fusion Product Management modules.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of data governance, compliance and audit practices.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Water Efficiency Coordinator
description:
Closing Date

2026-09-27

Job Title: Water Efficiency Coordinator

Location: We offer hybrid working between office and home. The primary office location for this role is Durrington.

Contract Type: Permanent

Hours: 37 hours per week, Monday - Friday

Salary: Up to circa £30,000 per annum

Job Overview

We are pleased to be recruiting for a Water Efficiency Coordinator to join Southern Water and support the delivery of our Water Efficiency Programme, including our new in-house Water Efficiency Audit service.

This is a varied role at the heart of the programme, providing comprehensive administrative, coordination and operational support across a range of water efficiency activities. You will help keep customer audits, engagement campaigns, events and wider demand reduction initiatives organised, on track and delivering a positive experience for customers and colleagues.

Working closely with Water Efficiency Field Engineers, Customer Engagement Officers, the Water Efficiency Field Performance Manager and the wider team, you will coordinate appointments and field activity, maintain accurate programme and customer records, monitor work queues and support performance reporting. You will also assist with customer communications, meeting administration, purchase orders, invoices, budget tracking and the coordination of materials where required.

The role supports the whole Water Efficiency Programme, giving you exposure to a broad mix of projects and stakeholders. You will play an important part in establishing efficient ways of working for a growing team, identifying opportunities to improve processes and helping the programme achieve its customer, operational and regulatory objectives.

About You

We are looking for an enthusiastic and highly organised coordinator who enjoys variety and takes pride in keeping people, information and activities running smoothly. You may come from an administration, coordination, customer service or business support background, and you will be confident managing several priorities while maintaining strong attention to detail.

You will have excellent communication and customer service skills, with the confidence to act as a first point of contact for customer enquiries, liaise with colleagues across the business and follow actions through to completion. You will be comfortable working independently as well as collaboratively and will bring a positive, proactive approach to supporting a new and developing service.

Strong Microsoft Office skills are essential, particularly across Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams and PowerPoint, alongside experience of maintaining accurate records and managing data. Experience using CRM, scheduling, workforce management or database systems would be advantageous, as would experience producing reports or supporting field-based and customer-facing teams.

Previous experience in the water industry, utilities, environmental services or sustainability programmes would be useful, but it is not essential. We are most interested in your organisational ability, customer focus, willingness to learn and enthusiasm for contributing ideas that improve service delivery.

Why Southern Water?

Southern Water is at the forefront of transforming Britain's water industry, investing significantly to enhance resilience, sustainability and service excellence. With £7.8bn planned investment for 2025-30, this is an opportunity to join a business committed to delivering a generational shift in the way water services are managed.

You will be joining at an exciting stage as we develop our in-house Water Efficiency Audit service and expand the work we do to help customers reduce their water use. This role offers the chance to support a broad programme, build valuable experience and make a practical contribution to water resource resilience and the environment.

At Southern Water, diversity and inclusion are core values. We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and are committed to fostering an environment where every individual is empowered to succeed.

If you are an organised, customer-focused all-rounder who would enjoy bringing energy and structure to a growing programme, we would love to hear from you. Apply now to join our Water Efficiency Team.

description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

As a Financial Solutions Advisor Stage I (FSA I), your journey begins obtaining your Securities Industry licenses, where you receive dedicated and personalized classes for your Securities Industry Essentials [SIE], Series 7 and Series 66 Exams. Once you obtain your licenses, you will be taught the foundational skills needed to be an advisor – from acquiring, building and managing client relationships to considering a client’s complex financial picture and guiding them with advice and solutions to help them live their best financial lives, all while humanizing financial interactions. Once you have reached your key milestones, you will begin working in a financial center where you will help to deliver Bank of America’s core banking, investment solutions and approach to client care. We will equip you with everything you need as you move through the stages of development.

Once you have demonstrated success as a licensed Financial Solutions Advisor Stage I, you will typically progress into the next role, Financial Solutions Advisor Stage II, where you will continue to practice the skills you’ve learned by growing and deepening relationships within a portfolio of clients. As a successful Financial Solutions Advisor Stage II, you will have the opportunity to advance in many roles within Bank of America and Merrill. The Academy will support you along the way with dedicated programs, tools, and resources throughout your career journey.

This position is subject to SAFE Act registration requirements. Pursuant to the SAFE Act requirements, all employees engaged in residential loan mortgage originations must register with the federal registry system and remain in good standing. Since your position requires SAFE Act registration, you will be required to register and to submit to the required SAFE Act background check and registration process. Failure to obtain and/or maintain SAFE Act registration may result in your immediate termination.

We’ll help you

• Collaborate with core banking and investment partners. Connect clients to the solutions we provide through Bank of America and Merrill to meet virtually all their financial needs.

title: Field Performance Technician
description:
At Sunrun, we’re on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we’re building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. To do it, we’re designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. It’s why we’ve become the #1 home solar and battery company in America. We’re unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle – from sale through installation and beyond – so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.

Who We Are

We’re on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs. Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses.


About Sunrun

Since 2007, Sunrun has grown into America's #1 home solar and battery company. We got here by putting our people’s safety and growth first. That’s why we created the Power+ program: to invest in your skills. We train you to work across different teams—from qualifying homes for solar, to installing, to inspecting the final work, and servicing existing systems. This versatility helps limit reduced hours and enhances job security in an industry affected by seasons. It also means you can solve customer problems in one visit, keeping you safely off the road and moving your career forward.

Overview
The Field Performance Technicians are responsible for the management, scheduling, and completion of all service and warranty related work. The Field Service / Field Performance Technician must have the ability to work both independently and as a member of the Performance O&M team. This position will interact closely with the customers, Branch Manager, the Senior Electrical Foreman, Construction Supervisor and the centralized scheduling Field Service Team.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Troubleshoot and resolve solar electric warranty and service issues that arise with: modules, inverters, monitoring and balance of system components

  • Investigate and mitigate any reported roof leaks including thorough documentation: complete roof leak checklist, photos and written observations

  • Communicate with the Construction Supervisor, and Engineering Team members to resolve any redline issues

  • Receive, update and complete Field Service Dispatches (FSDs) with Service Dashboard in Salesforce

  • Ensuring the timely communication and completion of service and warranty work with an emphasis on safety, quality, and customer satisfaction

  • Develop and refine processes and gain technical skills related to service work for residential solar photovoltaic systems following department policy to prepare for advanced technical skills as FPT2.


Education And Experience

  • High School diploma is required

  • 1 - 3 years of previous field construction or solar experience required

  • PV design or PV electrical experience is preferred

LICENSE AND CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS (include where appropriate)

  • Must maintain a clean driving record with the ability to pass a driving background check. Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license.

  • Valid state or local Electrical Journeyman certification or license preferred. Depending on state requirements an Electrical Journeyman certification or license may be required​

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

  • Knowledge of the NEC and applicable codes and standards

  • Must be a motivated team player, looking to succeed

  • Proven track record of excellent customer service

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills

  • Strong computer skills

  • Electrical/PV Installation Knowledge: Working knowledge of current NEC codes. Ability to interpret single line drawings and PV systems from roof to meter. Demonstrates knowledge of electrical principles as it pertains to solar interconnection/tie-in and code and how PV systems operate. Understands interconnection activities. Understands basic construction principles.

  • Safety: Adheres to company safety policies and procedures including ability to identify and report safety hazards, and the ability to encourage others to work safely

  • Customer Service: Ability to establish rapport, build relationships and loyalty with external and internal customers and coworkers, and remains tactful when communicating

  • Results Driven: Proven ability to meet deadlines and key metrics. Works independently, as a team player, and drives results in a fast paced, team based environment. Must be willing to assist teammates and build strong relationships to achieve company and department goals

  • Problem Solving: Solid logical decision making and troubleshooting skills with the ability to problem solve in a timely and effective manner. Exercises good judgment. Takes ownership of issues or questions and will escalate problems to the appropriate persons and follow up accordingly with the customer. Knows when to involve supervisors

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Ability to transport materials and equipment to complete assigned job tasks (up to 50 pounds frequently and up to 100 pounds with assistance)

  • Ability to work on rooftops with various angles and surfaces which requires frequent bending, twisting, squatting, climbing, kneeling, crawling, turning, standing, and balance

  • Ability to climb ladders

  • Ability to work in outdoor weather conditions including but not limited to: excessive noise, extreme heat, extreme cold, wet environment, and humidity

  • Ability to frequently utilize hand functions requiring fine motor skills, including but not limited to: fine manipulation, grasping, and pinching

  • Ability to work within the safe range of equipment such as ladders, fall protection harnesses and other personal protective equipment

  • Ability to work and maintain balance on roofs and other areas of height

  • Ability to work in the sun and possibly low light conditions

  • Ability to walk on rafters, roof tiles, and roof shingles without damage

  • Ability to distinguish colors such as red, black, yellow, white, green

  • Ability to work in confined spaces such as attics, basements, and crawl spaces which requires kneeling and crouching

  • Ability to hear verbal commands and warnings

  • Ability to work with chemicals using appropriate protections

.

Independent contractor

title: Merrill Financial Solutions Advisor (Partially Licensed) - Bloomfield Hills Greater Detroit Market
description:
Job Description:

Merrill Wealth Management is a leading provider of comprehensive wealth management and investment products and services for individuals, companies, and institutions. Merrill Wealth Management is one of the largest businesses of its kind in the world specializing in goals-based wealth management, including planning for retirement, education, legacy, and other life goals through investment advice and guidance.

Merrill’s Financial Advisors and Wealth Management Client Associates help clients pursue the life they envision through a personal relationship with their advisory team committed to their needs. We believe trust comes from transparency. Our trusted advisory teams are equipped with access to the investment insights of Merrill coupled with the banking convenience of Bank of America.

Merrill is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Merrill, we empower you to bring your whole self to work. We value the unique perspectives in our thoughts, business, and within our employees and clients. Our Wealth Management team represents an array of different skills and experiences that individuals bring from all backgrounds and careers; whether gained through military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.

Role Specifics:

This job is responsible for working with high-net worth clients in a Merrill branch with annual revenues of $100k-$5mm, identifying needs, developing relationships, reviewing investment goals, and preparing investment recommendations that align with the goals of both existing and prospective clients. Key responsibilities include leveraging technology to achieve business growth goals, profiling activities to determine a client's investor profile and financial resource objectives, building a sustainable book of business and providing opportunities for advisors to pursue a career within the bank.

This position is subject to SAFE Act registration requirements. Pursuant to the SAFE Act requirements, all employees engaged in residential loan mortgage originations must register with the federal registry system and remain in good standing. Since this position requires SAFE Act registration, employees are required to register and to submit to the required SAFE Act background check and registration process. Failure to obtain and/or maintain SAFE Act registration may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination.

Responsibilities:

  • Learns how to provide tailored and personalized advice to clients through reviews and presentations, including partnering with management to assess financial goals and recommending investment advisory strategies
  • Understands client solutions that are best suited for their financial needs, such as core Banking, and Investment and Life Priority™ solutions
  • Shadows Financial Advisor teams to build their network by sharing relevant market developments and discussing new products (as appropriate) in an effort to promote portfolio growth
  • Leverages available resources and technologies to optimize the customer experience and serve the bank's customers with operational excellence and accuracy
  • Participates in on-going training focused on how to develop a book of business to meet and exceed pre-defined financial targets and determine how to progress to the next phase as an advisor
  • Builds relationships with internal service providers based on client needs and asset thresholds
  • Manages risk proactively in every aspect of business, product, and service transaction leveraging available tools

The Advisor Development Program (ADP) Journey:

During this stage of your journey, the Merrill Financial Solutions Advisor (MFSA) will help provide you with the necessary training and guidance through a defined path to become a successful and independent financial advisor. You will have the opportunity to work with both affluent and high net worth clients, identifying needs, developing relationships, reviewing investment goals, and preparing investment recommendations that align with the goals of both existing and prospective clients. In this role you will develop the relationship management skills necessary to operate in an Elite Growth Practice (EGP). From marketing yourself to managing your own practice, we’ll prepare you with everything you need as you develop within your role. The MFSA role provides experienced advisors the opportunity to pursue a career within Merrill Wealth Management. Once you have honed your skills and demonstrated success as a MFSA, you typically will progress into the next stage of training. Located in a Merrill branch.

We’ll help you:

  • Get training and one-on-one mentorship from managers who are invested in your success. You’ll enroll in our Academy to develop as an advisor; the potential for growth is yours!
  • Build connections to grow your network and business.
  • Starting at a Merrill branch, you’ll interact with Merrill financial advisors, institutional retirement participants and higher net worth clients.
  • Deliver advice through client reviews/presentations with confidence, including reviews of financial goals, and recommend investment advisory strategies to help clients achieve their financial goals.
  • Learn about the full suite of financial solutions.
  • Connect clients to solutions that are in their best interest, such as core Banking, Investment & Life Priority™ solutions, through Bank of America and Merrill to meet their financial needs.

As a Merrill FSA, you can look forward to:

  • A strong referral network from across the business to increase opportunities for affluent and high net worth client acquisition and provide access to partners who are specialists in their field.
  • Marketing strategies to reach wider audiences with greater appeal.
  • Ongoing professional development to deepen your skills and optimize your practice as the industry evolves.
  • Potential opportunities for professional growth.
  • Leadership opportunities, including leading client and conference seminars

We’re a culture that:

  • Is committed to building a workplace where every employee is welcomed and given the support and resources to build and advance their careers.
  • Along with taking care of our clients, we want to be a great place for people to work, and we strive to create an environment where all employees have the opportunity to achieve their goals.
  • Believes diversity makes us stronger so we can reflect, connect to and meet the diverse needs of our clients around the world.
  • Provides continuous training and developmental opportunities to help employees achieve their goals, whatever their background or experience.
  • Is committed to advancing our tools, technology and ways of working. We always put our clients first to meet their evolving needs.
  • Believes in responsible growth and is dedicated to supporting communities around the world by connecting them to the lending, investing and giving they need to remain vibrant and vital.

Required Qualifications:

  • Currently holds FINRA Securities Industry Essentials (SIE)
  • 4+ years of progressive professional and/or military experience
  • 2+ years of experience in the investments industry
  • Ability to obtain Series 7 and 66 licenses within allotted program time
  • Is a self-starter who efficiently manages time and capacity
  • Sets and accomplishes goals, achieving whatever one sets their mind to
  • Builds and nurtures strong relationships
  • Collaborates effectively with others to get things done
  • Communicates effectively and confidently and is comfortable engaging all clients
  • Manages goals, navigates complexity, prioritizes tasks and executes in a fast-paced environment
  • Likes to learn, adapts to new information and seeks the right solutions for clients
  • Is thorough and thoughtful in incorporating relevant regulatory due diligence into daily activities and long-term strategies for clients

Desired Qualifications:

  • ​Experience working in the financial service industry and/or a sales environment where goals were met or exceeded
  • Strong computer skills and the ability to multitask in a demanding environment
  • Bachelor's Degree, preferably in business-related field
  • Proven ability to partner and promote lead generation

This role involves close collaboration across product engineering, service engineering, and SRE teams in a high-trust, well-coordinated environment.

If you are looking to excel in a fast-paced environment creating innovative solutions and want to make a significant long-lasting impact, this job is for you.

  • Design, build, and optimize cloud and data infrastructure to ensure the high availability, reliability, and scalability of systems to meet customer needs, while implementing SRE principles such as monitoring, alerting, error budgets, and incident management.

title: Senior Specialist, Network Regulatory & Real Estate
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing...

The Network Regulatory & Real Estate Specialist will manage real estate efforts in support of Verizon's real estate program for the Central Texas submarket. This involves vendor oversight of site acquisition and A&E partners to successfully perform due diligence, negotiating leases or amendments, managing work flow forecasts, obtaining governmental approvals and permits and PO management.

  • Tracking vendor performance, ensuring project trackers are updated, conforming to all leasing, zoning/permitting, environmental, and regulatory compliance policies

  • Working with the Real Estate Specialists, SAR, and law firms, and West Territory to obtain information needed for preparing and routing Deal Memo/Routing Document packages for signature

  • Receiving and uploading real estate agreement documents into NetDocs/FUZE (e.g., environmental, Title, Title Report Review, Deal Memo, Attorney Risk Assessments, Environmental Evaluation Summary, etc.)

  • Routing real estate related documents (e.g., leases, amendments, Right of Way Permits, etc.) received via mail and e-mail to sub-market management for execution

  • Conducting and participating in deployment calls with vendors, third parties and project team

  • Communicating modification project status updates to Network Team, Real Estate Manager, Site Acquisition Vendors, and Law Firms

  • Create, organize, and maintain real estate files

  • Driving project completion and site acquisition

  • Updating site databases (e.g., NetSites, NetDocs, Fuze, FUZEr, etc.) with new site development dates/milestones

  • Requesting location codes, project numbers, and budget strings for new sites and manage budget by way of POs

  • Sharing real estate related documents to other specialists and outside vendors (e.g., legal, site acquisition vendors, etc.)

  • Researching, finding, and providing documentation needed for projects by either looking in online tools and applications or in physical files

  • Providing additional support to other prioritizing projects as needed.

​

What we’re looking for...

This candidate is expected to work as a self-starter to drive their projects and effectively prioritize multiple competing projects in a fast paced environment. Must be able to collaborate with other internal teams to achieve successful outcomes. Must be detail oriented, self-motivated, a fast learner and a team player.

You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelors degree or four or more years of work experience.

  • Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience.

  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel up to approximately 25% of the time.

  • Proven ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks and projects with competing priorities and deadlines

  • Ability to function efficiently and effectively in a fast-paced professional environment

  • Detail-oriented and possess strong communication and organizational skills

  • Ability to efficiently use tools and applications such as MS Office and Google Suite

  • Ability to learn and efficiently use tools and applications such as FUZE SPM, WebEX

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • Project and vendor management experience including: managing project budgets, project timelines, creating reports, administrative assistance

  • Telecommunications real estate and/or property management skills

  • Familiarity with purchase orders/budget and driving financial responsibility preferred

  • Experience working across multiple platforms at a time

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

This is a hybrid role, working part time in office in Irving, TX and part time remotely.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits and Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

title: Software Engineer - Python , Networking Protocols - 4 to 8 years
description:
Meet the Team:

The Cisco Crosswork Network Controller quality engineering team helps ensure that a highly scalable, microservices-based SDN controller delivers reliable automation for IP transport networks. Crosswork Network Controller brings service and device lifecycle management, telemetry-driven insights, workflow automation, and intent-based closed-loop operations into one integrated solution for multivendor environments. Our team owns service provision and monitoring testing, validating customer-relevant workflows, solution integration, scale, resiliency, upgrades, and release readiness across the platform and its applications. We partner with development, product management, customer-facing, and operations teams to identify risk early, automate repeatable validation, and deliver dependable releases.

Your Impact:

  • Plan and execute service provision and monitoring test strategies for Crosswork Network Controller releases, translating customer and solution use cases into comprehensive end-to-end validation.
  • Build and maintain Python-based automation for GUI, REST API, platform, network-device, and service workflows to improve coverage and execution efficiency.
  • Validate integrated solution behavior across installation and upgrades, device onboarding, service provisioning, topology, telemetry, high availability, scale, and failure recovery.
  • Reproduce complex defects, perform root cause analysis, and collaborate with engineering teams to drive timely resolution and prevent regressions.
  • Communicate quality status and release risk through clear test plans, execution results, defect analysis, and continuous improvement of CI/CD quality gates.

Minimum Requirements: (Must Have)

  • Strong Python automation skills with experience designing and maintaining scalable test frameworks, libraries, and scripts for system and end-to-end validation. Hands-on experience testing REST APIs and JSON-based integrations.
  • Strong IP networking fundamentals, including routing protocols, MPLS, Segment Routing, TCP/IP, and L2/L3 VPN services, with the ability to configure network devices, validate control- and data-plane behavior, and troubleshoot multivendor environments.
  • Hands-on quality engineering experience designing and executing functional, integration, regression, upgrade, resiliency, scale, and end-to-end tests for distributed network-management or automation products.
  • Strong Linux/Unix, API, and platform troubleshooting skills, including log analysis, service-health validation, defect isolation, and release verification across clustered or containerized environments.
  • Ability to work in an cross-functional environment, collaborating with developers, product managers, customer-facing teams, and quality engineers to define acceptance criteria, automate workflows, improve coverage, and communicate release risk.

Optional Skills: (Good to have)

  • Experience with Cisco Crosswork, Cisco NSO, SR-PCE, model-driven telemetry, NETCONF/YANG, gNMI, SNMP, or related network-automation technologies is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes or other container platforms, virtualization, CI/CD systems, and test approaches for high availability, performance, scale, and upgrade or migration scenarios.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.


Disclaimer

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

  • be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
  • begin with screening or an interview
  • originate from a Cisco email address, and
  • be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.


If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Direct Ministry - Mid-County STL (Webster Groves)
description:
If you are currently on Young Life staff, please do not apply through this external jobs board. To apply for internal job opportunities, log in to Workday and use the Jobs Hub. Applying externally may delay your application and require you to resubmit internally.

Young Life requires all​ employees to sign a Statement of Faith. We recommend you read this statement before applying​ for any position.

Because of Young Life’s exclusive Christian purposes of evangelism and discipleship as set forth in its Articles of Incorporation and in these Bylaws, and to reflect what has always been and will continue to be the position of Young Life, specifically the Christian belief that each and every employee and volunteer of the corporation should minister as a servant of God with the primary responsibility of proclaiming the gospel of Jesus Christ and, as such, is an integral part of the Christian mission and ministry of the corporation,
Young Life shall only employ individuals or enlist volunteer leaders who: (a) profess a belief in Jesus Christ as their personal Savior and Lord; and (b) subscribe to the statements and policies required of all Young Life staff, including the Young Life Statement of Faith. Therefore, employees and volunteers of Young Life, during working and nonworking hours, shall: (i) be ready, willing and able to fulfill such ministry functions as may be required by the organization; (ii) refrain from conduct and statements that detract from the biblical standards taught and supported by Young Life, and (iii) abide by all policies and practices of Young Life including, without limitation, those related to religious belief or ministry activities.

Mission Staff

Summary:
Mission / AuthorityThrough both training and direct field ministry experience, learn how to lead and participate in effective Young Life ministry.


Ministry Functions:
Spiritual Development — “Following Jesus” includes prayer and spiritual disciplines, fellowship, growth and health and church relationships.
  • Develop a yearly personal growth plan that fosters a vibrant spiritual life including time for solitude, retreat, reflection, prayer and a sincere commitment to understanding God’s Word.

  • Seek and maintain relationships and disciplines, in the context of active participation in a church community.

  • Actively participate in the spiritual life of the Young Life community.

  • Lead teams and individuals in spiritual development.


Leadership Development — “Equipping leaders, committee and staff” includes key volunteer care, recruiting, team building and training, supervision and vision casting.
  • Meet with your volunteer leaders and area leadership on a regular basis.

  • Learn to recruit and train new leaders to build a leadership team that reflects the community.

  • Model excellence in contact work, club, Campaigners and camping to other leaders.

  • Assist in training leaders, team leaders and committee how to work effectively in teams and develop a yearly ministry strategy.

Resource Development — “Fueling the ministry” includes events, major donor care, public relations (branding) and TDS team.
  • Raise financial support as directed and maintain good donor care practices.

  • Communicate ministry updates and progress to personal donor partners.

  • Observe and learn to network and develop strategic relationships with key adults in the community, including: principals, pastors, parents, potential committee members as assigned by the area director.

  • Assist with camp fundraisers.


Direct Ministry — “Proclaiming and modeling” includes contact work, club, Campaigners and camp.
  • Actively engage in all three levels of contact work.

  • Lead a team to plan and conduct a new or existing Young Life club and Campaigners/discipleship ministry with excellence.

  • Lead a team to implement a summer and school-season camping strategy for a ministry.

  • Serve on a summer assignment at a Young Life camp each year.


Ministry Support — “Taking care of business” includes accounting, administration, communication (internal), data management and strategic plan.
  • Adhere to all Young Life policies and procedures and maintain professionalism concerning office hours, dress, conduct and time management.

  • Manage finances with stewardship, accountability and transparency using the mission-wide applications.

  • Maintain accurate information on kids, leaders and donors for area records.

  • Provide clear, prompt, appropriate and professional communication to everyone involved in ministry.

  • Set yearly strategic ministry plan and initiatives to reach every kid; review them on a regular basis.

  • Perform other duties as assigned and congruent with gifts, experience and area needs.



Training:
Missionwide Training
  • None is required.

  • RTD training events such as New Staff Training, Winter Training, Focus Conferences and Young Life University are available on a request basis with approval of the regional director.


Regional Training
  • There is no mission-wide regional-level training curriculum.

  • At the regional director’s prerogative, certain regional training events may be required.


Area Training
  • Actively engage in training provided by area leadership.

  • Individualized training supervised by the area director designed to develop personal spiritual maturity and enhance personal character.

  • Individualized program to learn and gain competency in ministry skills (e.g., The 5 C’s).

  • Become familiar with area strategy and ministry health as assigned by the area director.

  • Introduction to personal fund-raising principles including familiarity with Basic Elements for Part-time staff.




Education:
  • College degree preferred.


Qualifications Required for the Job:
Proven relational skills with both kids and adults.
  • Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality.


Job Specific Working Conditions:


Mid-County STL is looking for a YL veteran to lead and develop their team and ministry to students from Webster Groves HS. The attached job description is for full-time, but this position is for 20 hours per week. Young Life experience required; must live locally; this is not a remote position. Includes evening and weekend work.

title: Solar Technician I or II at Pigsah Ridge
description:
Job Description:

Overview

Deriva Energy, a portfolio company of Brookfield Renewable U.S., who is a nationwide leader in sustainable energy provides wind, solar, resilient backup power, and managed energy services across the U.S., with a total electric capacity of more than 6,000 megawatts of nonregulated renewable energy is seeking a Solar Technician I or II to be based in Pigsah Ridge solar site in Richland, TX.

The Solar Technician is primarily responsible for providing support to multiple Deriva Solar projects on a continual/on-demand basis and to establish O&M support for new site(s) start-up as well as long term operation and maintenance. It is important to note that each site is unique adding to the complexity of this position.

This position will be focused at our Pigsah Ridge Solar Site in Richland, TX.

Responsibilities

Maintenance of Solar Facilities

  • Diagnose and resolve faults on solar as they relate to mechanical or electrical issues

  • Perform pad mounted Transformer switching in accordance with all Lock Out/Tag Out procedures

  • Perform corrective tasks on solar equipment

  • Work as scheduled during the week and on call as required by manager

  • Always maintain a high level of safety awareness

  • Work in an outdoor environment for an extended period of time

  • Operate grounds keeping equipment including but not limited to weed eaters and lawn mowers

Compliance and Administrative Record Maintenance

  • EH&S documentation

  • Complete necessary paperwork (work order, timesheet, tool, and PPE inventory and additional paperwork as necessary.)

Additional Support for Sites

  • Willing to travel and assist other Deriva Energy Sustainable Solution solar facilities when needed

Basic Qualifications

Solar Technician - Level I

  • High school/GED

  • In addition to the High School/GED requirement, the ability to complete Level I job performance measures and training Deriva Energy renewables academy within 1 year

Solar Technician - Level II

  • High school diploma/GED

  • 2 years of related work experience

  • Completed Level I job performance measures and training Deriva Energy renewables academy

Desired Qualifications

  • Associates or Technical degree in Electrical Construction and Maintenance

  • Completion of a Solar training program

  • 1+ years of related work experience

  • Additional years of wind turbine or solar experience

  • Experience with multiple solar supplier technology

  • High voltage and sub-station maintenance experience

  • Familiarity with mechanical and electronic testing equipment

  • Knowledge of heavy equipment for facility maintenance

Working Conditions

  • The position may be located at a specific solar facility or part of a mobile team

  • Position will require fieldwork at a Solar facility as well as office work when necessary

  • Work schedules can vary depending on business need and can include changes in normal shift assignments, overtime, callout, and holiday and weekend work

  • Exposure to the natural elements (i.e. weather, heat/cold, noise, dust, humidity, and wildlife)

Specific Requirements

  • Valid driver’s license

  • Complete initial training in Deriva Renewable Academy (DRA)

Benefits

  • Health Insurance

  • Dental Insurance

  • Vision Insurance

  • 401(k) with matching

  • Employee assistance program

  • Flexible spending account

  • Life insurance

  • Paid time off

  • Parental leave

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

We value the independent thinking, problem solving, leadership, and teamwork that our veterans have developed through their service. We welcome applications from any service and any military occupational specialty.

Deriva Energy is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, family responsibilities, pregnancy, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity, transgender, sex stereotyping, protected veteran or military status, and other categories protected by federal, state or local law.

title: Planerare
description:
Boliden är ett högteknologiskt metallföretag med egna gruvor och smältverk som arbetar långsiktigt med att garantera samhällets tillgång till bas- och ädelmetaller. I ett sekel har vårt arbete varit en del av de värdekedjor som format det moderna samhället. På Boliden vet vi att metallerna vi bryter och tillgängliggör kommer att spela en avgörande roll även framöver - det som spelar roll är hur vi framställer dem. Bli en del av oss och driv förändring för kommande generationer.

Underhållsplanerare, Anrikningsverket i Boliden
Gillar du att skapa struktur, få saker att hända och samarbeta? Som Underhållsplanerare har du en viktig roll i Anrikningsverkets verksamhet där du planerar, samordnar och följer upp underhållsstopp. Låter det intressant? Ansök nu!

Din roll

I rollen planerar du insatser för att upprätthålla en säker och effektiv drift vid Anrikningsverket i Boliden. Du ansvarar för att planera och organisera de underhållsarbeten som ska genomföras genom att se till att rätt tekniska underlag, reservdelar och material finns tillgängliga inför varje uppdrag. Du agerar beställare mot både interna och externa resurser, och i samverkan med arbetsledare, mekaniker och produktion tar du fram tidsplaner för när arbeten ska genomföras. En viktig del av uppdraget är också att arbeta med utveckling och förbättringar av arbetssätt kopplade till planering och förebyggande underhåll.

Ditt team

Du är en del av underhållssektionen på Anrikningsverket. Gruppen består idag av en underhållsingenjör, en beredare/planerare och tre arbetsledare inom mek, förråd och förebyggande underhåll. I din roll som Underhållsplanerare samarbetar du med dina närmaste kollegor, produktionen samt med externa leverantörer och konsulter.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

  • Skapa årsplaner för underhållsstopp
  • Planera och samordna underhållsstopp
  • Bevaka inkorgen för arbetsorder
  • Säkerställa tillgång till reservdelar
  • Följa upp kostnader och resultat
  • Samverka och samordna med interna och externa parter

Ditt bidrag

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen är du strukturerad, kommunikativ och har lätt för att samarbeta. Vi söker dig som har förmågan att skapa dig en helhetsbild, dig som har modet och kan prioritera även under intensiva perioder och som tar ansvar för att hålla ihop planeringen och skapa goda förutsättningar för verksamheten.

Eftersom rollen har många kontaktytor behöver du vara trygg i att samordna människor och aktiviteter. Du har också ett tekniskt intresse, ett lösningsorienterat arbetssätt och en vilja att bidra till utveckling och ständiga förbättringar.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Gymnasieutbildning, inriktning mot teknik/industri eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet.
  • Tidigare erfarenhet från process- eller tillverkningsindustrin.
  • Behärska både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.
  • Goda datorkunskaper.
  • B-körkort.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att arbeta i underhållssystem och digitala planeringsverktyg.

Vi uppmuntrar dig att söka även om du inte uppfyller samtliga kvalifikationer. Vi värdesätter potential, motivation och viljan att utvecklas tillsammans med oss.

Varför arbeta tillsammans med oss

På Boliden tror vi på att främja en arbetsplats där omsorg, mod och ansvar är centralt i allt vi gör. Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats där vi tror på samarbete och där det du bidrar med kommer att ha en direkt inverkan på kommande generationer. Vi är ett företag som består av ansvarsfulla och kreativa människor som alla jobbar mot samma vision; att bli den mest hållbara och respekterade metalleverantören i världen.

Ansök idag för att bli en del av något verkligt meningsfullt!

Hos oss på Boliden är mångfald och inkludering en drivkraft för innovation. Vi vet att olika perspektiv och erfarenheter stärker oss och hjälper oss att ligga i framkant i en viktig och spännande bransch. Därför uppmuntrar vi ansökningar från människor med olika bakgrunder och synsätt. Tillsammans bygger vi en arbetsplats där alla kan känna sig trygga och inspirerade att nå sin fulla potential.

Vill du veta mer om rollen? Anna Vestermark, Underhållschef Anrikningsverket, anna.vestermark@boliden.com, 0910-70 59 47. Frågor om ansökan besvaras av vår Talent Acquisition Partner Charlotte Lindkvist, charlotte.lindkvist@boliden.com. Facklig information får du av Mats Lindblom, SACO, 073-350 04 19, Andreas Mårtensson, Unionen, 070-541 83 93 eller Peter Markström, Ledarna, 0910-77 40 09.

description:

title: Global Team Leader Production Validation, ABB Robotics
description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Production Engineering Manager


Your role and responsibilities

Contribute to ABB Robotics' success with technology, software, product, and system development! As ABB Robotics prepares for its journey together with SoftBank as planned new owners and with a focus on the next generation of intelligent automation and Physical AI, you will play a key role in ensuring our production validation capabilities continue to scale, innovate, and deliver world-class quality. The Production Validation Team develops hardware, software, and data solutions that ensure quality through automated validation testing of every robot produced in our factories worldwide.

The Global Team Lead for Production Validation identifies and implements innovative solutions to relevant challenges while enabling the organization to bring cutting-edge technologies to market faster and more efficiently. In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating and driving validation activities across our sites in Sweden, China, and the USA, ensuring alignment, transparency, and execution of key priorities within the global validation organization. The role provides technical and operational leadership to a team of validation engineers located in Västerås while maintaining a global perspective and stakeholder network.

This is a role for someone who enjoys creating structure in a complex environment, building strong relationships across functions, and driving continuous improvements. You will lead a team of highly skilled specialists while acting as a trusted partner to Production, R&D, Project Management, and Leadership teams. We are looking for a leader who can provide confidence, clear direction, and technical credibility while fostering collaboration across a global organization.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead, coach, and support a team of validation engineers, creating clarity, engagement, and a strong culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Lead and coordinate projects and strategic initiatives impacting Production Validation, including hardware/software implementations, system revisions, certifications, and validation methods, while proactively managing risks and dependencies.
  • Own the sprint planning process for the validation team, establishing priorities, tracking actions and deliverables.
  • Act as the primary interface between the validation team, Production, R&D, project teams, and management, building strong partnerships and ensuring alignment across stakeholders.
  • Drive regular status meetings involving Production Validation stakeholders across our production sites, ensuring effective communication, alignment, and timely resolution of issues.
  • Drive continuous improvement of validation processes, reporting, planning, and governance for both local and global activities, with a focus on increasing efficiency, reducing lead times, and enabling faster, high-quality testing.
  • Support quality assurance with SPC activities, driving process stability and support data-based quality improvements and standardization across global manufacturing operations.
  • Over time, contribute hands-on to validation and testing activities when needed, leveraging your technical expertise to support the team and help solve complex challenges.

Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Several years of experience in Production Validation, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Test & Verification, or a related discipline.
  • Proven experience leading complex technical initiatives in a global and cross-functional environment.
  • Experience with project management, sprint planning, and execution tracking.
  • Experience working with software releases, system revisions, certification processes, and validation of manufacturing or production systems is strong merit.

title: Faculty - Embryology Lab Director
description:
Department:

SOM KC Gynecology & Obstetrics (OBGYN)

-----

Gynecology and Obstetrics

Position Title:

Faculty - Embryology Lab Director

Job Family Group:

Academic

Job Description Summary:

The Clinical ART Director will provide leadership and oversight to the operational, technical and scientific functions of the embryology, andrology and phlebotomy laboratories. The Director will assume responsibility for and ensure compliance with all applicable regulations and institutional standards. As a member of the clinical faculty, the director participates in education and supports the ongoing research and academic mission of the University of Kansas Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology. The Director is expected to work in a highly collaborative manner with all clinical, educational and research partners.

Job Description:

Job Duties

  • Provide overall operational, administrative, technical, and scientific leadership for the ART laboratory and advise Division leadership regarding qualified laboratory personnel.

  • Establish, implement, and oversee laboratory policies, protocols, standards, and procedures in collaboration with the Medical Director and applicable leadership.

  • Oversee daily laboratory operations and perform laboratory procedures and testing as needed to support patient care and operational needs.

  • Ensure laboratory testing and treatment methods are scientifically valid, clinically relevant, and appropriate to patient and program needs.

  • Develop and oversee the laboratory’s quality management and quality assurance programs, including quality control, proficiency testing, quality improvement, corrective actions, and annual program review.

  • Monitor laboratory performance and ensure accurate, timely, and medically reliable results, documentation, and communication of laboratory data.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, accreditation, and institutional requirements, including timely reporting of federally mandated ART data to SART and CDC.

  • Recruit, train, supervise, and evaluate laboratory personnel; ensure staff maintain required competency, licensure, certification, and continuing education. Oversee the training and professional development of embryologists.

  • Provide consultation to physicians and other clinical staff regarding laboratory aspects of patient treatment and management.

  • Oversee selection and evaluation of laboratory equipment, methods, reagents, reference laboratories, and other resources to ensure quality, safety, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness.

  • Ensure laboratory facilities, equipment, environmental conditions, and information and record-management systems meet applicable safety, confidentiality, regulatory, and institutional requirements.

  • Coordinate and participate in regulatory and accreditation inspections and self-assessments; review findings and ensure appropriate corrective actions are implemented and sustained.

title: Financial Reporting Specialist
description:
As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world.

We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!

If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today.

At PGIM, You Can!

What you will do

We are looking for a reliable team player to support our European accounting team. As part of the team, based in Letterkenny, you will be responsible the general accounting on a day-to-day basis (e.g. UK GAAP, IFRS, US GAAP reporting) for a Business Unit (BU) of PGIM Ireland. You will also be responsible for updating, reviewing, and reconciling the general ledger and the review and analysis of the results of the BU. The role holder will ensure that intercompany and third-party invoicing is completed in a timely manner and monitor the collection of receipts.

The role holder will be a key participant in the annual audit process and assist with internal audit related matters for the BU as needed. They will also assist with the timely preparation of board reporting, ensuring that the data is complete, accurate and clearly analysed for the readers of the reports. The role holder will assist with the development of accounting policies, procedures and guidance and will help ensure the overall control framework is maintained.

In the dynamic environment of our corporate group, we offer a secure position with flexible working hours and opportunities for training and development.

What you can expect

  • Preparation of monthly and quarterly financial reporting, liaising with the business and shared services centre colleagues to ensure robust and timely reporting.

  • Participation in annual audit process.

  • Preparation of intercompany and third-party invoicing and monitoring of receipts.

  • Maintenance of control framework, including documentation of processes and controls.

  • Participation in BU forecast process and variance reporting.

  • Participation in projects e.g. to improve processes, reporting and control framework.

What you will bring

  • Degree in a relevant field

  • A professional accounting qualification or part qualified.

  • Experience of reporting under UK GAAP, IFRS and US-GAAP.

  • Experience of implementing and maintaining a control framework, including documentation of controls.

  • Experience of external and internal audits, including participation with internal and external stakeholders, to ensure the timely and successful completion of the audits.

  • Task orientated and able to analyse data and challenge inconsistencies to ensure data is robust and variances are understood and explained.

  • Good communicator, able to explain technical accounting issues clearly both verbally and in writing.

  • Skilled in office technology

*PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

What we offer you

  • Health Insurance: PGIM Ireland partner with Laya and BUPA to provide health insurance schemes that cover eligible employees day to day medical and hospital expenses.

  • Annual Leave : 23 days, increasing with service.

  • Pension Scheme: Members of the scheme can contribute up to 8% of salary per annum and PGIM Ireland matches contributions up to 8% of salary. Members can also make voluntary contributions to the scheme.

  • Annual Bonus Programme & Shop LK Vouchers: Along with an annual bonus employees are rewarded with Shop LK vouchers which are paid tax free.

  • Life Assurance: fully paid by PGIM Ireland, employees are covered from their start date and beneficiaries are provided with a lump sum of four times an employee’s salary.

  • Education Assistance: PGIM Ireland have an Education Assistance Programme that reimburses eligible employees for furthering their education.

About PGIM Global Asset Management

PGIM is the global asset management business of Prudential Financial, Inc. (NYSE: PRU), a leading global investment manager with nearly US$1.44 trillion in assets under management as of June 30th , 2025. With offices in 19 countries, PGIM’s businesses offer a range of investment solutions for retail and institutional investors around the world across a broad range of asset classes, including public fixed income, private fixed income, fundamental equity, quantitative equity, real estate and alternatives.

With a history dating back 150 years, and experience through more than 30 market cycles, PGIM takes a long-term view, not only in our investment philosophy, but also in how we develop our talent. We want to see our employees excel from their first day with the firm and throughout their tenure with PGIM. We will inspire you, support you, and help you reach your greatest personal and professional aspirations. If PGIM sounds like the place for you, join us. For more information about PGIM, visit PGIM.com.

Prudential Financial, Inc. of the United States is not affiliated with Prudential plc. which is headquartered in the United Kingdom.

Meet The Team:

At Cisco, safety and security are at the heart of everything we do. Cisco’s Global Corporate Security team is dedicated to protecting our employees, property, physical assets, and revenue. We ensure our teams and partners operate in a secure environment while maintaining business continuity.

The Global Monitoring Center (GMC) is a component of Cisco’s Global Security Operations Center (GSOC). The GMC functions as a centralized incident triage, escalations, and communications hub, operating 24/7/365 to monitor, evaluate, and respond to potential risks. Using best-in-class technology, the GMC proactively identifies threats that could impact Cisco’s people, assets, or operations and collaborates across teams to minimize disruptions and uphold Cisco’s brand reputation.

As a part of this team, you’ll play a crucial role in delivering quick responses and proactive measures to safeguard Cisco employees and assets worldwide.

Your Impact:

As a Global Monitoring Center Analyst, you’ll be at the forefront of identifying and responding to events that could affect Cisco’s global operations. You’ll analyze data, investigate incidents, and collaborate with partners to ensure a safe and secure environment for all Cisconians.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Monitoring internal systems, external data, and open-source information to identify potential security risks.
  • Performing first-level reviews and triaging incidents to assess their potential impact on employees, assets, or operations.
  • Communicating physical security and safety incidents to partners with urgency and accuracy in accordance with GMC Procedures.
  • Supporting additional tasks, including research, administrative, and investigative efforts, as needed.
  • Generating detailed incident reports and keeping documentation up-to-date with the latest information.
  • Tracking employee travel to high-risk locations and ensuring travel security requirements are met.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience in a Global Security Operations Center or similar environment OR 4+ years of experience in another physical security role.
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Flexibility to work outside regular hours as needed to support major incidents or provide shift coverage.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • A customer-focused attitude with a passion for service excellence.
  • Experience in high-tech environments and an eagerness to learn new tools and processes.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working in a remote, collaborative team environment.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally, including international trips, to support Cisco events or GMC operations on-site.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
