title: PGIM Credit,  Sr Associate, Asset Backed Securities Research
description:
Job Classification:

Investment Management - Investments

A GLOBAL FIRM WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE

As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world.

We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!

If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today. At PGIM, You Can!

What you can expect:

A research position on the Consumer Asset Backed Securities (“ABS”) credit research team within the Securitized Products group of PGIM Credit. The successful candidate will work closely with the ABF and ABS portfolio management teams to help formulate Consumer ABS strategy and help monitor the Consumer ABS portfolio. The successful candidate will be responsible for analyzing transaction collateral and economic conditions, assigning and maintaining internal credit ratings, reviewing transaction structures and documentation packages, communicating with investment banking teams, working closely with portfolio management and other internal colleagues to determine investment suitability and relative attractiveness, conducting surveillance on existing investments, and following industry trends.

What you will do:

  • Contribute to capital deployment strategies by identifying high-impact opportunities across Consumer ABS sectors and issuers, fueling investment idea generation and market positioning.
  • Present and support investment research and relative value trading strategies to the ABS portfolio management team, shaping the risk and positioning of the Consumer ABS book.
  • Engage with an issuer’s executive team to analyze business models, operational strategies, and financial health in the process of developing and maintaining internal credit ratings.
  • Assess issuer performance by integrating bottom-up historical data with top-down macroeconomic trends to inform risk-return expectations and influence security level buy, hold, or pass decisions.
  • Design, enhance, and maintain analytical tools and visualizations to strengthen risk and analytics frameworks, to drive actionable data driven insights.
  • Impact Consumer ABS sector strategies by monitoring emerging consumer borrower performance trends, macroeconomic indicators, and legal and regulatory changes.
  • Track Consumer ABS portfolio positions to evaluate credit risk, rating stability, and cash flow dynamics, while identifying trading opportunities.
  • Advance ESG integration by contributing to proprietary ESG Impact Ratings and documenting ESG engagements.
  • Build and nurture relationships with market participants, including buy-side investors, legal teams, rating agencies, sell-side firms, and trustees—to gain insights on emerging market dynamics.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 4-7 years of relevant experience in fixed income, securitized products, or consumer finance, with meaningful exposure to Consumer ABS or related consumer credit products.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
  • Exposure to consumer loan collateral, securitization structures, cash flow analysis, and key drivers of Consumer ABS performance are required.
  • Proficiency in Excel and some experience working with large datasets is required.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple assignments in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate investment views clearly.
  • Intellectual curiosity and strong interest in Consumer ABS and consumer lending markets.

What will set you apart:

  • Programming and data visualization skills (e.g., Python, Power BI, Tableau) are preferred.
  • Experience with Intex and structured finance modeling are preferred.

PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

PGIM believes in the Power of a Hybrid work arrangement. The Power of Hybrid is both the flexibility of work from home, as well as the networking and career development of in-person work with colleagues through three weekly anchor days.

title: FAI Quality Inspector
description:

We are now building a team in India to work closely with the existing team in Germany, leveraging virtual collaboration techniques and the diversity of our team to achieve our goals of continuous delivery, process improvement, and internalization of technical expertise.

You work closely with colleagues from the business analysis, IT architecture and IT operation departments in both agile and waterfall ways, contributing to the success of the growing domain Home Loan Savings.

  • Gender neutral parental leaves

  • 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)

  • Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members

Your key responsibilities

  • You provide high-quality solutions that meet functional as well as non-functional requirements.

Your skills and experience

  • Expertise and long-term experience in Cobol development, especially on an x86 platform with Micro-Focus in combination with Oracle, SQL, and PL/SQL

  • Very good knowledge of architecture and integration patterns, code conventions and other best practices

  • Experience working on UNIX Shell scripting

  • Basic development knowledge in Oracle including writing basic to complex queries.

  • Very good knowledge of architecture and integration patterns, code conventions and other best practices

  • Experience with Agile/SCRUM environment including agile tooling together with Experience and knowledge of investment business and its operations.

  • Pro-active team player with good communication and English language skills.

How we’ll support you

  • Training and development to help you excel in your career.

About us and our teams

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Shift Leader – Material Handlers
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Internal Logistics Supervisor-2nd Shift

__

Key Responsibilities

Team Supervision & Leadership

Supervise and coordinate material handler team members across the shift.

Assign daily tasks and priorities based on production schedule and material requirements.

Monitor team performance, productivity, and adherence to standard operating procedures.

Conduct regular briefings and huddles to communicate shift objectives and safety updates.

Provide on-the-job training and mentoring to ensure team competency and development.

Address performance issues and escalate concerns to management when necessary.

Foster a positive team environment and promote cooperation among team members.

Kanban & Supermarket Management

Oversee material flow from warehouse to Supermarket (SM) area.

Ensure materials are moved from Supermarket to line-side racks as per production needs.

Monitor and coordinate with the warehouse team for timely material replenishment.

Verify that missing materials are identified and communicated promptly.

Ensure Kanban signals are followed and materials are replenished according to schedule.

Inventory & Material Handling Oversight

Supervise weekly cycle counts to ensure inventory accuracy.

Verify proper handling and organization of materials across the supermarket and line-side areas.

Ensure bin labeling standards are maintained for easy identification.

Oversee the preparation and return of excess or unused materials to the warehouse.

Monitor empty bin management to ensure continuous material flow.

Review and verify material handling documentation and records.

Workplace Organization & Compliance

Lead by example and enforce 5S principles (Sort, Set in Order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain) in the material handling area.

Conduct regular 5S audits and address any deficiencies.

Champion API (Automated Process Improvement) initiatives in the Supermarket and material handling areas.

Ensure all team members adhere to safety protocols and prevent accidents.

Conduct safety briefings and investigate any incidents or near-misses.

Maintain compliance with company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

Quality & Performance Management

Monitor material quality and report any defects or discrepancies.

Ensure accurate and timely reporting of key metrics (material flow, cycle counts, safety incidents).

Collaborate with Production and Warehouse teams to resolve issues and improve processes.

Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for efficiency gains and waste reduction.

Prepare shift reports and communicate issues to the next shift lead and management.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Minimum 3-5 years of experience in material handling, warehouse operations, or production logistics.

Proven supervisory or leadership experience with the ability to manage and develop team members.

Strong understanding of Kanban and supermarket management principles.

Comprehensive knowledge of inventory control and material flow processes.

Solid understanding of 5S principles and lean manufacturing concepts.

Excellent organizational and time management skills.

Strong attention to detail to ensure inventory accuracy and quality standards.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Ability to lift and move materials regularly as required for the role.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Problem-solving ability and proactive approach to identifying and addressing issues.

Proficiency with warehouse management systems (WMS) or material handling software.

Safety-focused mindset with knowledge of OSHA regulations and safety best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Kanban systems and Just-In-Time (JIT) practices in a manufacturing setting.

Forklift, pallet jack, or other material handling equipment certification.

Experience with advanced WMS or ERP systems.

Six Sigma Green Belt or similar process improvement certification.

Experience in automotive, electronics, or industrial manufacturing environments.

Physical Requirements

Ability to lift and carry materials up to 50 lbs regularly, stand for extended periods, and perform repetitive bending, reaching, and moving actions. Ability to work in various weather conditions and potentially noisy environments. Willingness to work shift schedules, including potential overtime as needed for production demands.

Work Environment

This role operates in a warehouse and manufacturing production environment with exposure to machinery, materials, and equipment. The position requires regular movement between warehouse, supermarket, and production line areas. May involve exposure to dust, noise, and other industrial conditions.

title: Analyst, Data - Workday
description:
Venture Global LNG (“Venture Global”) is a long-term, low-cost provider of American-produced liquefied natural gas. The company’s Louisiana-based export projects service the global demand for North American natural gas and support the long-term development of clean and reliable North American energy supplies. Using reliable, proven technology in an innovative plant design configuration, Venture Global’s modular, mid-scale plant design will replace traditional designs as it allows for the same efficiency and operational reliability at significantly lower capital cost.

We are seeking qualified applicants for the position:

Analyst, Data - Workday

Located:

Arlington

Summary

The Workday Data Analyst is responsible for maintaining the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of employee and organizational data within Workday. This position serves as the key resource for ongoing Workday data auditing, validation, reconciliation, reporting, and analytics, helping ensure that HR data is complete, accurate, timely, and aligned with established business and data governance standards. The Data Analyst will conduct recurring and ad hoc audits of Workday data, identify data quality issues and trends, research root causes, coordinate corrections with HRIS and HR stakeholders, and develop reporting and analytical solutions to support data governance and operational decision-making.

General Description Duties & Responsibilities

  • Workday Data Auditing & Data Quality
    • Perform routine and comprehensive audits of employee, organizational, job compensation, supervisory organization, position, and other HR data within Workday.
    • Develop and execute recurring data quality audits to identify missing, inaccurate, inconsistent, outdated, or improperly configured data.
    • Validate Workday data against established business rules, policies, organizational structures.
    • Conduct data reconciliations between Workday and downstream systems.
    • Identify data anomalies, investigate discrepancies, determine root causes, and coordinate appropriate remediation.
    • Maintain detailed documentation of audit findings, corrective actions, trends, and outstanding data issues.
    • Monitor data quality metrics and identify recurring issues that may require process, configuration, training, or governance changes.
    • Assist with the development and maintenance of data quality standards, validation rules, audit procedures, and controls.
    • Support periodic HR data governance activities, including periodic data reviews and clean-up activities as needed.
    • Support data validation associated with Workday releases, enhancements, integrations, organizational changes, and system updates.
    • Analyze Workday data to identify trends, patterns, exceptions, and potential areas of risk.
  • Reporting & Data Analysis
    • Build and maintain Workday reports used for data auditing, validation, and reconciliation.
    • Perform ad hoc analysis of HR data to support audit findings and business inquiries.
    • Assist in developing dashboards and recurring reports to monitor data quality.
    • Translate audit findings into clear summaries for HRIS and HR stakeholders.
    • Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and audit processes.
  • HRIS Operations & Support
    • Provide analytical and technical support to the HRIS team for Workday-related data issues.
    • Collaborate with HRIS administrators, Workday functional leads, integration resources, and other technical team members to troubleshoot data issues.
    • Assist with Workday configuration testing by validating data and expected results.
    • Support testing of Workday business processes, reports, integrations, and system enhancements.
    • Identify opportunities to improve data accuracy through process improvements, automation, or system configuration changes.
    • Maintain documentation or audit procedures, data definitions, and validation rules.
    • Participate in Workday release testing and regression testing, with particular emphasis on data impacts.
    • Support special projects and other HRIS initiatives as assigned

Qualifications

Required experience

  • 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience with Workday.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, human resources, business administration, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience working with Workday HCM data, reporting, and business processes as well as performing data audits, reconciliations, validation, or data quality analysis.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including LOOKUP functions, INDEX/MATCH, IF statements, pivot tables, and data validation.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to spot issues and risks and escalate when appropriate.
  • Ability to prioritize and meet critical deadlines with a sense of urgency.
  • Attention to detail with a strong focus on operational excellence.

Preferred Experience

  • Workday reporting experience, including custom and advanced reports.
  • Experience with HR data governance and data quality frameworks.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL or another data visualization/analytics tool.
  • Experience with business process testing and Workday release testing.
  • Experience supporting SOX-controlled environments.
  • Experience working with payroll, benefits, compensation, recruiting, time tracking, or other HR systems.
  • Workday certification is a plus.

Required Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or related field preferred

Salary Range

$114,750 - 140,000

title: OR Assistant
description:
SUMMARY:

Under general supervision, but according to established policies and procedures, performs variety of non-medical duties in support of Surgical Services. Such activities include, but are not limited to, transporting patients to and from Operating Room; picking up and/or delivering supplies, materials, specimens, cultures and the like. Assists in preoperative scrubs; assists in lifting, positioning and supporting patients. Cleans and prepares equipment utilized in surgical procedures; prepares material for sterilization. Assists in cleaning and maintaining the operating rooms. Assembles charge form packets.
Brown University Health employees are expected to successfully role model the organization's values of Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence as these values guide our everyday actions with patients, customers and one another.

In addition to our values, all employees are expected to demonstrate the core Success Factors which tell us how we work together and how we get things done. The core Success Factors include:

Instill Trust and Value Differences
Patient and Community Focus and Collaborate

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Transports patients to and from the surgical suite. Reviews preoperative patient charts in order to ensure that all forms are signed and that all tests are completed; informs appropriate nursing personnel of discrepancy.
Assists in surgical room preparation by ensuring basic supplies are available such as blankets, solutions, and syringes. Cleans furniture and equipment between cases. Obtains necessary supplies and equipment required for specific procedure.
Assists in prepping patients for surgery; assists with preoperative scrubs; lifts and moves and positions patients, supports and holds patients for spinal anesthesia injection and the like.
Routinely inventories, requisitions, receives and stocks supplies in established areas, including sterile linen, instruments, scrub clothes and the like in order to ensure availability to meet anticipated needs.
Picks up supplies and materials for Surgical Services from various areas of the Hospital such as pharmaceuticals, blood and plasma, as well as routine supplies required by the department. Delivers cultures and surgery specimens to designated areas of the Hospital for analysis as appropriate.
Assists in general cleaning and maintenance of the Operating Room such as washing equipment, sorting and stocking supplies, cleaning room, washing stretchers and changing light bulbs and the like.
Cleans, dries, packages and seals a variety of supplies and material to be sterilized, such as washing, assembling and wrapping basin sets for sterilization. Occasionally operates steam/water pressure sterilizers in order to clean and sterilize items.
Assembles patient record packs of charge slips, appropriate for specific surgical procedure, to be completed by others.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

BASIC KNOWLEDGE:
High School Diploma or GED preferred.
Ability to recognized changes in patient's condition and report such to nursing personnel.
Ability to perform simple numerical calculations in order to calculate and requisition supplies.
Knowledge of aseptic techniques in order to ensure proper cleaning of rooms, equipment and materials.
Demonstrated knowledge and skills necessary to provide care to patients with consideration of aging processes, human development stages and cultural patterns in each step of the care process.
Ability to read, write and understand English, with ability to perform simple numerical calculations.
EXPERIENCE:
One to three months’ on-the-job training and experience.
br /WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
Physical abilities to transport patients throughout the Hospital, to assist in lifting and positioning patients and to clean and set up equipment.
Works in the Operating Room area and is exposed to odors, bodily fluids, etc. when assisting with patients.
Required to work for extended periods in standing position when assisting with preoperative procedures.
Some exposure to chemical fumes and infectious disease when cleaning equipment and rooms.
Frequent standing, walking, lifting and carrying in order to clean equipment and replenish supplies, transport patients and materials and stock areas.
Hazards of injury are minimized by adherence to established safety precautions.

title: Packaging Development Scientist
description:
Job Description:

Segment: Food & Nutrition

Location: Oud-Beijerland

Contract type: Permanent

We are looking for a visionary Packaging Development Scientist to join our dynamic team. This isn't just a job; it's a chance to be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the circular economy by reinventing how our iconic products are packaged. You will champion the technical projects that not only deliver significant business impact but also help us achieve our ambitious sustainability goals. If you're ready to make a tangible difference and see your ideas on shelves worldwide, this is the role for you.

What are your Key Responsibility

As our Packaging Development Scientist, you will be the driving force behind our packaging innovation. You will:

  • Drive End-to-End Innovation: Lead cutting-edge packaging projects from the initial spark of an idea to a successful launch. You'll manage timelines, budgets, and quality, turning ambitious concepts into reality.
  • Champion Sustainability: Be a key player in our plastic reduction initiatives and ensure our packaging portfolio meets and exceeds global regulatory standards (like California SB 54), making our business more circular.
  • Collaborate for Success: Act as the central packaging expert, uniting cross-functional teams including R&D, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Quality to ensure seamless project execution and system improvements.
  • Build Capability: Mentor and elevate the technical knowledge of our teams, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation in sustainable packaging across the business.
  • Stay Ahead of the Curve: Keep Mars at the leading edge by exploring emerging technologies, materials, and trends through industry networks, trade fairs, and expert collaborations.


What are we looking for?

We are seeking a candidate with a proven track record of technical excellence and a passion for sustainability.

  • A university degree in a technical field such as Engineering, Science, or Packaging/Product Design.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in packaging development, packaging engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Deep knowledge of the end-to-end packaging development process, from ideation and material selection to manufacturing start-up.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and teamwork skills. You are a natural collaborator who can inspire and influence others.
  • Fluency in English (both written and spoken) and proficiency in MS Office applications.

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

Ready to build a more sustainable tomorrow with us? Apply now and let's create a better world for pets and people, one package at a time!

title: Solution Engineer, Sales
description:
Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices. Our unmatched expertise, partnership, and breadth of products allow us to fine-tune solutions that meet the specific needs of everyone from solo practitioners to larger practices. With AI-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community.

Job Description

Join Ensora Health as a Solutions Engineer supporting Fusion, our industry-leading rehabilitation therapy platform. In this highly visible role, you'll serve as a trusted technical advisor, partnering with prospects, customers, Sales, Product, and Engineering to solve complex operational and clinical workflow challenges. From delivering compelling demonstrations to designing tailored solutions that improve practice performance, you will play a critical role in helping rehabilitation organizations achieve better outcomes, streamline operations, and maximize financial performance.
We're looking for someone who combines technical expertise, healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) knowledge, and a passion for innovation. As AI continues to transform healthcare technology, you'll leverage emerging AI capabilities to create smarter customer experiences, accelerate solution adoption, and help shape the future of rehabilitation software. If you enjoy solving meaningful business problems, influencing purchasing decisions, and working at the intersection of healthcare and technology, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the technical subject matter expert throughout the sales cycle, guiding customers from discovery through solution validation and implementation planning.

  • Deliver high-impact product demonstrations tailored to rehabilitation therapy organizations, highlighting clinical, operational, and financial outcomes.

  • Partner closely with Sales to understand customer objectives, uncover challenges, and translate business needs into scalable technology solutions.

  • Advise customers on rehabilitation workflow optimization, including scheduling, documentation, billing, claims management, and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) best practices.

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to influence product direction and ensure customer requirements are effectively represented.

  • Leverage AI-powered tools and capabilities to enhance demonstrations, accelerate problem-solving, and identify opportunities to improve customer outcomes.

  • Develop compelling technical proposals, solution designs, and ROI-driven recommendations that align with customer goals.

  • Stay ahead of industry trends across rehabilitation technology, healthcare operations, RCM, interoperability, and artificial intelligence.

  • Support strategic sales opportunities by serving as a trusted advisor to executive and operational stakeholders

.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Consulting, Technical Consulting, or a related customer-facing technical role.

  • Experience within healthcare technology, rehabilitation software, EHR, practice management, billing, or related healthcare SaaS environments.

  • Strong understanding of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), including claims processing, reimbursement workflows, payer interactions, denials management, and billing operations.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Experience designing and presenting customized software demonstrations and technical solutions.

  • Proficiency with AI-enabled tools and technologies, with the ability to apply AI capabilities to improve workflows, customer experiences, and business outcomes.

  • Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and consultative communication skills.

  • Ability to build credibility with clinical, operational, financial, and executive stakeholders.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Healthcare Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Willingness to travel as needed to support customer and prospect engagements.

Additional Information

While we've outlined some key qualities we typically seek, it's essential to remember that there might be additional unique strengths and talents you possess that would make you an exceptional match for us, even if they're not explicitly mentioned. Studies have consistently highlighted the significance of this principle, particularly for individuals from disenfranchised backgrounds, including women and other marginalized groups. The message we want to convey is that taking a leap of faith and applying can be incredibly rewarding. Your distinct abilities and perspectives could be exactly what we need to create a more diverse and inclusive team. So, don't hesitate—apply today and let's explore the exciting possibilities together!

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

At Ensora Health, Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging aren’t just words. We celebrate what makes us unique, foster an ecosystem of inclusion for all and harness our talents to promote diversity of thought and action in everything we do.

We instill Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging into the fabric of our CARING culture and business, as we strive to be recognized not only as the leader in healthcare technology, but also for our intentional efforts to promote a diverse community. ​

​We will champion non-discriminatory practices throughout the employee and customer lifecycle; caring for every person regardless of race, national origin, color, religion, disability, sex, orientation, or familial status.

title: Area Ministry Director -- Georgia (Undergraduate Ministry)
description:
Area Ministry Director -- Georgia (Undergraduate Ministry)

Work Location:

Remote - USA

Job Type:

Full time

An Area Director leads and oversees a ministry team to plant and to grow witnessing communities of students and faculty who follow Jesus on college and university campuses. Through these groups, we believe ever-increasing numbers of students and faculty from all ethnic groups and areas of the campus will be transformed by the gospel. We expect to see campuses increasingly become places where people, ideas, and structures flourish for the common good and to the glory of God. We confidently anticipate that our InterVarsity alumni will be growing disciples and change agents across the country and around the world.

What we are looking for:

We are looking for a highly motivated self-starter who loves Jesus and is equipped to navigate the nuances of college campus life with God’s compassion, grace, and truth. The ideal candidate knows how to balance individual effort with delegation and dependence, rest with hard work, and professional development with ministry care. While being based in Atlanta is preferred — we have a strong contingent of staff and alumni in the area and would love a leader who can grow that network and our presence throughout Georgia — it is not a requirement.

ESSENTIAL COMMITMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Spiritual Growth

The Area Ministry Director models spiritual maturity as a disciple of Jesus Christ so that your life and work increasingly reflects a growing love for God, God’s Word, God’s people of every ethnicity and culture, and God’s purposes in the world.

  • Pursue a vibrant relationship with the triune God through engagement with Scripture, prayer, and worship, both individually and in community
  • Exercise self-leadership (growing in self-awareness, self-management, relational integrity, and resiliency)
  • Embrace and practice Scriptural standards for behavior and attitudes, including those described in the Code of Conduct

​

2. Campus Ministry Leadership

As an Area Director, you inspire, coach and develop campus staff ministers (“ministers”), students, faculty, and ministry partners to increase the number of witnessing communities, as well as the size, health, spiritual maturity, and campus-wide influence of existing witnessing communities by being a:

Visionary Guide:

  • Create a culture of dependence on God to gain vision for establishing and advancing witnessing communities that reach every corner of every campus in your area
  • Model InterVarsity’s vision and Core Values for supervisees
  • Lead staff, students, and faculty through Scripture, prayer, teaching and discipleship experiences in a way that motivates and shapes their ministry around vision
  • Set appropriate annual goals through prayer, research and reflection with your teams

Structural Architect:

  • Lead your team to develop and implement plans to achieve ministry goals
  • Adapt the plan as needed through rhythms of action, reflection and evaluation
  • Develop, align and leverage programs and structures to move the mission forward

Missional Developer:

  • Recruit a diversity of qualified minister candidates
  • Develop ministers to spiritually grow in Christ in intimacy, like Christ in character, and with Christ in his mission to current and new campuses
  • Develop ministers professionally so that they are consistently increasing their gifts and skills as ministry leaders
  • Supervise ministers, using appropriate leadership style for the individual and situation, to help them accomplish assigned tasks. This will require coaching, assessing, correcting and affirming job-related behaviors
  • Proactively establish and develop healthy relationships across racial, ethnic, national background, and gender barriers with staff, students, faculty, and ministry partners to build effective and diverse communities
  • Build an effective minister team that collaborates well and accomplishes goals

3. Organizational Collaboration

As an Area Director, you are part of a national organization and work in partnership with local, area, divisional, regional, and national InterVarsity ministers and volunteers.

  • Participate in regional leadership as determined by the Regional Director, to set ministry vision and strategies, contribute to accomplishing plans, and provide regional leadership in specific areas
  • Positively and constructively respond to the direction and coaching of line supervisors
  • Build productive ministry partnerships with regional and national collaborative leaders
  • Establish systems, processes and protocols to fulfill regular operational and administrative tasks in a timely manner (reporting, finances, human resources, etc.)
  • Maintain sound financial status of the area through management of budgeting, expense control and ministry partnership development
  • Become familiar with and comply with all InterVarsity policies and procedures

4. Ministry Partnership Development (MPD)

As an Area Director, you will develop a team of partners who will resource the ministry financially, in prayer, or with volunteer service that advances the mission.

  • Develop and maintain a ministry among partners who will fund InterVarsity
  • Ensure ministry budget is fully funded
  • Supervise each minister’s MPD (collaborating with coaches when applicable) and equip staff to build ministry partners
  • Build resource networks with alumni, volunteers, churches, advocacy councils, and major donors, in particular to fund low-network ministers
  • Communicate regularly with ministry partners

5. Georgia Specific Commitments/Responsibilities

As the Area Director of Georgia, you will be responsible for growing the student and staff work throughout Georgia. This will include, but not be limited to:

  • Pastorally and professionally care for the current team of field staff and volunteer staff
  • Manage and nurture existing partnerships and establish new ones to support the ministry
  • Develop a staff recruitment strategy to grow the team
  • Provide staff with vision and direction for growth
  • Participate in a diverse Regional Leadership Team that sets vision and strategy for the whole region
  • Develop a strategy for reaching unreached campuses in partnership with national initiatives and partners
  • Strengthen partnerships with Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs), Hispanic-Serving Institutions (HSIs), and Asian American communities
  • Continue building a communal funding model that supports the financial health of all staff

6. Accomplish all other assigned tasks as appropriate

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Annually affirm InterVarsity’s Statement of Agreement (Doctrinal Basis and Purpose Statement). Abide by InterVarsity’s Code of Conduct
  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Minimum three years campus ministry or equivalent work experience required
  • Strong ministry skills (including the ability to communicate spiritual vision, teach spiritual and biblical principles, plan ministry programs, and spiritually disciple, coach and mentor)
  • Proven ability to work well with others and the ability to develop a team of campus ministers.
  • Strong interpersonal skills (including ability to minister to diverse ethnic communities and faculty)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated problem solving skills
  • Familiarity with word processing, presentation, email, and spreadsheet software

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The AD position leads ministry in a college campus environment. A designated office space may or may not be available. The AD is required to travel to on-campus and off-campus sites as appropriate. Off-campus travel includes, but is not limited to student ministry conferences, MPD meetings, and InterVarsity-sponsored training sessions, meetings, and conferences. The AD is regularly required to communicate with others, and routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, etc.

Pay Range: $56,844.00 - $75,792.00 per year

Pay: This position is funded through personal fundraising. Accordingly, compensation will vary based on the ability of the individual to secure a donor team to fund the cost of his/her salary. The anticipated salary range for this position on a full-time basis (40 hours/week) is dependent on a variety of factors, including location and cost of living. The actual salary received, including any geographic adjustment to account for location and cost of living, is subject to the individual’s ability to raise funds necessary to cover the full amount of such salary within the range set forth in the job posting details.

title: Lease Analyst
description:
Gulfport Energy Corporation is an Oklahoma City-based independent oil and natural gas exploration and production company with its principal properties located in the Utica Shale in Eastern Ohio, the SCOOP Woodford and SCOOP Springer plays in Central Oklahoma.

Gulfport aims to create sustainable value through the economic development of our significant resource plays in the Utica and SCOOP operating areas. Our strategy is to develop our assets in an environmentally responsible manner, while generating sustainable cash flow, improving margins and operating efficiencies and returning capital to shareholders. To accomplish these goals, we allocate capital expenditures to projects we believe offer the highest rate of return and we deploy leading drilling and completion techniques and technologies in our development efforts.

Title:

Lease Analyst

Full time

FLSA:

United States of America (Exempt)

Description:

Job Summary:

The Lease Analyst is responsible for the administration, maintenance, and analysis of oil and gas leases, contracts, ownership information, and lease obligations within Company land systems. This role is responsible for operational, legal, accounting, and land functions by ensuring accurate lease records, maintaining compliance with contractual obligations, resolving ownership and lease issues, and providing reporting and analysis for assigned assets. Responsibilities include lease and ownership record maintenance, lease and payment setup, obligation and compliance monitoring, reporting, and data analysis.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain a solid working relationship with interdepartmental Company personnel.

  • Set up oil and gas leases and associated contracts.

  • Review and analyze oil and gas leases for key terms and provisions.

  • Analyze data and enter information into land system quickly with a high level of accuracy.

  • Analyze and maintain mineral ownership records, leasehold interests, and contractual obligations to ensure accuracy of land system data and lease payments.

  • Research, resolve and communicate leasehold discrepancies, ownership issues, etc.

  • Review, calculate and create lease obligations for rentals, bonus, extension, and shut-in payments.

  • Monitor lease obligations and critical dates to ensure compliance with contractual requirements.

  • Maintain various reports using Excel or other reporting tools for management.

  • Maintain electronic lease records and supporting documentation in accordance with company record retention standards.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

  • Thorough knowledge of oil and gas land contracts and legal instruments.

  • Understanding of lease lifecycle management, production status impacts, lease-saving provisions, and ownership concepts.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and experience in Quorum Land System.

  • Ability to understand and resolve complex title issues.

  • Demonstrate ownership, initiative, and accountability in managing lease administration activities and data integrity.

  • Proficiency in utilizing Auditor websites and GIS.

  • Excellent written, organizational, communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Team oriented.

  • Experience with electronic files and scan processes.

  • Ability to perform detailed work with speed and accuracy.

  • Ability to organize and prioritize a diverse and heavy workload consisting of many detailed, separate procedures and deadlines.

  • Create strong work relationships with mineral owners and internal staff.

  • Ability to communicate effectively, both orally in person and using a telephone and in writing.

  • Recognize personal strengths and weaknesses and be proactive in self-development.

Education/Experience:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in Land Administration – Leases and Contracts

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent work experience.

Work Environment:

This job operates in both a professional office environment and a field environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, tablets, smart phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

Physical Requirements:

  • The ability to use a computer or phone for extended periods of time

  • Basic use of office equipment such as copiers and fax machines

  • Ability to lift 10 pounds occasionally

  • Ability to concentrate

  • Ability to sit for long periods of time

This is a full-time salaried position. Days and hours of work are typically Monday through Friday but can vary due to workload/needs of the company.

Occasional travel is expected for this position.

title: Director of Development & Alumni Engagement
description:

  • Six (6) years of progressive, successful experience in fundraising, alumni relations, advancement, constituent engagement, or related nonprofit/higher education work.

  • Background in capital campaigns and higher education advancement preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to create compelling, donor-centric cases for support and alumni-centered engagement opportunities.
  • Excellent oral and written communication, relationship-building, event planning, organizational, analytical, and project management skills.
  • Experience with constituent relationship management systems like Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge, Microsoft Outlook platforms, advancement communications, data-informed engagement strategies, and AI-based tools for fundraising and alumni outreach preferred.

Meet the Team

Splunk, a Cisco company, is building a safer, more resilient digital world with an end-to-end, full-stack platform designed for hybrid, multi-cloud environments.

We are looking for a Lead Data Scientist to drive advanced analytics and predictive modeling initiatives that power growth across the Splunk and Cisco portfolios. In this role, you will serve as a hands-on individual contributor—applying your data science expertise to real business challenges, collaborating across teams, and transforming complex data into actionable insights.

Your work will directly enable more scalable, consistent, and customer-focused sales strategies. This role focuses on execution, model development, and production support, working closely with senior data scientists on broader strategy and advanced projects.

Your Impact

  • Design, develop, and maintain predictive models and analytical workflows to drive revenue growth, customer engagement, and sales effectiveness.
  • Apply analytics and machine learning techniques to account prioritization, propensity modeling, and tailored sales recommendations within the TAS framework.
  • Conduct statistical and exploratory data analyses across large, multi-source datasets to uncover meaningful patterns and insights.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Partner, and Customer Success teams to understand business questions and translate them into impactful data science solutions.
  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines and features to support ongoing model development and refresh cycles.
  • Support deployment, monitoring, and validation of models in production environments.
  • Create clear documentation, dashboards, and presentations to communicate findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Apply data quality checks and validation methods to ensure the reliability of analytical outputs.
  • Collaborate with and support senior data scientists on complex modeling, experimentation, and AI-driven initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelors + 8 years of related experience, or Masters + 6 years of related experience, or PhD + 3 years of related experience
  • 3+ years of driving cross business initiatives across multiple businesses
  • Experience with continuous improvement of analytics processes, tools, and best practices.
  • Experience applying predictive modeling, statistical analysis, or machine learning to business problems.
  • Experience in Python and SQL, with experience using cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Pendo, RStudio, tableau.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with common data science and machine learning tools, frameworks, and workflows.
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources.
  • Exposure to model deployment, monitoring, or production analytics environments.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical results to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, work independently within a defined scope, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Interest in applied AI, responsible AI practices, and continuous learning.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

  • 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next

  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

  • 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

title: Project Manager
description:
Build a career powered by innovations that matter! At Novanta, our innovations power technology products that are transforming healthcare and advanced manufacturing—improving productivity, enhancing people’s lives and redefining what’s possible. We create for our global customers engineered components and sub-systems that deliver extreme precision and performance for a range of mission-critical applications—from minimally invasive surgery to robotics to 3D metal printing.

Novanta is one global team with over 26 offices located in The Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Looking for a great place to work? You have found it with a culture that embraces teamwork, collaboration and empowerment. Come explore Novanta.

Summary

We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead complex, cross-functional technical programs from planning through execution. This role is responsible for managing project roadmaps, milestones, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communication across multiple workstreams. The ideal candidate brings strong technical fluency, disciplined project management practices, and the ability to align engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver projects on time, within scope, and within budget.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Program and Project Governance: Define, document, and manage project roadmaps, milestones, deliverables, and cross-project dependencies for technical initiatives.
  • Technical Integration and Alignment: Partner with architects, engineering leaders, developers, and operations teams to translate product and technical requirements into clear execution plans.
  • Risk and Dependency Management: Identify technical constraints, project risks, and potential blockers, and work with stakeholders to develop practical mitigation plans.
  • Resource Planning: Coordinate resource needs and priorities across teams to support project delivery, maintain schedule discipline, and manage budget expectations.
  • Project Management Practices: Apply appropriate project management methods, including Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or traditional project planning, based on project needs.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Prepare clear project updates, metrics, risks, and decisions for business leaders, project sponsors, and cross-functional teams.
  • Vendor and Third-Party Management: Support vendor coordination, review statements of work, and track external deliverables to ensure commitments are met.

General Tasks

  • Comply with all applicable quality, occupational safety, and environmental requirements.
  • Follow instructions from quality, environmental, and occupational safety representatives.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, project management, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience: 10+ years of project management experience in a technical, engineering, manufacturing, software, infrastructure, or high-technology environment.
  • Project Portfolio Management: Demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities, shared resources, and interdependent deliverables.
  • Project Management Tools: Proficiency with MS Project or similar project planning tools, with the ability to develop schedules, track milestones, and manage dependencies.
  • Technical Tools: Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Asana, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms used to manage work, report progress, and present data.
  • Certifications: PMP, CSM, or similar project management certification preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PgMP, PMI-ACP, or similar advanced project management certification.
  • Prior hands-on experience in engineering, quality, manufacturing, software, systems, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience working with globally distributed or cross-cultural teams.

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 20% travel may be required to support project activities, business meetings, supplier engagement, or work with cross-functional teams at other Novanta locations.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to work in an office or manufacturing environment, including extended periods of sitting, standing, and using a computer.

  • The salary for this role will range from $135,000 to $165,000 annually based on full-time employment. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including but not limited to location, relevant skills, training, experience, education, etc.

  • Certain roles may be eligible for performance-based incentive compensation and/or long-term incentives. Incentives could be discretionary or non-discretionary depending on the plan.

  • Novanta supports all aspects of your life’s needs. This position provides a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits to make your quality of life better.

Novanta is proud to be an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, military and veteran status, disability, genetics, or any other category protected by federal law or Novanta policy.

Please call +1 781-266-5700 if you need a disability accommodation for any part of the employment process.

title: MG Patient Service Specialist
description:
SUMMARY:

This position is to function as a member of the administration team and complete assigned daily front end tasks to ensure smooth day to day operations in the BHMG physician practice. The Patient Service Specialist must maintain a professional, positive manner when talking with patients in-person, over the phone, or via email.
Brown University Health employees are expected to successfully role model the organization's values of Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence as these values guide our everyday actions with patients, customers and one another.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Answers calls and routes telephone calls appropriately; takes messages, follows through with each message, ensuring that the appropriate physician/staff member receives the information. Provides routine information to callers and gives only authorized medical advice from a provider.

  • Provides a high level of customer service to all new and existing patients of the practice.

  • Creates patient cases and documents telephone calls and messages into EPIC.

  • Schedules patient appointments and appropriate testing for patients as requested.

  • Registers patients in EMR and verifies information including demographics and obtains accurate health insurance information. Conduct eligibility checks to ensure insurance is reflected accurately.

  • Collects required insurance co-pays from patients including any prior balances.

  • Follows scheduling notes and direct schedules patient visits in other BHMG practices as advised.

  • Performs pre-visit planning daily for all upcoming scheduled appointments to include running insurance eligibility.

  • Responsible to obtain prior authorizations and/or insurance referrals as per practice need.

  • Performs outreach to select patient groups as directed for patient care and quality measurement/guidelines. Schedules specialty appointments/testing as required.

  • Performs work in EMR buckets as directed and per practice need.

  • Responsible to inform manager of administrative supply needs or assists with ordering.

  • Follows up with providers on missing slips and creates claims in EPIC.

  • Responsible to work assigned revenue cycle buckets as directed.

  • Must be able to work independently with little supervision.

  • Adheres to BHMG policies.

  • Always uses discretion to ensure patient confidentiality.

  • Performs other duties as requested.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • One to three years as a medical assistant preferred.

  • Strong customer service excellence expected.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills required.

  • Experience with EMR strongly preferred. (Athena a plus)

  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Word, Excel, and Outlook preferred.


EDUCATION:

High School Diploma or equivalent required. Education from approved medical assistant program or equivalent preferred.

title: Capital Planning
description:
The Opportunity

WB Capital & Models plays a central role in the execution of the Wholesale Banking (WB) strategy. The department focuses on optimizing the WB Balance Sheet, Capital and Funding positions and acts as Business Model Owner for the WB Credit Risk Models. The department will also play a central role in the analytics and pricing of the WB Lending products.

WB Capital & Models consists of 7 teams: (1) WB Capital Management, (2) WB Capital Planning, (3) WB Reporting & Analytics (4) Expert Team Large Corporate and Financial Institutions (5) Expert Team Specialized Lending (6) Expert Team Scoping & Defaults (7) Expert Team Regulatory Transformation.

Role and responsibilities

WB Capital Planning (WB CP) establishes long-term direction and goals of the WB Balance Sheet, Capital & Funding position, as well as the definition of the long-term risk appetite. The team is pivotal in the realization of the WB Capital Velocity ambition and works in close cooperation with Sectors and Lending.

As a WB CP team member you will:

  • Shape the future WB portfolio composition and profitability, considering broader bank interests such as the mix of regulatory capital, economic capital, output floor, funding, asset
  • Provide insights into the WB RWA portfolio through current trends, impact analyses, and forecasts for WB Sectors and Lending, WB Balance Sheet Committee, Capital Velocity MT, Models, and Risk Management Committee.
  • Set long-term WB capital planning and determine the optimal funding and capital mix, considering regulatory, economic and output floor capital, at sector and location levels.
  • Represent the WB in WB RAS envelope discussions & allocation across a.o. sectors and locations; drive the envelope review process and facilitate necessary adjustments.
  • Ensure understanding of WB RWA across the bank and drive alignment with the Regulatory Transformation Expert Team, Group Treasury, Finance, and Risk.
  • Take an active role in loan distribution projects by setting long-term distribution strategies with Sectors and Lending at the sector and location levels.
  • Manage long-term change initiatives related to balance sheet management activities.

How to succeed

We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.

Rewards and benefits

We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life. You can find out more about our employment conditions at

The benefits of working with us at ING include:

  • A salary tailored to your qualities and experience
  • 24-27 vacation days depending on contract
  • Pension scheme
  • 13th month salary
  • Individual Savings Contribution (BIS), 3.5% of your gross annual salary
  • 8% Holiday payment
  • Hybrid working to blend home working for focus and office working for collaboration and co-creation
  • Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
  • An informal working environment with innovative colleagues

​

About us

With 60,000 employees and operations in approximately 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities for people with initiative who want to help people take a step ahead in life and in business. Do you want to work at the cutting edge of what’s possible and at the same time ensure you work with integrity and hold the customer’s interests at heart? Do you want to be surrounded by progressive, inspiring, diverse and supportive colleagues? Then there is no better place to invest your talents than at ING. Join us. Apply today.

Questions?

Contact the recruiter attached to the advertisement for more information. Want to apply directly? Please upload your CV and motivation letter by clicking the “Apply” button.

title: Cash Office Associate
description:
As a member of the C&S Wholesale Grocers family of companies, SpartanNash is a food solutions company that delivers the ingredients for a better life. A distributor, wholesaler and retailer with a global supply chain network, SpartanNash distributes grocery and household goods, including fresh produce and the Our Family® portfolio of products, to locations in all 50 states.

Our braggingly happy team members — ranging from bakery managers to order selectors; from IT developers to vice presidents of finance; from HR Business Partners to export specialists — create braggingly happy customers spanning national accounts, independent and chain grocers, e-commerce retailers, U.S. military commissaries and exchanges, and the Company’s own brick-and-mortar grocery stores, pharmacies and fuel centers.

Ready to contribute to the success of our food solutions company? Apply now!

Location:

829 W. Main - Gaylord, Michigan 49734

Position Summary:

This role is responsible to perform all phases of the store's cash office operations in an accurate and efficient manner to ensure that the work shift contributes positively to the best interests of the store. Complete all other duties as assigned in a timely manner.

Here’s what you’ll do:

  • Observe strict confidentiality of all company records and financial information and safeguard against unauthorized access to such information at all times.

  • Support front-end activities to help ensure cashiers follow store policies when handling transactions, including cash, checks, debit/credit/EBT cards, ID verification, over-rings, refunds, bottle returns, vendor coupons, gift cards, and lottery ticket sales.

  • Follow all policies pertaining to the sale of alcoholic beverages, tobacco, pseudoephedrine, etc.

  • Accurately operate cash register, display cost of customer purchase, make change, cash checks, and issue receipts.

  • Accurately balancing cash and media to ledger and ensuring cash is controlled and safely deposited.

  • Knowledgeable and capable of implementing all related security and cash drawer accounting procedures.

  • Keep management informed of problems with pricing, cash registers, scales, or other cash office issues.

  • Maintain records on cash controls for internal audits.

  • Follow all PPE and Safety Guidelines

  • Follow all Food Safety and Cleaning Expectations

  • Follow Guest Experience Guidelines

  • Additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed

Here’s what you’ll need:

  • High school graduate or equivalent (GED)

  • Ability to read, write, comprehend, and interpret documents

  • Basic mathematical skills

  • Suggestive Selling/Knowledge of Products

  • Detail Oriented

  • Basic computer skills (email, spreadsheets, etc.)

Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. May be required to lift and/or move up to 30 pounds frequently, and up to 50 pounds occasionally. The associate is required to stand and walk for extended periods of time and may bend, stoop, twist and turn frequently. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is subject to a typical retail store environment (varied temperatures) and is exposed to outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate. Travel requirements vary by assignment.

As part of our People First culture, SpartanNash is proud to offer a robust and competitive Total Rewards benefits package.

SpartanNash is an Equal Opportunity Employer that invests in Associate development, recognizes and celebrates success, fosters two-way communication, and promotes a sense of belonging. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, including those with disabilities and Veterans.

title: Senior Financial Reporting Associate
description:
As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world.

We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!

If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today.

At PGIM, You Can!

What you will do

We are looking for a reliable team player to support our European accounting team. As part of the team, based in Letterkenny, you will be responsible for the ongoing processing of service invoices for our companies located in Europe. In the dynamic environment of our corporate group, we offer a secure position with flexible working hours and opportunities for training and development.

  • Initiate and monitor the invoice approval process

  • Processing of payment transactions

  • Account reconciliation and clarification

  • Master data maintenance

  • Several years of professional experience in accounts payable

  • Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style

  • High level of trustworthiness, reliability, and accuracy

  • Attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving

  • Strong communication skills

title: Senior Storage Systems Programmer Analyst
description:
Summary

Companion Data Services provides leading IT solutions and managed services. We operate multiple geographically disperse data centers, including two of the nation’s largest healthcare data centers – both rated among the top five percent of data centers worldwide by MIPS.
With three U.S. locations and decades of experience in government, commercial and education markets, our innovative solutions and reliable services allow clients to focus on core business and improve outcomes.
Our data centers host applications process billions of transactions, supporting state, federal and commercial business.


Description

Position Purpose:

Responsible for ensuring all systems programming decisions maintain the integrity of the overall systems infrastructure. Write or debug programs to maintain and control computer systems software, such as operating systems, networked systems, and database systems. Provide technical and disaster recovery expertise for systems software.

Location:

This position is full time and fully onsite in Columbia, South Carolina (strongly preferred), State College, PA, or Dallas, TX. This position operates within a work environment that is fast paced and a multi-platformed environment which may require action and response 24X7 to support the technical business needs of the customer.

Logistics:

Companion Data Services – one of BlueCross BlueShield of South Carolina’s subsidiary companies.

This position is not eligible for sponsorship now or in the future.

What You’ll Do:

  • Diagnose, isolate, and debug software problems and perform problem resolution. Identify issues that the vendor is responsible for and refer those issues appropriately.

  • Review and design system software and hardware builds analyzing system options and the impact on the overall systems infrastructure. Develop and document the framework for integration and implementation for changes to technical standards.

  • Coordinate installation, testing, and maintenance of systems software. Schedule system downtime in a way that minimizes user impact.

  • Review customer requests, security patches, and audit requirements for additions or changes to systems, and evaluate feasibility to determine if/how to handle the request while maintaining an adequate/appropriate overall systems infrastructure. To determine if requested changes are possible, review system capabilities, workflow, and scheduling limitations.

  • Provide technical guidance to project team areas as appropriate. May evaluate vendor-supplied software packages and make recommendations to IT management. In coordination with Project Leads and senior level staff, provide input on proposals that could potentially impact systems.

  • Assist in the establishment and implementation of standards and guidelines that guide the design of technology solutions across the enterprise.

  • Provide technical and disaster recovery support for systems software.

To Qualify For This Position, You’ll Need The Following:

Required Education:

  • Bachelor's in a job related field

Degree Equivalency:

  • Associates degree plus an extra 2 years of job-related work experience for a total of 10 years of required work experience (see "required work experience")

OR

  • 12 total years required work experience.


Required Work Experience:

  • 8 Years IT experience including extensive systems programming experience.

Required Skills and Abilities:

  • Strong analytical and logical thinking skills.

  • Thorough understanding of operating systems and foundation architecture.

  • Extensive knowledge of systems programming, graphical user interfaces, control languages, development, quality assurance, and integration methodologies.

  • Advanced knowledge of currently utilized programming productivity tools and their use.

  • Advanced knowledge/skills in analyzing system software and making recommendations for performance enhancements.


Required Software and Other Tools:

  • Standard office equipment.

We Prefer That You Have The Following:

  • IBM z/OS storage environments.

  • Working knowledge of Luminex Mainframe Virtual Tape (MVT), storage pools.

  • Initialization and configuration of DASD devices.

  • DFSMSdss full volume and logical dataset dump and restore.

  • Coding SMS ACS routines.

  • ISMF, HSM configuration and administration, SMS storage group utilization, RMM configuration and administration.

  • Working knowledge of Dino Software T-REX and UDM software products.

  • Exposure with IBM TDMF for z/OS.

  • Working knowledge of DELL EMC PowerMax and SRDF replication

  • Exploitation of zEDC.

title: Strategic Risk Advisor
description:
Job Description

Build the future with us

Would you like to contribute to analyzing the strategic issues shaping the future of a large organization? Do you enjoy understanding complex situations, collaborating with various business partners and helping implement practical solutions?

As a Strategic Risk Advisor, you will support business sectors in identifying, analyzing and monitoring strategic, cross-functional and emerging risks to help inform sound decision-making.

This position is a great opportunity to develop an in-depth understanding of the organization’s strategic issues, showcase your skills and fully realize your potential within a caring and trustworthy company. Here, people and their development are at the heart of our priorities, fostering an environment that encourages collaboration and innovation.


What you’ll accomplish with us

As a Strategic Risk Advisor, you’ll be at the core of our mission. Here are the main responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the identification, assessment, monitoring and tracking of strategic, cross-functional and emerging risks;
  • Conduct risk analyses and provide advisory support in assessing projects, initiatives and strategic matters;
  • Monitor action plans, mitigation measures, indicators and related documentation in collaboration with business partners;
  • Contribute to the preparation of reports, presentations and other documents intended for senior management and various committees;
  • Support and raise awareness among partners regarding the application of risk management methodologies, tools and standards;
  • Contribute to collecting, consolidating and analyzing data to provide an integrated view of risks;
  • Research and analyze emerging trends that may influence the business environment and the organization’s risk profile;
  • Collaborate with other risk management teams to ensure a consistent and harmonized approach;
  • Participate in facilitating workshops, working sessions and training activities, as required;
  • Participate in various projects or assignments requiring risk management expertise;
  • Perform any other responsibilities that contribute to achieving the team’s objectives.

  • Holds a bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting or another relevant field;

description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first.
