Virtual

What's in it for you

Trane Technologies has an exciting opportunity for a remote Project Developer in Key Accounts. As a Project Developer, you will support one of the most dynamic and fast-growing areas of the business: Small Commercial vertical accounts within Key Accounts.

In this role, you will work with internal teams, Account Managers, independent service providers, and national owner-direct customers to identify, develop, and help sell profitable, executable projects centered on digital solutions, service offerings, and turnkey project delivery. This includes scope of work development, project estimating, solution design support, subcontractor coordination, and proposal development.

The Project Developer plays a critical role in helping Account Managers uncover customer needs, shape practical and scalable solutions, and position Trane as a trusted long-term partner. This role requires a blend of technical aptitude, business acumen, project development discipline, and strong communication skills to support growth across strategic customer accounts and expand the Trane brand through an ongoing partnership cycle.

The Project Developer is responsible for supporting project acquisition and development efforts from early opportunity identification through project handoff, ensuring solutions are aligned with customer expectations, operational requirements, and business objectives.

What you will do

  • Develop small commercial HVAC, controls, connected building, digital, service, and turnkey solutions using Trane equipment, controls, and services, along with other complementary systems as needed.

  • Partner with Account Managers to identify and develop profitable, executable opportunities that support customer goals and drive business growth across national owner-direct accounts.

  • Assist in project scoping, concept development, solution validation, and preliminary design to support sales strategy and customer engagement.

  • Support Account Managers in developing project budgets, preparing subcontractor and independent service provider request for quotations (RFQs), and defining scope statements, schedules, specifications, and milestone dates.

  • Coordinate with independent service providers and internal stakeholders to develop executable project plans and ensure alignment on delivery expectations.

  • Provide technical and solution-development support in pursuit of Trane business, including participation in strategic account planning and job acquisition efforts.

  • Manage design support activities, including conceptual site plans and preliminary engineering documents, through turnover to execution teams as required.

  • Help develop and refine processes that improve project development effectiveness across digital, service, and turnkey offerings within Key Accounts Small Commercial.

  • Support secured customers from project development through transition to operations or execution teams.

  • Assist in driving customer satisfaction, account growth, and long-term relationship development that reinforces the Trane brand.

  • Support an infinite partnership approach by helping create repeatable value for customers through ongoing service, modernization, digital expansion, and turnkey project opportunities.

  • Some travel required; other duties as assigned.

What you will bring

  • Four-year degree in Engineering, Technical field, Business, or related field required.

  • Experience supporting project development, project management, service solutions, turnkey delivery, or construction-related sales support.

  • Ability to identify customer needs and help translate them into practical, profitable, and executable solutions.

  • Working knowledge of HVAC systems, controls, building systems, and the building construction industry.

  • Ability to audit existing mechanical and building systems and recommend solutions that improve performance, reliability, serviceability, and customer outcomes.

  • Strong estimating, scoping, and proposal support capabilities.

  • Ability to develop and write HVAC system-level sequence of operations and other system-level control requirements is a plus.

  • Proficiency in Visio, AutoCAD, and/or other design software; familiarity with digital platforms and connected building technologies is a plus.

  • Strong interpersonal, teamwork, and communication skills, with the ability to work across internal teams, external providers, and customer organizations.

  • Ability to work regularly and dependably while functioning effectively in a team environment.

  • Flexibility to work outside normal work hours or weekends as required, including some travel with occasional overnight stays.

title: Associate Director, Asset Management
description:
Purpose and Job Summary


Under the direction and supervision of the Senior and Managing Director of Asset Management, the Associate Director oversees a nationwide portfolio of commercial mortgage loans and related investments for ORIX USA’s Real Estate Investment Strategies (REIS) Group. Loan positions managed by the Associate Director are collateralized by commercial income—producing properties and require knowledge across multiple asset classes — including multifamily, senior housing/healthcare, self—storage, commercial, and manufactured housing. Duties are carried out from the Lender/Servicer perspective — ensuring compliance with financial, contractual, and legal requirements, processing Borrower requests, and analyzing and reporting on credit risk. The Associate Director also monitors Borrower performance against business plans, oversees construction draw administration, reporting, and funding, and conduct site inspections. Although the role centers on loan positions, the Associate Director may be assigned to REO (Real Estate Owned) or equity transactions.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Ensure Borrower’s contractual compliance with loan documents.
  • Monitor Borrower’s compliance with asset business plan.
  • Oversee draw administration for ground-up construction loans / renovation loans and coordinate with internal and external parties involved with the asset.
  • Evaluate and recommend appropriate action regarding anticipated repairs, future funding and capital expenditures for the collateral.
  • Assist in analyzing, underwriting and processing ad hoc Borrower requests, including requests for modifications of loan terms, changes to/releases of/transfers of collateral.
  • Coordinate preparation of post-closing legal documents with internal and/or external Counsel and review of same.
  • Analyze financial statements on income-producing properties to evaluate financial health and long-term viability.
  • Analyze operating statements, rent rolls and other information to determine relevant performance metrics, and accurately and timely report on same.
  • Conduct annual or semi-annual site inspections of physical collateral on assigned properties.
  • Investigate and maintain a working knowledge of relevant national, regional, and local (geographic) market conditions, and determine the impact on our collateral.
  • Analyze and report on the relative strengths of and credit risks associated with individual and entity sponsors / owners.
  • Make specific recommendations regarding non-performing assets and prudent loss mitigation steps specific to the deal.
  • Perform in-depth analysis of the credit quality of the asset, utilizing industry-standard real estate and financing analysis methods.
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly and ad-hoc reports regarding the collateral, the credit risk associated with the loan, and specific action plans or recommendations for the Lender / Investor.
  • Participate in various department, division and company projects and duties, as requested.
  • Possess and apply knowledge of the REINS group’s policies and procedures. Understand all mortgage and finance programs offered by ORIX.
  • Work professionally and harmoniously with team and coworkers.
  • Other projects and duties as assigned.

Education, Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, or related field required.
  • Minimum 5 years’ commercial real estate experience is required, preferably with a REIT, PE Firm, or Institutional Lender.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office suite.
  • Knowledge of commercial/multifamily mortgage lending and commercial real estate finance.
  • Knowledge of principles of securitization, CMBS, and 3rd party loan servicing.
  • Knowledge of commercial construction principles and practices is required.
  • Knowledge of commercial real estate valuation, including appraisal methodologies.
  • Knowledge of commercial underwriting principles and practices.
  • Knowledge of commercial loan documents and underlying legal concepts regarding secured financing, lien priority, lender liability, creditor rights and bankruptcy rules.
  • Knowledge of financial analysis and basic accounting principles required.
  • An excellent customer service attitude demonstrated by an ability to produce high quality deliverables, in an accurate and timely manner, to internal and external stakeholders. Must demonstrate critical thinking and be highly analytical to effectively diagnose problems and identify appropriate solutions.
  • Possess excellent organizational skills to meet deadlines and achieve goals.
  • Ability to travel as required for site inspections or other team meetings.
  • Flexibility and ability to work under pressure and adjust priorities, as needed.

Life at ORIX

We are committed to the health and well-being of our employees and offer a quality, competitive benefits package that provides valuable healthcare and financial protection for our workforce, while emphasizing a healthy work/life balance.

You Time

We want you to have the time needed to recharge and manage life with our competitive vacation policy, floating personal holidays, extensive leave options, our annual observed holidays, and more.

Family Care

Every family has a different journey and ORIX USA Group is proud to offer extensive benefit programs such as: infertility coverage, adoption support, child and elder care, fully paid maternity, and generous parental leave benefits to help you and your families along the way.

Job Description

Position Overview:
The Sterile Processing Technician provides sterile instruments and decontaminated, safe equipment for patients of all ages under the supervision of a Patient Care Manager/Coordinator or Chief Technician. He/She cleans, disinfects, assembles, packages and sterilizes surgical instruments; tests, operates and monitors sterilization equipment; documents and maintains sterilization records; assembles surgical supplies; and decontaminates, disinfects and distributes patient care equipment.

The Sterile Processing Technician verifies and assures accurate patient charges; orders patient equipment and supplies; and operates computer equipment to meet patient supply needs, for patient charge inquiry, and to post and credit charges. The Sterile Processing Technician must demonstrate knowledge of sterilization supplies and requirements, equipment and instruments; organizing, containing, and transporting items of varying compounds, textures or quantities; transporting and disposing of hazardous materials and sharp objects according to hospital procedures. He/She must demonstrate knowledge of sterilization procedures of various equipment and instruments and knowledge of wrapping and repackaging sterilized instruments.

The Tech must demonstrate the following skills: using sterilization equipment and instruments; arranging instruments on surgical trays; following written instructions and performing multiple tasks; and in establishing and maintaining cooperative working relationships with others.

Expectation is for all performed duties to be in accordance with Singing River Health System procedures and policies, accreditation organization, and governing guidance and publications for health care employees.

DISCLAIMER: This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, skills, efforts, requirements or working conditions associated with the job. While this intends to be an accurate reflection of the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks performed as assigned.

Education:
High School diploma required or GED equivalent. Knowledge of medical terminology essential.

N/A

Certifications:
Certification recommended within two (2) years of employment.

Central Service, OR Instrument/Supply and computer entry experience preferred.

Patient Care Manager, Patient Care Coordinator, and/or Chief Technician.

None

Work is moderately active: involves sitting with frequent requirements to move about the office, move about the facility, and to travel to another facility within the SRHS service area. Work involves exerting a negligible amount of force frequently to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Work involves using repetitive motions: substantial movements of the wrists, hands and/or fingers while operating standard office equipment such as computer keyboard copier and 10-key.

Work involves being able to perceive the nature of sound at normal speaking levels with or without correction; the ability to make fine discriminations in sound. Work requires close visual and acuity and the ability to adjust the eye to bring an object into sharp focus, i.e. shift gaze from viewing a computer monitor to forms/printed material that are closer to compare data at close vision.

Must be able to be active for extended periods of time without experiencing undue fatigue. Must be able to work flexible hours.

Keen mental faculties, sound judgment and decision-making skills for the preparation and sterilization of surgical instruments and the monitoring of computerized sterilization equipment. Job Description

​​The OneSource Project Manager is a member of the OS PMO Practice and is responsible for independently leading and driving multiple concurrent projects based on OneSource business priorities and project demand. Assignments may include new program implementations, transitions, process and continuous improvement initiatives, and other strategic or cross-functional OneSource projects. ​The Project Manager drives assigned projects from initiation through closeout by establishing and maintaining the integrated project plan and governance structure, coordinating cross-functional workstreams, and driving accountability to agreed milestones and deliverables. The Project Manager monitors overall project health, proactively manages risks, issues, dependencies and change, and escalates matters requiring additional support or decisions. Functional and workstream owners remain accountable for executing their assigned deliverables. ​Projects are managed using the methodology, governance framework, tools and standards established by the OS PMO Practice. Project Managers are expected to apply these standards consistently, tailor project-level materials where appropriate, maintain accurate project information, capture lessons learned, and contribute to continuous improvement of PMO tools and practices. The OS PMO Practice provides flexible project management support across the OneSource business based on organizational priorities and need.​

title: Surfacing Artists - (Mid & Senior)
description:
At Stellar, we aim to build a studio where people actually want to work.We face the inevitable ups and downs of production as a truly supportive and connected team, prioritizing open communication over anyone working in isolation. We value honesty, creativity, and looking out for one another.

The Opportunity:

We are expanding our team and looking for talented Surfacing/Texture Artists at the Mid, and Senior levels to join us on a premium streaming series for Marvel Animation.

In this role, you are the artist who gives our worlds their tactile reality. You will be responsible for creating the look, feel, and texture of characters, environments, and objects. This role requires an incredible eye for color design, a deep understanding of material properties, and exceptional painting skills to achieve a specific "painterly" aesthetic. If you love collaborating across departments to dial in the perfect look and want to raise the bar on a new series, we want you on our team.

In this role, success looks like:

Artistic Execution & Look Development:

  • Create high-quality textures that strictly adhere to the show’s production design across sets, props, and characters.
  • Utilize excellent brushwork to express a highly stylized, painterly aesthetic.
  • Accurately read surface art references and intuitively determine their physical material components (both natural and synthetic surface characteristics).

Technical Pipeline & Optimization:

  • Dial in and modify shader networks to achieve the specified look, always keeping a close eye on how your texturing setups impact overall rendering performance.
  • Design and build basic, optimized materials that can be reused efficiently throughout the studio.
  • Actively participate in the larger departmental effort to design and test new tools and workflows that benefit the entire surfacing team.

Collaboration & Accountability:

  • Act as a self-starter who consistently meets deadlines within a fast-paced, long-format production schedule.
  • Collaborate closely and communicate effectively with Modelers, Lighting Artists, Look Dev, and Leadership (VFX & CG Supervisors) to achieve the final in-film look. (Seniors will be expected to help mentor and guide Junior artists.)
  • Take constructive guidance from the Director and Modeling &Surfacing Supervisor and other creative/technical supervisors.

The Requirements

Must-Haves:

  • Experience (Choose your level):
    • Mid-Level: 3–5+ years of production experience. You can hit the ground running, dial in complex shader networks, and require minimal supervision.
    • Senior: 5+ years of production experience. You are an expert at surfacing the most complex hero assets, optimizing render performance, and are comfortable mentoring junior artists.
  • Core Tools: Professional experience using 3D painting tools like Mari, Substance Painter, and Photoshop.
  • Artistic Eye: Strong traditional painting skills with a deep understanding of color theory and design.
  • Education: A Bachelor's Degree in 3D animation (or equivalent high-level industry experience/art school training).
  • Eligibility: Legally eligible to work in British Columbia, Canada.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Previous Look Dev experience is a definite plus.
  • The experience and technical ability to model using Maya or ZBrush.


Why Join Stellar?

  • Flexible Environment: We offer a flexible hybrid schedule that will vary with project and team requirements.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Extended health benefits.
  • Growth: Professional development support to help you stay ahead of tech and creative trends.
  • Culture: A collaborative, ego-free environment where technical expertise fuels creative magic.
Competitive salary range: $70,000 - $85,000, based on your experience and skills.

We're always looking for ways to improve accessibility, so feel free to share any feedback or suggestions with us.

title: Engineering Product Manager, Cloud Control Studio
description:
Meet the Team

The most valuable enterprise applications are built around a customer's own systems, workflows, and expertise. Cloud Control Studio gives developers, IT teams, and partners a trusted way to build, distribute, and run those applications and AI agents in production, with enterprise security and governance built in from the start.

Studio is part of Cisco Cloud Control, Cisco's unified cloud management platform. Our mission is to help customers achieve real business outcomes with applications and agents built on their own systems and expertise, by making those applications easy to create and dependable to run for every individual, team, and organization that relies on them!

Your Impact

Studio product managers own outcomes across the application lifecycle rather than individual features. This product manager role is responsible for a critical customer outcome: customers can put applications and agents to work in meaningful workflows and depend on them to run reliably, securely, and manageably across many production environments!

This is where Studio's platform value is realized and where improvements compound across every application built on it, offering broad scope to shape the product. Examples of the problems in this space include how applications are packaged, deployed, upgraded, and administered by customer IT teams; how they are governed, observed, and supported at scale; and how the platform building blocks that applications are composed of stay coherent as the platform grows. The specific mix will evolve with the product; the outcome will not.

In this role, you will work closely with senior engineering and architecture leaders who build the Studio runtime, application registry, and hosting services, while staying directly connected to the customers, builders, and IT administrators who use them. You will:

  • Lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for your area, from customer and administrator discovery through product definition, engineering delivery, production validation, and continued improvement

  • Define how applications and agents behave consistently across packaging, deployment, versioning, automated upgrades, customer administration, identity and authorization, multi-tenant boundaries, persistent data, observability, and operations, and make those behaviors platform defaults rather than per-application decisions.

  • Steward the platform building blocks that applications are composed of, so that new capabilities and runtime resources can be added by other teams while preserving one coherent customer and administrator experience.

  • Translate broad, open problems into well-scoped releases with clear acceptance criteria, sequencing decisions, and measurable exit conditions, setting clear priorities on what ships now, what is simplified, and what comes next.

  • Validate delivered capabilities in real customer workflows and environments—not only in demonstrations—using prototypes, APIs, logs, and product instrumentation to test assumptions and drive open questions to resolution with evidence.

  • Bring engineering, design, security, identity, platform, operations, and go-to-market teams to clear product decisions, and communicate direction and trade-offs credibly to executives, customers, and technical partners.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree plus 12 years of related experience, Master's degree plus 8 years of related experience, or PhD plus 5 years of related experience in product management, software engineering, or technical product leadership for software products.

  • Prior experience in software product management or equivalent product ownership, with direct responsibility for requirements, prioritization, and roadmap decisions for enterprise software.

  • Applied experience working on an enterprise application platform, developer platform, cloud platform, or multi-tenant SaaS product where third parties or customers deploy software onto your platform.

  • Experience leading at least one technically complex capability in application lifecycle management, packaging and deployment, versioning and upgrades, customer administration, runtime governance, or platform operations from definition through production launch and customer use.

  • Previous background leading cross-functional delivery with engineering, design, and at least one of security, identity, operations, or customer-facing teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 12 or more years of product management experience for enterprise software, PaaS, or cloud platform products. Experience defining a platform or extension model (capabilities, resources, manifests, contracts) that multiple internal or external teams build against.

  • Experience leading the runtime and lifecycle side of an application platform: packaging, deployment, versioning, staging/promotion, retirement, administration, support, and operations of software built by others and shaping an early-stage platform into a mature, reliable production product.

  • Technical fluency across several of the following: APIs, OAuth and identity, authorization and RBAC, multi-tenant SaaS, cloud runtimes, application data and state, security, and observability.

  • Prior experience with generative AI, agent runtimes, tool integrations, and AI-assisted software development as well as coding or prototyping experience, including productive use of modern AI coding tools.

  • Experience operating secure, multi-tenant enterprise software at scale and with application ecosystems, ISV or partner programs, or marketplaces where third-party applications are published, certified and supported along with the ability to communicate complex product and technical decisions clearly and persuasively in written and verbal form.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: (80 -100%) Global Spare Parts Forecasting Specialist
description:

This position reports to:

Service Contract Manager

The Global Spare Parts Forecasting Specialist serves as the central hub between ABB's Local Service Organizations (LSOs) across multiple countries and feeder factories supplying UPS spare parts. This role combines strategic demand forecasting with operational support for spare parts sales and service delivery. The primary focus is to ensure accurate demand signal capture, consolidation, and translation into actionable supply plans while supporting end-to-end spare parts management to achieve high-level service quality, operational efficiency, on-time delivery, order growth, and customer satisfaction.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Monitor forecasting and supply performance through KPIs and dashboards, identify demand anomalies, and drive corrective actions to improve forecast accuracy, service levels, and on-time delivery.
  • Drive continuous improvement of planning processes, forecasting tools, ERP data quality, e-commerce platforms, and automation initiatives while ensuring compliance with ABB’s HSE and integrity standards.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in spare parts planning, demand forecasting, service operations, or supply chain management.
  • Experience in power electronics, UPS, critical power systems, or industrial equipment is preferred.
  • Proficiency with ERP systems (e.g., SAP), forecasting tools, Excel/BI solutions, and e-commerce platforms.
  • Fluent English; additional European languages are an advantage.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset with the ability to develop and improve forecasting models.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-cultural communication skills, with the ability to translate complex inputs into actionable recommendations.
  • Solid knowledge of spare parts strategies, service operations, and process improvement, with a focus on service availability, delivery performance, standardization, and automation.

title: Global Packaging Transformation Workstream Lead
description:
Job Description:

Global Packaging Transformation Workstream Lead

Role Purpose

The Global Packaging Transformation Workstream Lead is accountable for defining, delivering, and embedding key strategic shifts across the packaging portfolio, with primary focus on:

  • Transitioning Paper packaging to performance-based specifications

  • Leading the business case for outsourcing of flexible bag-making operations

  • Exploring and establishing upstream buying strategies and models for flexibles & paper

The role is accountable for delivering a validated pipeline of ~$10M in savings across these initiatives, ensuring value is clearly identified, tracked, and realised.

A critical component of the role is ensuring these transformations are aligned cross-segment across Mars Pet Nutrition, Royal Canin and Mars Snacking in Europe and North America, driving harmonisation, scale benefits, and consistency in supplier engagement and operating models.

Key Accountabilities

Workstream Leadership

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of global packaging transformation initiatives across Paper and Flexible materials.

  • Define strategy in synch with Sourcing managers (seg / OE / Central), scope, roadmap, and success measures for:

    • Performance-based specification deployment

    • Flexible bag-making outsourcing model

    • Upstream sourcing strategies

  • Own and deliver a savings pipeline of ~$10M, with clear milestones, accountability, and tracking mechanisms.

  • Ensure cross-segment alignment with Royal Canin & Mars Snacking (EU & NA) to maximise scale, leverage, and standardisation opportunities.

  • Manage dependencies, risks, and resources across a complex, multi-segment environment.

Business Capability Ownership

  • Own the future-state vision for:

    • Paper specification governance and performance frameworks

    • Flexible packaging bag making outsourcing and supplier operating models

    • Upstream buying and supplier integration

  • Drive common approaches and standards across segments, ensuring alignment where value can be unlocked.

  • Ensure capabilities are designed to sustain and expand savings delivery over time.

  • Act as the primary business decision-maker for the workstream.

Packaging Strategy Execution

  • Drive the shift to performance-based specifications in Paper, unlocking cost optimisation, simplification, and innovation.

  • Lead the transition to an outsourced bag-making model for Flexibles, capturing make-to-buy efficiencies and supplier scale.

  • Develop and implement upstream buying strategies, leveraging cross-segment scale in Europe and North America.

  • Translate all initiatives into quantified financial benefits, feeding into the $10M savings pipeline.

Cross-Functional Delivery Partnership

  • Partner with Procurement, R&D, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, and Finance teams across Pet Nutrition and Mars Snacking.

  • Ensure strong financial governance and validation of savings with Finance.

  • Align digital and analytics capabilities to track:

    • Specification-driven savings

  • Supplier cost performance

  • End-to-end value delivery

Stakeholder Engagement & Alignment

  • Build strong relationships across Pet Nutrition and Mars Snacking leadership teams in EU and NA.

  • Act as a key integrator across segments, ensuring alignment on value delivery priorities.

  • Drive senior-level alignment on trade-offs between cost, service, resilience, and innovation.

Business Readiness & Adoption

  • Ensure successful adoption of new models across both segments and regions.

  • Embed cost-conscious decision-making and ownership of savings at all levels.

  • Remove barriers to adoption that may impact value delivery.

Value Delivery & Benefits Realisation

  • Define, track, and report clear financial benefits, ensuring delivery of the ~$10M savings target.

  • Establish robust governance to validate and sustain savings over time.

  • Unlock cross-segment synergies and scale advantages.

  • Continuously identify additional value opportunities beyond the initial pipeline.

Key Outcomes

Success in this role will be demonstrated by:

  • Delivery of a $10M validated savings pipeline

  • Successful rollout of performance-based specifications in Paper

  • Effective outsourcing of flexible bag-making operations

  • Strong upstream sourcing strategies with measurable impact

  • High degree of alignment with Mars Snacking in EU and NA

  • Sustainable improvements in cost, agility, and supplier performance


What are we looking for?

  • Proven knowledge and practical experience with supplier/customer management.

  • A passion for driving value for our business by leveraging various sourcing channels.

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by The Five Principles.

  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.

  • A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.

  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.

Job Description:

What’s the role

As a Laboratory Technician, you will perform laboratory testing and analysis to ensure polyethylene products meet quality standards and customer requirements at our manufacturing facility in the United States. You’ll support production by generating accurate and timely analytical data, maintaining laboratory equipment, and following established quality and safety procedures. You will also help investigate quality issues, contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, and ensure reliable product certification. You’ll be part of a collaborative team that works closely with production, quality, and technical colleagues to deliver safe, high-quality products for our customers.

What you’ll be doing

· Perform routine and non-routine testing of polyethylene products to verify compliance with product specifications and quality standards.

· Document and report laboratory results accurately and in a timely manner.

· Operate, calibrate, troubleshoot, and maintain laboratory instruments and equipment.

· Follow approved analytical methods, laboratory procedures, and safety requirements.

· Monitor product quality data and identify trends or deviations requiring investigation.

· Provide analytical support to help resolve product quality and production issues.

· Maintain a clean, organised, and safe laboratory environment.

· Prepare and standardise laboratory reagents and reference materials.

· Collaborate with production, quality, and technical teams to support operational objectives.

· Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance laboratory efficiency, accuracy, and reliability.

· Complete testing activities within required production and shipping timelines.

· Support internal and external audits by maintaining accurate documentation and demonstrating compliance with quality management systems.

· Comply with ISO 9001 requirements and site quality standards.

What you bring

Essential Requirements

  • Legal authorization to work in the United States on a full-time basis.
  • Associate degree in a scientific discipline.
  • English language proficiency with the ability to read and interpret safety procedures, technical documents, operating instructions, and laboratory protocols.
  • Experience working in a laboratory environment within manufacturing or industrial operations.
  • Knowledge of analytical laboratory techniques and instrumentation, including polymer testing methods.
  • Experience operating laboratory equipment and maintaining accurate laboratory records.
  • Knowledge of quality management systems, statistical quality control, and Good Laboratory Practices.
  • Experience using laboratory information management systems and maintaining data integrity.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across different teams.

Preferred Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific discipline.
  • Experience supporting polyethylene, polymer, petrochemical, or chemical manufacturing operations.

title: Research Assistant
description:
Garvan Institute of Medical Research brings together world leading scientists and clinicians, collaborating locally and globally, to advance our understanding of disease, particularly cancer, autoimmunity and genetic disorders. Garvan is a global leader in fundamental biomedical research and its translation. Our mission is to make discoveries that will improve health for all.

To support this vision, the Garvan Institute has established strategic programs which bring together research expertise and cutting-edge technologies from across Garvan, along with clinical, industry and consumer partners. The Cancer Plasticity and Dormancy Program, led by A/Prof Christine Chaffer and Prof Peter Croucher, is one of seven strategic programs at the Garvan Institute.

The Cancer Plasticity and Dormancy Program is focused on discovering the fundamental control mechanisms that regulate cancer cell dormancy and cancer relapse. Our goal is to develop tools to predict relapse and develop new treatments to stop relapse before it occurs. There is a focus on understanding relapse in cancers that spread to the skeleton including multiple myeloma, breast and prostate cancer. The program has recently established the AllClear program, supported by a major collaborative research accelerator grant from the National Breast Cancer Foundation, to tackle cancer relapse in breast cancer. This is a major national and international collaborative program and flagship activity for the program.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Research Assistant provides essential technical and operational support to a research laboratory or group. The primary purpose of this role is to enable and facilitate high-quality medical research while optimising productivity through technical expertise and efficient resource management. Appointees typically hold a Bachelor’s Degree or a Master’s Degree and work with an increasing sense of direction and autonomy as they gain experience. Research Assistants are appointed on a salary scale depending on level of experience, performance and requirements of the role required within the lab/group.

Salary: Up to $90,000 (depending on experience) + 14% super + salary packaging

Employment Type: 2 year fixed-term contract with possibility to extend

SNAPSHOT OF BENEFITS

  • Generous salary packaging to save you income tax on your wages thereby boosting your monthly take home pay (max. $15,900 general expenses + $2,650 meals/accom)

  • Ample opportunities for on-going training and development

  • Stimulating, diverse and highly international research environment

  • Flexible work arrangements e.g. start / finish times

  • 18 weeks paid parental leave for both parents including paid superannuation

  • A range of additional leave types to meet your personal needs including cultural leave, conference leave, community service and study leave

  • Discounted Health Insurance

  • Lifestyle discounts with our community partners

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Depending on level of experience and requirements of the role, a Research Assistant is typically expected to:

Scientific Excellence

  • Experimental Execution: Conduct experiments and analyses – including tissue culture, western blotting, and routine assays – while establishing and maintaining robust methods and protocols.

  • Optimisation: Review current protocols and relevant literature to identify opportunities to improve, optimise, or implement new research techniques.

  • Specialist Advice: Provide technical advice to researchers within the group regarding specific research methods, instruments, and analysis tools.

  • Data integrity: Ensure all research data is accurate, high-quality, and conforms to good scientific practice, ensuring it is accessible to other researchers as required.

  • Scientific Communication: Communicate experimental results to researchers and collaborators through written reports and effective visual formats.

  • Scholarly Contribution: Assist in the preparation of research papers and contribute content to grant applications and research proposals.

Team Leadership

  • Mentorship & Training: Train students, postdocs, and peers on data collection, specialised instruments, and laboratory safety protocols.

  • Personal Growth: Take responsibility for own professional development by attending workshops and seeking to learn new techniques to support the group’s evolving research needs.

  • Team Collaboration: Work effectively as a reliable and approachable member of the research team, fostering a collaborative environment.

Resources & Planning

  • Operational Management: Manage the group’s daily operations, including the coordination of consumables, samples, and equipment maintenance.

  • Lab Coordination: Manage internal communications, such as scheduling team meetings and research presentations.

  • Compliance & Outputs: Manage research data and outputs to ensure compliance with open access requirements of funding bodies and publishers.

  • Project Delivery: Balance the competing needs and timelines of multiple research projects within the lab and with external collaborators to meet deadlines.

Institute Contributions

  • Values & Integrity: Demonstrate scientific and professional integrity at all times, acting as a role model for ethical behaviour.

  • Active Participation: Contribute to the wider institute community by participating in committees, outreach projects, or donor activities.

ABOUT YOU

The key skills and experience include:

Essential

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Science or Medicine (preferably with Honours)

  • Relevant experience (at least 1 year) in cancer cell biology or immunology

  • Experience with animal models of cancer, including animal handling, dosing (IV, IP, SC), and tissue collection

  • Experience with processing human samples (blood, bone marrow, and/or tissue)

  • Experience with cell biology, immunofluorescence, confocal microscopy and image analysis, flow cytometry

  • Molecular biology skills (western blotting, qPCR)

  • Ability to rapidly learn new techniques

  • Results-oriented

  • Excellent time management and ability to prioritise tasks

  • Display innovative and proactive abilities

  • Comfortable with moderate decision making

Desirable

  • Possess strong computing skills including basic bioinformatic analysis, particularly with regard to RNA-seq methodologies

  • Experience with CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing

  • Expertise/knowledge in the field of cancer immunology or tumour microenvironment

ABOUT GARVAN

Garvan Institute of Medical Research is an independent Medical Research Institute (MRI) in Sydney, delivering scientific and clinical impact on a global basis and in partnership with organisations that share our vision. We are proud to be one of Australia’s largest and most highly regarded MRI’s.

Our vision is global leadership in discoveries to impact and our enduring purpose is to impact human health, by harnessing information encoded in our genome.

We seek to see our world-class discovery research achieve life-changing impacts, not only for individual patients with rare diseases, but for the many thousands affected by complex, common disease.

Garvan promotes a diverse workplace and is committed to the principles of equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging. We are always looking for culture ‘add’, not culture ‘fit’ and are building diverse teams with great sets of complementary styles and skills to help deliver our important work effectively.

HOW TO APPLY

To apply for this position, please submit your application with a CV and cover letter as one document, stating why you are interested in this role. We are reviewing applications as they are received. If you think you’re the right person for this role, we’d love to hear how your capabilities, achievements and experience set you apart. Only applicants with full working rights in Australia are eligible to apply for this role.

title: Supervisor, Service Desk (Temporary)
description:
Please Note: If you are a current Hydro Ottawa employee with access to Workday, apply to this job via the Workday application.

At Hydro Ottawa, we empower the lives of the people in the communities we serve.

As the electricity distributor to the Nation’s Capital, our work powers the essential activities that make up our lives - at home, at work and at play. And as Ontario’s largest municipally-owned producer of green power, we are leading the way to a greener tomorrow.

We are seeking a Supervisor, Service Desk, a change champion and innovative leader ready to embrace the opportunity to guide and mentor others, and enable them to do their best work. And in doing so, to leave a legacy.

Are you ready to make a difference in our community?

JOB SUMMARY

The Supervisor, Service Desk is responsible for the day-to-day efficient and effective operation of the Service Desk, ensuring exceptional service delivery that meets business standards and exceeds customer expectations. This role provides direct leadership to Service Desk staff, oversees workload distribution, monitors performance, and ensures timely resolution of customer requests and escalations. The Supervisor, Service Desk ensures operational consistency, regulatory compliance, and safe coordination of field-related work while maintaining strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead, coach, and supervise Service Desk staff by setting clear goals, conducting performance reviews, and providing ongoing feedback to drive accountability and ensure high quality service delivery.

  • Determine work procedures, schedules, and workflow for the effective daily operation of the Service Desk to optimize efficiency and customer service effectiveness.

  • Develop and deliver operational training, resources, and technical assistance for Service Desk staff to ensure goals and objectives are consistently achieved.

  • Act as the final point of contact for complex customer escalations, reviewing and approving responses to customers and the public regarding high-priority requests for information or complaints.

  • Oversee the coordination and approval processes for third-party permits (e.g., ESA permits) and certify/sign-off on operational removals to ensure public and employee safety and mitigate field-related risks.

  • Monitor and manage the Service Desk operating budget and allocate financial and staffing resources effectively.

  • Monitor operational performance using established metrics and analytics to measure employee productivity, quality, and overall customer service effectiveness.

  • Build and maintain strong operational relationships with internal groups (e.g., Design, Scheduling, Operations, Communications, Digital Transformation) to ensure a consistent application of corporate standards and alignment for service desk requests.

  • Stay informed of new programs, service rules, and reporting requirements for regulators and senior management, ensuring staff adhere to all health and safety standards and applicable laws.

  • Maintain in-depth knowledge of Conditions of Service, internal policies, and corporate strategic directions to guide staff, drive positive change management, and build a positive work environment.

  • As a member of the Crisis Communications Team, react quickly and effectively to crises which present a reputational risk.

  • Perform other related duties as required.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Post-secondary education in a related field, such as Business Administration.

  • Minimum 3 years’ supervisory experience in a fast-paced office environment, preferably in a customer service or contact center setting.

  • Demonstrated people leader experience combined with the ability to manage performance may substitute for academic requirements.

  • Experience managing operational crisis situations, both internal and external.

  • Experience working with cross-functional groups.

  • Strong computer skills; proficient in the use of office productivity and collaboration tools, preferably Google Workspace.

  • Proven ability to function effectively under pressure, with demonstrated experience or training in crisis management, preferably supporting a Crisis Communication Team (CCT) during large-scale events or incidents.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • English essential, both oral and written

  • Bilingual (English/French) considered an asset

This is a management group opportunity and salary will be commensurate with qualifications.

title: Actuarial Analyst - New Grad
description:
TELUS Health is empowering every person to live their healthiest life. Guided by our vision, we are leveraging the power of our leading edge technology and focusing on the uniqueness of each individual to create the future of health. As a global-leading health and well-being provider – encompassing physical, mental and financial health – TELUS Health is improving health outcomes for consumers, patients, healthcare professionals, employers and employees.

Join our team and what we’ll accomplish together

TELUS Health Consulting practice brings over 60 years of experience and innovative thought leadership to pension & savings, actuarial, compensation and overall financial well-being consulting and outsourcing. Our purpose is to improve the financial wellbeing of individuals and the organizational resilience of employers and fiduciaries. We are also one of the largest pension plan administrators in Canada, serving over five million plan participants. We are a diverse organization with unparalleled capabilities for our clients and their people.

The Defined Benefits and Actuarial Services practice within Consulting is composed of a dedicated group of nation-wide professionals with extensive experience in the fields of pension & savings and actuarial consulting. We specialize in providing strategic guidance, expert analysis, and effective risk management to help our clients offer the best pension plan for their plan members. With a deep understanding of complex mathematical models and statistical analysis, our team excels in assessing and quantifying risks in the retirement landscape. Our Defined Benefits and Actuarial Services Consulting team brings a wealth of knowledge and expertise to every engagement

Here’s the impact you’ll make and what we’ll accomplish together

Are you highly analytical, savvy with problem solving, detail oriented and a collaborative team player? If so, we are seeking an Actuarial Analyst to join our team. You will help support best in class pension programs by assessing the financial health of pension plans, conduct plan valuations, analyze funding requirements, and ensure regulatory compliance. If you are interested in learning more about the pension industry and possess the ability to provide accurate and reliable financial analysis, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity to contribute to TELUS Health.

What you’ll do…

  • Assess the financial health of pension plans by conducting regularly valuations (i.e plan assets, liabilities, participant demographics, and investment performance to determine the funding status of the plan)

  • Calculate pension benefits for a plan participant based on factors such as years of service, salary history, and retirement age; ensuring calculations comply with plan rules, government regulations, and actuarial principles

  • Help plan sponsors determine the appropriate contribution levels to ensure long-term sustainability of the plan

  • Assist in the design and modification of pension plans

You have…

  • Post-secondary education in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field

  • Successful completion of at least 2 exams from the SOA or CIA

  • Strong competency with MS Office, particularly Word, Excel and PowerPoint

What you bring…

  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data analysis and reporting

  • Continuous learning mentality; staying updated with the latest developments in actuarial science, regulatory requirements, and industry standards

Nice to Have

  • Bilingual (English and French)

A bit about us

We’re a people-focused, customer-first, purpose-driven team who works together every day to innovate and do good. We improve lives through our technology solutions and foster a culture of innovation that empowers team members to solve complex problems and create remarkable human outcomes in a digital world.

TELUS is proud to foster an inclusive culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to fair employment practices and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. We offer accommodation for applicants with disabilities, as required, during the recruitment process.

Note for Quebec candidates: if knowledge of English is required for this position, it is because the team member will be asked, on a regular basis, to interact in English with external or internal parties or to use English applications or software as part of their tasks.

title: Lead, SMC Revenue Growth
description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.


The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.


We are looking for a Lead, Revenue Growth to join Snap Inc’s global Small and Medium Customers (SMC) organization. This role will lead and launch high-growth programs to serve Snap’s global SMC audience and drive retentive revenue growth in priority business segments. Quarter-backing SMC organization’s overall strategy in each segment, this person will own retentive revenue goals for segments they own globally. And ensure that SMCs succeed by leveraging Snap to power their business’ growth.

The ideal candidate brings experience owning revenue targets and leading go-to-market initiatives, with a lens akin to driving product-led growth. They will have a proven track record in problem solving, scaling, and leading growth initiatives. They will develop, deploy and scale global programs that address the needs of SMCs in their segment - via a test and iterate framework. The role will set and own strategic go-to-market roadmaps, with clear resourcing and support from a wide array of cross-functional groups (Marketing, Operations, Product, Engineering, Advertiser Support, and Data Analytics).

What you’ll do:

  • Be the single-threaded owner for retentive revenue growth from a key SMC segment globally

  • Influence program strategy to drive business growth contributing from ideation to goal attainment

  • Influence business plans, customer and market insights, and analyze program effectiveness

  • Iterate and scale programs to grow adoption of business solutions across Snap’s platforms

  • Build relationship, strategy, and roadmapping with relevant product and engineering teams, supporting small and mid-market revenue and retention efforts.

  • Evolve segment-specific vision and solutions + service-levels needed to grow relevant outcomes for SMCs in that segment

  • Own performance measurement criteria and KPIs to track against business growth goals

  • Influence global, cross-functional teams including sales, marketing, operations, data science, and product to drive program execution

  • Present results and recommendations based on program performance

  • Drive communication and influence a broad range of stakeholders

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Experience developing playbooks for launching new products or programs, especially into SMC or high-growth consumer areas

  • High comfort with and passion for data driven decision making

  • Proven track record in running programs that are multi-geography, and complex in nature

  • Experience simplifying complexity and effectively communicating with business and technical executives, as well as external stakeholders

  • Expertise in resolving hard trade-offs; often spanning multiple weeks.

  • Experience or familiarity in working with the media or digital advertising industry

  • Ability to influence change among partner teams, in service of building new approaches and shifting the daily behaviors of a team

  • Proficiency in presentation skills and comfort presenting to and communicating with senior leadership

  • Adept at influencing product teams in building solutions for specific segments of customers (SMB or consumer space)

  • Experience leading cross-functional teams to launch new products / programs and drive results, in a rigorous KPI-driven setting

  • Proven track record in problem solving, analytical thinking, and driving strategies that are data-driven and people-informed

Minimum Qualifications:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent years of experience

Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

As a Financial Solutions Advisor Stage I (FSA I), your journey begins obtaining your Securities Industry licenses, where you receive dedicated and personalized classes for your Securities Industry Essentials [SIE], Series 7 and Series 66 Exams. Once you obtain your licenses, you will be taught the foundational skills needed to be an advisor – from acquiring, building and managing client relationships to considering a client’s complex financial picture and guiding them with advice and solutions to help them live their best financial lives, all while humanizing financial interactions. Once you have reached your key milestones, you will begin working in a financial center where you will help to deliver Bank of America’s core banking, investment solutions and approach to client care. Once you have demonstrated success as a licensed Financial Solutions Advisor Stage I, you will typically progress into the next role, Financial Solutions Advisor Stage II, where you will continue to practice the skills you’ve learned by growing and deepening relationships within a portfolio of clients. As a successful Financial Solutions Advisor Stage II, you will have the opportunity to advance in many roles within Bank of America and Merrill. title: Process Engineering Team Leader
description:
Company:

INEOS Olefins & Polymers USA

Interested in joining a winning team? A team whose employees are empowered to make a difference?

Job title: Process Engineering Team Leader

Offer Range: $160,000 - $200,000 (commensurate with experience)

Location: Alvin, Texas

Organizational Context and Job Purpose

The Olefins & Polymers USA division of INEOS is one of the largest producers of olefins and polyolefins in North America. From its manufacturing locations at Chocolate Bayou and the Battleground Manufacturing Complex, it is a merchant marketer of butadiene, ethylene, polypropylene and high-density polyethylene with annual revenue of over $4B.

The Chocolate Bayou Site is located in Southeastern Texas about 40 miles South of Houston and consists of two Olefins units that produce approximately 4bn pounds/year of ethylene, 2 Polypropylene units that produce approximately 1B pounds/ year of polypropylene, and the Light Ends storage & transfer facilities at Stratton Ridge.

How the Role Fits In

The Process Engineering Technical Team Leader provides site-wide leadership for consistent and standardized process engineering support across Olefins, Polymers, and Utilities at our Chocolate Bayo facility. The role establishes common engineering practices, assures technical rigor and process safety governance, develops process engineers, and coordinates priorities and resources to meet site needs. The Team Leader serves as the primary interface between the Production, Process Engineering team, the Technical Team, Site Leadership, Operations, Maintenance, SHE, Reliability, and Project teams.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

• The position is accountable for understanding and putting into practice the INEOS 20 Principles. Additionally, the team leader has a special responsibility to cascade the understanding of these principles through their team.

• Lead the Process Engineering function as a site-wide technical discipline, providing clear priorities, consistent expectations, and effective allocation of process engineering resources.

• Establish and sustain standardized methods, tools, calculations, documentation, and review practices for process engineering work across all operating units.

• Maintain strong interfaces with unit teams while preserving discipline governance, independent technical judgment, and consistent site standards.

• Build process engineering capability and succession depth through structured development, mentoring, work assignment, and technical progression.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

1. Team Leadership and Site-Wide Support

• Translate site priorities into an integrated Process Engineering work plan across Olefins, Polymers, and Utilities.

• Assign and rebalance work based on risk, business impact, urgency, workload, and development needs.

2. Process Engineering Standards and Technical Assurance

• Maintain standardized work practices, templates, calculations, documentation requirements, and quality checks.

• Ensure appropriate technical review of evaluations and analyses, ensure assumptions, data sources, risks, recommendations, and approvals are clearly documented

3. Process Performance, Troubleshooting, and Operating Discipline

• Lead technical challenge for complex troubleshooting across process equipment and controls

• Ensure structured problem solving is used and corrective actions are technically sound, sustainable, and verified where needed.

4. Process Safety Compliance and Risk Reduction

• Provide discipline leadership for Safe Operating Limits, operating envelopes, and associated technical bases.

• Provide process engineering support for PHAs, HAZOPs, LOPAs, MOCs, investigations, audits, and risk reviews.

5. Environmental Compliance

• Provide timely calculations, technical bases, data evaluation, and root-cause support for environmental events and permit compliance.

• Guide evaluation of process design, operating strategy, emissions reduction opportunities, and environmental improvement feasibility.

6. Continuous Improvement and Projects

• Promote technically justified improvements that strengthen process safety, reliability, environmental performance, and operating stability.

• Assure sound engineering basis, risk review input, acceptance criteria, and documentation for plant trials and technical evaluations.

7. Development of Process Engineers

• Maintain development plans that build technical skills, process safety knowledge, unit experience, business understanding, and leadership behaviors.

• Provide coaching, feedback, mentoring, peer review, and targeted training to strengthen engineering judgment and execution.

Education and/or Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering with 10+ years of relevant experience

• Demonstrated experience applying process engineering principles in chemical manufacturing or a comparable continuous-process environment.

• Demonstrated knowledge of process safety management, environmental compliance, engineering calculations, process troubleshooting, and technical documentation.

• Ability to lead, coach, prioritize, and coordinate engineers supporting multiple operating units and competing site needs.

• Strong technical judgment, written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills.

• Ability to review complex engineering work, challenge assumptions constructively, and communicate risk and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in petrochemical, refining, polymers, olefins, utilities, or similar continuous manufacturing operations.

title: Studio Coordinator- Green Hills
description:
OUR PEOPLE POWER OUR PURPOSE

The CorePower team is the heartbeat of the company. We prioritize our people first, and we are invested the employee experience so that together we can create an experience powerful enough to transform lives, including our own. We believe in the power of human connection, community, and going beyond the transactional to make a positive difference in people’s lives. Join our team and discover what happens when you ignite your intention to make a difference.

HOW WE SHOW UP

We are fiercely committed to our core values of empowering everyone, practicing gratitude, building community, growing forward and laughing together. These core values align us in service of CorePower’s higher purpose – to power love from the inside out. They are our guiding principles; internal agreements we make as a CorePower team about how we interact with each other and our students. Living our core values means they guide all our activities, define our workplace culture, and ensure there are no missed opportunities to fulfill our higher purpose.

We embrace our differences and foster an inclusive space where everyone can reach their full potential. We uplift, inspire and guide one another. We make time to share the power of yoga together, celebrate milestones and find joy in the present moment.

ROLE SUMMARY

As a Studio Coordinator (SC), you live your power by supporting the world class CorePower Yoga studio experience including coordinating studio operations and holding the studio to the highest health and safety standards. In alignment with our Core Values, you work alongside the Studio Manager to deliver results and sustained growth towards all current company and studio-level goals. In the SC role, you will learn the business and develop the skillset to operate a studio.

Studio Presence and Guiding the Student Experience

  • Act as an ambassador of the CorePower Yoga Core Values at all times and consistently inspire these values in others

  • Support the Studio Manager in achieving company and studio level goals, including membership growth, retail sales, community outreach, teacher and SET recruitment, and programming enrollment

  • Commit to flexible schedule of 18-29 hours per week in studio in support of operations coordination and teaching (if certified), include health and safety protocol execution, front desk guidance, and team support

  • Must be flexible with schedule availability within the hourly commitment in service of the studio and team

  • Responsibly run the studio, including by acting as the point of contact for students and staff when Studio Manager is not present, up to 20 hours per week

  • Support maintaining an appropriate level of studio supply inventory so that all provisions and amenities are available for students at all times including cleanliness inventory, locker room amenities, towels, programming materials, etc.

  • Engage and know your studio community consistently; greet students by name, serve as an ambassador of yoga both inside and outside of the studio, and spend quality time at the front desk fostering community

  • Support our teachers learning experience of working the POS and other pre/post class duties

Coordinate and Execute Health, Safety and Cleanliness Protocol in the Studio​

  • Uphold high standards for the studio and when on duty, ensure that the physical studio space meets the high CPY standards of cleanliness and functionality including a safe environment, optimum heat and humidity, inspiring music, and clean and clutter-free surroundings in all areas of the studio

  • Support communication around Smart Health Protocol to students upon entry and throughout their visit at CPY ​

  • Act as an extension of the Studio Experience Team (SET) including cleaning the studio, stocking amenities, and ensuring the CPY cleanliness protocol is always followed while on duty in the studio

  • Support the SET team by interviewing SET applicants, hiring SET employees, scheduling SET employee's shifts, stepping in for no call/no shows, training, and disciplining/terminating SET employees who have violated CPY's policies and standards

  • Lead Orientation for new Studio Experience Team members and train them on cleanliness protocol and role expectations

Coordinate Studio Systems

  • Act as a liaison between the Studio Manager and the teaching and SET teams in training, communicating, and coordinating studio operational systems including but not limited to:

  • Point of Sales System (POS); understand and efficiently navigate POS to sign students in, sell packages and memberships, and explore and correct problems with student accounts when at the desk

  • Online Reservation System; support administrative follow up of late cancel fees, waitlist, student support, etc

  • Subbing Application; support training and usage for teaching team

  • HRIS Application; support training and usage for teaching and SET team

  • Help Desk; Submit facilities tickets when on duty ​and communicate follow up needs to Studio Manager

Teaching Schedule

  • Support the studio class schedule by teaching a minimum of 6 classes per week of branded CorePower Yoga classes and support the studio through subbing additional classes as needed

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Must demonstrate CorePower Yoga Core Value

  • Excellent oral communication skills, professionalism and exceptional interpersonal skills are required

  • Experience in Customer Service required

  • Completion of a Yoga Alliance certified 200-hour program is preferred

  • Yoga Sculpt teacher training is preferred

  • Familiar and comfortable in studio systems such as the HRIS, intranet, point of sale systems, company scheduling and payroll systems, etc.

  • Ability to build relationships with individuals with diverse personalities and styles and at different levels of seniority

  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and can prioritize while working under multiple deadlines

  • Proven self-starter with ability to take on new projects with enthusiasm

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office products: Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel

  • Excellent Time Management skills

  • Ability to take initiative and prioritize

  • College (BA/BS) preferred

THE FINE PRINT

  • Availability must match the needs of the business and leadership zig-zag schedules – morning, evening, weekend and some holiday availability and flexibility required

  • Must be able to move around the studio space, crouch, reach, and lift up to 25 lbs.

  • If certified to teach, must be able to step in to teach class with little to no notice while scheduled in the studio

THE PERKS

  • Free All Access Membership - use anytime, in studio or online

  • Free All Access Membership for a Plus One - bring someone along!

  • Retail Discounts

  • Continued Education Offerings

  • Access to Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 1.5x Holiday Pay: Earn time-and-a-half pay for hours worked on New Year’s Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day.

WHO WE ARE

At CorePower Yoga, we live our power by showing the world the incredible life-changing things that happen when you root an intensely physical workout in the mindfulness of yoga. This is our promise. We are the nation’s largest yoga studio brand with over 200 locations across the country, digital livestream and on-demand classes, and thousands of passionate yoga teachers sharing the transformative power of our practice.

As a team, we love seeing the magic that happens in a CorePower Yoga class when physical meets mindful and strive to create a work environment that mirrors the balance, empowerment and community experienced in our yoga studios.
