Chief Security Office

The Chief Security Office (CSO) is responsible for the creation, maintenance, and implementation of the information security strategy of Deutsche Bank Group. CSO steers the measures derived from the information security strategy and provides guidance to employees regarding the identification, development, implementation, and execution of all processes which serve to reduce information security risk, to respond to incidents, and to establish appropriate policies and standards for information security management.

Role Overview

The Information Security Specialist (f/m/x) within the TDI CSO Embedded Risk Team (ERT) is responsible for driving Information Security Risk within the bank's defined risk tolerance while supporting the overall security strategy. The role acts as a key partner across all 3LoDs, ensuring effective governance, oversight, and Control linkage to Information Security Risk Findings. The role requires strong communication, stakeholder engagement, risk analysis, and management reporting skills to support senior leadership decision making and effective risk reduction.

Your key responsibilities

Providing end-to-end oversight of the Information Security Risk Finding portfolio by driving risk analytics, reporting, governance, stakeholder engagement, and continuous process improvement to support risk-informed decision-making across the organization.

  • Manage the Information Security Risk Finding portfolio, ensuring findings are linked to relevant controls from the DBs Control Inventory to identify recurring deficiencies and systemic control gaps.

  • Oversee and challenge control-linkage exceptions, coordinating timely investigation, escalation, through resolution.

  • Analyse risk themes, control weaknesses, and remediation effectiveness to identify emerging risks, recurring issues, and cross-divisional dependencies.

  • Develop risk portfolio analytics and management reporting, providing senior stakeholders with clear insights, recommendations, remediation status, and trend information to support risk-based decision-making.

  • Partner with stakeholders across all three Lines of Defense, acting as a key first-line contact for Information Security Risk Findings and supporting effective governance.

  • Drive continuous process and tool improvement by identifying enhancement opportunities and translating operational needs into clear business requirements.

Your skills and experiences

  • Strong understanding of Information Security Risk Management, knowledge of Information Security framework like ISO 27001, finding management, and remediation governance.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities, combined with experience in process improvement, business requirements definition, and effective challenge and escalation

  • Proven experience in risk analysis, identification of systemic control weaknesses, and interpretation of risk trends and dependencies.

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to collaborate globally across business, technology, control functions, and all three Lines of Defense.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex risk information into concise, management-ready insights and recommendations.

  • Experience in preparing and presenting risk reporting, portfolio analytics, and status updates to senior management, governance forums, and working groups.

  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimize workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

    Networking opens up new perspectives, helps us thrive professionally and personally as well as strengthens our self-confidence and well-being. You can benefit from PME family service, FitnessCenter Job, flexible working (e.g parttime, hybrid working, job tandem) as well as programs that foster diversity, equity and inclusion.

You can benefit from offerings such as pension plans, banking services, company bicycle or “Deutschlandticket” as well as from exclusive employee rates and personalized financial advice through our “Mitarbeiterbank”.

title: Pediatric Proton Radiation Oncologist
description:
Job Description:

The Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (BIDMC), Harvard Medical Faculty Physicians at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, Inc. (HMFP) in Boston in collaboration with the Dana-Farber Cancer Institute (DFCI) are actively seeking a full-time Radiation Oncology faculty member with interest/expertise in Pediatric Proton Radiation Oncology. This individual will serve as the Pediatric Radiation Oncology Disease Site Leader, providing clinical and academic leadership while advancing multidisciplinary care, research, and program development for pediatric patients. The primary clinical practice location will be at our Main Campuses in the Longwood Medical Area of Boston, Massachusetts.

The candidate must be a board-certified radiation oncologist and must have completed their residency in an ACGME-accredited radiation oncology program and/or fellowship in an accredited US training program. Applicants must have a demonstrated record of excellence in pediatric radiation oncology care/research and have exceptional clinical and interpersonal skills with a desire to work as part of a collegial, collaborative, multi-disciplinary team. Additionally, clinical and research expertise in proton therapy for pediatric patients is required. The successful candidate will play a key role in the development, growth and leadership of our pediatric radiation oncology program and will help shape the development of our innovative proton therapy program featuring next-generation upright proton therapy technology, including a dedicated upright CT simulator. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to the design and implementation of a cutting-edge clinical program while advancing research and expanding access to state-of-the-art proton therapy for children with cancer. The ideal candidate will contribute to our institutions’ research and teaching missions.

The selected candidate will be appointed to an academic rank of Instructor, Assistant Professor, or Associate Professor at Harvard Medical School (HMS), commensurate with a formal HMS review of the candidate’s academic accomplishments/ contributions and teaching responsibilities.

Please upload a curriculum vitae and a cover letter summarizing your clinical and research interests/background addressed to:

Mary Ann Stevenson MD PhD

Chair, Department of Radiation Oncology

Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center

Harvard Medical School

As a teaching hospital of Harvard Medical School, BIDMC and the Department of Radiation Oncology provide a clinically advanced and supportive academic environment for residents, fellows, and faculty. We’re also proud and excited to be an integral part of the landmark collaboration among Dana-Farber Cancer Institute (DFCI), Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (BIDMC), and Harvard Medical Faculty Physicians (HMFP) to establish New England’s only freestanding adult inpatient cancer hospital. The collaboration will provide unparalleled opportunities for radiation oncology and other physician specialties to be part of DFCI’s internationally recognized cancer team.

Harvard Medical Faculty Physicians at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (HMFP) is one of the largest physician organizations in New England, dedicated to excellence and innovation in patient care, education, and research. As a physician-led organization, HMFP partners with more than 2,400 providers to support the delivery of exceptional care, promote professional development, and foster balance at work and home. HMFP physicians have faculty affiliations with Harvard Medical School (HMS) and provide care throughout the Beth Israel Lahey Health (BILH) system and additional hospitals across Massachusetts.

Pay Range:

$440,000 -- $534,000

The base pay range reflects what Harvard Medical Faculty Physicians at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (HMFP) reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this role at the time of posting and may be modified from time to time. Actual compensation within this range may be determined based on several factors, including academic appointment, work experience, specialty training, geography of work location, anticipated productivity, FTE basis, and role expectations. In addition to base compensation, this role may be eligible for performance-based incentives, which may include bonuses for productivity and quality HMFP also offers a comprehensive and generous employee benefits program to eligible employees, including health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement plan(s) with employer contributions.

title: Assistant Director of Development, W.P. Carey School of Business
description:
Assistant Director of Development, W.P. Carey School of Business

The principal activity of the Assistant Director of Development is to be externally focused, with responsibility for engaging a portfolio of individuals, corporations, and foundations that have a potential affinity with ASU. The Assistant Director’s effectiveness will be evaluated on the ability to achieve financial goals and contact metrics consistent with the programs and prospects assigned.

What you’ll do

  • Create fundraising and engagement efforts for the W. P. Carey School of Business Department of Information Systems, including the Center for AI and Data Analytics. These efforts help advance the ASU Charter through philanthropy.

  • In a team approach with the Director of Development at the W. P. Carey School of Business, create fundraising and engagement efforts for three W. P. Carey School of Business areas, which include, but are not limited to: Department of Marketing, Department of Management and Entrepreneurship, and The School of Technology, Innovation, and Entrepreneurship (T.I.E.)

  • Actively engages donors, alumni, faculty, staff, and students managing a personal portfolio with a focus on securing gifts at or above the $50,000 level in accordance with performance metrics with a target fundraising goal of $500,000-$1million annually

  • Guided by the direction and scope of a prospect’s interest, collaborates with various faculty, institute/center directors, and unit-based and foundation-based fundraisers to leverage the maximum philanthropic potential of a prospect

  • Develops and submits written proposals, budgets, and other collateral materials as needed for securing philanthropic investments

  • Assists in the development and execution of strategic fundraising and engagement efforts of assigned area(s) by designing, implementing, evaluating, and refining development activities to drive donor retention, reactivation, acquisition, and pipeline growth

  • Uses the ASU Foundation (ASUF) prospect management and tracking system (i.e., Salesforce) to record and coordinate contacts and proposals

  • Ensures proper stewardship and recognition of donors in portfolio

  • Assists the development team with campaign planning and implementation

  • Participates as a member of the ASUF development team and serves as a resource to development colleagues regarding fundraising opportunities

  • Establishes strong working relationships with deans, chairs, directors, and faculty members of assigned units

What you'll need

  • Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to interact effectively with academic leadership, faculty, prospects, donors, and/or volunteers in a wide range of roles

  • Ability to conduct research, gather data, analyze information, and prepare effective, accurate, and timely reports and other documents to support development objectives

  • Database management skills

  • Ability to exercise good judgment, to demonstrate an understanding of ethics related to development activities, and to use discretion in interactions with donors, prospects, volunteers, and others

  • Ability to foster effective working relationships within a team environment

  • Community relations skills and the ability to communicate and work effectively within a diverse community

  • Program planning and leadership skills

  • Highly developed verbal and written communication skills and the ability to present effectively to small and large groups

  • Ability to maintain a high degree of confidentiality and responsibility regarding information related to Foundation and University business and confidential prospect information

  • Ability to develop knowledge of, respect for, and skills to engage with those of other cultures and backgrounds

  • Ability to represent the institution well and possess an advocate’s belief in the vision of ASU as the New American University

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and comfortable working in donor/prospect computer database systems

  • Knowledge of CRM, specifically Salesforce

Relevant qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field

  • Two (2) to (3) years of successful development experience or transferrable experience

  • Demonstrated ability in securing major grants and gifts from individuals, corporations, foundations, and other private funding sources

  • Demonstrated organizational skills and experience in managing events and other complex activities in support of development objectives

Preferred education and experience

  • Advanced degree

  • Two (2) to (3) years of successful development experience in higher education or transferrable experience

  • Knowledge of fundraising techniques, including proposal development, prospect identification, fund solicitation, database management, donor tracking, and social networking and marketing tools in higher education

Benefits

  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) plan with matching employer contribution

  • 22 days of vacation time

  • 11 holidays, including your birthday

  • Parental leave

  • Significant tuition reductions

  • Professional development is highly valued at ASU Foundation, where employees are encouraged to look across the organization and nurture new areas of interest

  • $30 bi-weekly cell phone reimbursement

About ASU Foundation

The ASU Foundation fosters partnerships between ASU and like-minded individuals, corporations and foundations who believe in ASU’s mission and provide resources for ASU to manifest its charter into meaningful impact. These partnerships empower ASU to advance student access, serve our community, protect the planet, create equity in higher education and conduct research for the public good.

At the ASU Foundation we value

Character
We prioritize character and integrity in every decision and action, establishing trust as the foundation of all that we do.

Service
We are dedicated to serving our students, donors, communities, and colleagues by fostering support and collaboration to ensure that our efforts are impactful.

Innovation
Innovation drives us to create meaningful opportunities and solutions, helping every member of our global community achieve meaningful outcomes.

Job Description Summary:

The position plays a key role in advancing public health research and community-based initiatives through data management, analysis, project coordination, and scholarly dissemination. This position supports all phases of research and evaluation projects, including literature reviews, participant engagement, partnership development, grant proposal preparation, manuscript development, and the translation of findings into actionable reports, presentations, and publications.

Job Description:

Job Duties Outlined:

Data Management & Research Activities

  • Manage, monitor, and maintain multiple online databases and assessments.
  • Collect, clean, analyze, and interpret quantitative and qualitative data to support project evaluation and reporting.
  • Perform data management, statistical analysis, and reporting using SPSS, SAS, and/or Excel.
  • Coordinate participant follow-up activities, including survey administration and response tracking to maximize completion rates.
  • Conduct, analyze, and interpret follow-up assessments to demonstrate progress made, as well as serve as a key contributor on related research publications.
  • Prepare reports, data summaries, and presentations for funders, partners, and project stakeholders.
  • Ensure compliance with research protocols, institutional policies, and the ethical conduct of research related to human subjects’ research.

Project Coordination & Partner Engagement

  • Recruit and engage community and organizational partners to support successful implementation of projects.
  • Schedule and coordinate partner trainings, outreach activities, meetings, and other events.
  • Manage continuing education credit administration through AHEC.
  • Coordinate and track payment processing to ensure timely completion of financial obligations.
  • Maintain regular communication with Research Manager, project partners, and other stakeholders regarding project activities, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Collaborate with community partners, researchers, and subject matter experts to support program implementation, evaluation, and dissemination efforts.

Scholarly Activities & Other Responsibilities

  • Conduct literature reviews to inform research studies, grant proposals, manuscripts, and program development activities.
  • Update applicable statistics, citations, and supporting documentation used in publications, reports, and funding proposals.
  • Assist with the development, preparation, and submission of grant proposals.
  • Serve as key contributor on research publications; conduct data analysis, author major sections of research paper, and responsible for publication submittals to journal for approval.
  • Lead and support special projects and technical assistance for community partners and stakeholders as needs are identified.

Company: Cobb

Position Summary:

  • This position is responsible for the daily care of flocks and proper collection and identification of eggs in the Ped Sister/Super Sister houses by performing all essential duties. Other duties may be assigned.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Collect eggs and scan barcode using handheld scanner, place in plastic flat, and mark appropriately per line identification standards and properly calculates and records number of eggs laid per flock (50%)
  • Provide daily care of flock by using calculator to properly calculate # of pounds per pen and recording, using hopper scale to weigh proper # of pounds per pen, distributing feed into feed hoppers by carrying buckets, using digital scales to obtain average weight of each flock by weighing 30 females, collecting weekly lab samples by using boot swabs for environment and cleft pallet swabs for birds, monitor flock for signs of injury/illness and report to lead/manager, and collecting, recording, and disposing of flock mortality (30%)
  • Maintains flock environment by flushing water lines weekly by turning flush valve, maintaining pen bedding and nests to animal welfare standards, and using handheld electric blower to clear dust from equipment (fans, inlets, etc.) once a week (10%)

Other duties, responsibilities, and activities:

  • Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice. Such as: Operate a high pressure and regular water hose, maintains foot pans and hand sanitizer, maintain vehicle by checking fluid levels, filters, tire pressure, and clean/disinfect to remove debris, maintains a clean and organized work area. (10%)

  • The jobsite is a biosecure environment which requires showering, changing clothing and footwear before entering the facility. Appropriate clothing and footwear are provided by the Company. No jewelry may be worn on the jobsite except for medical ID jewelry and body piercings covered by appropriate clothing. Must be willing to sign an agreement to avoid any avian species (chickens, ducks, birds, etc.). Must be willing to sign and abide by the Company Biosecurity and Company Animal Welfare Guidelines.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

  • Physical: Must use safe lifting techniques. Must regularly lift flats of eggs weighing up to 12 pounds and weigh hens (6-12 pounds). Will regularly be required to pull/push crates of eggs weighing up to 60 pounds. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand majority of shift (concrete floor); walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; balance; stoop; talk or hear. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision; distance vision; color vision; peripheral vision; depth perception; and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Tools and Equipment: Requires use of hand tools such as permanent marker, brooms, pitchfork, scissors, nail clippers, etc. and safe operation of vehicle to and from work area.
  • Environment: Required to work on wet, slippery surfaces and in hot, dry, dusty, wet and cold environments.
  • Personal Protective Equipment Required: Safety goggles and/or glasses, chemical gloves, waterproof apron, and rubber boots are required. Must wear company provided facial covering. NIOSH approved N95 particulate respirators and arm protectors may be worn as needed.
  • Chemicals Commonly Used: Disinfectants, vehicle fluids, and lubricants.
  • Safety: Team member is expected to follow all applicable safety policies and procedures. These include but are not limited to Hazard Communication, Respiratory Protection, LOTO and Personal Protective Equipment. Team member is expected to identify, address and mitigate safety related risks.

title: Sport Reporter
description:
Nine is Australia’s largest locally owned media company. We are home to premium, trusted news, sport and entertainment. Nine's assets span free-to-air television, free and paid streaming, publishing and digital audio, and digital outdoor and retail media. Our content reaches almost every Australian - meaning what we do has real impact. We bring people together, celebrate the big moments, and capture the everyday ones. As our iconic and emerging brands continue to evolve, we offer unique opportunities for you to bring fresh ideas, innovate, and make your mark on the future of Australian media.


As Australia’s most widely read masthead and number one news brand, Sydney Morning Herald is proudly committed to fearless, independent, and accurate journalism. Reaching millions each month across print and digital platforms, our newsroom offers unparalleled opportunities to contribute to a storied legacy, shape national conversations, and drive impact in the media industry.

Job Description

Reporting to the Sport Editor, this 10-month contract opportunity is an exciting role for a dynamic, multi-skilled journalist eager to lead the coverage of fast-paced sporting events. You will play a crucial role in delivering high-impact breaking news, sharp analysis and compelling features for The Sydney Morning Herald’s digital and print platforms. Bringing authority and an extensive source network to your reporting, you will thrive on setting the sports agenda.

Day-to-day you will:

  • Drive fast, accurate breaking news coverage across key sporting codes for digital and print platforms.

  • Generate unique story ideas, follow up developments and react swiftly to daily news cycles.

  • Cultivate and maintain an extensive network of contacts and sources across the sporting community.

  • Produce exclusive news reports, analytical pieces and feature stories to tight deadlines.

  • Deliver original video content and adapt reporting to suit diverse audience formats.

  • Uphold strict standards of accuracy, balance, media law and editorial ethics across all published copy.

  • Collaborate closely with newsroom colleagues.

What you'll bring:

  • Prior sport reporting experience with a strong track record of breaking news.

  • First-rate news judgment and the agility to respond instantly to developing stories.

  • Deep knowledge of major sporting codes, industry trends and key stakeholders.

  • An established network of reliable contacts and trusted industry sources.

  • Outstanding written communication skills with the ability to create engaging video content.

  • Exceptional time management skills to balance breaking news priorities with longer-term projects.

  • A collaborative mindset with a strong commitment to quality, fair and inclusive journalism.


Additional Information

How we work
At Nine, our flexible work options vary by role and team. Depending on the position, this may include flexible hours, hybrid work, or part-time arrangements. We welcome discussing your flexibility needs during the hiring process - just ask the Talent Acquisition team.

Our employee benefits include:

title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
We’re looking for a Technical Business Analyst join our team in Bradford on a permanent basis. This is a hybrid role, with two days in the office and three days working remotely each week.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a growing team, playing a key role in delivering technology-led transformation across the business.

Sitting at the intersection of business and technology, translating complex requirements into clear, actionable solutions while collaborating closely with engineering, product, and key stakeholders to bring them to life.

You’ll be working on a range of initiatives, from system enhancements and integrations to large-scale transformation programmes, you’ll help drive efficiencies, improve processes, and deliver meaningful business value.

What will you be doing?

  • Partner with stakeholders to elicit, analyse and document business and technical requirements for cloud-based and platform solutions
  • Act as the key interface between business, product and engineering teams, ensuring requirements are clearly translated into scalable, technical deliverables
  • Support delivery of solutions across a GCP-based environment, including APIs, integrations and platform capabilities
  • Produce high-quality artefacts including user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps and data flows aligned to agile delivery
  • Work closely with engineers to ensure solutions align with architecture principles, Terraform-managed infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions)
  • Facilitate workshops to define current vs future state processes, identify gaps and drive transformation outcomes
  • Support end-to-end delivery lifecycle, from discovery and design through to build, testing and release
  • Collaborate with Cloud Platform teams to ensure solutions integrate effectively with core tooling (GitHub Enterprise, Terraform, Jira, Confluence)
  • Own and manage the backlog refinement process, ensuring priorities align with business value and technical feasibility
  • Support UAT and validation activities, ensuring delivered solutions meet functional and non-functional requirements
  • Identify opportunities to automate, optimise, and drive continuous improvement across systems and processes.
  • Ensure adherence to best practices in data handling, security, and platform governance within cloud environments
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to drive alignment, maintain pace, and deliver successful outcomes

We tend to look for people with:

Essential:

  • Proven experience as a Technical Business Analyst or similar role, with exposure to product-led or product development environments
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, Kanban) and experience working in fast-paced, iterative teams
  • Proven ability to gather, analyse, and translate business and technical requirements into clear, actionable outputs.
  • Experience supporting cloud-based solutions and digital transformation initiatives
  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, from discovery through to delivery
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to solve complex problems and make data-led decisions
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence engaging at all levels including senior leadership
  • Highly organised, resilient and adaptable, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a dynamic environment

Desirable

  • Exposure to user-centred design principles and UX/UI considerations
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with awareness of AI capabilities as a plus
  • Basic understanding of programming languages such as Python or JavaScript (React)
  • Awareness of technical architecture, across both cloud and on-prem environments
  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment, or within high-growth teams

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive salary
  • 25 days annual leave with the option to purchase 5 more.
  • Enjoy your birthday off, plus receive an additional 3 days of annual leave once you reach 5 years of service.
  • Access to wellbeing and mental health benefits such as the Calm app, personal medical, critical illness cover and dental insurance, plus many more.
  • Matched pension contribution up to 10%
  • Access to our car benefit scheme
  • Access to our online learning platform to continue to develop and grow your career with us
  • The chance to join an innovative, fast-paced and passionate team

Who we are:

#LibertyBlume a Liberty Global company, is a rapidly growing business services provider, specialising in tech-enabled back-office solutions. Our mission is to deliver efficiency, scale and value to our customers through Business, Procurement and Financial Solutions. If you’re curious, customer centric and enjoy being one step ahead, join us on our scale up journey and unlock your freedom to grow!

Liberty Global is an equal opportunity employer, committed to an inclusive environment and accommodating all candidates. We’re eager to hear from you, no matter your background.

title: Leader, Semiconductor Product Engineering
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/29/2026

This role with be hybrid from one of Cisco offices in San Jose, CA, Carlsbad, CA, Holmdel, NJ or Maynard, MA

Meet the Team

Optics Operations Product Engineering team partners with cross-functional team of developing engineers to design and sustain Optical transceiver components and modules throughout their product lifecycle. Product Engineers are self-motivated, result oriented, and strong-minded engineers who adopt creativity and new ways of thinking to deliver innovative solutions.

Your Impact

Optics Operations is an organization that enables and accelerates innovation to create an unrivaled customer experience & competitive advantage for Cisco through end-to-end operation leadership and product lifecycle managements. As part of Optics Operations, you will lead and mentor a team of talented product engineers, driving AI-driven process transformation, automated yield intelligence, and Design-for-Manufacturing (DFM/DFx) methodologies within our silicon and component product portfolio. You will partner closely with engineering leaders, fab foundries, OSAT partners, and design teams to deliver breakthrough quality, maximize wafer and component yields, and ensure scalable supply chain resilience.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Lead an engineering team to deliver state-of-the-art semiconductor wafer products meeting Cisco quality and performance standards

  • Partner with cross-functional teams (design, foundry, IC packaging, test, reliability) to exceed yield, quality, and costs targets.

  • Lead the product engineering team to drive yield & Quality, implement DFx principles and manage products from initial silicon to high volume manufacturing (HVM)

  • Collaborate with design & test teams to establish manufacturing and test strategies, including DFT implementation, test hardware specs, and test program creation

  • Deliver AI-Driven process transformation to continuously improve quality, yield, and cost through test time reduction and root-cause analysis across design, fab, and packaging

  • Create and execute strategies leveraging AI-powered analytics to streamline product development, accelerate failure identification, and enhance yield management

  • Coach and upskill junior to senior engineers, fostering technical capabilities and an AI-driven mindset to maximize productivity and efficiency

Minimum Qualifications

  • MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Optical Physics, Photonics, or related engineering fields

  • 10+ years of semiconductor industry experience (mmWave, DSP, Silicon Photonics) as a technical lead, including 5+ years of direct people leadership

  • Technical expertise in semiconductor fabrication processes, wafer sort/probe testing, and advanced packaging (2.5D/3D, flip-chip, optical interconnect)

  • Proven mentoring skills with the ability to inspire and develop engineers across career stages, fostering accountability and continuous learning

  • Hands-on mastery of Statistical Process Control (SPC), Design of Experiments, Six Sigma methodologies, and yield management software (e.g., JMP, Spotfire)

  • Strategic mindset with deep silicon engineering expertise to guide engineering teams through complex projects

  • Direct experience managing technical deliverables with leading foundry ecosystems and OSAT partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python, machine learning libraries, or enterprise AI tools to automate semiconductor yield learning, test pattern generation, or anomaly detection

  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with proven ability to navigate complex matrix organizations and resolve high-stakes vendor defects

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Senior Wealth Management Reporting Analyst
description:
Who You’ll Work With:

We are seeking a Senior Reporting Analyst at the Associate Officer level to join the Consolidated Reporting team within Wealth Management Operations. This is a hands-on role within a collaborative team environment, focused on delivering accurate, high-quality consolidated reporting and responsive operational support to Financial Advisors, their Associates, and, when appropriate, Ultra High Net Worth clients.

The team partners with Addepar to provide a consolidated view of client assets across managers and custodians. The analyst will contribute across the full Addepar servicing lifecycle, from onboarding and quality control through report production, ongoing maintenance, and stakeholder support. Success requires the judgment to interpret complex case instructions, independently research issues, collaborate with the appropriate internal and external partners, determine the right resolution path, and clearly communicate findings and next steps.

This role provides broad exposure to consolidated reporting, investment data, performance reporting, complex client relationships, custodian connectivity, and wealth technology. The analyst will deepen technical and servicing expertise while building the judgment and communication skills needed to take on increasingly complex assignments and broader responsibility within Wealth Management Operations.

What You'll Do

As a member of the Consolidated Reporting team, you will work with colleagues across Operations, global reporting teams, custodians, vendors, and technology partners throughout the Addepar servicing lifecycle.

1. Client Onboarding and Implementation

  • Partner with Financial Advisors and Associates to onboard new client relationships to Addepar and support a smooth transition into ongoing servicing.
  • Interpret onboarding requirements, identify missing or conflicting information, and research custodian-specific considerations.
  • Support account setup, Letters of Authorization, account connectivity, and guidance on Addepar capabilities and limitations.
  • Research and resolve onboarding issues by coordinating with teammates and the appropriate internal or external partners.

2. Reporting Quality Control and Data Validation

  • Perform quality control for new client setups and ongoing report production.
  • Research and resolve data discrepancies, holdings or performance variances, account mapping issues, and reporting exceptions.
  • Use available resources across the team, custodians, vendors, and technology partners to determine root cause and resolution.
  • Help maintain the accuracy and integrity of client reporting data.

3. Consolidated Reporting and Custom Deliverables

  • Produce and quality control daily, monthly, quarterly, recurring, and customized consolidated reports covering internally and externally held assets.
  • Support complex client relationships and maintain an understanding of client-specific reporting and servicing requirements.
  • Contribute to reporting enhancements, process improvements, new product support, and user acceptance testing.

4. Platform Maintenance and Case Management

  • Manage account and entity updates, configuration changes, reporting modifications, and other ongoing maintenance requests.
  • Review and interpret incoming case instructions, clarify incomplete or ambiguous requests, and identify the underlying business need.
  • Take ownership of assigned requests, independently research issues, collaborate with teammates and partners, and drive work through resolution.
  • Maintain clear case notes, client-specific servicing instructions, and procedures to support transparent, team-based coverage and continuity.

5. Advisor, Associate, and Client Support

  • Serve as a knowledgeable team resource for Financial Advisors, Associates, and, when appropriate, Ultra High Net Worth clients.
  • Investigate and resolve reporting, data, platform, account feed, and operational inquiries.
  • Translate technical or operational findings into clear, practical guidance for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Communicate timely status updates, recommendations, resolutions, and next steps while managing stakeholder expectations throughout the process.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • 2 to 4 years of relevant experience in client reporting, performance reporting, investment operations, wealth management operations, or a related financial services function strongly preferred.
  • Prior Addepar experience strongly preferred. Experience with another portfolio accounting, consolidated reporting, or wealth technology platform will also be considered.
  • Demonstrated intellectual curiosity and the ability to interpret detailed instructions, navigate ambiguity, investigate beyond the obvious answer, identify root causes, independently research complex issues, and determine appropriate resolution paths.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings and recommendations clearly to Financial Advisors, Associates, clients, Operations partners, vendors, and teammates.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, responsiveness, and comfort supporting high-touch, complex relationships, including potential direct interaction with Ultra High Net Worth clients.
  • Ability to contribute effectively within a centralized, team-based servicing model, share knowledge, maintain transparent documentation, support consistent service across the group, and engage the appropriate partners or escalation resources.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, accountable, and comfortable taking responsibility for complex servicing inquiries from initial intake through final resolution while managing competing priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.
  • Strong Excel skills and proficiency with Microsoft Word and PowerPoint, with the ability to learn and navigate multiple reporting, case-management, and data platforms.

About AB

We are a leading global investment management firm offering high-quality research and diversified investment services to institutional clients, retail investors, and private-wealth clients in major markets around the globe. With over 4,000 employees across 57 locations operating in 26 countries and jurisdictions, our ambition is simple: to be the most trusted investment firm in the world. title: Data Integration Lead, Vice President
description:
Job Description:

Employer: DWS Group

Title: Data Integration Lead, Vice President

Location: Madrid

Job Code: placeholder for LinkedIn job wrapping

About DWS:

Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures – but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.

Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.

We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow.

As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

This is your chance to invest in your future.

Read more about DWS and who we are here.

Team / division overview

DWS Corporate Functions Technology operates across a hybrid landscape of DWS-managed applications, Deutsche Bank-provided technology services, cloud platforms, SaaS solutions and enterprise integration services.

This role offers a unique opportunity to help shape and implement the strategic future-state technology landscape for DWS Corporate Functions globally, working across cloud, on-premise, SaaS and enterprise platforms in a regulated asset management environment.

The Data Integration Lead will be responsible for defining and delivering the data integration architecture required to support this transformation. The role will provide technical leadership across cloud and hybrid technology ecosystems, ensuring that data can move securely, reliably and efficiently between strategic platforms, enterprise services and business-critical applications.

Your responsibilities –

As Corporate Functions Data Integration Lead, Vice President, you will:

  • Define and evolve the enterprise data integration architecture and roadmap for DWS Corporate Functions across cloud-native, hybrid, SaaS and on-premise ecosystems.
  • Lead architectural decisions for strategic integration scenarios, including GCP-to-GCP, GCP-to-on-premise, application-to-application, batch, real-time, event-driven, API-led and CDC-based data integration.
  • Establish standards, frameworks, reusable patterns and best practices for data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, distribution and integration across strategic platforms.
  • Drive modernisation from legacy ETL platforms towards cloud-native integration services, ensuring migration choices are pragmatic, controlled and aligned to DWS architecture, risk and operational resilience expectations.
  • Provide technical governance and design assurance across major initiatives, challenging solution designs where needed and ensuring alignment with agreed architecture principles and engineering standards.
  • Lead the design of near real-time and real-time data processing solutions, including streaming pipelines, low-latency feeds and event-driven services where these are the right architectural fit.
  • Oversee the design of reliable, scalable and observable data feeds for market, reference, position, transaction, investment and operational data.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership for strategic initiatives, including design reviews, proof-of-concept work, complex issue resolution and guidance on implementation quality.
  • Partner with engineering teams, platform owners, architects and business stakeholders to ensure integration solutions are secure, resilient, scalable and operationally supportable.
  • Mentor engineering teams and promote engineering excellence, including DevOps, CI/CD, automation, observability, documentation and platform modernisation practices.
  • Own technology risk, controls, architecture review outcomes and operational stability for integration solutions within the role’s scope.
  • Provide clear updates, recommendations and technical leadership to senior management on integration strategy, delivery progress, risks and key decisions.

We are looking for

  • 10+ years' experience in data integration, ETL, enterprise data engineering or integration architecture, with evidence of operating at senior technical leadership level.
  • Strong practical understanding of Google Cloud Platform services relevant to data engineering and integration, including GCS, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Composer, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions and Kubernetes.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise integration and data movement platforms such as StreamSets, Informatica PowerCenter / IICS, uFlow or comparable workflow orchestration technologies.
  • Proven experience architecting and delivering streaming data pipelines using technologies such as Kafka, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Spark Streaming or comparable event streaming platforms.
  • Strong understanding of event-driven architecture, message-based processing, API-led integration, microservices-based data exchange, and CDC patterns.
  • Experience designing enterprise integration frameworks, reusable components, data ingestion patterns, transformation services and distribution platforms.
  • Experience designing high-volume enterprise data feeds and low-latency data processing solutions in complex hybrid-cloud environments.
  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.
  • Strong engineering capability in at least one modern programming language, preferably Python, with the ability to review, guide and challenge implementation quality.
  • Good understanding of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, data lineage and master data management concepts.
  • Experience with Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, cloud-native design and operational observability practices.
  • Experience working in regulated financial services, preferably within Banking, Asset Management or Wealth Management.
  • Understanding of Asset Management business processes and data domains would be advantageous.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Relevant cloud, data engineering or integration architecture certifications would be advantageous.

What we’ll offer you:

At DWS we’re serious about diversity, equity and creating an inclusive culture where colleagues can be themselves and it’s important to us that you enjoy coming to work - feeling healthy, happy and rewarded. At DWS, you’ll have access to a range of benefits which you can choose from to create a personalised plan unique to your lifestyle. Whether you’re interested in healthcare, company perks, or are thinking about your retirement plan, there’s something for everyone.

DWS’ Hybrid Working model is designed to find the right balance between in-person collaboration and engagement in the office, which is core to our working culture, and working from home. Each business group varies on the split between time spent in the office and at home, but this will be discussed and made clear as part of your application and interview process. We will continue to review and evolve our working environments and methods to ensure that we are working in the best way possible for our people.

If you require any adjustments or changes to be made to the interview process for any reason including, or related to a disability or long-term health condition, then please contact your recruiter and let them know what assistance you may need. Examples of adjustments include providing a change to the format of the interview, or providing assistance when at the DWS office. This will not affect your application and your recruitment team will discuss options with you.

We at DWS are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, one that embraces dialogue and diverse views, and treats everyone fairly to drive a high-performance culture. The value we create for our clients and investors is based on our ability to bring together various perspectives from all over the world and from different backgrounds. It is our experience that teams perform better and deliver improved outcomes when they are able to incorporate a wide range of perspectives. We call this #ConnectingTheDots.

title: Healthcare Contracting Analyst
description:
SUMMARY: The Contracting Analyst reports to the Director, Contract Analytics and Modeling. Under general supervision, produces financial and statistical reports and analytics. Assists in the establishment of appropriate contract rates and reimbursement structures and evaluates existing contract performance as well as forecasting impact of proposed contract rates. Builds and maintains payer contract models in the contract management tool. Designs and prepares accurate, timely and actionable analyses, financial models, dashboards and reports that effectively support payer contract negotiations and payer relations strategies and decision-making. Conducts research and generates analytics to evaluate the drivers of key trends that impact contract margin performance, synthesize findings and identify risks and opportunities. Implements and validates payer contract model terms, including the assessment of payment variances for revenue optimization. Brown University Health employees are expected to successfully role model the organization's values of Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence as these values guide our everyday actions with patients, customers and one another. In addition to our values, all employees are expected to demonstrate the core Success Factors which tell us how we work together and how we get things done. The core Success Factors include: Instill Trust and Value Differences Patient and Community Focus and Collaborate RESPONSIBILITIES: Conducts in-depth reviews and analysis on the cost and utilization of contracts. Provides financial analysis to support contract negotiations and compliance, including fee-for service, bundled payments, shared savings, and capitated contracts. Completes annual reconciliations and settlements. Identifies and isolates problems/potential problems, issues and areas for financial improvements. Recommends and implements necessary changes. Develops financial strategies, plans and forecasts for all fee-for-service and alternative payment models. Develops computer models and reports for tracking and evaluating performance of contracts, including risk-based contracts. Assists in the planning and development of negotiation scenarios, i.e., modeling various payment alternatives. Works with payer representatives to solve problems, issues. Maintains effective relationships with the clinical and physician leaders, IPAs and Health Plans, system affiliates, Corporate Services Finance Department, plan representatives and Contract Managers. Maintains departmental database to track financial performance of contracts. Oversees contract reporting and quarterly performance reports. Prepares financial and statistical reports. Prepares and distributes affiliate contract financial reports. Prepares simulation models and financial Executive summaries. Functions as the finance liaison with health plan representatives. Leads finance and/or reporting teams of various contracts. Participates in team/staff meetings. Participates in councils and other such committees as required. Provides value-added analytic support in the development and monitoring of standard and ad hoc cost and utilization reporting. Identifies and understands the trends and patterns of utilization and evaluates clinical/medical management programs and initiatives. Performs complex analyses. Interprets trends, regulatory changes, and/or forecasts, and anticipates impact for members. Participates in the development and ongoing enhancement of revenue, cost and utilization reporting to meet the needs of medical managers as well as business and finance managers. Analyzes and interprets cost utilization information; identifies key drivers and underlying issues; performs appropriate drill down queries; summarizes and present findings and opportunities. Works with member/client to implement identified opportunities and make recommendations to management and members and provide guidance in selecting alternatives for costs savings and efficiency. Leads the development of contracting reports, analysis and financial reconciliations required to understand the key drivers of the relevant business unit or service line. Helps to develop the systems and processes that are the foundation for reporting and analysis. Participates as a content expert in key forums and meetings with Senior Leaders, Directors, Managers, Medical Directors and other Executives. Designs and creates charts, graphs, tables and reports to support findings and develop recommendations. Supports evaluation of new and existing business opportunities through scenario modeling and financial analysis. Provides input for budget/forecast revenue and cost projections. Provides input for profitability projections and pricing strategy. Identifies and reports quality risks related to contract reporting. Ensures that related information is obtained, documented in detail, tracked and available for access and quality review. Works closely with the Central Business Office, Strategic Business Planning, Reimbursement/DSDS, Managed Care Contracting and Utilization Management departments to identify revenue and cost savings opportunities, support new product and business development, regulatory compliance, contract negotiations and reconciliation of incentive arrangements with other payers and vendors. Drives the development of appropriate program metrics and outcomes during the design phase of new clinical programs with an understanding of available and reliable data. Develops data queries; conducts rigorous analyses using appropriate statistical methods; interprets results and presents findings to leadership. Collaborates with outside program vendors in analyzing and interpreting outcomes of vended programs. Quantifies the impact of clinical initiatives on overall medical expenses and trends and works with finance and budget staff to incorporate into the appropriate financial and budget reporting. Develops and maintains strategic pricing model to produce various pricing scenarios using core variables (current price, market, cost, fee schedules, and Payor mix). Provides analytics to support the development of rational strategic and defensible pricing strategy recommendations and coordinates annual strategic pricing review. Recommendations will be based on assessment of charge structure compared to peer hospitals, internal cost accounting data, and claims level data. Analyzes chargemaster accuracy in accordance with regulatory requirements, compliance requirements, and appropriateness of bundling/unbundling. Develops processes and analyzes day-to-day charge master pricing requests and works with PFS to implement related changes. Reviews annually the CPT/HCPCS codes and revenue code updates. Creates ad hoc pricing reports summarizing benchmarking, cost, and revenue data. Performs other related duties as required. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: BASIC KNOWLEDGE: Bachelor's Degree in Business, Finance, Health Administration or related field. EXPERIENCE: Four to six years of experience in healthcare with a heavy emphasis in one of the following areas: reimbursement, contracting, financial analysis or forecasting. Strong understanding of provider reimbursement methodologies and managed care programs and contracts. Strong analytical skills, including the ability to understand complex concepts, develop analyses that are responsive to business needs, and summarize relevant findings in a clear, concise manner. Highly proficient in Microsoft Office, specifically MS Excel, Access and PowerPoint. Experience in Allscripts EPSi decision support tool preferred. Highly organized with strong project management skills, including the ability to meet deadlines, effectively communicate with all levels of the organization, and work as part of a team. title: Global Corporate Coverage Associate– Non-Bank Financial Institutions
description:
Job Description:

Job Title Global Corporate Coverage – Non-Bank Financial Institutions

Corporate Title Associate

Location New York, NY

Overview

At the heart of Deutsche Bank’s client franchise is the Corporate Bank, a market leader in risk management for FX and Rates, Cash Management, Trade Finance & Lending, Trust & Securities Services. Focusing on the Treasurers and Finance departments of corporate and institutional clients across the globe, our universal expertise and global network allow us to offer truly integrated and effective solutions.

Coverage teams provide clients with full access to the expertise of the Corporate Bank and Investment Bank. Our Non-Bank Financial Institutions (NBFI) Coverage group focuses on offering corporate banking solutions to large international Alternative Asset Managers, Insurance companies, Market Infrastructure companies, Hedge Funds, Traditional Asset Managers, Pension Funds, and Specialty Finance companies.

What We Offer You

  • A diverse and inclusive environment that embraces change, innovation, and collaboration
  • A hybrid working model, allowing for in-office / work from home flexibility, generous vacation, personal and volunteer days
  • Employee Resource Groups support an inclusive workplace for everyone and promote community engagement
  • Competitive compensation packages including health and wellbeing benefits, retirement savings plans, parental leave, and family building benefits
  • Educational resources, matching gift, and volunteer programs

What You’ll Do

Deutsche Bank is looking for an experienced senior Associate to join the NBFI Coverage team in New York. In this capacity, you will be required to support lead coverage bankers in developing and cultivating strong client relationships with assigned Non-Bank Financial Institution clients in the sector. Responsibilities will include producing accurate and timely analysis of clients, compiling competitor data, producing pitch book presentations, and supporting our clients with ad-hoc queries around our services. In this role you will develop a good understanding of the origination processes, product offerings, and the preparation of internal desk reports and pipeline deals to reflect the contribution of the NBFI Group to the broader coverage universe.

As a senior Associate, you will be responsible for supporting the build out of the Insurance sector vertical, which will encompass Life & Annuity Insurers, Property & Casualty, Insurance Brokers and Reinsurers. In this capacity you will directly assist the sector head and other senior industry bankers with origination activities, strategy, compliance, KYC due diligence, business management, and first line of defense risk management - financial, non-financial, and credit.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensure, in close cooperation with Global Coverage Banker (GCB), that Deutsche Bank is the provider of choice for clients and that all avenues for working with our clients across different geographies and products are explored
  • Support the execution of the Global NBFI coverage strategy, inclusive of all NBFI sectors
  • Assist senior bankers in the coverage, origination, and relationship management efforts for NBFI clients across Deutsche Bank’s global product suite with a particular focus on Corporate Bank solutions, including Cash Management, Trust & Securities Services, FX & Rates Hedging, Strategic Corporate Lending, and Trade Finance & Lending
  • Contribute to the development of marketing materials and the build-out of Deutsche Bank’s NBFI Coverage franchise and reputation in the market
  • Maintain and ensure adherence to high standards in the production of internal and external materials, including but not limited to pitch decks, product pamphlets, brochures, strategy, and business review pages across the team
  • Attend and hold an active role in client dialogue alongside GCBs to build relationships with existing and potential clients whilst actively driving meeting preparations and key follow ups; at times, will lead execution discussions with clients and serve as a proxy to GCBs in internal and external settings
  • Develop productive relationships with other colleagues across divisions to ensure clients receive seamless service across all products
  • Pro-actively develop understanding of Corporate Bank products and solutions for NBFIs
  • Build and maintain industry, market, and regulatory expertise for NBFIs and Insurance clients to maximize sector penetration and identify revenue opportunities
  • Support the onboarding process for clients (working closely with KYC and control colleagues), responding to internal/external stakeholder queries to ensure a timely and efficient process
  • Establish and maintain KYC profiles and other required client information in accordance with the Bank’s policies and procedures of regular review of KYC information

Skills You’ll Need:

  • Proven experience within financial services (preferably Corporate Banking) with an understanding and interest in NBFIs and experience at Associate level in a comparable role.
  • Prior knowledge of Insurance Companies and Insurance Brokers is preferred
  • Pro-active networking skills and an accessible approach to working with colleagues across the business and in other regions
  • Good project management skills and ability to work autonomously
  • Understanding of credit fundamentals for NBFI clients (preferably Insurance)
  • Strong quantitative, numerical, and analytical skills with Excel-based modeling experience
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to synthesize complex problems into elegant and concise conclusions
  • Strong commitment to integrity, professionalism, and teamwork
  • Understanding of KYC, AML, risk management and risk mitigation
  • Academic degree with outstanding credentials and relevant finance or economics experience
  • FINRA Series 63 and 79 license holders preferred (will be required)

Skills That Will Help You Excel

  • Fast learner with problem-solving skills and ability to synthesize data accurately and concisely​
  • Ability to connect and build strong relationships with others, with effective verbal and written communication and presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills: effective and concise communicator at all levels, both verbal and written

title: Software Engineer, Inference Systems
description:
At River AI, our mission is to create personal AI owned and shaped by each individual. To achieve this, we are rewriting the entire stack from scratch: personal hardware for local inference, bespoke training infrastructure, next-generation UIs, and frontier deep learning research.

Who we are

We are scientists, engineers, and builders from the industry's top tech companies and AI labs. We bring a proven track record of scaling consumer systems for hundreds of millions of users and architecting the pre-training infrastructure behind today's frontier models.

About the Role

We are looking for exceptional inference systems engineers to build the engines that serve large models through the River API. Your goal is to deliver fast, reliable inference while making efficient use of GPU compute and memory.

You will take ownership of the serving runtime, from request scheduling and continuous batching to KV-cache management, distributed model execution, and checkpoint loading. Your work will support both customer-facing inference and the sampling workloads that power reinforcement learning.

Working closely with GPU kernel engineers, researchers, and infrastructure engineers, you will bring new models into production and improve their performance across realistic workloads. You will measure success through latency, throughput, reliability, and cost, with careful attention to numerical correctness and model behavior.

What You’ll Do

  • Optimize inference for dense and mixture-of-experts models, including fine-tuned models and adapters.
  • Improve batching, caching, and admission control to balance throughput, latency, memory use, and fairness.
  • Accelerate multi-GPU execution, communication, and model loading while preserving model-version consistency.
  • Improve RL sampling throughput while keeping samples and log probabilities tied to the correct model version.
  • Build reliable streaming, cancellation, and recovery under failures and overload.
  • Profile bottlenecks and validate improvements through reproducible performance and correctness tests.

Skills & Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience building inference engines or performance-sensitive distributed services.
  • Strong understanding of transformer inference, GPU memory, concurrency, and networking.
  • Proficiency in Python and C++ or Rust.
  • Strong debugging and profiling skills across models, runtimes, and services.
  • A collaborative mindset and strong ownership of engineering outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications: (We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all of these)

  • Experience extending SGLang, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or similar frameworks.
  • Work on advanced serving techniques, such as speculative decoding or disaggregated prefill and decode.
  • Familiarity with expert parallelism, GPU collectives, and quantized inference.
  • Experience with multi-adapter serving, dynamic checkpoint loading, or RL sampling.
  • Familiarity with CUDA graphs, custom kernels, and NVIDIA profiling tools.
  • Experience operating model-serving systems under production traffic.

Logistics & Benefits

  • Location: Palo Alto, California.
  • Compensation: $200,000–$420,000 USD annual base pay, depending on experience and skills.
  • Benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited PTO; and relocation assistance as needed.
  • Visa Sponsorship: We sponsor visas and support the process for the right candidate.

description:

We invest in contemporary and emerging technology each year to support the Federal Reserve and our economy, and we’re building a dynamic and diverse team for our future.

The Identity & Access Management (IAM) team is seeking a people manager to lead a technical, agile team that supports our access management services during a pivotal transformation period. This role offers a unique chance to shape technical skillsets and cultivate a high-performing team culture in an organization that's modernizing its security infrastructure. The IAM function is evolving. As we migrate to cloud and new Colo data centers, as well as implement zero-trust architecture, we need a leader who can demonstrate technical vision, partner with product and agile professionals, and support people development. This role is part of the Information Security & Policy portfolio within System IT.

Key Activities

  • Leads and develops staff to drive progress toward key outcomes, ensuring goals and priorities align with the organization's mission and strategic direction.

  • Builds and applies business expertise and broad perspective to influence and advance organizational strategy and goals.
  • Collaborates with leadership colleagues across the organization to build shared understanding of people practices, processes, and terminology, fostering a cohesive employee experience.
  • Promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by respecting varied backgrounds and experiences, and ensuring all employees have the opportunity and resources to contribute, influence, and succeed.
  • Establishes trust and confidence by fostering positive relationships and maintaining effective communication across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Empowers teams to self-organize and make decisions, removing obstacles and developing an environment where creativity thrives.
  • Champions agile principles and practices to drive continuous improvement, adaptability, and innovation across teams.

Key Characteristics

Talent Development:

Provides ongoing coaching, mentorship, and constructive feedback to support employee growth and performance. Creates individualized development plans and identifies growth opportunities to expand employee capabilities and support career progression. Builds a strong talent pipeline by identifying and preparing high-potential employees for future leadership roles. Delegates meaningful work and empowers employees to take ownership, build confidence, and drive decision-making. Ensures equitable access to development opportunities and fosters a culture of continuous learning across all employees.

Strategy Implementation:

Provides strategic input to drive department results. Develops and communicates a clear strategic vision that aligns with organizational mission and long-term goals. Collaborates across teams and functions to ensure strategic initiatives are integrated and aligned organization-wide. Partners with product managers and delivery partners to ensure direct team is supporting goals aligned with strategic roadmaps and priorities.

Influence and Communication:

Demonstrates advanced written and verbal communication skills, consistently engaging diverse audiences and adapting communication style across various settings and groups to maximize effectiveness. Effectively navigates and manages difficult conversations with confidence and professionalism. Collaborates consistently with peers and senior leadership to identify and implement effective solutions. Partners with leadership across product and delivery teams to discuss, review, and advance IAM strategic roadmap initiatives.

Business Breadth/Depth:

Possesses strong knowledge of the business line's core functions, products, and processes, along with a working understanding of related business areas and their interdependencies. Drives organizational change by leading skill development and workforce planning initiatives within access management and security disciplines. Leverages business knowledge to optimize resource allocation, operational efficiency, and workforce planning within the business line.

Independence and Judgement:

Executes responsibilities independently with limited oversight, proactively taking ownership of assignments. Identifies and addresses problems decisively, taking timely, appropriate action while involving others when needed to leverage diverse talents and skills; makes and influences decisions that drive business results. Weighs risks, benefits, and business impact when making decisions, ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Applies critical thinking to evaluate options and determine the most effective course of action.

  • Typically requires at least 6 years in a formal leadership role or relevant informal leadership experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university, or equivalent combination of directly related education and/or work experience.
  • Strong leadership and team-building capabilities
  • Strong risk assessment and decision-making skills
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong project management and organizational abilities
  • Agile mindset and experience operating within a kanban or scrum team preferred
  • Understanding or experience with IAM platforms preferred
  • Understanding of compliance frameworks (NIST, SOC 2, etc.) preferred

description:

Acts as a trusted extension of the Executive Office by ensuring the Principal’s security, punctuality, and privacy through expert executive protection, discreet transportation, and the careful management of highly confidential matters. Exercises exceptional judgment and discretion while supporting seamless executive operations and sustaining the highest standards of confidentiality.

This position has regular access to confidential, proprietary, and personal information. The selected individual must sign a Non‑Disclosure Agreement (NDA) and adhere to strict confidentiality standards during and after their employment.

Job Description:

  • Ensures comprehensive executive safety by proactively managing safety and risk, assessing routes and environments, coordinating with security personnel and authorities, and maintaining readiness for effective emergency response.

  • Monitors the Principal’s wellbeing, privacy, and day‑to‑day safety by maintaining vigilant situational awareness and upholding strict confidentiality during all movements and appearances.

  • Maintains secure, punctual, and discreet transportation by keeping the vehicle in excellent condition, planning optimized routes, and ensuring all documentation and driving practices remain accurate and compliant.

  • Executes special and confidential assignments for the Principal or Executive Assistant with precision, safeguarding sensitive information and exercising sound independent judgment when rapid decisions are required.

  • Supports Executive Assistant–delegated operational priorities by coordinating effectively with vendors, drivers, and security personnel, and ensuring timely communication of updates, changes, and incidents.

  • Optimizes executive logistics by functioning as a reliable, discreet extension of the Executive Assistant, adapting fluidly to shifting demands, and maintaining seamless support for daily CEO operations.

  • Supports daily operational continuity by aligning logistics with the Principal’s evolving priorities, providing support to family members or guests as needed, and reinforcing best practices through guidance to designated support partners.

  • Ensures strict compliance with organizational policies, safety and privacy requirements, and transportation regulations to uphold secure and lawful operational standards.

  • Supports emergency preparedness and operational continuity by participating in required safety drills and assisting in response actions during weather-related or critical incidents.

  • Executes supplementary duties as assigned to uphold the role’s flexible and trusted nature, ensuring responsive support during evolving operational demands.

  • Performs additional duties as assigned, consistent with the role’s flexible and trusted nature.

Additional Job Description:

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Administration, Security or related field from an accredited institution.

Experience

title: Human Capital Business Partner - Associate Director
description:
Position Overview

Apollo is a high-growth, global alternative asset manager. In our asset management business, we seek to provide our clients excess return at every point along the risk-reward spectrum from investment grade to private equity with a focus on three investing strategies: yield, hybrid, and equity. For more than three decades, our investing expertise across our fully integrated platform has served the financial return needs of our clients and provided businesses with innovative capital solutions for growth. Through Athene, our retirement services business, we specialize in helping clients achieve financial security by providing a suite of retirement savings products and acting as a solutions provider to institutions. Our patient, creative, and knowledgeable approach to investing aligns our clients, businesses we invest in, our employees, and the communities we impact, to expand opportunity and achieve positive outcomes.

The Apollo Human Capital team is responsible for managing HC processes and strategic initiatives which span the employee lifecycle, including talent acquisition, onboarding, training and development, performance management, organization planning, compensation, analytics, immigration, and employee engagement. Come to Apollo and join a community of extraordinary people who are committed to a culture of excellence and collaboration in everything that we do. We invest in our people for the long term and are committed to supporting their development at every stage of their career.

You will partner closely with business leaders, employees, and Human Capital colleagues to build trusted relationships, drive key people initiatives, and take increasing ownership of business and stakeholder relationships as you develop in the role.

  • Partner with HC Business Partners to execute critical Human Capital priorities, including analytics, culture and engagement, performance management, training and development, and employee relations, with increasing ownership of key initiatives and stakeholder relationships over time.

  • Build trusted relationships with managers and employees across the business, serving as a point of contact and advisor on Human Capital matters.

  • Analyze Human Capital data to identify trends, develop thematic insights, and inform business and talent decisions.
