About Us

DO YOUR CAREER JUSTICE! Each and every day, North Carolina's courts help provide safety for our communities, prosperity for our economy, and protection for the rights, liberties, and freedoms that sit at the foundation of our state and federal constitutions. Consider an exciting and rewarding career with us and join the more than 7,000 elected officials and employees who make up our workforce and help us ensure that justice is administrated without favor, denial, or delay.

Description of Work

SALARY RANGE: $58,035.00 - $92,082.00

The Guardian ad Litem Program Supervisor serves as a manager for cases in abuse, neglect, and dependency (AND) court for child client cases our program is appointed to represent. This includes recruiting, training, and supervising child advocate volunteers in their advocacy for child clients. The supervisor may directly serve child clients in cases without a child advocate volunteer. Work may include travel in the district as well as in other areas where a child may be placed by the county child welfare agency or the court. This position is stationed in McDowell County and will require travel in and out of state.

Knowledge Skills and Abilities/Management Preferences

Duties include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Plan and facilitate training for prospective child advocate volunteers (GALs).

  • Review juvenile petitions and assign cases to the guardians ad litem. Reassign cases, as necessary.

  • Triage cases without child advocate volunteers by investigating issues, visiting child clients, and interviewing people with relevant information needed to effectively advocate for the children whose cases you may be assigned to manage.

  • Manage appointment and release orders for child advocate volunteers, staff, and the program. Track case assignments and develop strategies for case assignment in consultation with the District Administrator.

  • Support the attorney advocate in his/ her role by conferring on case issues and ensuring necessary documents and court reports are prepared and available for court. This includes entering records in Enterprise Justice.

  • Supervise child client cases, with or without child advocate volunteers appointed.

  • Coordinate court docket with the juvenile clerks, guardians ad litem, and attorney advocates.

  • Notify child advocate volunteers and staff of scheduled and ad hoc reviews, conferences, staffings, and hearings.

  • Under direction of the District Administrator, visit child clients, prepare court reports, and attend court prepared to testify. Provide case management for other court proceedings for staff and volunteers.

  • Enter and review data from court dockets and Enterprise Justice to ensure cases comply with statutory requirements.

  • Maintain child client files in accordance with state laws, NC State Bar Rules and Advisory Opinions, NCGAL policies and procedures, NCAOC Record Retention Schedule, and requirements of State Archives.

  • Work with staff and statewide Committees on recruitment and training. Schedule training and track completions for attendees.

  • Handle other duties, as assigned by the District Administrator, Regional Administrator, State Office Staff, or district staff.

This position is stationed in the McDowell County Office.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities / Competencies:

Knowledge of: office practices and procedures to organize and maintain the office; Microsoft Office platform; Enterprise Justice; accurate data collection and entry practice; the mission and responsibilities of the NC Guardian ad Litem Program; federal child welfare law and practice; NC General Statutes and Chapter 7B (child abuse, neglect and dependency law); court practice, processes and responsibilities; NC Administrative Office of the Courts policies and procedures, NCGAL policies and procedures, and other general governing policies as to how work is to be performed; supervision techniques and practices; adolescent development and behavior; family dynamics; trauma-informed practices; effective public speaking, including testifying in court; excellent verbal and written communication skills; and acknowledge of community resources.

Skills in: leading, coaching, and motivating guardians ad litem or staff; organizing and assigning tasks; analyzing and resolving issues; interviewing; expressing ideas clearly in written and verbal form; managing crisis situations calmly; establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with attorneys, judicial officials, local agencies, media and the general public which will encourage positive outcomes for the child clients the NCGAL Program represents. Demonstrated success with developing positive and purposeful relationships with agencies, people, and clients for positive outcomes.


Ability to: supervise guardians ad litem and evaluate their performance; provide guidance to guardians ad litem in writing investigation plans, reports to the court, and make recommendations to the court in the best interest of children; provide creative leadership in recruiting, supervising, and maintaining guardians ad litem; speak effectively in public; clearly express ideas orally and in writing, establish and maintain effective working relationships with others.

What you’ll be doing

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer – Platform as a Service (PaaS)

Meet the Team

You will join the Platform as a Service (PaaS) team, the backbone of our digital infrastructure. We manage a diverse ecosystem of platforms, including API Gateways like Mule and Mashery, messaging systems like Kafka, and other middleware systems. As a senior member of this team, you will lead the evolution of our internal platforms, driving the transition toward No-Ops and AIOps to ensure our infrastructure is as intelligent as it is scalable.

Your Impact

You will take ownership of the full-stack lifecycle of our platform offerings. From designing intuitive UI/UX interfaces for platform consumers to architecting the backend services that power our initiatives, your work will directly impact client productivity and system reliability. You will lead technical direction, mentor junior engineers, and champion architectural standards that allow us to scale seamlessly.

  • Platform Architecture: Design and maintain scalable PaaS solutions, including API Gateways (Mashery, Mule) and Kafka messaging clusters.
  • Full Stack Development: Build and maintain platform portals and dashboards using UI/UX technologies (Angular, React, Figma) and robust backend services (Python, Go).
  • Operational Excellence: Manage CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Argo CD, and Argo Workflows to ensure seamless delivery and deployment.
  • AI/ML & AIOps: Drive the migration toward AIOps and No-Ops by integrating ML models to automate monitoring, incident response, and infrastructure optimization.
  • System Design & Ownership: Lead complex system design sessions, ensuring high availability, security, and performance across all platform layers.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Act as a technical lead, conducting code reviews, establishing best practices, and mentoring junior engineers to foster a culture of technical excellence.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a liaison between infrastructure, SRE, and software engineering teams to translate business needs into robust technical solutions.
  • On-Call Support: Provide proactive on-call support for platform services, ensuring high availability and rapid resolution of operational issues to maintain service level objectives.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record in full-stack development and platform engineering, including 1+ years in machine learning-related roles.
  • Expertise in building modern, user-centric interfaces using React or Angular, supported by Figma design workflows.
  • Deep proficiency in Python and/or Go for backend service development.
  • Experience managing and optimizing Postgres and MongoDB databases.
  • Advanced skills in CI/CD automation with Jenkins, Argo CD, and Argo Workflows, with a good understanding of Kubernetes-based deployment solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Good experience with Kubernetes and good understanding of API Gateways (e.g., Mashery, Mule) and messaging platforms (Kafka).
  • Experience with building AI products and workflows, including LLMs, LangChain, RAG systems, and agentic frameworks.
  • Demonstrated experience in AI/ML for automating day-to-day operational workloads.
  • Ability to architect distributed systems that are resilient, observable, and easy to maintain.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. title: R&D Testing & Lab Specialist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Technical Product Manager

__

Your Role and Responsibilities

As an R&D Testing & Lab Specialist, you will play a key role in testing and validating innovative electrical distribution products, including consumer units, plastic enclosures, and installation materials. You will be responsible for executing laboratory test plans, maintaining certifications, coordinating with external laboratories and certification bodies, and ensuring compliance with relevant quality standards and electrical regulations.

Your main responsibilities include:

  • Executing routine and qualification tests for new and existing products.
  • Defining, planning, and executing test plans while ensuring timely completion.
  • Maintaining product certifications and supporting certification processes.
  • Coordinating testing activities with external laboratories and certification bodies.
  • Identifying product non-conformities and proposing technical solutions.
  • Supporting maintenance activities for laboratory equipment and test setups.
  • Assisting external certification inspectors during product testing activities.
  • Ensuring prototypes are assembled correctly and that test results are accurately documented and reported.

Your Working Environment

You will be based at ABB's R&D Center in Ede, part of the Smart Buildings Business Line. The team develops and validates products used by grid operators, installers, OEMs, and distributors.

This is an office-based position. You will primarily work from our Ede location and occasionally travel within the Benelux region to external laboratories, certification bodies, and ABB facilities, including our factory in Belgium. Travel accounts for approximately 25% of your time.

Your Team

You will join a team of approximately 20 professionals, with 16 colleagues based in the Netherlands and additional team members located in Belgium and Spain. The team combines extensive technical expertise with a collaborative and supportive culture.

Everyone contributes to a shared goal, and international collaboration is a key part of the role. You will work closely with colleagues across multiple countries and functions to ensure successful product development and certification.

Why Join ABB?

This position offers an exciting opportunity to work on a wide variety of products, projects, and customer requirements. You will be part of a leading global technology company and market leader in electrical distribution solutions.

What makes this role unique:

  • Exposure to a broad portfolio of innovative electrical products.
  • Collaboration with international teams, customers, laboratories, and certification bodies.
  • A highly technical environment where quality and innovation are central.
  • Opportunities to further develop your expertise in testing, certification, and product validation.
  • Potential career progression towards a Laboratory Manager role.

Qualifications for the Role

You are a hands-on technical professional who enjoys working independently while collaborating with colleagues across international teams.

Required qualifications:

  • Completed MBO Level 4 education in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a completed HBO degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering.
  • Minimum of 3 years of technical work experience.
  • Strong knowledge of electrical engineering principles and electrical standards.
  • Ability to read and interpret standards, regulations, technical specifications, and test plans.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in international environments.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience working in a laboratory environment.
  • Experience working with certification bodies or product certification processes.
  • NEN 3140 certification.

About ABB

ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, helping industries become more efficient and sustainable. With approximately 110,000 employees in more than 100 countries, ABB combines engineering expertise and digital innovation to create a more productive and resource-efficient future.

What's in It for You?

We offer a challenging full-time position (40 hours per week) within an international organization committed to your growth and development.

In addition, we offer:

  • Competitive salary based on your experience and qualifications.
  • Fixed 13th-month salary.
  • 27 vacation days plus 13 ADV days.
  • Excellent pension scheme.
  • Travel expense reimbursement.
  • Company laptop and phone.
  • Training, development, and career growth opportunities.

The recruitment process consists of two interview rounds.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:

Analysis & Design

  • Collaborate with analyst tester and developer colleagues to create user story definitions and acceptance criteria.

  • Collaborate with analyst testers and solution consultants to ensure the solution well-defined and fit-for-purpose. It must meet end-to-end requirements are work well. This requires learning underlying business processes and understanding the technical environment in which you are operating. Provide solutions and recommendations for the resolution of technical issues that arise and ensure solutions meet the technical specs and design requirements;
  • Be a part of designing APIs and external system interfaces for integration into core FNZ products and third-party vendor applications.

Development

  • Interpret complex financial business requirements and translate into high-transactional, high-availability, secure, working systems
  • Design and build the highly intuitive user interface and interactive financial tools required by financial advisers and investors.
  • Non-functional requirements: Consider non-functional requirements. We produce high-volume, real-time transaction processing systems that support millions of trades every day in investment securities in multiple world markets. You will work with other developers to make sure that solutions developed are secure, reusable, maintainable and performant.
  • Collaborate with other developers to make sure that the solutions developed are robust and in-line with the requirements.
  • Ensure code is designed and built in a reusable manner.
  • Able to build medium complexity features end-end.
  • Continually develop an understanding of the business functionality of FNZ platforms

Quality

  • Participate in code reviews to gain feedback on your technique from senior peers and to give advice to junior peers. Review senior developers' code to enhance your skills and knowledge.
  • Write automated unit tests for any newly created code; and
  • Perform manual testing to ensure any changes made to the system are of a high standard and the system hasn’t regressed. Collaboration / Communication
  • Engage in the collaboration and communication channels in the organisation. Participate in solution design to ensure that creative solutions and tough problems solved are called out appropriately to the developer community, and where they lead to visible outcomes, to the broader FNZ teams and clients.
  • Collaborate with other developers to share knowledge, best practices, useful technology, and opportunities for cross-project system design / solutions.
  • Mentor new starters to ensure they understand both platform and SDLC.
  • Deliver knowledge-sharing sessions on topics of your personal expertise.

Technology

  • Stay up to date with industry practices, new technologies, tools and methods and suggestion adoption that are best suited to FNZ.
  • Proactively resolve technical (environmental, coding and testing) issues that impede development progress. Assist in the resolution of technical issues when requested.
  • Create novel solutions to problems by incorporating cutting edge technology or generic concepts.

Functional Area Responsibilities

Analyst Developers at FNZ are all-rounders who can work across the full stack. This role involves working with complex business requirements in a wide range of functional areas in the financial services and platform domain. In this role, you are responsible for continued learning both in the FNZ business domain and your technical skills as a professional software engineer. You achieve this growth through hands-on work, training and interaction with your senior colleagues. You are also responsible for collaborating with internal and client SMEs to deliver complex data mapping solutions for migrations: analyzing, designing and maintaining ETL workflows, resolving issues, testing and providing post-implementation support. Analyst Developers own non-functional requirements and are responsible for ensuring that their code complies with coding standards, is secure and performs well. At entry-level, you are responsible for learning best-practice in these areas from your senior peers.

Experience required

Primary requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher (min A- average for under-graduate, first class for post-graduate);
  • Confident, and able to take initiative in a delivery-focused environment;
  • Independent, self-directed working style;
  • Ability to learn quickly in a dynamic fast-paced industry;
  • Enjoy working as part of a high-performance team;
  • Hard-working, innovative and takes pride in their work; and
  • Passionate about creating innovative solutions for customers.

title: Software Engineer, GPU Kernels
description:
At River AI, our mission is to create personal AI owned and shaped by each individual. To achieve this, we are rewriting the entire stack from scratch: personal hardware for local inference, bespoke training infrastructure, next-generation UIs, and frontier deep learning research.

Who we are

We are scientists, engineers, and builders from the industry's top tech companies and AI labs. We bring a proven track record of scaling consumer systems for hundreds of millions of users and architecting the pre-training infrastructure behind today's frontier models.

About the Role

We are looking for exceptional GPU kernel engineers to build the compute primitives behind River’s training and inference infrastructure. Your goal is to make large models faster to train and more efficient to serve.

You will own performance-critical operations, including attention, matrix multiplication, mixture-of-experts execution, and low-precision computation. Working closely with researchers and systems engineers, you will identify bottlenecks, implement kernels, validate correctness, and bring improvements into production.

What You’ll Do

  • Build fast GPU kernels for attention, matrix multiplication, expert routing, and related operations.
  • Optimize memory access, tiling, and synchronization to make efficient use of GPU hardware.
  • Develop FP8, FP4, and mixed-precision kernels while preserving numerical correctness.
  • Accelerate fine-tuning and RL through optimized adapters, backward passes, and fused operations.
  • Profile real workloads and integrate improvements into training and inference runtimes.
  • Build reproducible benchmarks that verify correctness, gradients, and performance.

Skills & Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience optimizing GPU kernels with CUDA, Triton, CUTLASS, CuTe, or comparable tools.
  • Strong understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchies, and parallel execution.
  • Proficiency in C++ and Python.
  • Strong foundations in linear algebra, floating-point arithmetic, and numerical computing.
  • Strong debugging and profiling skills, with a collaborative approach to engineering.

Preferred Qualifications: (We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all of these)

  • Experience optimizing for NVIDIA Blackwell or Hopper GPUs.
  • Work on attention, mixture-of-experts kernels, grouped GEMMs, or low-rank adapters.
  • Experience implementing backward passes and validating gradients.
  • Familiarity with FP8, FP4, and quantized weight layouts.
  • Experience integrating custom operators into PyTorch, SGLang, vLLM, or similar frameworks.
  • Open-source contributions or a track record of shipping substantial kernel optimizations.

Logistics & Benefits

  • Location: Palo Alto, California.
  • Compensation: Depending on experience and skills the expected base pay is $200,000 - $420,000 USD per year.
  • Benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited PTO; and relocation assistance as needed.
  • Visa Sponsorship: We sponsor visas and are committed to supporting the process for the right candidate.

Job Description

Finance assistant i Afregning (25 timer)

Er du struktureret, grundig og god til at holde styr på detaljerne? Og har du lyst til at få erfaring med økonomi i en international virksomhed?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Hos Europcar Danmark søger vi en Finance Assistant til vores Afregningsteam. Du behøver ikke have erfaring fra en økonomiafdeling. Det vigtigste for os er, at du er struktureret, ansvarsbevidst og har lyst til at lære.

Stillingen er på 25 timer om ugen og kan derfor være et godt match, hvis du fx holder sabbatår, er i starten af din karriere, studerer eller blot ønsker et deltidsjob, hvor du kan udvikle dine kompetencer.

En vigtig rolle i vores økonomiafdeling

Du bliver en del af vores økonomiafdeling, som består af 12 engagerede medarbejdere fordelt på tre teams: Afregning, Debitor og Kreditor. Hvert team har sin egen teamleder, men vi arbejder tæt sammen på tværs og hjælper hinanden med at nå vores fælles mål.

Vi har base på Jens Baggesens Vej i Aarhus, og du vil opleve en uformel og samarbejdsorienteret kultur, hvor vi er hands-on og hjælper hinanden i hverdagen.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver

Som Finance Assistant i Afregning får du blandt andet ansvar for:

  • Håndtering af hele processen omkring parkeringsafgifter og fartbøder
  • Opkrævning hos kunder og registrering af betalinger i henhold til gældende aftaler
  • Håndtering af vejafgifter
  • Løbende dialog og koordinering med relevante interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere

Du får ansvar for dine egne opgaver, men du bliver naturligvis grundigt introduceret til både processer og systemer.

Det vigtigste er, hvordan du arbejder

Du behøver ikke kunne debet og kredit på fingerspidserne fra første dag. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du er typen, der har styr på tingene, følger en opgave til dørs og opdager, hvis noget ikke ser rigtigt ud.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er struktureret og omhyggelig og har sans for detaljer
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver
  • Bevarer overblikket, også når der er flere opgaver på én gang
  • Er nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære nyt
  • Er serviceminded og trives med kontakt til forskellige mennesker
  • Har en naturlig interesse for administrative og økonomiske opgaver
  • Behersker dansk og engelsk i både skrift og tale

Måske har du tidligere arbejdet med administration, kundeservice, butik, kontor eller noget helt andet. Det vigtigste er, at du kan se dig selv i en rolle, hvor struktur, præcision og ansvarlighed er afgørende.

Hvad får du hos os?

Hos Europcar får du mulighed for at få praktisk erfaring med økonomi og administration og samtidig blive en del af en international virksomhed.

Du får:

  • En deltidsstilling på 25 timer om ugen
  • En varieret hverdag med egne ansvarsområder
  • Mulighed for at lære om økonomi og afregning i praksis
  • Dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger, som står klar til at hjælpe dig godt i gang
  • En uformel kultur med plads til både faglighed og godt humør
  • En international arbejdsplads med kolleger og samarbejde på tværs af lande og kulturer

Vi tror på, at forskellige baggrunde skaber et stærkere team. Derfor er det ikke din titel eller din tidligere branche, der er afgørende for os – det er din tilgang til arbejdet og din lyst til at lære.

Har du styr på detaljerne?

Hvis du er struktureret, nysgerrig og klar til at få erfaring med økonomi, glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Du kan læse mere om Europcar Danmark og vores værdier på Europcar Danmark.

Send din ansøgning og CV via linket ’Søg stillingen’. Bemærk, at vi kun behandler elektroniske ansøgninger, der er modtaget via linket.

title: Patient Service Tech
description:
At Accendra Health, we understand that healthcare is complex, and we’re here to make it easier. We help deliver care beyond traditional settings, making essential products and services more accessible through every stage of life. As part of the care team, our teammates play a critical role in delivering personalized, long-term care for the patients we serve.

If you’re interested in meaningful work with impact, explore our career opportunities and join us in our purpose of Bringing Care To Life™.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $21.56 - $23.05 hourly. The actual compensation offered may vary based on job related factors such as experience, skills, education and location.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Apria Healthcare’s mission is to improve the quality of life for our patients at home. We are looking for empathetic, thoughtful, and compassionate people, to meet the needs of our patients. Already an industry leader in healthcare services, we provide home respiratory services and select medical equipment to help our patients sleep better, breathe better, heal faster, and thrive longer.

JOB SUMMARY

The Patient Service Technician is responsible for delivering and picking up equipment from homecare patients.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Delivers and picks up equipment from homecare patients. Sets up equipment and instructs patients on the basic use of equipment. Assists patients in solving problems regarding equipment use.
  • Schedules and organizes daily deliveries and pickups according to geographic territory. Loads and unloads durable medical or infusion equipment, oxygen and medical supplies onto delivery vehicle.
  • Complies with all applicable regulatory requirements including providing documents needed for the driver qualification file and abiding by hours of service, daily log, hazardous materials (placarding, training and shipping papers) and vehicle inspection and maintenance regulations.
  • Completes necessary paperwork including daily delivery logs, pick-up and delivery forms, reimbursement documents and vehicle maintenance logs. Distributes paperwork to appropriate personnel.
  • Notify supervisor if any one of the following items is discovered in the patient's home:

    Physical abuse of any family member

    Home environment is unsafe for the care ordered, such as unsanitary conditions or insufficient food for children

    Animals in the home that cause unsanitary conditions

  • Maintains daily vehicle maintenance logs and incident reports. Ensures vehicles are in proper working condition. Ensures preventive maintenance on vehicles is performed on a timely basis according to D.O.T., F.D.A. and Joint Commission.
  • Responds to emergency delivery calls as needed and on an on-call basis.
  • May clean and assist with the repair of equipment.
  • Performs routine vehicle maintenance including the checking of gasoline, oil fluids, tire pressure and brakes. Reports malfunction to supervisor.
  • Performs other related duties as directed by supervisor.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • N/A

MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education and/or Experience

  • Education or experience equivalent to a high school diploma is required.
  • At least one-year related work experience is required.
  • Must be at least 21 years of age or older at the time of hire.
  • Minimum of three years driving history required.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations or Professional Designations

  • Must possess a valid Driver’s license.
  • Successful completion of Apria Healthcare's Driver Training Program.
  • Must meet job-related requirements to comply with D.O.T., F.D.A. and Joint Commissions regulations.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES

  • Business Acumen
  • Problem Solving/Analysis
  • Communication Proficiency
  • Personal Effectiveness/Credibility

Computer Skills

  • Basic computer skills

Language Skills

  • English (reading, writing, verbal)

Mathematical Skills

  • Basic math skills.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee uses his/her hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, or crouch; talk or hear. The employee uses computer and telephone equipment. Specific vision requirements of this job include close vision and distance vision. Must be able to travel by plane and automobile (if applicable).

  • Regularly required to use hands to write, use computer, operate a motor vehicle, use a hand held device, telephone and use a document imaging system and manipulate documents.
  • Regularly required to read documents and write neatly, legibility and transcribe accurate information and numbers/values.
  • Employee continually engages in activities that require talking and hearing.
  • This position requires frequent variations including sitting, walking, standing, kneeling, reaching or stooping.
  • The employee must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license, specific to vehicle operated in the conduct of this job.
  • Specific vision abilities required to perform this job safely include close vision, distant vision, night (low to limited light) vision and the ability to adjust focus to work on a computer and read documents.
  • Strength Aspects:
    • Frequently required to stand and lift objects from 1” to 36” high with weights ranging from 10 lbs - 160 lbs, and carry objects for distances ranging from 1 ft -350 ft, including travel up and down stairs or in elevators.
    • Frequently required to push or pull objects weighing from 20 lbs – 60 lbs, up and down stairs, through doorways and thresholds, using dollies or carts, or on flat or angled surfaces which may include outdoor surfaces, carpeting or smooth floors. Distances pushed or pulled could range from 1-25 ft on average.
    • Frequently required to grip objects with hands, up to 15 lbs of force.
    • Frequently required to grip objects with fingers, up to 10 lbs of force.
  • Body Position and Flexibility Elements
    • Frequently required to climb 100 stairs on average ranging from 3”-10” in height,
    • Frequently stepping in and out of company vehicles ranging up to 20” in height.
    • Occasionally required to climb ladders up to 10’ high, in general.
    • Frequently required to bend down at the waist to a torso level of 24” above the floor.
    • Frequently required to reach, on average, 20” away from the body.
    • Occasionally required to kneel on one or both knees and squat to perform many of the above tasks.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

While performing the duties of this job, the employee rarely is exposed to fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

  • The employee is required to inspect and safely operate a motor vehicle during the day and night and in a wide range of weather and traffic conditions.
  • The noise level in the work environment is varies based on the locations or activities proximate to which can range from low to high.
  • There is moderate exposure to dust, fume, mists and odors.
  • Temperature ranges from normal indoor climate-controlled environment in buildings or vehicles and various outdoor conditions and temperature extremes encountered throughout the year in a variety of US states.
  • General lighting is generally provided via florescent lighting indoors, and natural lighting outdoors, and low light conditions consistent with outdoor and/or night working environment.
  • During off site travel events the employee may be exposed to higher noise levels requiring the use of hearing protection, with moderate potential exposure to moderate dust, chemicals, fumes and odors, as well as cryogenic and cleaning agents.
  • During off site travel events the employee may be required to ride in company delivery vehicles and accompany employees on deliveries and enter into patient homes.
  • May be required to receive vaccinations and participate in medical assessments and testing consistent with the work environment or patients exposed to.
  • Will be required to wear various personal protective equipment consistent with the hazards encountered in this role.
  • Will be required to use hand tools for assembly and repair, material handling equipment, cutting, carrying devices, cleanup kits or equipment.
  • May be required to work with cryogenic fluids requiring special precautions and PPE.

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described above are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

title: Associate Therapist (Missouri) Here Now Health
description:
Associate Virtual Therapist – Foster-Impacted Youth and Families

(Medicaid – Missouri)

Employment Type: Full-Time (35 hours/week)
Reports To: Clinical Supervisor, Here Now Health

About Here Now Health

Here Now Health is the first virtual behavioral health company built exclusively for children and families impacted by the child welfare system. We serve Medicaid members eligible due to their foster status, including children in foster care, adopted youth, young adults aging out, and those involved in family preservation or juvenile justice.

Our care model delivers trauma-informed, high-touch mental health services that prioritize consistency, trust, and accessibility in systems where those qualities are too often missing. Our mission is to make consistent, early, and preventative care the standard for youth and young adults impacted by child welfare — reducing crisis escalation, improving family stability, and creating measurable value for states and Medicaid partners.

Role Summary

As an Associate Virtual Therapist with Here Now Health, you will provide compassionate, trauma-informed mental health care to youth ages 5–26 and their caregivers. You will support clients navigating instability, system involvement, and complex trauma, often across multiple placements or life transitions.

This role includes structured clinical supervision toward independent licensure and is designed to support both strong client outcomes and meaningful professional growth within a relational, mission-driven care model.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide virtual one-on-one therapy to youth and caregivers using evidence-informed, trauma-focused modalities
  • Conduct clinical assessments and contribute to collaborative, measurement-based care plans
  • Build relational continuity across transitions, supporting clients through placement or life changes
  • Partner with non-clinical Care Advocates to coordinate wraparound support and access to services
  • Offer caregiver support sessions to strengthen family stability and outcomes
  • Maintain timely and accurate clinical documentation aligned with Medicaid and telehealth standards
  • Participate in weekly supervision, team meetings, and required trainings
  • Provide support during moments of escalation or crisis in alignment with trauma-informed care practices
  • Engage in peer consultation and cross-functional collaboration with clinicians and care team members

What Sets This Role Apart

  • Low caseloads designed to prioritize depth, trust, and sustained engagement
  • The opportunity to serve youth and caregivers often excluded from traditional care models, including those without stable placements or consistent caregivers
  • Dedicated clinical supervision and mentorship toward full licensure
  • A team culture where lived experience in foster care, kinship care, or system involvement is valued and welcomed
  • An integrated care model connecting therapy with caregiver support, care coordination, and advocacy

What You Need

  • Master’s degree in social work
  • Active associate-level or provisional license (LMSW) in Missouri
  • Experience providing therapy or support to children, adolescents, or families (internship experience welcomed)
  • Familiarity with trauma-informed and culturally responsive care
  • Interest in serving youth impacted by foster care, adoption, family preservation, or juvenile justice systems
  • Comfort working in a virtual environment and using telehealth platforms
  • Commitment to relational, equitable, and person-centered care
  • Ability to complete background checks required by Medicaid and/or child welfare systems

Strong plus: bilingual Spanish/English, multi-state eligibility, or prior Medicaid experience

Licensure Growth

Here Now Health provides no cost clinical supervision toward independent licensure, included as part of the role. We support licensure advancement and professional development aligned with state requirements.

Compensation & Schedule

  • Full-time, salaried role based on a 35-hour workweek
  • Salary range: $50,000–$60,000 annually, based on licensure stage, experience, and relevant expertise (35 hours/week)
  • Salary includes 22 hours per week of required client-facing (billable) care, plus supervision, documentation, and non-client clinical responsibilities to total 35 hours
  • Associate therapists may have the opportunity to provide up to 5 additional client-facing hours per week beyond the required 22 hours, compensated at $40/hour, with approval
    • Up to an additional $200 per week, and
    • Up to an additional approximately $10,000 per year, if consistently worked
  • Availability requirement:
    • Schedule is 12-8 PM, M-Th, 3-6 PM Friday Central Time
  • 100% remote; work hours follow the therapist’s local time zone

Benefits (W-2, Full-Time)

  • Paid time off, including holidays and sick time

  • Health insurance, with the option for a fully covered individual plan

  • 401(k)

  • CEU and professional license costs covered

  • Company-provided computer

  • Additional compensation consideration for Spanish-speaking and multilingual clinicians

We’d Especially Love to Hear From You If

  • You have lived experience in foster care, kinship care, or as a system-impacted caregiver
  • You value strong supervision and thoughtful mentorship
  • You thrive in a mission-driven, startup-style environment
  • You believe consistent, relationship-based care can change outcomes for youth and families

title: WB Strategy and Operations Officer
description:
As Strategy and Operations Officer, you will be the operating rhythm and execution discipline behind the Wholesale Banking (WB) Chief Data Office (CDO) organization. This role creates the structure that enables leadership to steer priorities, make informed decisions, and maintain transparency across strategy, finance, governance, risk, and communications.

You will provide the organizational clarity and coordination needed to keep a complex data function aligned, controlled, and moving with purpose, ensuring that strategic ambitions are translated into disciplined execution across the WB CDO landscape.

The team

The Operational, Risk & Compliance Management Unit serves as the control, assurance, and risk discipline backbone of the WB CDO organization. It is accountable for embedding data governance, regulatory compliance, and control frameworks into the day-to-day operations of Wholesale Banking.

The unit ensures that data initiatives are executed with the appropriate level of control, auditability, and regulatory adherence, strengthening ING’s risk posture and supervisory confidence. It enables regulator-ready, controlled, and traceable data management practices while ensuring compliance with critical frameworks such as BCBS239, GPDP, GRRD, and broader data risk and control requirements.

Working closely with Product Areas, Regional Data Offices, Data Delivery, and control functions, the team connects strategy, governance, and execution, ensuring data products and initiatives are compliant by design and audit-ready by default.

Roles and responsibilities

In this role, you will provide operational leadership, governance discipline, and strategic coordination across the WB CDO organization.

  • Translate WB CDO strategy into structured plans, execution frameworks, governance artifacts, and operating model routines.
  • Drive portfolio and operational steering, maintaining visibility on priorities, demand, capacity, delivery progress, dependencies, risks, trade-offs, and decision requirements.
  • Provide financial governance across cost management, FTE allocation, budget versus actuals, investment choices, and resource implications.
  • Orchestrate management meetings, data councils, portfolio reviews, and leadership forums with clear agendas, decision traceability, action tracking, and follow-through.
  • Prepare executive materials, strategic narratives, dashboards, and leadership updates that support alignment, escalation, and decision-making.
  • Track regulatory programs, audit findings, control execution, remediation progress, evidence, and leadership visibility across WB CDO.
  • Coordinate Product Areas, Regional Data Offices, Data Delivery, control functions, and business, data, and technology teams to ensure coherent execution and consistent communication.
  • Improve operating model discipline, governance documentation, reporting routines, and execution practices to strengthen efficiency, transparency, scalability, and organizational maturity.

Success factors

We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you'll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we'll support you in becoming an even better version of yourself.

  • Strong capability to translate strategy into structured plans, execution frameworks, governance artifacts, and operating model routines.
  • Solid understanding of portfolio steering, governance cadence, performance oversight, dependency management, and decision tracking.
  • Strong financial governance skills across budgeting, cost transparency, FTE and capacity management, investment tracking, and resource allocation.
  • Working knowledge of regulatory programs, audit processes, control execution, remediation tracking, and evidence management.
  • Strong analytical and reporting capabilities, converting complex information into decision-ready insights, dashboards, narratives, and executive materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate stakeholders across Product Areas, Regional Data Offices, Data Delivery, control functions, and business, data, and technology teams.
  • Strong organizational skills with a structured, execution-oriented, and detail-driven approach.
  • Proven ability to improve governance, transparency, operating discipline, and execution consistency within complex environments.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to support leadership alignment, escalation, and decision-making through concise written and verbal communication.

Rewards and benefits

We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life. You can find out more about our employment conditions via Find out more about our employment conditions.

At ING, we are committed to empowering people and businesses to stay a step ahead in life and in business. We do this through innovation, collaboration, and by building sustainable and future-proof solutions for our customers.

description:
Job Classification:

Investment Management - Investments

A GLOBAL FIRM WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE

As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world.

We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!

If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today. At PGIM, You Can!

What you can expect:

A research position within the Securitized Products group of PGIM Credit focused on Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities (“CMBS”) strategies that will work closely with portfolio management to analyze CMBS and digital infrastructure investments, monitor portfolio positions, and contribute to investment decision-making. Responsibilities include analyzing transaction collateral, assigning and maintaining internal credit ratings, reviewing transaction documentation packages and third-party reports, conducting surveillance on existing investments, and evaluating relative value opportunities across new issue and secondary markets. The role also involves assessing commercial real estate fundamentals, property-level performance trends, borrower and sponsor considerations, regulatory and legislative developments, and broader sector themes that may affect credit risk and portfolio positioning. The candidate will collaborate with internal teams and external market participants, including investment banks, issuers, rating agencies, servicers, trustees, and other due diligence providers, to support transaction execution and ongoing market insight.

What you will do:

  • Analyze CMBS transactions across new issue and secondary markets, including collateral characteristics, property-level underwriting, loan structure, sponsor strength, credit enhancement, cash flow stability, and structural features.

  • Develop and maintain internal credit views and relative value assessments for CMBS investments, including conduit, SASB, CRE CLO, data center, agency CMBS, and other commercial real estate securitized products.

  • Build and maintain models, scenario analyses, and visualization tools to assess bond performance under varying commercial real estate, interest rate, prepayment, extension, default, loss severity, and recovery assumptions.

  • Assign and maintain internal credit ratings and monitor rating stability, credit migration risk, cash flow volatility, collateral performance, portfolio positioning, and trading opportunities.

  • Review transaction documents, offering materials, third-party reports, legal structures, representations and warranties, control rights, triggers, servicing standards, and other deal-specific considerations.

  • Monitor portfolio holdings and market developments, identifying changes in commercial real estate fundamentals, property sector trends, sponsor or borrower behavior, financing conditions, and regulatory or legislative developments that may affect risk and return.

  • Partner with portfolio managers, traders, and other research teams to formulate investment recommendations and contribute to CMBS strategy, portfolio construction, and relative value discussions.

  • Engage with issuers, dealers, servicers, rating agencies, trustees, and other market participants to deepen market insight, source opportunities, and support transaction execution.

  • Contribute to internal presentations and client-facing materials on CMBS market themes, commercial real estate trends, investment recommendations, and portfolio positioning.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree required

  • 4-7 years of relevant experience in fixed income, securitized products, commercial real estate finance, digital infrastructure, or securitized products research, with meaningful exposure to CMBS or commercial mortgage collateral.

  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including solid capabilities in fixed income mathematics, credit analysis, cash flow analysis, and scenario modeling.

  • Programming and data visualization skills are preferred, including Python, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.

  • Exposure to CMBS collateral, commercial real estate fundamentals, securitization structures, transaction documentation, loan underwriting, and key drivers of CMBS performance.

  • Proficiency in Excel and experience working with large datasets.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple assignments in a fast-paced, high-intensity environment.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate investment views clearly to portfolio managers, traders, research colleagues, and other stakeholders.

  • Intellectual curiosity and strong interest in capital markets, commercial real estate, and commercial mortgage-backed securities.

What will set you apart:

  • Experience with Intex, Trepp, Bloomberg, Real Capital Analytics, property-level data sources, or other structured finance and commercial real estate analytics tools is preferred.

  • Experience with digital infrastructure

PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

title: Thought Leader Liaison, Gynecological Oncology – Pac South / Southwest
description:
Thought Leader Liaison, Gynecological Oncology – Pac South / Southwest

Territory includes but is not limited to: Texas, New Mexico, Arizona, Hawaii, and Southern California.

The Thought Leader Liaison (TLL), Gynecological Oncology builds and manages strategic relationships with a select group of U.S. external experts (EEs), with a deliberate focus on cultivating partnerships and insights across both academic and community oncology settings to ensure commercial strategies reflect the realities of where patients receive care.

This role is accountable for generating strategic insights, translating science to actionability, and building brand advocacy. This includes leading strategic engagement with key external experts through robust engagement planning and insight generation aligned to brand and therapeutic area strategies. The TLL generates strategic insights through ongoing interactions with external experts, congresses and executive engagements, while working closely with US/Global Commercial, Medical, and Regulatory partners to translate field perspectives into meaningful business actions that shape brand strategy.

TLLs support the oncology in-line brands within their geography while helping prepare the organization for successful oncology launches through disease-state engagement, external expert partnership, and insights that inform future commercial strategy.

Six geographies will cover the United States, each aligned with an Oncology Field Vice President, who will be an important stakeholder.

Key Responsibilities:

External Expert Engagement & Relationship Management

  • Develop and execute strategic external expert engagement plans designed to build long-term partnerships while generating meaningful commercial insights, especially within the community setting.
  • Plan and execute External Expert engagements aligned to brand priorities and External Expert needs outside of advisory and congress events, planning and maintaining a consistent level of execution as aligned with TLL Director. This includes a mix of live and virtual engagements in your geography.
  • Help create, segment and manage a thought leader network (network mapping) to optimize engagement and insight generation.

Insight Generation & Strategic Impact

  • Gather and synthesize regional insights from external experts through forums such as 1:1 interactions, congress, publication, and provide them to the brand team.
  • Share synthesized insights with commercial leadership to help shape the following, but not limited to, brand strategy, resource allocation, customer engagement strategies, and launch planning.
  • Help identify emerging treatment paradigm shifts in your respective region, competitive dynamics, biomarker evolution, and unmet needs that may influence future commercial strategy.
  • Seek compliant External Expert feedback on initiatives and materials.

Advisory, Peer to Peer & Congress Engagements

  • Execute and synthesize advisory boards, expert consultancies, and other strategic engagement forums to answer critical business questions and inform commercial decision making.
  • Coordinate and support External Expert executive interactions with commercial leadership.
  • Shape peer-to-peer education content through speaker identification, training/operations support, and relationship management.
  • Participate in key local, regional, and national congresses and serve as onsite host for congress product theater speakers and EEs.
  • Capture and synthesize congress insights to identify emerging trends, competitive developments, and implications for brand strategy.

Cross‑Functional & Operational Excellence

  • Partner effectively with medical, legal, compliance, regulatory, and marketing teams to ensure external engagements are strategically aligned and within GSK policies and adhering to PHARMA guidelines
  • Apply strong project management skills to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Manage agency and vendor partners to ensure timely, high‑quality execution.
  • Understand risk associated with the activities on Strategic Engagement and be adept and agile in their management and mitigation.

Why you?

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in field sales, product marketing, or medical/clinical roles within pharma or biotech.
  • Oncology experience required.
  • Valid driver’s license.
  • Willingness to travel 60–80%, including nights and weekends.
  • Experience presenting to executive audiences (live and virtual) and influencing strategic decisions or stakeholder alignment.
  • Experience leveraging insights to guide strategy development and proactively refine approach in response to evolving data and market dynamics.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience as an Oncology TLL
  • Master’s degree.
  • Strong account management and cross‑functional leadership experience.
  • Marketing and/or sales management background.
  • Advanced project management and organizational skills.
  • Proven adherence to regulatory and compliance standards with proactive risk identification and mitigation.
  • Ability to communicate effectively to HCPs and executives.
  • Experience and knowledge with technology, software and adaptability to learn new AI tools.

Join our fast-paced and dedicated food testing laboratory, where accuracy, teamwork and commitment to quality are at the heart of everything we do.   • Reliable and punctual, with a flexible approach to working hours and changing priorities.

title: Information Security Engineer II
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

At Simmons Bank, the Security Engineering Team is responsible for the design, implementation, and maintenance of security solutions to include, but not limited to: Identity & Access Protection, Email Security, Network Security, Endpoint Protection, Data Protection and Vulnerability Management. These security solutions secure critical business operations and protect our customers and data.

You will join a team of Associates dedicated to ensuring the security of the corporate network and be responsible for the day-to-day operation of the Information Security Program.

Level II Security Engineers are primarily responsible for the implementation and maintenance of security systems and supporting end-users’ use of the Company’s security services. Level II Security Engineers operate with limited direct supervision and provide mentoring of Level I Security Engineers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Systems Engineering

  • Contributes substantially to the design and implementation of security systems, as needed

  • Identifies and documents system security requirements to assist with solution selection

  • Assists with the evaluation of new technologies or process improvements that enhance security capabilities

  • Serves as specialist for certain security systems, as assigned

System Administration

  • Configures, maintains, and monitors the Company’s security systems, including but not limited to: secure email gateway, firewall, VPN, network access control, secure web gateway, security information and event management platform, endpoint protection, data loss prevention and vulnerability scanning tools

  • Supports Level I Security Engineers with service request and incident tickets, as needed

  • Supports Level I Security Engineers with system changes, as needed

  • Handles service request and incident tickets pertaining to security systems

  • Reviews system alerts and responds in accordance with established procedures (e.g. triage, mitigate, and escalate)

  • Researches, tests and presents proposed security system changes to IT and Business leadership

  • Conducts security system changes in accordance with the change management process

  • Collaborates with external parties (e.g. vendor support, professional services and others) to maintain security technologies

  • Monitors cases, tickets, and incidents opened with vendor support to ensure timely response and remediation

  • Applies upgrades, patches, and other configurations in support of the patch management and vulnerability management processes

  • Maintains the team’s written documentation (e.g. diagrams, procedures, and other system information) for the Company’s security systems

Administrative

  • Participates in rotating on-call schedule representing the Security Engineering team

  • Mentors other team members and supports cross-training

  • Communicates security concerns to management in a timely manner

  • Completes training related to this position, as assigned, in a timely manner

  • Pursues IT and/or Security certifications relevant to this position

  • Takes initiative and responsibility for achieving desired results

  • Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Education and/or Experience

  • Minimum of six (6) years of experience in information technology, network engineering, or security engineering (required)

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field (preferred)

  • Direct experience administering security systems such as: endpoint protection, network access control, web content filtering, data loss prevention, vulnerability scanners, and firewalls (required)

  • Experience in operational roles supporting of IT systems, networks, or applications and direct experience conducting basic troubleshooting steps, documenting tickets, and communicating with end-users (required)

Certifications

  • CompTia A+, Security+, Network+, or other baseline security related certifications (required)

  • CISSP, SSCP, CEH, or other intermediate security related certifications (preferred)

title: Senior Director, Operations Finance
description:
Job Description

Turn the numbers behind every rental into the decisions that drive the fleet forward.

This is a strategic finance seat at the leadership table, not a support role. Fox Rent A Car needs a Senior Director of Operations Finance who can stand shoulder to shoulder with Operations, Fleet, and Revenue Management and turn hard numbers into decisions that move a nationwide rental network. You will own the financial story behind fleet economics, pricing, and location profitability, and you will be trusted to challenge assumptions at the executive level.

Your Primary Focus Is To:

Financial Leadership and Business Partnership

  • Serve as the senior finance business partner to Operations and regional/location leadership.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with executive and operational leaders.
  • Translate operational strategies and initiatives into financial impacts, including revenue, EBITDA, cash flow, and return on invested capital.
  • Provide financial leadership for new locations, market expansions, acquisitions, and major operational initiatives.
  • Establish financial accountability and performance expectations across the operating organization.
  • Challenge assumptions and identify opportunities to improve financial performance.

Rental Operations Finance

  • Own financial analysis and performance management for the company's rental operations.
  • Analyze profitability by location, market, vehicle class, customer segment, channel, and rental product.
  • Develop operating metrics and dashboards that provide management with timely visibility into performance.
  • Analyze revenue per rental day, average daily rate, utilization, rental days, fleet availability, ancillary revenue, and contribution margin.
  • Identify operational trends, risks, and opportunities and recommend corrective actions.
  • Establish benchmarks and best practices across the rental network.

Fleet Financial Management

  • Partner with Fleet leadership to optimize fleet size, mix, utilization, acquisition, and disposal decisions.
  • Analyze vehicle-level and fleet-level economics throughout the vehicle lifecycle.
  • Develop financial models supporting vehicle acquisition and replacement decisions.
  • Evaluate depreciation, maintenance, repair, damage, transportation, fuel, and disposal economics.
  • Monitor fleet aging and its impact on revenue, operating costs, customer experience, and residual values.
  • Partner with Fleet and Remarketing teams to optimize vehicle disposition strategies and maximize proceeds.
  • Evaluate the financial impact of OEM programs, vehicle incentives, purchase agreements, and financing arrangements.

Revenue and Pricing

  • Partner with Revenue Management to evaluate pricing strategies and revenue optimization opportunities.
  • Analyze rate performance, demand, seasonality, vehicle availability, length of rental, and market conditions.
  • Evaluate the financial impact of promotions, discounts, loyalty programs, corporate accounts, and distribution channels.
  • Develop profitability analysis that balances revenue growth with fleet utilization and operating costs.

Budgeting, Forecasting and Planning

  • Lead the annual operating budget process for the operations organization.
  • Develop monthly and quarterly forecasts for revenue, expenses, EBITDA, fleet investment, and cash flow.
  • Establish forecasting methodologies and improve forecast accuracy.
  • Analyze actual results versus budget, forecast, and prior year.
  • Identify key drivers of variances and work with operating leaders to develop corrective actions.
  • Lead long-range financial planning and scenario analysis.

Operational Expense Management

  • Drive disciplined management of operating expenses across the rental network.
  • Analyze labor productivity, staffing levels, overtime, vehicle transportation, maintenance, fuel, facilities, insurance, and other operating costs.
  • Develop productivity metrics and cost-per-unit benchmarks.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce costs without compromising customer service or operational effectiveness.
  • Partner with Operations to develop and execute cost improvement initiatives.

Performance Reporting and Analytics

  • Develop executive-level reporting packages that clearly communicate operational and financial performance.
  • Establish standardized KPIs across locations and regions.
  • Improve the use of financial and operational data in decision-making.
  • Develop dashboards and analytical tools that provide real-time or near-real-time visibility into performance.
  • Leverage business intelligence, automation, and data analytics to improve financial reporting and forecasting.

Capital and Investment Analysis

  • Evaluate capital requirements for fleet, facilities, technology, and other operational investments.
  • Prepare business cases and ROI analyses for major investments.
  • Monitor actual returns against approved business cases.
  • Partner with Treasury and Corporate Finance on fleet financing and capital requirements.
  • Assess the impact of fleet investment decisions on liquidity, leverage, and cash flow.

Leadership and Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Operations Finance organization.
  • Establish clear goals, accountability, and performance expectations.
  • Develop finance talent capable of partnering effectively with field and executive leadership.
  • Promote a culture of analytical rigor, operational accountability, continuous improvement, and business partnership.
  • Collaborate with Corporate Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, FP&A, and other finance functions.

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive finance experience, with significant experience supporting operations.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing finance teams and/or operating finance functions.
  • Experience in the rental car, automotive, fleet, transportation, mobility, travel, hospitality, or similarly operationally intensive industry strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, operational analysis, and performance management.
  • MBA, CPA, CMA, or other advanced professional designation preferred.

Skills & Strengths:

  • Strong understanding of P&L management and operational drivers.
  • Experience partnering with senior executives and operational leaders.
  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills.
  • Experience with ERP, FP&A, business intelligence, and data analytics platforms.
  • Experience managing finance for a multi-location or geographically dispersed operation.
  • Experience with fleet economics, vehicle remarketing, or asset-intensive businesses.
  • Experience with revenue management and dynamic pricing.

We Offer:

  • Medical, Vision, Dental, 401k, Employee Discounts, Referral bonus
  • Company-paid Life Insurance
  • Company-paid AD&D Insurance
  • Flexible spending account
  • Parental leave
  • Employee assistance program

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Accordingly, all members of society, irrespective of age, color, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, race, national origin, religion, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, citizenship status, belief, or any other protected characteristic, are encouraged to apply to join our team. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We are committed to complying with the Americans with Disabilities Act and all applicable state and local disability laws, and reasonable accommodations are available upon request for both candidates and employees.

Europcar Mobility Group

Europcar Mobility Group is a global mobility player, with 75 years of mobility services expertise and a leading position in Europe. “We help to change the way you move” is what we stand for and brings us together.

We offer to individuals and businesses a wide range of car and van rental services, be it for a few hours, a few days, a week, a month or more, on-demand or on subscription, relying on a fleet of more than 250.000 vehicles, equipped with the latest engines including an increasing share of electric vehicles.

Our brands address differentiated needs, use cases and expectations: Europcar® - a global leader of car rental and light commercial vehicle rental, with a premium positioning, Goldcar® - a frontrunner at providing low-cost car rental services in Europe, and Fox-Rent-A-Car®, one of the main players in the car rental market in the US, with a "value for money" positioning.

title: Post Doctoral Research Assistant
description:

We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion, creating a community where colleagues feel respected and valued. We aim to reflect the diversity of our students and communities, and to strengthen our university through collaboration and diverse perspectives, across all roles at the University.

An exciting opportunity has emerged at the E.A. Milne Centre for Astrophysics, within the University of Hull, for a dedicated Postdoctoral Research Assistant. This position requires a candidate with expertise in computational astrophysics or theoretical chemistry, demonstrating strong proficiency in electronic structure calculations, high-performance computing (HPC), and code development for molecular spectroscopy. This full-time, 3-year position supports the STFC-funded project UKRI4116: “Biosignatures of molecular halogens”, led by Dr. David M. Benoit in collaboration with Bard College (USA) and the University of New South Wales (Australia). The role focuses on developing computational methodologies to build a theoretical spectroscopic database of halogenated molecules, enhancing our ability to detect potential signs of life beyond Earth in existing and future astronomical observations.

The role demands a candidate with a strong background in computational astrophysics, electronic structure theory, and molecular spectroscopy, capable of contributing significantly to the development of automated computational pipelines for halogenated biosignatures. Furthermore, it requires a professional with exceptional skills in scientific communication, including the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely, and to produce high-quality written scientific materials. The ideal candidate will also possess robust critical thinking and analytical problem-solving skills, essential for navigating the complexities of high-throughput astrophysical spectroscopic data generation on supercomputing infrastructure.
