- Renew, up-sell and close on-time contracts in assigned territory

- Increase sales penetration at existing accounts

- Understand customers’ and partners’ procurement process

- Supervise and report state of customer relationships, pipeline, and forecasts

- Supervise quote creation progress to mitigate contract closure risks.

- Maintain internal and external relationships in support of closing the sale

- Build deep relationships with customer executives and partners to understand objectives and accelerate their path to value

- Utilize data and insights from cross-functional resources to co-create the customer renewal sales strategy with the account team; play a key role in developing the coordinated account plan and success plan

- Understand the overall industry environment

- Attend and present at internal meetings with other company organizations that are necessary to perform duties; aid business development

- Monitor and report on market and competitor activities and provide relevant reports and information

- Analyze data and trends to identify growth opportunities

Who You'll Work With

This role resides in the Customer Experience organization, one of Cisco’s fastest growing teams that delivers profitable growth throughout the customer lifecycle with a series of selling motions to drive higher value and an efficient experience from Cisco solutions.

Who You Are

- Excellent executive level communication and presentation skills

- Process Specialist: Strong process leadership skills and financial acumen with the ability to successfully develop and implement policies for forecasting, data quality and accuracy

Required experience:

- You hold a BS/BA (or equivalent) plus 7+ years related sales experience and 2 – 3 years of experience handling HW and/or software renewals

- You have a consistent track record in delivering excellent results against pre-defined goals and targets

- You are driven, upbeat, self-starter

- Excellent social skills

- Excellent communications skills (both written and verbal) and the ability/affinity for building new relationships

- High degree of creative ability, analytical and business skills and independent judgment

- A strong knowledge of Cisco and general IT Service renewals would be preferred, as well as a wide appreciation of the IT market landscape

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Supervisor, Operations
description:
The Operations Supervisor is a critical execution leader within the service center, ensuring daily dock, freight, and operational activities run with precision, safety, and financial discipline. This role exists to translate network strategy into real-world execution—balancing throughput, cost control, service quality, and compliance in a fast-paced LTL environment.

As Roadrunner continues to scale its Smart Network™, this position plays a key role in protecting shipment integrity, optimizing load flow, and maintaining operational consistency across linehaul and local delivery functions. Success in this role means running a clean, compliant, and high-performing dock, delivering reliable service outcomes, and contributing directly to terminal profitability and network efficiency.



What you’ll do

1. Execute dock and terminal operations with precision

  • Oversee daily dock operations including load planning, freight handling, and linehaul coordination
  • Ensure freight is processed accurately with proper routing, documentation, and data entry
  • Maintain high standards for load quality, minimizing damages, OS&D incidents, and rehandling
  • Step into operational roles—including forklift operations—when needed to maintain continuity

2. Optimize service center performance and cost control

  • Monitor daily operating costs and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and margin performance
  • Support budget attainment through effective labor utilization, contractor coordination, and workflow management
  • Ensure billing, rating, payroll, and administrative processes are completed accurately and on time

3. Drive safety, compliance, and risk management

  • Maintain a safe and compliant work environment aligned with DOT, OSHA, and hazardous materials standards
  • Support contractor compliance including equipment standards, qualification requirements, and operational procedures
  • Enforce freight security protocols and ensure adherence to company and regulatory policies

4. Lead and develop frontline teams

  • Supervise, coach, and direct service center personnel with clear expectations and accountability
  • Provide real-time feedback, performance management, and development support
  • Foster a culture of ownership, teamwork, and operational excellence through visible leadership

5. Coordinate across network stakeholders

  • Partner with linehaul contractors, drivers, and internal teams to ensure seamless freight movement
  • Communicate effectively with corporate teams, customers, and external partners
  • Resolve operational issues quickly, applying sound judgment in dynamic, variable conditions

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s degree or 1–2 years of relevant operations or logistics experience (or equivalent combination)
  • Experience in transportation, LTL, warehouse, or service center operations preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to supervise, train, and evaluate team members
  • Strong working knowledge of safety protocols, compliance standards, and hazardous materials handling (Hazmat certification preferred)
  • Forklift certification (or ability to obtain)
  • Solid analytical and mathematical skills with the ability to interpret operational and financial data
  • Proficiency in PC applications (email, spreadsheets, database systems); AS/400 experience preferred
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage across all levels of the organization
  • Proven ability to prioritize, delegate, and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong problem-solving capability in situations with limited standardization

How you operate

  • You think in systems, not tasks—understanding how decisions impact network performance
  • You own outcomes, not activity—delivering measurable results under pressure
  • You move decisively while maintaining control and operational discipline
  • You lead from the front—modeling accountability, work ethic, and safety standards
  • You communicate clearly—ensuring alignment across teams, contractors, and stakeholders
  • You balance speed and accuracy—protecting both service and profitability
  • You adapt quickly—navigating ambiguity and shifting priorities with confidence




Compensation & Setup

  • Pay: $60,000 – $65,000 base salary
  • Location: Onsite | Chicago, IL
  • Shift Start Time: First Shift: 3 am, Second Shift: 11:00 am, or Third Shift: 7:00 pm.
  • Benefits: Full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and paid time off

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical Demands

  • Heavy physical activity performing strenuous daily activities of a primarily productive/technical nature.
  • While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, climb, balance, reach/handle items, work with fingers, have color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and talk and hear others in conversations via the phone or in person.
  • The employee is occasionally subjected to odors from the dock area and lifts objects up to 100 lb.

Work Environment

  • The noise level is loud based on multiple printers and forklifts running outside of the door.
  • Work in outdoors and indoors shop environment with adequate ventilation.
  • Might be required to occasionally work in wet or humid conditions (non-weather), near fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts, toxic or caustic chemicals, vibrations, and outdoor weather conditions.
  • The above statements reflect the general details necessary to describe the principal functions of the position and are not intended to be all inclusive.
  • The position and any of the requirements listed above are subject to change at any time according to the changing needs of the company.

* Roadrunner is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.

* We will not accept unsolicited candidates from external recruiters or recruiting agencies. Thank you!

#LI-OnsiteChicago, IL




About Roadrunner


Roadrunner is for ambitious, smart people who excel at execution over talking about it, and who would rather invent the next standard in freight than accept the status quo.

We are looking for the Best of the Best. Action driven leaders who want to be part of real change and help design the future of LTL in the U.S. This is a place where high performers can grow, influence outcomes, and make an impact while working directly with executives and smart people from across industries.


We bring a winner mindset. We take ownership, raise the bar, and measure ourselves by results. We Run Safe. We Run Smart. We Run Together. These principles create an environment of high standards, clear ownership, and direct collaboration. We trust data over intuition, move with urgency, and hold each other accountable because winning requires it.


Roadrunner exists to prove that LTL can be better than the industry has settled for. To be the best means we need to think bigger, look outside the box, and question every assumption: too many handoffs, limited visibility, and the quiet belief that “this is just how it works.” We rejected that story. We built a proprietary Smart Network™ for direct, long haul, metro to metro service that delivers fewer touches, faster transit, real time visibility, and genuine accountability. We are the most tech forward company in LTL, and we are not finished widening the gap.


The foundation is already strong. Recognized as one of Built In Chicago’s Best Large Places to Work. Earning top marks for improvement, quality, and service. The real opportunity is still ahead: helping invent what comes next.


If you want to be evaluated among the Best of the Best and help set the new standard in LTL, we should talk.

title: Senior Business Analyst (Investment Valuation Solutions)
description:
Why you’ll love working here:

  • high-performance, people-focused culture

  • our commitment that equity, diversity, and inclusion are fundamental to our work environment and business success, which helps employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves

  • learning and development initiatives, including workshops, Speaker Series events and access to LinkedIn Learning, that support employees’ career growth

Job Summary

HOOPP’s Information Technology teams deliver innovative technology solutions to help build a stronger financial future for the healthcare community. As a Senior Business Analyst, you will contribute to building the technology underpinning HOOPP’s official valuation, stress testing, and sensitivities of financial derivatives across asset classes.

Our ISG Risk Valuation team delivers solutions that drive HOOPP’s official overnight pricing, security level sensitivities that help drive trading decisions, as well as solutions that underpin HOOPP’s risk and exposure limit monitoring. As a Senior Business Analyst, reporting to the Director, ISG Risk Valuations, you will work closely with technology and investment finance professionals to define and build the backbone of HOOPP’s investment valuation leveraging vendor and in-house built software acting as the bridge between financial modelling and technology solutions.

We cultivate a culture that emphasizes innovation, collaboration, practicality, and the courage to challenge the status quo. This role is well suited to someone who combines technical depth with curiosity, sound judgment, product thinking, systems thinking, and a willingness to test new ideas. You will look beyond immediate symptoms, identify underlying needs, and develop solutions that are secure, sustainable, and valuable in delivering the pension promise. Success in this role requires the ability to navigate ambiguity, ask thoughtful questions, and turn emerging technologies into practical solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

What you will do:

  • Hands-on analysis and delivery of complex Valuation solutions across a comprehensive set of asset classes (Equity, Fixed Income, Credit, Derivatives, FX, OTC products etc.).

  • Guide and support the Product Owner and Solution Architect in developing and realizing the product vision (develop roadmaps, manage scope, define minimal viable products, prioritize backlog, create stories to incorporate user and technical feedback etc.).

  • Develop and foster relationships with HOOPP business partners (Traders, Portfolio Managers, Risk, Finance, Security Operations, Data Management) and other Investment Technology teams to capture requirements, prototype solutions, provide demos, test and support the final deliverable.

  • Create sustainable AI-powered solutions with a focus on capital markets valuation usage.

  • Challenge existing solution delivery processes and propose innovative workflows with AI to better support the mandate of the team.

  • Become the expert on HOOPP’s official valuation, initial margin, risk, and exposure monitoring process and support the day-to-day operation of the systems.

What you will bring:

  • 5+ years of experience within capital markets (risk models, reporting, valuation models, statistical analysis, and finance theory) combined with 2+ years of experience in technology delivery.

  • Solid grounding in the software development life cycle, including Agile delivery practices, techniques, and tools.

  • Strong working knowledge of the AI tooling landscape, with hands-on experience embedding AI into technology delivery and/or capital markets workflows; experience building conversational or chatbot solutions in a capital markets context is an asset.

  • Hands-on proficiency with SQL and Python, and the ability to read and reason about code in other languages.

  • Proven ability to interact confidently and effectively with all levels of the organization and build strong working relationships in a team-oriented, collaborative environment, including negotiating and facilitating consensus among diverse stakeholders with conflicting interests to produce workable solutions.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear, accessible language for diverse audiences.

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage complex processes and relationships that span business units, with diplomacy and professionalism.

  • Degree in Finance, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics or Computer Science; CFA or FRM designation a plus.

The expected annual base salary range for this role is: $103,000 - $153,000 CAD

The actual base salary offered to the successful candidate may vary based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, individual's expertise and level of experience applicable to the role they are being offered.

title: Large Language Model Intern
description:
Joining Razer will place you on a global mission to revolutionize the way the world games. Razer is a place to do great work, offering you the opportunity to make an impact globally while working across a global team located across 5 continents. Razer is also a great place to work, providing you the unique, gamer-centric #LifeAtRazer experience that will put you in an accelerated growth, both personally and professionally.

Job Responsibilities :

Train and optimize language models for Razer Software, across the full pipeline — pretraining corpus construction, fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment optimization.

Job Scope

You'll work with senior data scientists and engineers on the model powering Razer Software, covering the full training pipeline:

  • Corpus construction — cleaning, filtering, deduplication, and mixing of training data

  • Fine-tuning — SFT, LoRA, and preference optimization runs

  • Evaluation — quality, latency, and memory benchmarking against production constraints

  • Deployment optimization — compression and quantization experiments for on-device targets

You'll own discrete workstreams end-to-end (design → run → debug → analyze → iterate) rather than executing isolated tasks handed down by a mentor.

Learning Objectives

By the end of this internship, you will have:

  • Hands-on experience across the full LLM training lifecycle at production scale — not toy datasets

  • Practical judgment in data engineering: how cleaning/filtering/mixing decisions propagate into model quality

  • The ability to independently run a rigorous ML experiment loop — hypothesize, train, evaluate, diagnose subtle regressions, iterate

  • Direct exposure to how deployment constraints, shape training and architecture decisions, including compression, quantization, and distillation tradeoffs

  • Mentorship from senior engineers and visibility into how a production roadmap for a shipping AI feature actually gets decided.

Candidate Requirements

  • Education: Current Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD student in CS, AI, Data Science, or a related field

  • Must-have knowledge: LLM training paradigms (pretraining, SFT, LoRA, preference optimization); Transformer/deep learning fundamentals; how deployment constraints (latency, memory) shape training decisions

  • Must-have skills: Python; hands-on PyTorch model training; data engineering for training corpora (cleaning, filtering, dedup, mixing); end-to-end experiment running (debugging, hyperparameter tuning, analysis); benchmarking quality/latency/memory

  • Nice-to-have: Model compression (quantization, distillation), distributed training (multi-GPU/parallelism), Hugging Face/Accelerate/DeepSpeed, Linux environment

  • Screening bar (hard requirement): Demonstrable hands-on model training/fine-tuning experience (coursework, research, internship, or open source). API-calling or prompt-engineering-only experience does not qualify.

  • Strong positives: Trained a model from scratch (any scale), multi-GPU training, model compression/on-device deployment work, top-tier publications (CVPR, NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, ICLR, EMNLP, etc.)

title: Medical Science Liaison (MSL) – Hemato-Oncology – Eastern Europe & UK
description:
Join Amplity, the full-service go-to partner of biopharma companies that delivers flexible + specialized medical + commercial services. No matter where a drug is in its lifecycle, we scale with ease to maximize resources + improve impact for all our clients. Through strategic partnerships + deep therapeutic expertise, Amplity transforms how breakthrough treatments reach the people who need them.

Medical Science Liaison (MSL)

Hemato-Oncology (Myelofibrosis & Leukemia)

Business Unit: Medical Affairs
Reports to: Program Director, Amplity
Location: Poland, Czech Republic, Hungary, or the United Kingdom (Remote / Field-Based)

Territory: Eastern Europe & United Kingdom

Role Type: Individual Contributor

About the Role

Amplity is partnering with a leading global pharmaceutical company to recruit an experienced Medical Science Liaison (MSL) to support Medical Affairs activities across Eastern Europe and the United Kingdom.

This field-based role offers a unique opportunity to engage with leading experts in Myelofibrosis (MF) and Leukemia (AML), support clinical development activities, and contribute to advancing innovative treatments in hemato-oncology.

As a member of a highly collaborative Medical Affairs team, you will serve as a trusted scientific partner to healthcare professionals, investigators, and key opinion leaders, while generating valuable insights to help shape medical strategy and support clinical trial execution.

This position is ideally suited to an experienced MSL or field medical professional who enjoys scientific exchange, cross-country collaboration, and working within a dynamic international environment.

Why Join Us?

Meaningful Scientific Impact

Contribute to advancing therapies in areas of significant unmet need for patients living with Myelofibrosis and Leukemia.

International Exposure

Collaborate with leading hematology experts, investigators, and healthcare professionals across multiple European countries.

Strategic Medical Affairs Role

Combine scientific engagement, insight generation, and clinical trial support in a highly visible field medical position.

Flexible Field-Based Environment

Work remotely with a high degree of autonomy while remaining closely connected to regional and global teams.

Professional Growth

Join a global organization that supports ongoing development, scientific excellence, and long-term career progression.

Purpose of Role

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a member of a field-based team of medical scientists with established personal and scientific credibility who functions as an extension of the Medical Affairs organization. The primary role of the MSL is to provide fair, balanced, objective scientific information and education to healthcare professionals (HCPs) and internal stakeholders, in line with scientific and business needs.

The MSL is responsible for maintaining a deep understanding of the hemato-oncology treatment landscape and for building strong scientific relationships with healthcare professionals and medical thought leaders involved in multiple phases of product development.

A strong background in Myelofibrosis (MF) and/or Leukemia (AML) is highly preferred. The successful candidate will engage with key stakeholders across multiple European countries, drive scientific exchange, gather strategic insights, and support clinical trial progression.

Key Accountabilities

Opinion Leader Engagement

  • Identify, develop, and maintain collaborative relationships with current and future Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and healthcare stakeholders.
  • Provide advanced scientific and medical support to KOLs and academic centers.
  • Engage healthcare professionals, investigators, and thought leaders in scientific exchange focused on disease state, treatment landscape, and emerging data.
  • Act as a primary liaison for investigators interested in participating in clinical trials and investigator-sponsored research.
  • Represent the organization at scientific congresses, professional society meetings, and other relevant medical events.
  • Deliver scientific presentations and respond appropriately to unsolicited scientific inquiries.

Scientific Expertise

  • Develop and maintain deep expertise within hemato-oncology, particularly Myelofibrosis and Leukemia.
  • Build a strong understanding of regional treatment paradigms, healthcare systems, and stakeholder networks.
  • Execute territory plans aligned with regional Medical Affairs objectives.
  • Maintain awareness of the competitive landscape, new clinical data, and emerging scientific developments.

Clinical Trial Support

  • Gather and communicate field insights that support clinical and medical strategies.
  • Support investigator-sponsored studies where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with Clinical Operations to identify suitable clinical trial sites and support patient recruitment efforts.
  • Maintain strong relationships with investigators participating in ongoing company-sponsored clinical trials.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Support scientific activities at congresses, advisory boards, and medical education programs.
  • Share competitive intelligence and healthcare market insights with internal stakeholders.
  • Provide scientific education in response to unsolicited medical inquiries.
  • Support execution of Medical Affairs projects, training initiatives, and scientific programs.
  • Contribute to a collaborative culture through knowledge sharing and peer support.

Compliance

  • Operate in a highly ethical manner while complying with all laws, regulations, industry codes, and company policies.
  • Ensure all activities are conducted in accordance with local and international compliance requirements.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and reporting of field activities.
  • Complete all required training and compliance activities within established timelines.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Advanced scientific degree (MD, PharmD, PhD, MSc, or equivalent).
  • Previous Medical Affairs experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Previous MSL experience.
  • Experience in Hemato-Oncology.
  • Experience presenting complex scientific and clinical information to healthcare professionals.
  • Strong understanding of clinical trial design, execution, and evaluation.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting clinical trial recruitment and investigator engagement.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).
  • Fluency in at least one local language (Polish, Czech, Hungarian, or English for UK-based candidates).
  • Ability to travel extensively across Europe.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in Myelofibrosis (MF).
  • Experience in Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) or other Leukemia indications.
  • Experience as an international or regional MSL supporting multiple countries.
  • Experience engaging with hematology investigators and academic centers.

Personal Attributes

  • Strong scientific credibility and communication skills.
  • Relationship builder with excellent stakeholder engagement capabilities.
  • Strategic thinker with strong territory management skills.
  • Highly collaborative and values-driven.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously in a field-based environment.

About Amplity

Amplity is the global partner of healthcare companies, building transformational solutions that improve the lives of patients worldwide.

We specialize in:

  • Clinical & Medical Outsourced Solutions – Delivering end-to-end medical and clinical engagement capabilities globally.
  • Commercialization – Supporting product launches and commercialization strategies.
  • Consulting – Helping healthcare organizations solve complex business and medical challenges.
  • Remote Engagement – Creating innovative ways to connect with healthcare professionals and patients.
  • Field Outsourced Solutions – Building tailored field teams that deliver measurable impact.

Our culture is built on our EPIIC values:

  • Excellence
  • Passion
  • Integrity
  • Innovation
  • Collaboration

How to Apply

If you are an experienced MSL with expertise in Hemato-Oncology, Myelofibrosis, or Leukemia, and are looking for an opportunity to have a meaningful scientific impact across multiple European markets, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV in English.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

For questions regarding the role or to request reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please contact:

Laura Franco
📧 laura.franco@amplity.com

Application Note

All applications and CVs must be submitted in English to be considered for this opportunity.

About Us

Amplity powers biopharma innovation through expert-led teams that deliver. Whether you knew us in the 80’s as Physician Detailing Inc., or in the 00’s as part of Publicis Health , the companies that came together in 2019 to form Amplity have delivered contract medical, commercial + communications excellence for 40+ years.

Our people-driven, tech-enabled DNA fuels everything we do. Our professionals understand the pharmaceutical industry from the inside out. With a deep grasp on product lifecycles, marketing hurdles, operational nuances + the complex needs of providers and patients, we help our clients launch products + operate smoothly with precision — across all business shapes, sizes + specialties.

We are on a mission to improve patient outcomes through executional excellence — enabling our partners in pharma to thrive in turn. At Amplity, we are allies in excellence. And we do it quicker, better, nicer than anyone else.

Our Diversity Policy

We encourage and support equal employment opportunities for all associates and applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation or veteran status. Employment decisions are evaluated on the basis of an individual's skills, knowledge, abilities, job performance and other qualifications. In addition, Amplity Health maintains policies and procedures designed to comply with applicable federal, state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which Amplity Health has facilities.

title: Purchasing Operations Buyer
description:
Position Purpose

The Purchasing Operations Buyer sits within the Supply Chain Purchasing organization and performs transactional purchasing work that supports the daily operating needs of Rio Las Vegas. The role converts approved requisitions and department requirements into accurate purchase orders, secures supplier confirmations, tracks deliveries, resolves routine order issues and maintains complete purchasing-system documentation.

Purchasing Operations Buyers operate under a shared-duty model. Each buyer has primary operational assignments while remaining trained and prepared to cross-cover other departments and categories during absences, workload peaks and business-critical events. Strategic sourcing, major negotiations and contract strategy remain with the Supply Chain Director and Supply Chain Purchasing Manager.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Operational Purchasing Support

· Serve as the primary transactional purchasing contact for assigned operating departments and routine requirements.

· Review purchase requests for completeness, approved specifications, funding, business need and required delivery timing.

· Translate department requirements into accurate purchase orders and clear supplier instructions.

· Maintain regular communication with internal customers regarding order status, risks, substitutions, delays and required decisions.

· Cross-cover other departments and purchasing assignments using common procedures, shared documentation and established escalation paths.

Purchase-Order Lifecycle

· Create, issue, revise and close purchase orders accurately and within established service levels.

· Obtain supplier confirmations and verify pricing, quantities, units of measure, terms, lead times, ship-to locations and delivery dates.

· Track open orders, expedite critical requirements and resolve backorders, substitutions, shortages, damages and invoice discrepancies.

· Coordinate delivery requirements with suppliers, Warehouse Operations, operating departments and project teams.

· Maintain accurate notes and supporting documentation so each order has a complete audit trail.

· Review open purchase orders routinely, follow up on overdue acknowledgments and delivery dates, and close or cancel stale commitments with appropriate approval.

Demand, Replenishment and Operational Continuity

· Review usage, par levels, reorder points, inventory availability and upcoming operational demand with departments, Warehouse Operations and Inventory Control.

· Anticipate seasonal events, promotions, holidays, projects and business-volume changes that may affect routine purchasing requirements.

· Identify potential stockouts, long lead times, allocations and supply disruptions early and escalate them with practical alternatives.

· Coordinate approved emergency purchases in accordance with after-hours, authorization and documentation procedures.

Quote Collection and Buying Support

· Obtain and compare supplier quotations in accordance with competition and approval requirements.

· Confirm routine pricing, freight, lead times, minimums and service terms against approved agreements or documented quotations.

· Prepare clear quote comparisons covering cost, availability, quality, delivery timing and operational impact for manager review.

· Escalate strategic, high-value, high-risk, sole-source or noncompetitive purchases to the Supply Chain Purchasing Manager or Director.

· Provide transactional support for sourcing events, supplier reviews and contract implementation when requested.

Supplier and Delivery Management

· Maintain productive supplier relationships and hold vendors accountable for confirmations, pricing, quality and delivery commitments.

· Monitor recurring supplier issues and coordinate corrective actions with the Purchasing Manager and internal stakeholders.

· Support new-vendor onboarding and ensure required commercial, tax, insurance and system information is complete before purchasing.

· Coordinate FF&E support activities—including quotes, confirmations, logistics and delivery tracking—when assigned.

· Coordinate returns, replacement orders, return authorizations, freight claims, damage claims, credits and supplier corrective actions.

· Maintain current supplier contacts, order instructions, delivery requirements, minimums, lead times and approved ordering methods.

Specifications, Samples and Product Changes

· Confirm that requisitions and purchase orders contain clear product or service specifications, approved brands, pack sizes and units of measure.

· Coordinate product samples, demonstrations or operational evaluations when requested and document stakeholder approval before substitution or conversion.

· Verify that proposed substitutions meet operational, quality, safety, brand and budget requirements before routing them for approval.

· Communicate discontinued products, packaging changes, minimum-order changes and other supplier updates to affected departments.

Systems, Data and Compliance

· Execute purchasing transactions accurately in MMS/Stratton Warren and other approved systems.

· Support item setup and maintain accurate descriptions, units of measure, pack sizes, pricing, vendors and delivery information.

· Follow approved BPO, requisition, approval and purchase-order workflows and promptly correct system or data exceptions.

· Support No PO, No Pay by preventing unauthorized commitments and escalating noncompliant requests or deliveries.

· Protect confidential pricing, contract, supplier and business information.

· Maintain purchasing records in accordance with document-retention requirements, including requisitions, quotes, approvals, confirmations, changes and supplier correspondence.

· Follow ethical purchasing, conflict-of-interest, gift and supplier-interaction policies.

Commercial and Financial Controls

· Verify purchases align with approved contracts, pricing, rebates, budgets and delegated authority.

· Prevent split transactions, duplicate orders, unsupported emergency purchases and other control circumvention.

· Research invoice and receiving discrepancies and coordinate timely resolution with Accounts Payable, Warehouse Operations and suppliers.

· Document savings, cost avoidance and recoveries using Finance-approved rules; do not claim unvalidated benefits.

· Track applicable rebates, credits, freight recoveries, returns and pricing corrections through final resolution.

· Support month-end purchasing close by reviewing open commitments, unresolved receipt or invoice issues and purchase orders requiring closure or accrual follow-up.

Reporting and Workload Management

· Maintain open-order, overdue-delivery, exception and workload reports for assigned operational areas.

· Provide status updates on critical orders, shortages, supplier risks, unresolved discrepancies and required management decisions.

· Organize competing requests by operational criticality, approved need, lead time and service impact while communicating realistic completion dates.

· Participate in team coverage planning, purchasing huddles, supplier meetings and continuous-improvement activities.

Decision Authority

· Place routine orders with approved suppliers within established contracts, competition rules and delegated authority.

· Return incomplete or noncompliant requests and require necessary approvals or supporting documentation.

· Recommend substitutions or alternative suppliers when service, availability, quality or cost is at risk.

· Escalate material price changes, sole-source requests, contractual exceptions, critical shortages and supplier failures.

Required Qualifications

· Two or more years of purchasing, buying, procurement, supply chain or closely related experience.

· Demonstrated ability to manage purchase orders, supplier communications, delivery tracking and problem resolution.

· Working knowledge of purchasing controls, competitive quotes, commercial terms and invoice/receiving reconciliation.

· Strong organization, attention to detail, prioritization, customer service and written and verbal communication skills.

· Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and purchasing, inventory or ERP systems.

· Ability to calculate unit costs, extensions, percentages, price variances, freight impact and basic quote comparisons accurately.

Preferred Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, business, hospitality or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.

· Hospitality, gaming, resort, food and beverage, engineering, OS&E or FF&E purchasing experience.

· Experience with MMS, Stratton Warren, Coupa, Oracle or comparable purchasing systems.

· Experience supporting multiple categories and cross-covering other buyers.

Working Environment

Work is performed primarily in an office, with regular activity throughout the property, warehouse, receiving areas, and supplier locations. The role generally follows standard business hours but requires flexibility for urgent operational needs, projects, inventories, special events, weekends, or holidays. The position may occasionally require lifting and carrying items weighing up to 25 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Job Description Disclaimer

This job description summarizes the primary responsibilities and qualifications of the position and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties. Operational assignments may be modified to support coverage and business needs. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the role.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. title: Product Manager, SASE Platform
description:

Meet the team
The Cisco SASE team is reimagining the digital perimeter by engineering an autonomous, agentic ecosystem. By unifying SD-WAN, Secure Service Edge, Identity and Observability into an AI-orchestrated fabric, we are collapsing silos between networking and security to build a pro-active, intelligent platform that secures and advances next-generation enterprise at scale.


Your Impact
As a Product Manager for the SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) Platform at Cisco, you will spearhead our pivot toward an AI-driven, agentic operating model. Your core mission is to architect and deploy AI agents that unify operations and self-management across use cases, including AI and agentic security, cloud-based applications, data security, modern branch and remote access, and principles of zero trust architecture. By collapsing functional silos you will build a cohesive ecosystem anchored by Cisco Cloud Control and the AI Canvas.


In this role, you'll compose the end-to-end vision for our administration interaction model, shifting from manual configuration to intent-based, AI-orchestrated management. By crafting agentic workflows, you will streamline cross-domain investigations, significantly accelerating problem resolution and driving platform-wide engagement.


You will serve as the primary architect of a strategy that transforms disparate security and network components into highly efficient and intelligent SASE experience.


AI-Driven Product Strategy: Develop and own the end-to-end lifecycle of cross-domain features. You will define the roadmap for AI operational simplicity, ensuring that agentic workflows contribute across the SASE stack.
Agentic Workflow Design: Architect and lead the lifecycle of intelligent, cross-domain AI agents to simplify complex network and security operations.
Lifecycle Ownership: Own the full product lifecycle—from conceptualization and AI model integration to production, release, and end-of-life—ensuring that intelligent features remain performant and relevant.
Central Coordination: Act as the central hub for engineering, data science, design, and marketing teams as you lead AI-enabled products through the development and distribution pipeline.
End-to-End Management: Provide continuous oversight throughout all product stages, including the improvement of agentic capabilities, maintenance of AI models, and platform upgrades.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Facilitate deep technical alignment between engineering, business development, and customer support to bring autonomous, AI features to market.
Value Proposition: Articulate the strategic benefits of our agentic platform to internal teams, customers, and partners, identifying the tangible value of AI operational efficiency.
Performance Metrics: Define, monitor, and optimize key performance indicators specifically related to AI agent efficacy, cross-domain investigation speed, and overall system automation success.
Customer Adoption: Accelerate the adoption of intelligent features by identifying strategic investment opportunities and influencing channel partners to prioritize AI-ready infrastructure.


Minimum qualifications

  • 3+ years of product management experience within the technology sector

  • Experience with AI/ML, Large Language Models (LLMs), and/or agentic frameworks

  • Experience with SASE, Enterprise Networking, and/or Security markets

  • Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years' related experience, Master’s degree with 3+ years' relevant experience or PhD with 1+ year experience

Ability to lead, influence, motivate and build consensus across an organization

  • Security mindset working at scale, with experience bridging networking & security

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

To be knowledgeable in the areas of G.M.P and safety, as it pertains to the mixing process. To possess a strong ability to follow instructions. To account for all raw materials accurately. Learn and follow all safety procedures related to the set up and operation of the equipment, including the lock-out/tag-out procedure

To set up and operate efficiently, all product forming, proofing, baking, and cooling equipment on the lines which they have received training while maintaining a safe work environment and adhering to Tyson policies and procedures. Accurately identify all raw materials used in the mixing / blending process. Assist in the accurate verification of proper blend number usage in accordance with specified dough formula.

Possess the ability to read, comprehend, and accurately perform any written/typed instructions for an item formulation. Responsible for discarding trash in the proper container. Maintain a clean and organized work area

Responsible for discarding trash in the proper container. Maintain a clean and organized work area. Inform proper warehouse personnel in a timely manner of all raw materials needed for the mixing / blending process. Remove inedibles. Must be willing and able to operate a powered industrial truck.

  • Must be willing and able to lift up to 100 lbs. repeatedly throughout the shift. Team members in this job classification shall experience prolonged exposure to temperature extremes ranging from 60 – 120 degrees with moderate noise levels.

title: Hardware & Systems Management Technician
description:
Hardware & Systems Management Technician

Location: Boca Raton, FL (On-Site – 5 Days/Week)
Department: Software Engineering & Product Management
Employment Type: Full-Time (W-2)
Compensation: $50,000 – $60,000 annually, based on experience + discretionary bonus eligibility

The Mission

At Grubbrr, we build world-class kiosk software, but great software depends on reliable, scalable hardware. As our Hardware & Systems Management Technician, you will own the creation, automation, and lifecycle management of standardized system environments powering our kiosk deployments.

Your mission is simple: ensure every kiosk we ship is stable, remotely accessible, and deployment-ready in minutes, not hours.

This role sits at the intersection of hardware operations, systems engineering, and software deployment, and offers a growth path toward DevOps or Systems Engineering for candidates who enjoy automation and infrastructure ownership. Your work directly impacts deployment speed, field reliability, and customer experience. You will help enable scalable kiosk rollouts while reducing operational friction across engineering, support, and implementation teams.

Key Responsibilities

Remote Management Architecture

  • Configure BIOS/UEFI settings and Out-of-Band Management tools (e.g., Intel vPro/AMT)

  • Deploy and maintain Remote Monitoring & Management (RMM) solutions

  • Ensure full remote visibility, monitoring, and recoverability across deployed kiosks

Image Lifecycle Management

  • Create, test, and maintain standardized “Golden Images” across multiple hardware platforms

  • Support Windows, Linux, and/or Android environments

  • Manage image versioning, updates, and deployment reliability

Automated Provisioning

  • Develop automation scripts using PowerShell, Bash, or Python

  • Reduce manual configuration through repeatable provisioning workflows

  • Improve deployment speed, accuracy, and scalability

Hardware Validation

  • Perform burn-in testing and validation of new hardware platforms

  • Verify compatibility with Grubbrr software and device management systems

  • Troubleshoot hardware/software integration issues

Documentation & Operational Excellence

  • Maintain detailed documentation for configurations, imaging standards, and setup procedures

  • Define repeatable “out-of-box” deployment processes

  • Support occasional after-hours troubleshooting when required

Technical Toolkit

CategoryPreferred Skills & Tools
Operating SystemsWindows IoT/Pro, Android (Linux experience a plus)
Imaging ToolsClonezilla, Acronis, Macrium, SCCM, MDT
Remote AccessTeamViewer, LogMeIn, VNC, SSH, VPN tunneling
Device ManagementMicrosoft Intune, Esper, Hexnode, or similar
NetworkingDHCP, static IP configuration, firewalls, DNS fundamentals
HardwareNUCs, industrial PCs, touch displays, POS printers, scanners, payment devices

Who You Are

  • Automation-First Thinker — If you do something twice, you automate it.

  • Detail-Driven Operator — You understand that one incorrect configuration can mean a costly field visit.

  • Systems Problem Solver — You enjoy making hardware and software ecosystems work seamlessly together.

  • Ownership Mentality — You take pride in building reliable systems that scale.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Mid-level experience supporting hardware systems, device imaging, or endpoint management

  • Experience with system provisioning, scripting, or automation strongly preferred

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced engineering environment

  • Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills

  • Ability to work onsite in Boca Raton, FL

Growth Opportunity

This role is designed for candidates interested in expanding toward:

  • DevOps Engineering. Systems Engineering, Infrastructure Automation and/or

  • Device Fleet Management at scale

You will work closely with software engineers and product teams while gaining hands-on experience with deployment automation and infrastructure operations.

Work Environment

  • Discretionary bonus eligibility

title: Modeling Artists - (Mid & Senior)
description:
At Stellar, we aim to build a studio where people actually want to work. We face the inevitable ups and downs of production as a truly supportive and connected team, prioritizing open communication over anyone working in isolation. We value honesty, creativity, and looking out for one another.

The Opportunity:

We are expanding our team and looking for talented Modeling Artists at the Mid or Senior levels to join us on a premium streaming series for Marvel Animation.

In this role, you will be bringing wildly creative designs to life. Whether you are building characters, sprawling sets, vehicles, or organic hard-surface props, you are the artist who translates 2D brilliance into optimized 3D reality. This role requires an incredible eye for detail, a deep understanding of form, and a mastery of Maya.

In this role, success looks like:

Asset Creation & Optimization:

  • Confidently work from production designs to create a wide variety of digital assets, including characters, sets, props, vehicles, and both organic and hard-surface elements.
  • Critically analyze pre-viz and production designs to create highly optimized assets that perfectly balance aesthetic beauty with the technical requirements of the pipeline.

Technical Problem Solving & Pipeline:

  • Utilize your hands-on, deep knowledge of Maya tools to work efficiently and cleanly.
  • Collaborate closely with downstream departments (Rigging, Surfacing) to proactively troubleshoot and solve potential problems early in the pipeline before they become bottlenecks.

Collaboration & Accountability:

  • Act as a self-motivated, task-driven professional who consistently meets team and production deadlines.
  • Be a collaborative team player who communicates openly and works well with Supervisors and Team Leads. (Seniors will be expected to help mentor and guide Junior artists).
  • Actively participate in team, departmental, and production meetings or screenings.


The Requirements

Must-Haves:

  • Experience (Choose your level):
    • Mid-Level: 3–5+ years of production experience. You can hit the ground running, tackle complex assets, and require minimal supervision.
    • Senior: 5+ years of production experience. You are an expert at optimizing the most complex hero assets, anticipating pipeline bottlenecks, and are comfortable mentoring junior artists.
  • Artistic Eye: A keen eye for form, shape, and texture, paired with flexible, "outside-the-box" creative thinking.
  • Core Tools: A solid understanding and working experience with Maya, ZBrush, and Photoshop.
  • Mindset: A learning-centered attitude and a passion for strong design and technical execution.
  • Eligibility: Legally eligible to work in British Columbia, Canada.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience or understanding of additional software, including Substance Painter, Substance Designer, Blender, or Redshift.

Why Join Stellar?

  • Flexible Environment: We offer a flexible hybrid schedule that will vary with project and team requirements.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Extended health benefits.
  • Growth: Professional development support to help you stay ahead of tech and creative trends.
  • Culture: A collaborative, ego-free environment where technical expertise fuels creative magic.
Competitive salary range: $70,000 - $85,000, based on your experience and skills.

At Stellar Creative Lab, we believe diversity and inclusion are key to creativity and collaboration. We’re committed to building a supportive, open, and diverse community where everyone can thrive. We're always looking for ways to improve accessibility, so feel free to share any feedback or suggestions with us.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply, though priority will be given to BC Residents, Canadians and Canadian Permanent Residents.

title: PGIM Credit, Asset Backed Finance Surveillance Director
description:
Job Classification:

Investment Management - Investments

A GLOBAL FIRM WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE

As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world.

We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!

If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today. At PGIM, You Can!

What you will do:

PGIM is seeking an organized and analytical professional to conduct surveillance of Asset Backed Finance (“ABF”) assets. This individual will work alongside the research teams to track transaction performance across all ABF investments and escalate situations where performance deviates from expectations. This cross-transaction generalist role will also partner with technology teams to improve automated surveillance coverage. The role offers exposure to the full spectrum of PGIM's ABF investments and a direct view into the investment process, making it a strong platform for growth.

What you can expect:

  • Monitor ABF transactions at the deal level, assessing performance against structural features and against PGIM’s underwriting assumptions.

  • Track collateral performance trends against underwritten credit assumptions and translate loan-level performance into deal-level implications.

  • Follow and interpret transaction events, such as amendments, restructurings, servicer changes, etc., and communicate the credit impact.

  • Produce concise surveillance summaries that highlight performance trends, and forward-looking considerations to inform portfolio reviews; handle ad hoc surveillance requests as they arise.

  • Partner with the ABF Deal Team to develop and standardize issuer reporting packages, closing gaps where current reporting is inconsistent or insufficient for effective surveillance.

  • Partner with the technology team to improve automated surveillance coverage and strengthen escalation and monitoring practices across the ABF platform.

  • Engage with external parties to obtain and interpret transaction-level information, and support portfolio reviews, risk discussions, and internal inquiries with clear, analysis-driven insight.

  • Identify and escalate collateral-integrity or cash-reconciliation anomalies, such as unexplained variances between reported and expected collateral or cash, that may signal fraud, double-pledging, or other data-integrity risk.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree required

  • 5-10 years of relevant experience in securitized products with exposure to a wide range of asset classes.

  • Demonstrated ability to monitor securitized products performance at the deal level and loan level.

  • Experience reviewing periodic transaction reporting, which includes periodic trustee reporting and ongoing miscellaneous deal notices

  • Strong understanding of Intex and Bloomberg

  • Programming and data visualization skills required, with the ability to leverage AI to build efficient systems that analyze both existing datasets (e.g., Bloomberg, Intex, dv01) and bespoke issuer reporting not captured by traditional databases

  • Detail-oriented and analytical, comfortable managing a steady calendar of recurring surveillance deadlines.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate performance views clearly to portfolio managers, traders, research colleagues, and other stakeholders.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across teams.

PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

PGIM believes in the Power of a Hybrid work arrangement. The Power of Hybrid is both the flexibility of work from home, as well as the networking and career development of in-person work with colleagues through three weekly anchor days.

title: Estimator
description:
Ames Construction has been building America for more than 60 years, and our people are the reason we continue to succeed.


We are a full-service, heavy civil and industrial contractor building critical infrastructure, including highways, bridges, mines, dams, rail, and more. Our teams take on challenging projects that keep communities safe, supply chains moving, and the country connected.


At Ames, we are Fueled by Family. That means we look out for one another, take pride in our work, and build strong relationships rooted in trust and respect.


Guided by our core values of People, Team, Our Bond, Persistence, and Vision, we do what we say we will do, push through challenges, and deliver work we’re proud of.


When you join Ames, you’re joining a company built for long-term success, where skilled people, strong teams, and disciplined execution come together to build careers and a better future.

The Estimator is the individual responsible for preparing designated tasks for bids, cost estimates and proposals assigned by the Office Chief Estimator or Senior Estimator leading the bid, in accordance with Ames Values and Strategic Plan. This position will assist or support each assigned bid or proposal with quantity takeoffs, pricing and preparation of estimates.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Analysis of plans, specifications, and other related engineering documents.

  • Study and understand measurement and payment terms, schedules, milestones and permitting requirements, etc.

  • Following and using Ames Estimating Manual protocols and procedures

  • Computer-aided preparation of quantity take-offs, verification of site conditions, review of construction methods and equipment utilization.

  • Responsible for timely, thorough and accurate quantity take-offs.

  • Assist in preparing bid documents and developing bid construction schedules.

  • Assist in soliciting material suppliers and subcontractors.

  • Provide and compute production-based costs in HCSS Heavy Bid estimating software

  • Assist in preparing quality proposals for the Offices pursuits.

  • Consult with vendors and subcontractors to ensure a clear understanding of their scope of services.

  • Compare and analyze subcontractor and material supplier quotes for necessary scope coverage.

  • Review and understand contractual requirements for the scope of work assigned.

  • Collaborate and assist with developing proposal clarifications, inclusions and exclusions for self-performed work and work performed by material suppliers and subcontractors.

  • Attending pre-bid site visits and investigations.

  • Responsible for ensuring and demonstrating cost certainty for items assigned to price.

  • Identify risks and opportunities for items assigned to price (Risk Management).

  • Assist in the closing of estimates.

  • Provide support and transition for successful projects to Operations.

  • Instill Safety as a top priority.

  • Promote Ames and look for additional project opportunities.

  • Assist with recruiting and developing the estimating team.

  • Follow all operation procedures within all estimates to win work.

  • Develop and maintain relationships with clients, communities and partners.

  • Maintain confidentiality with respect to sensitive items and information.

  • Ensure assigned tasks deadlines are met.

  • Demonstrate progressive understanding and responsibility in estimating job function including multiple work types (i.e. earthwork, underground pipe, concrete, etc.) HCSS Heavy Bid Program:

  • Utilize the crew database for pricing the work. Only modify existing crews as needed.

  • Responsible for pricing of assigned items of work in the estimate, with enough activities and detail to demonstrate reasonable cost certainty.

  • Do not add, modify or change equipment pieces or rates in the equipment setup or labor rates without permission from the Chief Estimator.

Business Development

  • Review publications for potential projects to bid as assigned by the Office Chief Estimator.

  • Present potential leads on bid opportunities to the Office Chief Estimator.

Qualifications & Skills

  • 3-7 years’ experience in general engineering construction.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction, Engineering, or Construction Management, or equivalent experience.

  • Ability to work in a team environment and be self-motivated.

  • Possess a positive attitude.

  • Demonstrate strong interpersonal skills to interface with owner representatives, engineering firms, subcontractors, other team members, and senior management.

  • Competent in the use of computer software applications including HCSS Heavy Bid or similar estimating programs,

  • AGTEK or similar earthwork programs, Bluebeam, Microsoft Word and Excel.

  • Knowledge of Primavera P6 Scheduling.

  • Strong communication skills both written and oral.

  • Ability to review and address technical issues with solutions in a timely manner.

  • Time management, multitasking, and prioritization.

  • Must have a valid Driver’s License.

Working Conditions

  • Location – This position will work at the Central Office located in Burnsville, MN.

  • Work additional hours, as required, to complete bids/ estimates within deadlines.

  • Travel – This role will be expected to travel as needed to project locations and area Offices.

  • Office environment – extensive sitting at desk and computer; some standing, bending at the waist, stooping and reaching required; ability to lift 0-49 pounds occasionally.

  • Construction site environment – physical ability to stand, walk, crawl, bend, reach and climb. Exposure to elements and job site risks including high noise levels.

Total Rewards

People are the most important asset at Ames Construction.

  • Base salary range is $75,000-$100,000 a year, which varies depending on many factors, including experience, skills, and knowledge.

  • This role is eligible for a discretionary bonus.

  • Ames offers generous retirement benefits, including Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) participation and a 401k match.

  • Ames' non-craft health benefits package is designed so that our team members flourish, with medical, dental, and vision (all at one low premium), voluntary benefits, company holidays, and paid time off. Please see the Benefits section of our Careers page for more information.

Ames Construction is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Ready to build a career with a company that’s leading the foodservice industry?

Role Summary

The Data Management / Program SME will lead delivery across strategic FRR, NFRR, and ADS initiatives, driving the execution of data governance, data quality, lineage, and remediation programs. The role will serve as the primary liaison between Business, Technology, Data Management, and Regulatory stakeholders to improve data health visibility, strengthen controls, and support regulatory and audit commitments.

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional delivery of FRR, NFRR, and ADS workstreams.

  • Drive governance forums and track progress against strategic and regulatory commitments.

Data Governance & Regulatory Delivery

  • Lead initiatives related to:
    • Data quality management
    • Data lineage and metadata management
    • Data issue management and remediation
    • Regulatory reporting data controls
  • Support development of evidence packages, action plans, and responses for Audit, Compliance, and Regulatory reviews.
  • Drive risk-based prioritization of data issues and remediation activities.

ADS & Data Health

  • Partner with Technology and Data teams to enhance the ADS control and monitoring framework.
  • Improve transparency of data health through metrics, reporting, dashboards, and governance routines.
  • Drive adoption of consistent data quality standards across critical data flows and authorized data sources.

Stakeholder Management

  • Engage senior stakeholders across Global Markets, Finance, Technology, Operations, Risk, and Data Management functions.
  • Facilitate discussions to gather business requirements, document processes, and drive issue resolution.
  • Present progress, risks, and recommendations to senior management and governance forums.

Required Functional Skills

  • Strong knowledge of Data Management and Data Governance principles.
  • Experience supporting Regulatory Reporting programs (FRR, NFRR, Market Risk, Finance, or similar regulatory initiatives).
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Data quality frameworks
    • Data lineage and metadata management
    • Data issue management and remediation
    • Audit and regulatory response processes
  • Experience establishing governance routines and management reporting.

Required Technical Skills

  • Advanced SQL and data analysis skills.
  • Experience working with large-scale data platforms, data warehouses, and data lakes.
  • Familiarity with metadata and lineage tools.
  • Experience developing data health metrics, dashboards, and management reporting.
  • Understanding of data controls across capture, transport, and consumption layers.

Preferred Experience

  • Global Markets, Trading, Market Data, or Regulatory Reporting domain experience.
  • Experience supporting NFRR, data breach remediation, or regulatory issue remediation programs.
  • Knowledge of ADS, authorized data sources, and enterprise data management frameworks.
  • Experience leading complex enterprise data transformation programs.

Success Measures

  • Improved visibility of data health through enhanced metrics and governance reporting.
  • Successful delivery of RII, lineage, and audit remediation commitments.
  • Establishment of a risk-based framework for prioritization and remediation of critical data issues.
  • Delivery of executive-level reporting and dashboards that provide transparent views of data quality, controls, and remediation progress.

Job Description :

Job Title: Indirect Tax Senior

About the role

Diageo’s Global Tax model aligns core roles in direct tax, indirect tax, and tax business partnering.

Global Tax includes subject matter experts, business partners, and reporting and compliance teams. Global Tax has developed Tax Reporting and Compliance Centres of Excellence in Budapest, Bogota, Bangalore, and Manila. These centres support reporting, as well as technology and governance.

The North American Tax team is comprised of US tax and Canadian tax experts who oversee all areas of US & Canada (“NAM”) federal, state, and international income taxes, as well as key indirect taxes,

The purpose of this role is to ensure that the markets’ indirect tax processes are carried out accurately, efficiently (utilising automation), and on time, in full compliance with internal control procedures and legislative requirements.

Dimensions

a) Financial: The NAM market constitutes approximately 40% of the overall net sales and one half of operating profit for management purposes.

b) Market Complexity: The NAM market is extremely complex, active in all areas of Diageo global business (supply, brand ownership, marketing and distribution etc.). The legislative environment is extremely complex and can change rapidly.

Reporting includes more than 20 management reporting packages, multiple legal entities, and federal, state, provincial and local audits.

Purpose of Role

The purpose of this role is to ensure that the markets’ indirect tax processes are carried out accurately, efficiently (utilising automation), and on time, in full compliance with internal control procedures and legislative requirements.

Accountabilities

· Reviewing or preparing complex indirect tax returns in accordance with global standard process and controls, utilising automation tools where applicable

· Complying and ensuring accuracy and timely filing of indirect tax returns and other related reporting

· Working closely with indirect tax analysts to ensure compliance with market specific regulatory requirements and legislative changes

· Regularly informing the Team Leader on daily issues. Responsible for flagging risks and tax saving opportunities identified during the return preparation and flagging unusual or new business scenarios and commenting on their tax treatment.

· Reviewing or preparing balance sheet reconciliations and ensuring these are done on time and in an internal and external control compliant way.

· Actively managing tax document retention for your markets.

· Contributing to continuous improvement through establishing a LEAN approach to drive effectiveness and efficiency of the indirect tax compliance processes.

· Ensuring 100% CARM and 100% PCAOB accuracy on Indirect Tax related CARM controls.

· Ensuring the Tax Calendar is monitored and filled in a timely and quality manner.

What you'll bring

· Minimum 2-3 years relevant tax experience in SSC and/or Big 4 advisory environment

· Strong analytical skills

· Able to work with tight deadlines.

· Ability to work independently, organize, and prioritize workload appropriately.

· Experience in the review and/or coordination of the work of others in an advantage

title: Corporate Director, Risk Management
location: SeaWorld Parks & Entertainment Corporate - Orlando, FL
description:
SeaWorld is a world-renowned leader in the themed-park and entertainment industry. Our success is built on a passion for caring for animals and a dedication to delivering positive, memorable experiences to people from around the world. Were also committed to helping ambitious people achieve their professional best. We're always seeking exceptionally skilled and knowledgeable individuals to join our team.

Director, Risk Management

Department: Legal
Reports To: Chief Legal Officer
Location: Orlando, FL (Corporate)
Travel: Up to 25%

The Director, Risk Management is responsible for leading the Company's enterprise risk management strategy, insurance programs, and risk mitigation initiatives across United Parks & Resorts. Reporting to the Chief Legal Officer, this role partners closely with executive leadership and business stakeholders to identify, assess, and minimize operational, financial, regulatory, and reputational risk while supporting the Company's strategic objectives.

This position oversees the Company's property and casualty insurance portfolio, claims management strategy, business continuity planning, and enterprise risk initiatives. The Director serves as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, balancing operational needs with proactive risk management practices that protect the Company, its guests, ambassadors, animals, and assets.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead the Company's enterprise risk management (ERM) program, identifying and evaluating risks across all business functions and park operations.
  • Develop and execute strategies to mitigate operational, financial, legal, environmental, and reputational risk.
  • Manage the Company's comprehensive insurance portfolio, including property, casualty, general liability, workers' compensation, cyber liability, directors & officers liability, and other commercial insurance programs.
  • Oversee relationships with insurance brokers, carriers, third-party administrators, actuaries, and external consultants.
  • Direct insurance renewals, underwriting submissions, policy negotiations, and coverage analysis to optimize protection while managing total cost of risk.
  • Provide oversight of significant liability, property damage, and workers' compensation claims, partnering with Legal, HR, Finance, Safety, and Operations as appropriate.
  • Analyze claims trends and loss data to identify opportunities for operational improvements and risk reduction.
  • Partner with Legal on litigation strategy involving insured claims and complex liability matters.
  • Develop and maintain enterprise risk assessments, reporting findings and recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Lead business continuity and crisis preparedness initiatives, ensuring plans remain current and operationally effective.
  • Collaborate with Corporate Safety, Environmental Health & Safety, Security, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, and other functional leaders to promote a proactive risk management culture.
  • Support acquisitions, strategic initiatives, and major capital projects by conducting risk assessments and insurance due diligence.
  • Monitor emerging risks, regulatory developments, and industry trends affecting the Company.
  • Prepare executive-level reporting and presentations regarding enterprise risk, insurance performance, and claims metrics.
  • Manage departmental budget, vendor performance, and risk management technology solutions.
  • Lead, coach, and develop members of the Risk Management team.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Finance, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or related field required.
  • Master's degree, MBA, or JD preferred.

Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in corporate risk management, insurance, or related discipline.
  • Experience leading enterprise risk and insurance programs for a large, multi-location organization.
  • Experience managing commercial insurance renewals and complex liability claims.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with executive leadership on strategic risk initiatives.
  • Hospitality, entertainment, theme park, resort, or consumer-facing industry experience preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of commercial insurance coverages and risk financing strategies.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise risk management frameworks.
  • Understanding of claims administration, litigation management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Excellent analytical and financial acumen with the ability to evaluate risk exposure and cost implications.
  • Exceptional negotiation and vendor management skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex risk concepts to executive and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong leadership, influencing, and relationship-building abilities.
  • Experience presenting to executive leadership and boards or board committees preferred.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite; experience with risk management information systems (RMIS) preferred.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
  • Exercises sound judgment and maintains the highest level of integrity.
  • Demonstrates executive presence and professionalism.
  • Builds strong cross-functional partnerships.
  • Drives accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Leads through influence and collaboration.
  • Thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while effectively managing competing priorities.

Working Conditions

  • Corporate office environment with periodic travel to park locations.
  • Occasional travel to support claims, insurance inspections, audits, and enterprise initiatives.
  • Ability to respond to urgent risk-related matters outside normal business hours when necessary.

Job Description:
