title: HSE Specialist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

HSE Specialist

__

Your role and responsibilities



In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to improving Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) performance in your assigned area of responsibility to cultivate a high-performance culture with a strong focus on HSE. Each day, you will support the business by applying in-depth HSE knowledge and offering solutions and advice. You will also showcase your expertise by ensuring effective risk management through HSE excellence along the ABB value chain.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification HSE team in Apodaca.



You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Conduct thorough reviews of applicable federal, state, and local HSE regulations (e.g., SEMARNAT, STPS, PROFEPA in Mexico). Ensure site operations are compliant through gap analyses, legal registers, and periodic audits.

  • Perform detailed risk assessments using methodologies. Develop and implement targeted action plans to eliminate or mitigate identified risks, ensuring alignment with operational priorities and safety culture goals.

  • Lead and support Management of Change (MoC) processes. Ensure that changes in equipment, processes, materials, or personnel are evaluated for HSE impacts. Facilitate risk assessments, documentation updates, and training to maintain compliance and prevent unintended consequences.

  • Coordinate and conduct investigations of incidents, near misses, and unsafe behaviors. Use structured methodologies to identify contributing factors and root causes. Document findings clearly and develop corrective actions that address systemic issues.



Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering.

  • 2+ years of experience in Health, Safety and Environment, preferably within a manufacturing environment.

  • Knowledge and practical experience with ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and ISO 50001 management systems, including experience as a lead or internal auditor for ISO 45001.

  • Knowledge of Mexican federal, state, and local HSE regulations, including applicable STPS requirements, and preferably knowledge of the PASST program.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, risk assessment, and change-management skills, with the ability to translate findings into practical corrective and preventive actions.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Power BI.

  • You are at ease communicating in Business English


More about us


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Regional Technician Development Partner
description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.

The Regional Technician Development Partner is responsible for the regional implementation, execution, measurement, and continuous improvement of technician learning and development programs. This role partners with the Regional Service Leader, Technician Program Manager, Area Service Leaders, Area Service Managers, Field Instructor Network instructors, recruiting partners, and community workforce organizations to strengthen technician capability, improve program adoption, and build a sustainable technician talent pipeline.

The role owns the regional technician development roadmap, gathers field and business input, prioritizes development needs, supports training execution, tracks program effectiveness, and communicates progress to regional service leadership. The role also helps ensure technician development efforts are aligned with business priorities, safety expectations, quality standards, engagement goals, and long-term workforce needs.

Reporting Structure

This role reports directly to the Regional Service Leader and has a dotted-line relationship to the Technician Program Manager. The role works closely with Area Service Leaders, Area Service Managers, Field Team Leaders, Field Instructor Network instructors, Recruiting, HR, and other regional support partners.

Core Responsibilities

Program Strategy, Roadmap, and Governance

· Build and maintain the regional technician development roadmap in partnership with the Technician Program Manager and Regional Service Leader.

· Gather and prioritize technician learning needs, skill gaps, emerging requirements, and business priorities from regional service leaders and field teams.

· Lead a standard management rhythm for technician development, including recurring reviews, action tracking, participation updates, and effectiveness measures.

· Conduct quarterly and year-end business pulse reviews with service leadership to review program effectiveness, gaps, and required changes.

· Maintain a visual management system that tracks training demand, participation, completion, progression, FIN capacity, engagement, and business outcomes.

Program Execution and Field Adoption

· Coordinate regional delivery of technician learning and development programs, including apprenticeship, onboarding, technical training, skill advancement, and career pathway initiatives.

· Support train-the-trainer processes to promote consistent, high-quality program delivery across the region.

· Partner with FIN instructors and field leaders to support training readiness, scheduling, participation, and follow-through.

· Facilitate or support training delivery in small and large formats when needed as a regional support resource.

· Ensure program execution is aligned with safety expectations, quality standards, operational needs, and technician engagement goals.

Workforce and Talent Pipeline Development

· Build and maintain regional relationships with schools, apprenticeship programs, community workforce organizations, and early talent channels.

· Coordinate outreach, events, and partnerships that promote technician career pathways and improve regional hiring readiness.

· Support pre-employment and early career initiatives by connecting regional talent sources to technician development programs.

· Partner with Recruiting and regional leaders to identify pipeline needs and convert outreach activity into usable technician talent flow.

Communication and Stakeholder Engagement

· Provide clear and timely communication to leaders, technicians, trainers, and employees regarding program schedules, expectations, participation needs, and outcomes.

· Share regional program updates, participation trends, learner feedback, best practices, and execution insights with service leadership and the Technician Program Manager.

· Coordinate with communication or marketing partners to share training accomplishments, program updates, and success stories with internal and external stakeholders.

· Build strong relationships with technicians, trainers, service managers, and business leaders to strengthen engagement and adoption of technician development programs.

Administrative and Operational Responsibilities

· Maintain documentation related to program design, training schedules, participation records, learning resources, and program outcomes.

· Assist in managing training resources, tools, materials, and program logistics to ensure readiness and availability.

· Conduct regular portfolio reviews of executed and forecasted training with business leaders.

· Analyze program data and field feedback to recommend adjustments to training offerings and regional priorities.

· Travel within the region approximately 30-40% to support onsite training, relationship building, workforce outreach, and regional execution.

Qualifications

· High school diploma or GED with at least 7 years of relevant experience, or bachelor degree with at least 5 years of relevant experience.

· Relevant experience may include HVAC service, technical training, workforce development, operations, education, or program management.

· Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

· Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority.

· Strong organizational, program management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

· Ability to analyze program data, identify trends, and recommend actions based on business needs.

· Ability to travel regionally approximately 20-30%.

Preferred

· Experience supporting technician development programs in an HVAC or service-focused environment.

· Experience working with the Field Instructor Network or similar technical training network.

· Experience building relationships with schools, apprenticeship programs, workforce organizations, or community partners.

· Experience leading team meetings, mentoring technicians, or coordinating multi-stakeholder programs.

· Track record of improving program adoption, training participation, or technician development outcomes.

Key Skills

· Technician development and field credibility

· Program management and execution discipline

· Training roadmap development and prioritization

· Data analysis, reporting, and visual management

· Cross-functional influence without direct authority

· Communication with technicians, managers, senior leaders, and community partners

· Relationship building with schools, workforce partners, trainers, and field leaders

· Ability to convert feedback into action and action into measurable outcomes

· Strong judgment, problem solving, and follow-through

Success Measures

· Expansion of FIN class offerings, instructor capacity, and technician participation.

· Improved technician onboarding consistency and early career progression.

· Increased technician talent pipeline generation through Recruiting, school partnerships, and workforce outreach.

· Improvement in engagement measures, including TAP engagement scores where applicable.

· Timely progression and successful development of regional technicians and service leaders.

· Clear regional training roadmap with quarterly updates, action plans, and measured progress.

· Consistent execution of technician development initiatives across areas in alignment with business priorities.

· Demonstrated improvements in skill-gap closure, program adoption, learner feedback, and leadership satisfaction.

· Training accomplishments and program outcomes communicated clearly to internal stakeholders.

title: Analyst Tester
description:
Role Description

The role is responsible for the business and functional solution design, technical analysis of FNZ’s platform capabilities, business processes analysis and end to end testing (including supporting client UAT). They will work both independently and within a client aligned team to examine existing IT systems and business models, analyse requirements (both business and technical) and to decompose these into user stories and a supporting solution design. These activities will likely include the management of stakeholders (internal and external) to ensure that solution designs meet requirements. The Analyst Tester is also required to work closely and proactively with Analyst Developers to implement quality and future proof functionality. The Analyst Tester will need a broad knowledge of FNZ platform capabilities and a deep understanding of assigned functional areas of the FNZ platform. They will work with Solution Consultants supporting client workshops and providing input into requirements. The Analyst Tester will be involved in and demonstrate end to end ownership in all aspects of analysis/testing from the more technical testing approaches including test automation, database manipulation, xml injection testing, to test design, functional specification testing and supporting UAT. There is an expectation that the Analyst Tester will learn about our application, our business and the industry we operate in as well the range of test tools and methodologies we use to support our business.

Specific Role Responsibilities

Analysis:

  • Develop and maintain a deep knowledge of the platform functionality and business processes related to a functional area.
  • Educate and prepare customers (external and internal) on core FNZ platform functionality.
  • Working closely with our customers (on-site if required) to develop solutions and testing these solutions to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Attend customer workshops when required and input into requirements on a consultative basis.
  • Collaborate with internal and client SMEs to deliver complex data mapping solutions for migrations: analyzing, designing and maintaining ETL workflows, resolving issues, testing and providing post-implementation support.
  • Work closely with Solution Consultants to understand the agreed scope of a change and design solutions that meet the customers business and technical requirements within that defined scope.
  • Understanding the features that make up the solution from the end user perspective, ensuring these are documented accurately.
  • Author user stories that make up the assigned feature(s) using the correct business outcome driven syntax.
  • Produce Systems artefacts as per FNZ SDLC and follow the best practices and guidelines.
  • Work with Analyst Developers and Delivery/Project Managers to ensure business requirements are met and solutions are kept up to date.
  • Ensure that any new business developments adhere to procedural and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Perform cross functional collaboration to address gaps in the business and technical solution.
  • Identify and document any non-functional requirements related to the functionality.
  • Provide guidance and clarity to technical resources around the business requirements and user stories.
  • Support the management of defects and associated root cause analysis.
  • Functionally review build artefacts for the functional area assigned.
  • Interact with FNZ S&S and Investment Operations functions, as required, throughout the delivery lifecycle and post-implementation.
  • Have knowledge of the regulatory environment in which the analyst operates and ensure that all solutions deliver a compliant platform.

Test Design & Preparation:

  • Ensure acceptance criteria for each story is defined and covers both positive and negative testing scenarios using correct BDD syntax to feed into automation tests.
  • Review/analyse business requirements to ensure they are quantifiable and testable.
  • Write/Produce artefacts to support testing activities such as Test Designs, Test Matrices, Test Cases, Test Procedures, Test Scripts and Behavioural Models.

Test Execution and Defect Management:

  • Perform structured and context-driven (formal /ad-hoc) system, system integration and regression testing as required.
  • Ensure the changes developed are to an acceptable standard by reviewing solutions, conducting regular functional reviews and testing the changes end to end once the feature is available.
  • Ensure that the user stories are delivered to the client to a high standard of quality and conduct walkthroughs of the delivered functionality with clients (as required).
  • Author reusable tests and conducting end to end system, regression and mis-use case testing as part of the production readiness process.
  • Assist with user acceptance testing or other client support activities if required.
  • Use internal defect tracking and test case management system(s) to document test cases, record defects and record test case execution results.
  • Raise, validate and re-test defects.
  • Participate in defect triage meetings as directed.

Collaboration / Communication:

  • Provide regular and timely updates to the Delivery Manager on progress to plan as well as key risk and issues.
  • Work with the delivery teams both internally and externally (client side).
  • Ensure that delivery issues are called out appropriately and where there are process improvements that would increase efficiency they are promoted, owned and delivered against.
  • Collaborate with other Analyst Testers to share knowledge, best practices, useful technology, and opportunities for cross-project solutions.
  • Maintain high standards regarding written and verbal communication to ensure that information is clearly and concisely documented and appropriately disseminated.
  • Strive for excellency in adopting the FNZ Values and put the customer first, think big and make an impact, take personal accountability for meeting deadlines and delivering high quality work, constantly aim to maximise the value FNZ delivers to our customers.

Technology:

  • Keep up to date with the latest and/or relevant technologies, tools and methods. Identify adoption of processes, technology and tools best suited to FNZ.
  • Proactively identify technical issues (environmental, coding and testing) that may impede test progress to enable early resolution of said technical issues.

Experience required

Preferred Industry Knowledge

  • Experience in an analysis or testing environment.
  • General investment/wealth/life and/or pensions products and the markets in which FNZ and our customers operate.
  • An understanding of the regulatory environment FNZ operate within.
  • 3+ years of experience in technology delivery in the financial services/wealth market.

Required Knowledge & Skills

  • 1st class degree or equivalent experience
  • Experience working within an analysis or testing role previously.
  • Confident, and able to take initiative in a delivery-focused environment.
  • Independent, self-directing and delivery focused working style.
  • Superior analytical thinking and problem solving.
  • Intermediate computer skills essential (Microsoft Office)
  • Database and SQL knowledge essential
  • Excellent organisational, administration and time management skills.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills, confidence in dealing with internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred Knowledge & Skills

  • Experience with defect management tools (Jira)
  • Experience using collaboration tools (Confluence, Teams)
  • Experience with webservices, automation, performance and security testing tools

About FNZ Culture

Our culture is what drives us. It's at the heart of who we are and everything we do. It's what inspires, excites and moves us forward. Our ambition is to create a culture for growth, one that opens up limitless opportunities for our employees, customers and the wider world. At FNZ we know that great impact is only possible with great teamwork. That’s why we value the strength and diversity of thought in our global team. The FNZ Way is the cornerstone of what we do. It is comprised of four values that set the standard for how everyone at FNZ interacts with each other, with our customers, and with all our diverse stakeholders around the world.

  • Customer obsessed for the long-term
  • Think big and make an impact
  • Act now and own it all the way
  • Challenge, commit and win together

Read more about The FNZ Way and our values:

Opportunities

Right from day one, you will work alongside exceptional, multicultural teams - experts in their respective fields - who will inspire and challenge you to make your greatest impact.

Be part of a highly successful, rapidly growing, global business that is leading the delivery of financial services via cloud computing and partners with some of the world’s largest companies;

Working in a flexible and agile way that meets the needs of the business and personal circumstances;

Remuneration, significant financial rewards and career advancement is based on individual contribution and business impact rather than tenure or seniority;

We provide global career opportunities for our best employees at any of our offices in the UK, EU, US, Canada, South Africa and APAC.

Commitment to Equal Opportunities

At FNZ, we recognise that diversity, equity and inclusion are important factors contributing to our success. We embrace the unique perspective and capabilities of our current and future employees, which will help us continue to drive innovation and achieve our business goals. Recruitment decisions at FNZ are made in a non-discriminatory manner without regard to gender, ethnicity/race, faith, age, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, socio-economic background, disability or military veteran status where all applicants and employees are valued and respected.



About FNZ


FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.


We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.


We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2.5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).

Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.

The Scribe Tech is responsible for:

  • Capturing accurate and detailed documentation of the patient visit into the EMR in a timely manner.
  • Assisting the physician with basic patient care and medical procedures.
  • Assisting site managers with directing patient flow, inventory, and following up on labs.

*This is a great opportunity for those interested in CNA, MA, EMT, or Paramedic careers

title: Software Engineer, Distributed Training
description:
At River AI, our mission is to create personal AI owned and shaped by each individual. To achieve this, we are rewriting the entire stack from scratch: personal hardware for local inference, bespoke training infrastructure, next-generation UIs, and frontier deep learning research.

Who we are

We are scientists, engineers, and builders from the industry's top tech companies and AI labs. We bring a proven track record of scaling consumer systems for hundreds of millions of users and architecting the pre-training infrastructure behind today's frontier models.

About the Role

We are looking for exceptional systems engineers to build the distributed training engines behind the River API. Your goal is to make fine-tuning and reinforcement learning fast, numerically correct, and reliable across large GPU clusters.

You will own the execution of training workloads, including gradient computation, optimizer updates, rollout coordination, and checkpoint recovery. Working closely with researchers and inference engineers, you will bring new learning methods into production and improve how efficiently models use compute.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and optimize distributed training for large dense and mixture-of-experts models, including low-rank adapter training.
  • Improve reinforcement-learning pipelines by coordinating sampling, reward computation, training updates, and weight transfer.
  • Optimize GPU memory use, parallelism, and communication to increase training throughput.
  • Implement reliable checkpointing, resumption, and worker recovery while preserving consistent training state.
  • Validate losses, gradients, and optimizer behavior, and diagnose numerical or distributed execution failures.
  • Partner with researchers to implement new algorithms and make them accessible through the River API.

Skills & Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical industry experience.
  • Hands-on experience building or substantially improving distributed model-training systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and a modern deep-learning framework, such as PyTorch or JAX.
  • Solid understanding of backpropagation, optimizers, mixed-precision training, and GPU memory management.
  • Strong debugging skills across concurrent execution, collective communication, and distributed failure recovery.
  • A highly collaborative mindset and a bias for action to push boundaries across the stack.

Preferred Qualifications: (We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all of these)

  • Experience with reinforcement-learning infrastructure, rollout generation, or asynchronous training.
  • Familiarity with tensor, pipeline, expert, or data parallelism and their performance tradeoffs.
  • Work on LoRA, mixture-of-experts training, distributed optimizers, or activation checkpointing.
  • Experience with NCCL, communication profiling, and overlapping computation with data transfers.
  • Proficiency in C++, Rust, or CUDA, with experience investigating performance below the framework layer.
  • Contributions to training frameworks or a track record of operating large training runs.

Logistics & Benefits

  • Location: Palo Alto, California.
  • Compensation: Depending on experience and skills the expected base pay is $200,000 - $420,000 USD per year.
  • Benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited PTO; and relocation assistance as needed.
  • Visa Sponsorship: We sponsor visas and are committed to supporting the process for the right candidate.

Office Environment

Everett/Mill Creek Young Life is looking for an Area Administrator who can provide the organization, communication, and support needed to help the area grow. This position is approximately 10–15 hours per week, with some variation throughout the year. Hours will increase during special events and busier seasons and decrease during calmer seasons. title: Europe Medical Affairs Head, Lung - Oncology
description:
Reporting to: VP & Regional Medical Director, Oncology Europe

Role overview
GSK’s lung oncology portfolio is expanding rapidly in Europe. The Europe Medical Affairs Head, Lung – Oncology is accountable for building the medical foundations for multiple lung indications ahead of first European filings, and for shaping successful launches across the region. This includes developing and activating the external network and strategic partnerships, driving evidence plans tailored to the European context, ensuring country readiness, and providing clear leadership across the matrix.
This role is a key member of the Europe Oncology Medical Affairs Leadership Team and reports to the VP & Regional Medical Director, Oncology Europe. It works in close partnership with the Global Medical Franchise Head, the R&D Therapeutic Area Head, and cross-functional regional and country stakeholders. Country medical directors and their teams sit in local markets; the lung strategy is delivered through them, making influence, scientific credibility and collaboration critical to success.


Key responsibilities
1. Lead the European lung medical network
• Map and build the lung oncology medical community across Europe, including key external experts and centres.
• Define and establish strategic partnerships with cooperative groups, registries, academic centres and patient organisations, selected on their scientific and network impact.
• Synthesise insights from the European network into clear regional medical positions and advocate these with global development and evidence teams so that global plans reflect European needs and reality.
2. Shape evidence for European access
• Define early real-world evidence (RWE) needs for lung oncology in Europe, in close collaboration with Access, HTA and global evidence partners.
• Lead the development of PICO-aligned evidence strategies in the context of the EU HTA Regulation (HTAR) and mandatory Joint Clinical Assessments (JCA).
• Provide regional direction on phase IIIb/IV programmes, collaborative studies and investigator-sponsored research (ISR) in lung, in line with GSK SOPs and governance.
3. Drive launch readiness across countries
• Set the regional medical launch plan per indication and define minimum medical standards and deliverables for each country.
• Own the scientific narrative and regional medical plan for lung across indications and lifecycle.
• Lead structured readiness reviews against agreed milestones and provide transparent reporting on status, risks and mitigation to regional and global stakeholders.
4. Lead and influence through the matrix
• Provide functional leadership to country medical leads in lung oncology, aligning local execution with the regional strategy.
• Partner closely with Commercial, Market Access, Regulatory, R&D and Global Medical at regional and country level, driving alignment and consensus rather than directive control.
• Communicate clear, evidence-based positions on contested or complex topics to senior management and scientific audiences, explicitly stating counter-arguments and evidence gaps.
• Coach and develop country medical colleagues in external engagement, insight generation and scientific exchange, building lung capability across the European organisation as the portfolio grows.
• Identify, develop and retain medical talent across Europe.
5. Ensure medical governance and compliance
• Hold overall medical governance and fair-balance oversight for all lung oncology medical activities in Europe.
• Ensure adherence to GSK policies, SOPs and local regulations, proactively identifying and escalating issues and risks.

Basic qualifications
• Medical Doctor (MD) with board certification or equivalent clinical and industry experience in oncology.
• 7+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry in oncology medical affairs; lung cancer experience is essential, experience in other solid tumours is an advantage.
• Demonstrated European launch experience, including pre-launch, launch and post-launch phases for at least one first-in-market indication.
• Experience in regional or global medical roles, or senior in-country roles with clear global exposure.
• Proven track record of external engagement with oncology experts, cooperative groups and congresses, with evidence of translating insights into strategy and/or evidence generation decisions.
• Working knowledge of HTA and evidence planning in Europe, including practical understanding of HTAR and JCA implications.
• Fluent in written and spoken English; an additional European language is an advantage.

Preferred qualifications & skills
• PhD or PharmD in a relevant scientific discipline.
• Established, active network in lung oncology across Europe.
• Demonstrated agility in building country medical plans, developing evidence strategies and delivering successful launches.
• Deep subject matter expertise in lung cancer.
• Strong understanding of access and commercial considerations, including comfort with indication-level KPIs, forecasting and launch economics.
• High level of technology fluency and ability to use digital tools to drive insight generation, collaboration and execution.
• Proven matrix and indirect leadership skills, with a track record of building trust and influence across functions, geographies and cultures.

What the role offers
• End-to-end ownership of a key therapy area in Europe, from pre-launch through launch, post-launch optimisation and into future pipeline indications.
• Exposure and collaboration with senior stakeholders across R&D, Medical, Commercial and Access, with direct accountability for performance in European countries.
• Opportunity to shape evidence strategies and external partnerships in a priority growth area for GSK Oncology.
• A leadership team and culture that value robust debate, scientific excellence and clear, well-argued positions.

Why GSK
GSK has taken bold steps into oncology, investing significantly in science, talent and pipeline. Lung cancer is central to our European oncology strategy. Our culture is grounded in being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing, underpinned by our values of transparency, respect, integrity and patient focus in how our medical organisation operates.
If this sounds like the next step you want to take in your career, we would be pleased to explore the opportunity with you.


Skills

Cross-Functional Leadership, Digital Fluency, Enterprise Thinking, High Impact Communication, Launch Excellence, Patient Impact

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: AHRI Information Security Analyst
description:
The Air-Conditioning, Heating, and Refrigeration Institute (AHRI) is one of the largest trade associations in the nation, representing more than 300 heating, ventilation, air-conditioning (HVAC), water heating, and commercial refrigeration manufacturers from all parts of the world. Ensuring human comfort, productivity, and safety while practicing environmental stewardship is the mission of AHRI.

AHRI has an opening for an Information Security Analyst. This position plays a critical role in protecting the association’s member data, proprietary research, and digital platforms. The Information Security Analyst will monitor and respond to security threats, ensure compliance with data protection regulations, and support secure operations for membership systems, event platforms, and advocacy tools.

Essential duties and responsibilities for this position include but are not limited to:
  • Investigate and respond to incidents impacting member data or online services.
  • Perform regular vulnerability scans on association websites, portals, and third-party integrations.
  • Conduct risk assessments of association assets, networks and data.
  • Help deliver cybersecurity training for staff and member-facing teams.
  • Maintain and optimize security tools (SIEM, endpoint protection, firewalls).
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or related field from an accredited college/university.
  • Industry security credential, such as CompTIA Security+, Microsoft SC 200, or equivalent. CISSP or CISM is preferred but not required.
  • Two to four years of hands-on work experience in relevant information security or IT security roles. Experience in nonprofit or association environments preferred.
  • Working familiarity with public cloud AZURE, endpoint management systems.
  • Knowledge of security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001).
AHRI offers a full benefits package of health insurance benefits, a tuition assistance program, a matching 401(k) program, a flexible work schedule and friendly work environment. The salary range for this position is $105,000 to $130,000 based on relevant experience in the role.

The work location for this position is Arlington, VA. We do not offer a remote option. Subject to supervisor approval, AHRI employees are eligible for participation in AHRI's alternate workplace program after 90 days of employment and a 90-day appraisal at a level of meets expectations.

The North Carolina Department of Natural and Cultural Resources (DNCR) enriches people’s lives through education and stewardship of North Carolina’s natural and cultural resources. The North Carolina Zoo is growing and it’s an exciting time to join our team! The North Carolina Zoo is seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic Intern & Special Programs Coordinator to join our team. The Intern & Special Programs Coordinator works under the leadership and guidance of the Director of Volunteer & Intern Services in the administration of a comprehensive internship program and time-limited volunteer initiatives and is responsible for the day-to-day management of assigned program components. Job Description:

Job Title: European Securitisation Research – Associate/Vice President

Location: London

Corporate Title: Associate/ Vice President

Deutsche Bank Research is responsible for economic and financial analysis within Deutsche Bank Group, covering asset allocation and all major industry sectors. We identify crucial trends, assess market risks and opportunities, and advise the Bank, its clients, and stakeholders. We contribute to public discourse on economic, fiscal, labour market, and social policy issues through high-quality research.

As a Vice President/Associate within the European Securitisation Research team, you will play a key role in delivering market-leading insights to asset managers and clients on European Securitisation trends. You' will support the development and dissemination of impactful investment themes and respond to both internal and external client inquiries. Your responsibilities will include authoring research, promoting investment views, and actively marketing them to internal and external stakeholders.

What we’ll offer you

A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its centre.

You can expect:

  • Hybrid Working - we understand that employee expectations and preferences are changing. We have implemented a model that enables eligible employees to work remotely for a part of their working time and reach a working pattern that works for them

  • Competitive salary and non-contributory pension

  • 30 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, with the option to purchase additional days

  • Life Assurance and Private Healthcare for you and your family

  • A range of flexible benefits including Retail Discounts, a Bike4Work scheme and Gym benefits

  • The opportunity to support a wide ranging CSR programme + 2 days’ volunteering leave per year

Your key responsibilities

  • Formulate and write independent research on various European Securitisation markets, with a strong emphasis on Collateralised Loan Obligations (CLOs)

  • Develop and publish market investment themes across a variety of European Securitisation sub-sectors with focus on Residential Mortgage-Backed Securities (RMBS) and Asset-Backed Securities (ABS) and, crucially, CLOs

  • Support clients with insights into European Securitisation markets and the thematic trends that affect bond prices, including specific expertise on the CLO market. Modelling and written reports will provide useful insight in client meetings

  • Use and develop various third-party applications and existing databases as information sources to assess the potential impact of business and financial themes on the European securitisation market, with a particular focus on data relevant to CLO analysis

Your skills and experience

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • Experience of working independently and accurately with data sets

  • Knowledge of fixed income and structured finance, including a solid understanding of CLO structures and mechanics

  • Ability to understand deal indentures and knowledge of International Futures Exchange (INTEX) and Bloomberg

  • Database management and modelling experience using Structured Query Language (SQL), Python, Visual Basics for Applications (VBA) programming languages

  • Interest in financial products and ability to link product performance with overall macro developments, with a particular interest in and understanding of the CLO market

  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs

How we’ll support you

  • A culture of continuous learning to aid progression

  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

  • We value diversity and as an equal opportunities’ employer, we make reasonable adjustments for those with a disability such as the provision of assistive equipment if required (e.g. screen readers, assistive hearing devices, adapted keyboards)

Deutsche Bank is the leading German bank with strong European roots and a global network. Click here to see what we do.

Deutsche Bank in the UK is proud to be named in The Times Top 50 Employers for Gender Equality and has been awarded a Gold Award from Stonewall and named in their Top 100 Employers.

title: Quality Technician II
company: Welcome to Hayward Residential and Commercial Pool Products
description:
Hayward Holdings Inc. (NYSE "HAYW") is one of the leading manufacturers of residential swimming pool equipment in the world, with a significant presence in the commercial pool market that is continuously growing. title: Senior Software Engineer – Workday Finance
description:
For decades, DTN has been the silent force behind some of the world’s most critical industries—helping businesses navigate complexity, uncertainty, and risk with smarter, faster decisions. From agriculture to energy to weather intelligence, our proprietary Operational Decisioning Platform transforms raw data into decision-grade insights—enabling companies to optimize supply chains, ensure market stability, and safeguard infrastructure against disruption. We don’t follow trends—we set the standard for precision, trust, and operational impact.

DTN is at an exciting inflection point. Building off a foundation of financial strength, profitability, and industry trust, we’re accelerating growth and expanding our global footprint. Our purpose-built solutions—powered by AI and honed by decades of vertical expertise—are helping some of the world’s most significant enterprises thrive amid operational constraints and uncover new opportunities in a fast-changing world.

Job Description:

DTN is seeking a highly experienced Senior Software Engineer – Workday Finance to join our Finance engineering organization and build scalable, reliable, and secure software solutions supporting critical financial business processes.

In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain high-quality software for enterprise Finance applications and services. You will work closely with Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, QA, and Finance domain experts to translate complex business requirements into robust technical solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with experience building distributed, cloud-based enterprise applications and an understanding of financial systems and business processes.

What You Will Be Responsible For

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain highly scalable software services supporting Workday Finance capabilities
  • Own complex technical problems from requirements and architecture through implementation, production deployment, and ongoing support
  • Design and implement reliable APIs, backend services, data models, and distributed systems
  • Develop solutions supporting financial transactions, accounting, billing, revenue, reporting, and related Finance workflows
  • Ensure financial data is accurate, consistent, secure, traceable, and auditable
  • Design systems capable of handling high transaction volumes while meeting performance, availability, and reliability requirements
  • Build resilient services with appropriate handling of retries, failures, duplicate transactions, and data reconciliation
  • Participate in architecture and design reviews and influence technical direction
  • Partner with Product Management and Finance subject-matter experts to translate business requirements into effective technical designs
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and continuously improve system reliability, performance, and observability
  • Develop automated unit, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Contribute to CI/CD, DevOps, monitoring, logging, and operational excellence
  • Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, improve engineering processes, and reduce technical debt
  • Mentor other engineers and provide technical leadership within the team
  • Champion engineering best practices through code reviews and continuous improvement initiatives

What You Will Bring to the Position

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience with demonstrated ownership of complex systems
  • Strong programming experience in one or more modern languages such as Java, Python, C++, Go, or similar
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles
  • Experience designing and developing distributed systems and scalable backend services
  • Strong experience with RESTful APIs, service-oriented or microservice architectures, and asynchronous/event-driven systems
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience
  • Experience with cloud technologies and modern software development practices
  • Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, logging, and production support
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex technical problems and develop practical, scalable solutions
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Experience developing ERP, Finance, accounting, billing, revenue, or financial management software
  • Understanding of financial concepts including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, billing, revenue recognition, accounting periods, and financial reporting
  • Experience with high-volume transaction-processing systems
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and distributed messaging systems
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or comparable container technologies
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, or other cloud platforms
  • Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Familiarity with financial data reconciliation, auditability, and data-integrity requirements
  • Experience working within an enterprise SaaS environment
  • Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring experience

What You Can Expect from DTN

  • Competitive Salary
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Flexible working hours
  • Remote work model (position dependent)
  • Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance Plans
  • 6% 401K matching
  • Unlimited access to 13k+ courses via learning platform to support employee career advancement
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Compensation

The targeted hiring base pay range for this position is between $109,500 and $145,500. DTN is a pay for performance organization, which means there is the opportunity to advance your compensation with performance over time. The actual base pay offered for this position will be dependent upon many factors, including but not limited to: prior work experience, training/education, transferable skills, business needs, internal equity and applicable laws. The targeted hiring base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for market competitive variable pay and benefits.

DTN is a global data and technology company helping operational leaders in energy, agriculture, and weather-driven industries make faster, smarter decisions. Our Operational Decisioning Platform turns complex data into decision-grade insights—empowering customers to expand their margins, accelerate growth, and outpace risk. With more than 1,200 employees globally, DTN serves the companies that feed, fuel, and protect the world.

At DTN, we value clarity, trust, and action. We’re a team of problem-solvers, outcome-drivers, and industry nerds who believe that precision matters – and that mission is at the core of what we do.

  • Trust Built: We earn it. We keep it. We protect it. Our neutrality, precision, and integrity are non-negotiable.

title: Project Manager, OFE (Power Generation)
description:

The company’s Louisiana-based export projects service the global demand for North American natural gas and support the long-term development of clean and reliable North American energy supplies. Using reliable, proven technology in an innovative plant design configuration, Venture Global’s modular, mid-scale plant design will replace traditional designs as it allows for the same efficiency and operational reliability at significantly lower capital cost.

We are seeking qualified applicants for the position:

Project Manager, OFE (Power Generation)

Located:

Arlington

We are seeking qualified applicants for a Manager, OFE Project located in Arlington, VA.

Summary

The Venture Global OFE team is responsible to ensure that the properly specified and configured Power Island, Pre-treatment and Liquefaction Equipment is delivered on time. The Venture Global OFE team is also responsible for the performance, interface and correct functionality of the Power Island, Pre-treatment and Liquefaction Equipment. The broad range of supplied equipment includes gas turbine generators, steam turbine generators and heat recovery steam generators (HRSGs) from GE Gas Power Systems, Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) from GE Grid Solutions, Energy Management Systems (EMS) by GE Power Conversion, Liquefaction Train Systems by Baker Hughes and Pretreatment Systems by UOP/Honeywell.

General Description Duties & Responsibilities

  • Accountable for the complete implementation of the OFE Purchase Orders for Power Island equipment, including the on-time provision of correctly configured turbines, HRSGs, GIS, Power Transformers and EMS.

  • Accountable to ensure design reviews with the OFE team and OFE Vendors in relation to equipment design development are completed in support of project schedules.

  • Accountable to ensure coordination of design reviews with the EPC engineering teams responsible for the detailed design of the Power Island.

  • Responsible for the on-time delivery of all design documents and for the coordination for information flows to and from the EPC Power Island detailed design teams.

  • Accountable to ensure the highest quality in all delivered equipment through direct engagement in critical quality evolutions and coordination with internal Quality organization.

  • Responsible to demonstrate effectively communicate clearly and promptly up, down and across the VG organization

  • Build strong relationships and manage expectations to deliver successful outcomes.

  • Demonstrate strong planning skills with the ability to adapt to changing site priorities as needed.

  • Strong record keeping and coordination skills – expectation to drive discipline with EPC in this area.

  • Participate in all electrical and mechanical Pre-Start-Up Safety Reviews (PSSR).

  • Support electrical and mechanical commissioning in project punch list activities.

  • Deliver quality assurance and audit of equipment installation, electrical and mechanical test plans and pre-commissioning procedures

  • Review installation scope packages and validate necessary forms for completed turnover package

  • Ensure test procedures are reviewed and properly integrated for component and system testing

  • Accountable to provide monthly project reviews

  • Support site Change Management for electrical discipline

  • Support checkout installed systems and equipment adhering to OEM requirements, system descriptions, and good industry standard practice

  • Demonstrate willingness to travel domestically and internationally 40% or more to support customer witness tests or factory acceptance tests.


Qualifications

Required Experience

  • Minimum 10-15 years of experience in Power Generation design, maintenance, or operations, or project management

  • Minimum 10 years of mechanical or electrical experience leadership roles with increasing responsibilities and/or specialization

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as Project Lead on mid to large scale power generation project

  • MS Office Suite Experience

  • P6 Experience

  • EPC experience

Stanford Health Care

title: Safeguarding Investigator
description:
Safeguarding Investigator

Full Time / 37.50 hours per week / Monday to Friday

Remote with ad hoc travel to our nurseries and our offices in Northampton and London

Salary From £43k per annum

Closing Date for this role: 15/10/26 or sooner if right candidate is hired

All applicants need to attach an up-to-date CV to be considered

Purpose of Role:

The Safeguarding Investigator is responsible for leading and delivering safeguarding investigations across a range of complexity, from low-level concerns through to complex, high-risk and sensitive cases. Applying professional curiosity, sound judgement and robust risk assessment, and working closely with operational leaders, HR, Legal, Regulatory Specialists and external agencies, the role ensures safeguarding concerns are investigated thoroughly and effectively, risks to children are identified and managed, and learning is captured to strengthen safeguarding practice across the organisation. All investigations will be thoroughly documented, with clear records of evidence, findings, decisions, and the rationale underpinning outcomes.

What We Can Offer You:

  • Our benefits include, but are not limited to;

  • Flexible working and holiday entitlements

  • Discounted childcare

  • Quarterly Employee Appreciation Weeks

  • Annual gala award evening

  • Fantastic range of discounts on high street retailers, grocery stores, cinema tickets, holidays and more

  • Wide range of wellbeing resources, supporting our teams for the ups and downs of daily life

Why Bright Horizons?

Our support functions enable our nurseries to deliver the best possible care and education to over 10,000 children across the UK. Through this support, our nurseries can deliver excellence – with 98% of our 270+ portfolio being rated Good or Outstanding by Ofsted.

We’re on a mission to change the future for children, families, and the people we work with, and are committed to progressive working values like flexibility, work-life balance, and wellbeing.

Responsibilities:

  • Concerns are identified and acted upon promptly.

  • Appropriate referrals are made to the LADO, Children's Services, Police and/or Ofsted where required.

  • Risk to children has been assessed and mitigated at all stages of the investigation.

  • Consideration is given to the Voice of the child throughout the process

  • Evidence of any bias and the impact on the Safeguarding Culture is identified and followed up

  • Accurate records and decision-making rationales are maintained.

  • Leaders maintain oversight of the concern and took appropriate action.

  • Learning is identified and used to improve practice

Key Accountabilities:

  • Assess, monitor and manage actual or potential risks to children throughout the investigation process, ensuring appropriate safeguarding measures are implemented, reviewed and escalated where necessary.

  • Ensure the child's welfare, lived experience and voice are central to investigation planning, decision-making and recommendations.

  • Ensure investigation findings, conclusions and recommendations are proportionate, evidence-based and supported by clearly documented rationale.

  • Handle sensitive information in accordance with data protection legislation, confidentiality requirements and information-sharing protocols.

  • Lead and manage the end-to-end delivery of safeguarding investigations, ensuring all cases are handled thoroughly, consistently and within defined timelines.

  • Conduct a wide range of safeguarding investigations using professional curiosity to ensure all relevant lines of enquiry are explored.

  • Conduct safeguarding investigations with an understanding of the Local Authority Designated Officer (LADO) process, ensuring that investigation findings, emerging concerns and any subsequent allegations are evaluated promptly and escalated to the LADO where thresholds are met or further consultation is required.

  • Apply defined internal/external thresholds and criteria to determine appropriate investigation approach

  • Produce clear, accurate and evidence-based investigation reports, findings and recommendations.

  • Maintain comprehensive, structured and compliant case records and documentation.

  • Ensure all investigations are conducted in line with safeguarding, legal and regulatory requirements

  • Participate in quality assurance activity across safeguarding investigations, providing robust scrutiny of practice, decision-making and record keeping ensuring investigations are thorough, evidence-based, compliant and child-focused.

  • Work closely with the Head of Investigations on more complex or high-risk cases, escalating where appropriate

  • Support coordination of cases requiring regulatory notifications, ensuring clear and accurate information

  • Identify themes or learning from cases and contribute to continuous improvement and share with wider safeguarding team.

  • Provide clear updates and reporting on investigation progress, risks and outcomes to stakeholders

  • Collaborate with Operations, HR and Legal to ensure a coordinated and consistent approach to safeguarding cases

Essential Experience:

  • Experience conducting safeguarding investigations or managing complex casework

  • Strong understanding of safeguarding processes and principles

  • Ability to assess risk and manage cases effectively

  • Experience producing clear and accurate case documentation

  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills

Desirable Experience:

  • Experience within early years, education, childcare, healthcare or other safeguarding-focused environments

  • Experience working with regulatory bodies, Local Authorities or inspection frameworks

  • Knowledge of employment processes relating to investigations (e.g. disciplinaries)

Qualifications:

  • Safeguarding or investigation-related training or accreditation – Desirable

Personal Attributes

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality

  • Good judgement and decision-making skills

  • Professional and calm handling of sensitive issues

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • Organised and able to manage multiple cases

  • Demonstrates behaviours aligned with HEART principles, acting with Honesty, Excellence, Accountability and Respect

title: CRM Communications Coordinator
description:
Founded in 1854, Hamline was the first university in Minnesota and among the first coeducational institutions in the nation. Hamline University provides a world-class education for undergraduate and graduate students. Our faculty, staff, and students cultivate an ethic of civic responsibility, social justice, and inclusive leadership and service.

Hamline University is an Equal Opportunity employer. Hamline University does not discriminate on the basis of race; color; religion; creed; sex; national origin; marital status; familial status; status with regard to public assistance; membership or activity in a local human rights commission; disability; age; protected veteran status; or any other status protected by applicable law in its education or employment programs or activities. The University will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.

JOB SUMMARY

The CRM Communications Coordinator plays a vital role within Hamline University's enrollment division, coordinating and executing the day-to-day tactical communication plans across undergraduate, graduate, and online degree completion programs. Reporting directly to the Assistant Vice President for Enrollment Systems and Operations, this position serves as an essential hub—working closely with the enrollment operations team, the university marketing team, and the undergraduate and graduate enrollment teams. The Coordinator utilizes Slate CRM to build, deliver, and monitor communication campaigns that engage prospective students. This role focuses heavily on the technical setup, visual formatting, timing, and brand consistency of all automated and ad-hoc communication flows, ensuring a seamless prospective student experience from initial inquiry through enrollment.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

CRM Communications & Technical Execution

  • Draft, design, and deploy engaging, audience-tailored communication content, email campaigns, and automated text workflows for undergraduate, graduate, and degree-completion populations, adhering to copy, tone, and strategic direction set by enrollment leadership.
  • Build and schedule CRM communication features—including Deliver campaigns, automated message workflows, SMS outreach, and event communications—integrating approved written content into responsive templates.
  • Utilize CRM template tools and drag-and-drop editors to build visually responsive, mobile-optimized email layouts. Set up routine communication populations using data queries, filters, and dynamic Liquid syntax to render tailored content blocks automatically.
  • Collaborate closely with the admissions operations team and enrollment leaders to align technical data workflows, content production schedules, and message timing with key milestones across the recruitment cycle.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration & Brand Compliance

  • Partner heavily with the University Marketing and Communications team to translate creative content, messaging assets, and campaign layouts into functional CRM communication workflows.
  • Assist the leaders of Undergraduate and Graduate Admission by executing tailored recruitment campaigns, deadline reminders, and population-specific message tracks.
  • Act as a dependable bridge between creative marketing intent, admissions recruitment schedules, and operational CRM execution.
  • Ensure all CRM-generated emails, text messages, and landing pages adhere strictly to Hamline University's brand guidelines, tone, and visual standards.

Data Accuracy, Quality Control, & Testing

  • Conduct rigorous quality assurance and proofing for all communication logic, hyper-links, target populations, and layout formatting prior to deployment.
  • Monitor delivery metrics, open rates, and click-through rates, assisting the AVP with compiling regular data reports to help evaluate communication effectiveness.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot system-related communication errors or delivery failures, collaborating with the AVP for Enrollment Systems and Operations to resolve technical glitches promptly.
  • Ensure strict compliance with digital communication regulations and telephone outreach policies, maintaining precise data privacy standards.

Operational Support & Event Coordination

  • Support the communication logic for campus visit programs and virtual events, creating automated confirmation templates, reminder text workflows, and follow-up surveys.
  • Document internal communication workflows and update reference guides for CRM communication setups to foster continuity within the enrollment team.

Other Duties

  • Perform additional work-related duties as assigned, including backup support to members of the enrollment operations team as needed. The omission of specific duties does not preclude the supervisor from assigning duties that are logically related to the position.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS

The CRM Communications Coordinator reports directly to the Assistant Vice President for Enrollment Systems and Operations. This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities over full-time staff, but works in close daily alignment with the admissions operations team, marketing team, and undergraduate and graduate enrollment teams. The Coordinator may assist in managing communication tasks or workflow assignments for undergraduate student workers within the department.

BUDGET MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES

This position does not have direct budget management or cost center responsibilities.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES AND KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Proficient computer literacy and technical aptitude with a strong willingness and capacity to train extensively on advanced higher education CRM systems (Slate preferred).
  • Strong capability to design visually appealing layouts and execute edits using content management systems, drag-and-drop design builders, or standard email marketing tools.
  • Strong collaborative and interpersonal skills, with a proven capability to communicate effectively across diverse internal teams (operations, marketing, and recruitment leadership).
  • Excellent written communication and storytelling skills, with demonstrated experience writing clear, engaging content for marketing or student recruitment communications.
  • Exceptional proofreading, editing, and formatting skills, with meticulous attention to detail and narrative brand alignment.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle simultaneous tasks and meet clear production deadlines.
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with a focused attention to data accuracy and testing protocols.

MINIMUM EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.
  • 1+ years of experience in higher education admissions, marketing, communications, or a general administrative operations role.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience using a database system, marketing platform, or CRM (e.g., Slate, Salesforce, etc.) to look up information, pull lists, or send communications.

PREFERRED EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

  • 2+ years of experience within a college admissions framework directly building and testing communications inside Slate CRM.
  • Experience working in a private, liberal arts university setting.
  • Proven success managing shared project request queues involving multiple creative and operational stakeholders.

REQUIRED LICENSURE/CERTIFICATION/REGISTRATION

N/A

WORKING CONDITIONS / EQUIPMENT

Must perform the following essential functions with or without a reasonable accommodation:

  • Must be able to work on a computer for extended periods of time.
  • Occasional night and/or weekend work may be required to support critical deadline communication windows or signature recruitment events (subject to overtime guidelines).

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

  • This is a full-time, 1.0 FTE, non-exempt (hourly) position, 12 months a year.

title: Derivative Valuation Analyst
description:
Who You’ll Work With:

AllianceBernstein is looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Derivative Valuations Analyst to help manage the daily pricing of our complex OTC derivatives. You will sit at the center of Operations, Portfolio Management, Risk, and IT, ensuring our global investment teams have the accurate valuation data they need to make decisions.

What You’ll Do:

This role is the engine of our OTC daily pricing operations. Much of your day will be spent involved in detailed validation, investigating data anomalies, and communicating across teams. We are looking for someone who takes natural ownership of their work. The role requires proactive identification of pricing anomalies, independent price and curve verification, root-cause analysis and clear data-driven escalations to key stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the daily derivative pricing process by validating models across all OTC products, catching exceptions, and resolving discrepancies before they reach the investment teams or external clients.

  • Serve as the primary contact for daily pricing questions. When data looks unusual, investigate the underlying market data and provide clear, straightforward explanations to Portfolio Managers, Risk, Audit, and external partners.

  • Maintain the integrity of our internal controls by tracking market events and regulatory shifts, ensuring our valuation processes consistently meet compliance standards.

  • Work with secondary pricing sources and external vendors, such as Bloomberg, to compare data and ensure reliable quality controls.

  • Take advantage of opportunities to use tools like Python or VBA to automate repetitive tasks, making the team’s daily workflows smoother and more efficient.

  • Model, test, and validate new OTC markets, vendors, strategies, and instruments as they are onboarded by the firm

What We’re Looking For:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Quantitative Finance.

  • Experience: 0 to 4 years of experience in OTC pricing, operations or middle-office roles.

  • Attention to Detail: You take pride in your accuracy and have the focus to execute detailed validations reliably, even when working against strict daily market deadlines.

  • Clear Communication: Ability to explain complex pricing or data issues simply and clearly for a variety of audiences.

  • Intellectual Curiosity: A natural drive to question how systems and models work, taking the initiative to test things on the side and learn underlying mechanics rather than blindly following a checklist.

  • Proactive Ownership: A strong sense of initiative to independently and proactively resolve system issues or feed failures, deploying a practical workaround to keep pricing moving forward and suggesting a longer-term permanent solution.

  • Technical Stack: Advanced Excel skills are mandatory. Familiarity with Python or VBA is needed but not required on day one. Prior exposure to Bloomberg, ICE IPA, Calypso or SIM Corp is a distinct advantage.

About AB

We are a leading global investment management firm offering high-quality research and diversified investment services to institutional clients, retail investors, and private-wealth clients in major markets around the globe. With over 4,000 employees across 57 locations operating in 26 countries and jurisdictions, our ambition is simple: to be the most trusted investment firm in the world. We realize that it's our people who give us a competitive advantage and drive success in the market, and our goal is to create an inclusive culture that rewards hard work.

Our culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration creates an environment where you can thrive and do your best work. Whether you're producing thought-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to our clients, we are fully invested in you. If you're ready to challenge your limits and empower your career, join us!

All are encouraged to apply. Deutsche Bank Technology in Berlin

DB Technology is a global team of tech specialists, spread across multiple trading hubs and tech centres. We have a strong focus on promoting technical excellence – our engineers work at the forefront of financial services innovation using cutting-edge technologies.

Our Berlin location is our most recent addition to our global network of tech centres and growing strongly. Chief Security Office

The Chief Security Office (CSO) is responsible for the creation, maintenance, and implementation of the information security strategy of Deutsche Bank Group. CSO steers the measures derived from the information security strategy and provides guidance to employees regarding the identification, development, implementation, and execution of all processes which serve to reduce information security risk, to respond to incidents, and to establish appropriate policies and standards for information security management.

Role Overview

The Information Security Specialist (f/m/x) within the CSO’s Embedded Risk Team (ERT) leads the Strategy, Reporting and Innovation horizontal function. The role focuses on developing and maintaining regular and ad hoc management reporting across CSO ERT to provide transparency on risk exposure and remediation progress. Innovation ideas from CSO ERT and key stakeholders are collected, prioritised and implemented through the established change management process. By combining data-driven insights with continuous improvement, the role supports informed management decisions and strengthens the efficiency and effectiveness of CSO ERT operations.

Within CSO ERT drive reporting and innovation, provide transparency on information security risk exposure and remediation progress to Senior Audience and oversee CSO ERT projects.
